faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

localized.name: Aldamon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Takuya Kanbara] w/2 or more [Hybrid] trait cards under: Cost 3
＜Rush＞
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
[End of Attack] [On Deletion] You may trash 1 [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait card from your hand. If this effect trashed, ＜Draw 2＞. Then, you may play 1 red, blue or green Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +4000 DP.

faqs.question: Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?
faqs.answer:
No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger. 
In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.

faqs.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw. 
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
faqs.answer:
This card has <Rush>, so it can attack. 
Unless the other cards have an effect that allows them to attack the turn they were played, they can't attack.

faqs.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card. 
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: アルダモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つカードが下に2枚以上ある「神原拓也」:コスト3
≪速攻≫
【進化時】このデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
【アタック終了時】【消滅時】自分の手札から、特徴に「ハイブリッド体」/「十闘士」を持つカード1枚を破棄できる。この効果で破棄したなら、≪2ドロー≫。その後、自分の手札/トラッシュから、進化元効果を持つ赤/青/緑のテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンをDP+4000。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化する進化条件は進化元となるテイマーをデジモンとしても扱い進化しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、テイマーからそのまま進化します。デジモンが進化するとは扱わず、「デジモンが進化するとき」効果や「デジモンが進化したとき」効果は誘発しません。
また、「デジモンが進化できない」効果が発揮された場合でも、この進化条件でテイマーから進化できます。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化した場合でも、進化ドローは行いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化ドローを行います。
どのような進化の場合でも、進化ドローは行います。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
このカードは≪速攻≫を持っているため、アタックできます。
「登場したターンでもアタックできる」効果がない他のカードの場合は、アタックできません。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

Yes. You must activate this card's inherited effect and use up its [Once Per Turn], even if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name. 
However, if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can't reference DP or delete a Digimon.

faqs.question: Does the Digimon card played by this card's [All Turns] effect have to be a [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait card?
faqs.answer: Yes. Only a [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait card can be played.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [All Turns] effect, placed cards from this card's digivolution cards under a Tamer, then attempted to play 1 card. 
If I then choose the cards placed under the Tamer for a DigiXros on the card to be played, can I choose the cards placed under the Tamer by this effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: When I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and would play cards from its digivolution cards, if I would choose this card for a DigiXros on those cards, can I choose this card in the battle area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
I have a Tamer. 
Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and play 1 card without placing any cards from this card's digivolution cards under the Tamer?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you activate this card's [All Turns] effect, you must place at least 1 card from digivolution cards under a Tamer when possible and play 1 card. 
However, if there is only 1 digivolution card, you can first place that card under a Tamer, then no card will be played.

faqs.question:
I have no Tamers. 
Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and play 1 card from this card's digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で登場できるデジモンカードは、特徴に「クロスハート」か「ブルーフレア」を持つカードでなければなりませんか？
faqs.answer: はい、特徴に「クロスハート」か「ブルーフレア」を持つカードのみを登場させることができます。

faqs.question:
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、このカードの進化元のカードをテイマーの下に置いたあと、1枚を登場させようとしました。
このとき、登場させるカードの持つデジクロスでテイマーの下に置いたカードを選べる場合、この効果でテイマーの下に置いたカードを選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、このカードの進化元からカードを登場させるとき、そのカードの持つデジクロスでこのカードを選べる場合、バトルエリアのこのカードを選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question:
自分のテイマーがいる状況です。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、このカードの進化元のカードを1枚もテイマーの下に置かずに、1枚を登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
この効果を発揮した場合、進化元のカードは最低1枚は可能な限りテイマーの下に置き、1枚を登場させます。
ただし、進化元が1枚のみの場合はそのカードは先にテイマーの下に置かれ、登場させることはできません。

faqs.question:
自分のテイマーがいない状況です。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、このカードの進化元のカード1枚を登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Gammamon] in text: Cost 3
＜Raid＞ ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Blocker＞
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 3 Digimon cards with [Gammamon] in their texts from your hand or trash as this Digimon's top or bottom digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards may attack without suspending.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Can I place just 1 card with [Gammamon] in its text in digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to place the specified number of cards in digivolution cards.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ガンマモン」の記述があるLv.5:コスト3
≪突進≫≪Sアタック+1≫≪ブロッカー≫
【進化時】【アタック時】［ターンに1回］自分の手札/トラッシュから、「ガンマモン」の記述があるデジモンカード3枚をこのデジモンの進化元の上か下だけに置くことで、このデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果の条件は、「ガンマモン」の記述があるカード1枚だけ進化元に置くことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【進化時】【アタック時】効果の条件の場合、指定された枚数分、進化元に置く必要があります。

localized.name: Gallantmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[WarGrowlmon] in name or w/[Hero] trait: Cost 3
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞
[When Digivolving] Delete up to 10000 DP total worth of your opponent's Digimon. Then, this Digimon may attack.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
[Your Turn] Your opponent's effects don't affect this Digimon with [Takato Matsuki] in its digivolution cards and it gets +5000 DP.

faqs.question: Can I activate BT12-089 [Takato Matsuki]'s [Main] effect and digivolve a [Hero] trait Guilmon into this card for a digivolution cost of 3?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can digivolve for a digivolution cost of 3. 
If you reference this card's 3rd digivolution requirement to digivolve, ignoring level, the digivolution cost will be 3.

faqs.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: 「BT12-089 松田啓人」の【メイン】効果を発揮して、特徴に「ヒーロー」を持つギルモンを進化コスト3でこのカード進化させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化コスト3で進化させることができます。
このカードの3つ目の進化条件を参照し、Lv.を無視して進化させる場合、進化コスト3で進化させます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve. 
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. 
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

faqs.question: After DNA digivolving, can the DNA digivolved Digimon attack using this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can attack.

faqs.question: If I choose to not use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, can I still use it to have 1 of my Digimon attack?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can attack.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, can I activate the DNA digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before processing the part of this card's [End of Your Turn] effect after "then"?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

faqs.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve. 
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. 
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, can I activate the DNA digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before processing the part of this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect after "then"?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: If a Digimon has an "attack targets can't be changed" effect, can I change its own attack target using <Raid> or other method?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: このカードの【相手のターン】効果で進化する場合、進化ドローはどのタイミングで行いますか？
faqs.answer:
進化させるデジモンの上にカードを重ねた時点で進化ドローします。
進化は、進化のルールによるドローも含めて進化したこととなります。
進化させるカードを重ね進化ドローも行ったあとに、以降の効果を処理します。

＜Jamming＞

localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?
faqs.answer:
No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger. 
In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.

faqs.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw. 
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

faqs.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card. 
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: ベオウルフモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つカードが下に2枚以上ある「源輝二」:コスト3
≪ジャミング≫
【進化時】【アタック時】ターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-4000。
【アタック終了時】【消滅時】自分の手札/トラッシュから、進化元効果を持つ黄/黒/紫のテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。その後、自分の手札から、特徴に「ハイブリッド体」/「十闘士」を持つカード1枚をこのデジモンか自分のテイマーの下に置くことで、≪2ドロー≫。
localized.sourceEffect: 【アタック時】ターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-4000。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化する進化条件は進化元となるテイマーをデジモンとしても扱い進化しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、テイマーからそのまま進化します。デジモンが進化するとは扱わず、「デジモンが進化するとき」効果や「デジモンが進化したとき」効果は誘発しません。
また、「デジモンが進化できない」効果が発揮された場合でも、この進化条件でテイマーから進化できます。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化した場合でも、進化ドローは行いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化ドローを行います。
どのような進化の場合でも、進化ドローは行います。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

faqs.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to trash a security card, can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect before giving all of my opponent's Digimon -6000 DP?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: If this card is checked from a security stack, does its [Security] effect activate, then does it battle with the attacking Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, its [Security] effect activates, then it battles.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

localized.name: LordKnightmon
localized.mainEffect:
When this card would be played, if you have a Digimon with [Knightmon] or [Lucemon] in its name, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, their Digimon's effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Knightmon] or [Lucemon] in their texts are played, ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card is played. In what order do they activate?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect. to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: If this card is checked from a security stack, does its [Security] effect activate, then does it battle with the attacking Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, its [Security] effect activates, then it battles.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: このカードは登場したときに誘発する効果を複数持ちますが、どの順で発揮することができますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発になるので、プレイヤーが発揮する順を選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このカード自身が登場したときにも誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン】自分のデジモンが特徴に「アドベンチャー」を持つデジモンに進化したとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、自分の手札から、特徴に「アドベンチャー」を持つカード1枚を登場できる。自分のテイマーの色2色ごとに、この効果で支払う登場コスト-1。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアにこのカードが2枚ある状況です。
このカード2枚の【自分のターン】効果を発揮して、特徴に「アドベンチャー」を持つカード1枚を、支払う登場コストを合計-2して登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場させる効果を複数同時に発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン】効果を発揮して、特徴に「アドベンチャー」を持つデジモンカードを登場させるとき、「ST21-13 石田ヤマト&高石タケル」の【自分のターン】効果を発揮して、支払う登場コストを合計-2して登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 友樹&拓也&泉
localized.mainEffect:
【セキュリティ】このカードをコストを支払わずに登場させる。
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】【登場時】自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つ色の異なるカード2枚までをこのテイマーの下に置ける。この効果で置いたなら、≪1ドロー≫。その後、このテイマーの下に特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つカードが4枚以上あるなら、メモリー+2。
〈ルール〉名称:「氷見友樹」/「神原拓也」/「織本泉」としても扱う。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］特徴に「ハイブリッド体」/「十闘士」を持つこのデジモンでアタックすることで、アタック終了まで、このデジモンは≪Sアタック+1≫を得る。

faqs.question: 「色の異なる」は、赤青の2色のカード2枚を異なる組み合わせとして選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
「XXの異なる」で参照する場合、XXのカードの情報を複数持つカードは、異なる一部を参照して、異なる組み合わせとして扱うことができます。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】【登場時】効果は、このカードの下にカードを置かなくても、「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: Marcus Damon & Agumon
localized.mainEffect:
[Your Turn] When this Tamer suspends, ＜Draw 1＞. Then, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a yellow Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If you have a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, for the turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 6000 DP Digimon, gains ＜Rush＞ and can't digivolve. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack. ⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [Marcus Damon].

faqs.question: This card has [Agumon] in its name, but is it also treated as a Digimon card or a Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't. 
It will only be treated as a Digimon if an effect treats it as a Digimon.

faqs.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP. 
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it. 
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

faqs.question:
I have this card and a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, can I choose to not activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If your turn ends while you have a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name in the battle area, you must choose 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s, and it will gain the "is also treated as a 6000 DP Digimon, gains <Rush>, and can't digivolve" effect. 
Then, you choose whether or not 1 of your Digimon will attack using the part of the effect after "then." At such times, [Once Per Turn] is considered to be used, even if you don't have 1 of your Digimon attack using the part of the effect after "then."

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both. 
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?May. 8, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect. 
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten. 
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
I have this card and 1 [Marcus Damon] in the battle area. 
I place BT21-044 [RizeGreymon] in the battle area by playing or digivolving, and the memory moved to 1 or more on my opponent's side. 
Can I use BT21-044 [RizeGreymon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to have 1 of my Digimon attack, resolve the attack, then use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to have 1 of my Digimon attack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if you pay a cost and the memory moves to 1 or more on the opponent's side during the main phase, first any effects that triggered during that timing must resolve, then the end of the turn timing occurs. 
In this case, once all of the attacks from [RizeGreymon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect have resolved, then the end of the turn timing will occur. Because the attack has already resolved and isn't currently occurring, you can activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect and have 1 of your Digimon attack.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

sourceNotes: アドバンスブースター DIGIMON GENERATION [AD-01]

localized.name: 大門大&アグモン
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン】このテイマーがレストしたとき、≪1ドロー≫。その後、自分のデジモン1体を手札の名称に「グレイモン」を含む黄のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-3で進化できる。
【自分のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］名称に「アグモン」/「グレイモン」を含む黄の自分のデジモンがいるなら、ターン終了まで、自分の「大門大」1体はデジモン・DP6000としても扱い、≪速攻≫を得て、進化できない。その後、自分のデジモン1体でアタックできる。
〈ルール〉名称:「大門大」としても扱う。

faqs.question: このカードは名称に「アグモン」を含むカードですが、デジモンカードやデジモンとしても扱いますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、扱いません。
効果でデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合のみ、デジモンとしても扱います。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードを「DPX000のデジモン」としても扱う効果です。
例えば、テイマーがデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合、通常のデジモンと同様にアタックができたり、下に重ねられているカードの進化元効果を得ます。
ただし、登場したターンのテイマーをデジモンとして扱っても、そのターンはアタックすることはできません。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに、このカードと名称に「アグモン」か「グレイモン」を含む黄の自分のデジモンがいる状況です。
自分のターン終了時になったとき、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果を発揮しないことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
バトルエリアに、名称に「アグモン」か「グレイモン」を含む黄の自分のデジモンがいる状況で自分のターン終了時になった場合、自分の「大門大」1体を選び、「デジモン・DP6000としても扱い、≪速攻≫を得て、進化できない」効果を与えなければなりません。
そのあとに、「その後」以降の効果で自分のデジモン1体でアタックするか選択します。このとき、「その後」以降の効果でアタックしなかった場合でも[ターンに1回]は消費しています。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でテイマーをデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合、テイマーではなくなりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、デジモンとテイマー両方として扱います。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でテイマーをデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合、そのカードが発揮した効果の種類はデジモンの効果とテイマーの効果両方として扱われますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、両方の効果として扱います。

【Assembly -6】 [WarGreymon]×[MetalGarurumon]

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question: When does a "when [...] leaves the battle area" effect trigger?
faqs.answer:
It triggers when a card in the battle area is placed in another area. 
The following areas are considered other areas: 
●Deck
●Digi-Egg deck
●Breeding area
●Hand
●Trash
●Security stack
●Under a card (in a Digimon's digivolution cards or under a Tamer)

faqs.question: Does a "when [...] leaves the battle area" effect trigger even if a "when [...] would leave the battle area" effect activates and prevents it from leaving?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't trigger.

faqs.question:
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮して、1つ目の処理で相手のデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、「離れるとき」などの他の即時型効果でこのカードがバトルエリアから離れました。
そのあとに、この効果の「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮した場合、発揮したカードが効果の途中でその場所を離れた場合でも、最後まで解決します。

faqs.question: 「バトルエリアを離れたとき」効果は、いつ誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
バトルエリアから、それ以外の場所に置かれたときに誘発します。
バトルエリア以外の場所とは、以下を指します。
●デッキ
●デジタマデッキ
●育成エリア
●手札
●トラッシュ
●セキュリティ
●カードの下(デジモンの進化元やテイマーの下)

faqs.question: 「バトルエリアを離れたとき」効果は、「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果を発揮して離れなかった場合でも誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、誘発しません。

localized.name: Biyomon
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon is blocked, it gets +2000 DP.

faqs.question: How long does the 2000 DP boost from this card's inherited effect last?
faqs.answer: It lasts until the end of the turn you activated it.

faqs.question: I activate this card's inherited effect to boost its DP. Later, this digivolution card is trashed. Does the DP boost go away?
faqs.answer: Yes, the +2000 DP boost ends.

faqs.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when attacking an opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No. If your opponent doesn't block, the effect doesn't activate.
Regardless of what the target of attack is, the effect activates when a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards attacks an opponent's Digimon and has its attack target changed to a blocking opponent's Digimon.

faqs.answer: この効果を発揮した自分のターン終了時までです。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果が発揮してDPが上昇しました。その後、この進化元が破棄されました。DPはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: その時点でDP+2000の効果は失われます。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、相手のデジモンに対してアタックしたときも発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、相手がブロックをしなかったのであれば、発揮しません。アタックの対象に関係なく、このカードを進化元に持つデジモンのアタックを、相手のデジモンがブロックして、アタックの対象をその相手のデジモンに変更した時に発揮します。

localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] Gain 3 memory. At end of turn, lose 3 memory.

faqs.question: I attack with this card, and gain 3 memory from the card's attack effect. If this Digimon is deleted as a result of the attack, do I still lose 3 memory at end of turn?
faqs.answer: The effect has already activated, so you lose 3 memory at end of turn.

faqs.question: I attack with this card, and gain 3 memory from the card's attack effect. If I then announce that I'm passing, how much memory do I lose?
faqs.answer: Announcing the pass moves the memory counter to 3 on your opponent's side. Since it's the end of the turn, you then lose an additional 3 memory, moving the memory counter to 6 on your opponent's side.

faqs.answer: It activates immediately after the card enters play. Even if there are other [When Attacking] and "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects waiting to be activated, the [On Play] effect was just triggered, so it activates first.

faqs.question: If this Digimon has a level 4 or lower Digimon card in its digivolution cards, do I have to activate this card's effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as you are able to.

localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by dropping to 0 DP, trigger ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck).

faqs.question: Two of my opponent's Digimon reach zero DP and are deleted simultaneously. Can I draw 2 cards?
faqs.answer: No, if multiple Digimon are deleted at the same time, you can only draw 1 card.

faqs.question: I use BT2-041 [ShineGreymon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to delete 2 or more of my opponent's Digimon simultaneously. Does this mean I can draw 2 cards?
faqs.answer: No, the deletion of multiple Digimon using [BT2-041 ShineGreymon]'s skill is treated as occurring at the same timing, so you only draw 1 card.

localized.name: Chirinmon
localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] Gain 3 memory. At end of turn, lose 3 memory.

faqs.question: I attack with this card, and gain 3 memory from the card's attack effect. If this Digimon is deleted as a result of the attack, do I still lose 3 memory at end of turn?
faqs.answer: Yes, the effect has already activated, so you lose 3 memory at end of turn.

faqs.question: I attack with this card, and gain 3 memory from the card's attack effect. If I then announce that I'm passing, how much memory do I lose?
faqs.answer: Announcing the pass moves the memory counter to 3 on your opponent's side. Since it's the end of the turn, you then lose an additional 3 memory, moving the memory counter to 6 on your opponent's side.

localized.name: Jagamon
localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. You can digivolve this card into 1 level 6 green Digimon card among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to reveal cards from my deck, but then choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve. 
In such cases, you return all of the revealed cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

faqs.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [When Attacking] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw, and where do I draw from?
faqs.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck. 
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. 
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect when I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果は、デッキのカードをオープンし、進化しないことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化しないことができます。
そうした場合、オープンしたカードを全て好きな順番でデッキの下に戻します。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果で進化する場合、進化ドローはどのタイミングで行い、どこからドローしますか？
faqs.answer:
進化させるデジモンの上にカードを重ねた時点で進化ドローをし、オープンされていないデッキからドローします。
進化は、進化のルールによるドローも含めて進化したこととなります。
進化させるカードを重ね進化ドローも行ったあとに、以降の効果を処理します。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果で進化した場合、残ったカードをデッキの下に戻す前に、進化したカードの【進化時】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果は、デッキが2枚以下のときに発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
発揮した場合、デッキのカードを可能な限りオープンします。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 그린 이외의 Lv.6인 디지몬 카드가 오픈되었습니다. 그 카드로 진화할 수 있습니까?

localized.mainEffect: 【상대의 턴】 상대의 디지몬이 플레이어에게 어택했을 때, 이 디지몬이 레스트 상태라면, 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시킨다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 레스트 시키는 디지몬은 어느 플레이어가 선택하나요?
faqs.answer: 이 카드의 플레이어가 선택합니다.

faqs.question: 상대가 어택 시, 상대 디지몬 1마리를 레스트 시키는 효과를 가진 디지몬으로 어택하여 자신의 액티브 상태인 이 카드를 레스트 시켰습니다. 이때 이 카드의 효과는 발휘되나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 발휘됩니다. 이 카드의 효과는 상대 디지몬이 플레이어에게 공격하고 있고 리액션 타이밍에서 이 디지몬이 레스트 상태라면 공격 선언 시 액티브 상태였다고 해도 발휘합니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 《블로커》를 가지고 있고 액티브 상태일 때, 상대 디지몬이 공격했습니다. 이 디지몬으로 블록 하여 레스트 상태가 되었을 경우, 이 카드의 효과를 발휘시켜 상대 디지몬 1마리를 레스트 시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer:
네, 발휘 순서에 따라 가능합니다. 이 디지몬의 【상대의 턴】 효과는 리액션으로 《블로커》와 동시에 유발합니다.
먼저, 《블로커》를 발휘하여 레스트 상태가 된 후 【상대의 턴】효과를 발휘하면, 상대의 디지몬을 레스트 시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: How can I digivolve into this card?
faqs.answer: You can digivolve into this card from a red or blue level 6 Digimon by paying its digivolve cost.

faqs.question: I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose one of my opponent's Digimon. Is that Digimon deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes. The chosen Digimon and all Digimon with the same name as that Digimon are deleted.

faqs.question: I choose [Greymon] with this card's When Digivolving effect while my opponent has a [Greymon], [MetalGreymon], and [WarGreymon] in play. Are all of them deleted, or just [Greymon]?
faqs.answer: Just [Greymon]. Only Digimon with names that completely match the specified name are deleted.

faqs.question: My opponent has [ST1-09 MetalGreymon], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], and [BT1-114 MetalGreymon] in play in their battle area. I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose [ST1-09 MetalGreymon]. Are all of my opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card numbers may be different, but the names match. All of your opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards are deleted.

faqs.question: If I attack with this Digimon when it has a level 6 Digimon card in its digivolution cards, do I always have to activate this card's When Attacking effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can choose not to.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to return a level 6 digivolution card to my hand but choose to not unsuspend this card?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

localized.name: Omnimon
localized.mainEffect:
[When Digivolving] Choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Delete all of your opponent's Digimon that share a name with it.
[When Attacking] You can unsuspend this Digimon by returning 1 of this Digimon's level 6 digivolution cards to your hand.

faqs.question: How can I digivolve into this card?
faqs.answer: You can digivolve into this card from a red or blue level 6 Digimon by paying its digivolve cost.

faqs.question: I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose one of my opponent's Digimon. Is that Digimon deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes. The chosen Digimon and all Digimon with the same name as that Digimon are deleted.

faqs.question: I choose [Greymon] with this card's When Digivolving effect while my opponent has a [Greymon], [MetalGreymon], and [WarGreymon] in play. Are all of them deleted, or just [Greymon]?
faqs.answer: Just [Greymon]. Only Digimon with names that completely match the specified name are deleted.

faqs.question: My opponent has [ST1-09 MetalGreymon], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], and [BT1-114 MetalGreymon] in play in their battle area. I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose [ST1-09 MetalGreymon]. Are all of my opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card numbers may be different, but the names match. All of your opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards are deleted.

faqs.question: If I attack with this Digimon when it has a level 6 Digimon card in its digivolution cards, do I always have to activate this card's When Attacking effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can choose not to.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to return a level 6 digivolution card to my hand but choose to not unsuspend this card?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

sourceNotes: ブースターパック NEW EVOLUTION [BT-01]

localized.name: オメガモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化時】相手のデジモン1体を選ぶ。そのデジモンと同じ名称の相手のデジモン全てを消滅させる。
【アタック時】このデジモンの進化元のLv.6のデジモンカード1枚を手札に戻すことで、このデジモンをアクティブにする。

sourceAttributes.type: 聖騎士型/ロイヤルナイツ

faqs.question: このカードにはどうやって進化するのですか？
faqs.answer: 赤のLv.6デジモンか、青のLv.6デジモンから進化コストを支払って進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの進化時効果は、効果で選んだ相手のデジモンも消滅させますか？
faqs.answer: はい。選んだデジモンも、選んだデジモンと同じ名称なので消滅します。

faqs.question: このカードの進化時効果で「グレイモン」を指定しました。「メタルグレイモン」や「ウォーグレイモン」を消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、名称が完全に一致してない場合は選んだデジモン以外消滅しません。

faqs.question: 相手のバトルエリアには「ST1-09 メタルグレイモン」、「BT1-021 メタルグレイモン」、「BT1-114 メタルグレイモン」がいます。このカードの進化時効果で「ST-09 メタルグレイモン」を選びました。相手の「メタルグレイモン」全てを消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、カードナンバーが異なっても同じ名称のデジモンは全て消滅させることができます。

faqs.question: このカードのアタック時効果は、進化元にLv.6のデジモンカードがあるときにアタックしたら、必ず発揮しなくてはなりませんか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、任意で発揮できます。

faqs.question: このカードのアタック時効果は、進化元のLv.6のデジモンカードを手札に戻して、このカードをアクティブにしないことはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

localized.name: 오메가몬
localized.mainEffect:
【진화 시】 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 선택한다. 그 디지몬과 같은 명칭인 상대의 디지몬 전부를 소멸시킨다.
【어택 시】 이 디지몬의 진화원인 Lv.6의 디지몬 카드 1장을 패로 되돌리는 것으로, 이 디지몬을 액티브로 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드는 어떻게 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 레드인 Lv.6 디지몬과 블루인 Lv.6 디지몬에서 진화 코스트를 지불하여 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화 시 효과는 효과로 선택한 상대의 디지몬도 소멸시키나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 선택한 디지몬도 선택한 디지몬과 같은 이름이므로 소멸합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화시 효과로 「그레이몬」을 지정했습니다. 「메탈그레이몬」이나 「워그레이몬」을 소멸시키는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이름이 완전히 일치하지 않는 경우에는 선택한 디지몬 이외에는 소멸시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question:
상대의 배틀 에어리어에는 「ST1-09 메탈그레이몬」, 「BT1-021 메탈그레이몬」, 「BT1-114 메탈그레이몬」이 있습니다.
이 카드의 진화시 효과로 「ST-09 메탈그레이몬」을 선택하였습니다. 상대의 「메탈그레이몬」 전부를 소멸시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 카드 넘버가 다르더라도 같은 이름의 디지몬은 전부 소멸시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 공격 시 효과는 진화원에 Lv.6 디지몬 카드가 있을 때 공격하면 반드시 발휘해야 합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 임의로 발휘할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 어택 시 효과로 진화원의 Lv.6 디지몬 카드를 패로 되돌리고 이 카드를 액티브로 하지 않는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 불가능합니다.

localized.name: 오메가몬
localized.mainEffect:
【진화 시】 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 선택한다. 그 디지몬과 같은 명칭인 상대의 디지몬 전부를 소멸시킨다.
【어택 시】 이 디지몬의 진화원인 Lv.6의 디지몬 카드 1장을 패로 되돌리는 것으로, 이 디지몬을 액티브로 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드는 어떻게 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 레드인 Lv.6 디지몬과 블루인 Lv.6 디지몬에서 진화 코스트를 지불하여 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화 시 효과는 효과로 선택한 상대의 디지몬도 소멸시키나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 선택한 디지몬도 선택한 디지몬과 같은 이름이므로 소멸합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화시 효과로 「그레이몬」을 지정했습니다. 「메탈그레이몬」이나 「워그레이몬」을 소멸시키는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이름이 완전히 일치하지 않는 경우에는 선택한 디지몬 이외에는 소멸시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question:
상대의 배틀 에어리어에는 「ST1-09 메탈그레이몬」, 「BT1-021 메탈그레이몬」, 「BT1-114 메탈그레이몬」이 있습니다.
이 카드의 진화시 효과로 「ST-09 메탈그레이몬」을 선택하였습니다. 상대의 「메탈그레이몬」 전부를 소멸시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 카드 넘버가 다르더라도 같은 이름의 디지몬은 전부 소멸시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 공격 시 효과는 진화원에 Lv.6 디지몬 카드가 있을 때 공격하면 반드시 발휘해야 합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 임의로 발휘할 수 있습니다.

localized.name: Tai Kamiya
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set your memory to 3.
[Your Turn] All of your red Digimon with 4 or more digivolution cards gain ＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card).

faqs.question: I have both this card and [ST2-12 Matt Ishida] in play. How do I activate their effects?
faqs.answer: You can resolve their effects in any order. For example, if you're starting the turn at 1 memory, you can resolve this card's effect first to go up to 3 memory, then activate [ST2-12 Matt Ishida]'s effect to go to 4 memory and above.

faqs.question: If I have two copies of this card in my battle area, does my Digimon with 4 or more digivolution cards gain <Security Attack +1> twice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each card's effect activates individually: <Security Attack +1> gets applied twice, allowing you to check two extra cards.

faqs.question: I use this card's effect to give one of my Digimon <Security Attack +1>, which I use to attack my opponent. The card revealed from the first check has a security effect that reduces my Digimon's digivolution cards to 3 or fewer. Does it still have <Security Attack +1>?
faqs.answer: Your Digimon loses <Security Attack +1>, and the second check isn't performed.

sourceNotes: ブースターパック NEW EVOLUTION [BT-01]

localized.name: 八神太一
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下のとき、3にする。
【自分のターン】進化元を4枚以上持つ赤の自分のデジモン全ては≪セキュリティアタック+1≫（このデジモンがチェックするセキュリティの枚数+1）を得る。

faqs.question: 自分のバトルエリアに、このカードと、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の両方が登場していたら、効果の発揮はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
好きな順番で処理を行えます。
例えば、メモリーが1でターンを開始したとき、このカードの処理を先に行ってメモリーを3にした後で、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の効果を発揮して、メモリーを4以上にできます。

faqs.question: このカードが2体いるとき、進化元を4枚以上持つ自分のデジモンは≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を2つ得られますか？
faqs.answer: はい、それぞれ効果が発揮するので、≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を2つ得られることになり、チェックできる枚数+2となります。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を得ていたデジモンが、相手プレイヤーにアタックし、1枚目のチェックで相手のカードのセキュリティ効果によって進化元を破棄されて3枚以下になってしまいました。≪セキュリティアタック+1≫はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: その時点で≪セキュリティアタック+1≫は失われ、2枚目のチェックは行えません。

localized.mainEffect:

localized.name: Matt Ishida
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set your memory to 3.
[Your Turn] When you play a blue Digimon, you can suspend this Tamer to trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: I have both this card and [ST2-12 Matt Ishida] in play. How do I activate their effects?
faqs.answer: You can resolve their effects in any order. For example, if you're starting the turn at 1 memory, you can resolve this card's effect first to go up to 3 memory, then activate [ST2-12 Matt Ishida]'s effect to go to 4 memory and above.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect activate if it's suspended?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does. Unless otherwise specified, cards don't lose effects when suspended.

localized.name: 石田ヤマト
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下のとき、3にする。
【自分のターン】青の自分のデジモンが登場したとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、相手のデジモン1体の進化元を、下から1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: 自分のバトルエリアに、このカードと、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の両方が登場していたら、効果の発揮はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 好きな順番で処理を行えます。例として、メモリーが1でターンを開始したとき、このカードの処理を先に行ってメモリーを3にした後で、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の効果を発揮して、メモリーを4以上にできます。

faqs.question: レストしているこのカードの【自分のターン開始時】効果は発揮されますか？
faqs.answer: はい。発揮されます。レスト状態でも効果が失われるわけではありません。

localized.name: T.K. Takaishi
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set your memory to 3.
[On Play] Look at your security stack, then reveal 1 card in it and add it to your hand. If that card is yellow, trigger ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) Then shuffle your security stack.

faqs.question: I have both this card and [ST2-12 Matt Ishida] in play. How do I activate their effects?
faqs.answer: You can resolve their effects in any order. For example, if you're starting the turn at 1 memory, you can resolve this card's effect first to go up to 3 memory, then activate [ST2-12 Matt Ishida]'s effect to go to 4 memory and above.

faqs.question: This card's On Play effect says "Look at your security stack." What does this mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: It allows you to look at all of the cards in your security stack without revealing them to your opponent. You then pick one of those cards, reveal it, and add it to your hand.

faqs.question: What happens if I use this card's On Play effect to add a card from my security stack to my hand that isn't yellow?
faqs.answer: Shuffle your deck without triggering <Recovery +1 (Deck)>.

localized.name: 高石タケル
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下のとき、3にする。
【登場時】自分のセキュリティの内容を全て確認して、その中の1枚をオープンして手札に加える。そのカードが黄のカードのとき、≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫（自分はデッキの上からカードを1枚セキュリティの上に置く）。その後、自分のセキュリティをシャッフルする。

faqs.question: 自分のバトルエリアに、このカードと、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の両方が登場していたら、効果の発揮はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 好きな順番で処理を行えます。例として、メモリーが1でターンを開始したとき、このカードの処理を先に行ってメモリーを3にした後で、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の効果を発揮して、メモリーを4以上にできます。

faqs.question: 登場時効果の「内容を全て確認し～」とはどういうことですか？
faqs.answer: 相手には公開せず、自分だけ自分のセキュリティのカードすべての内容を見ることができます。その後、手札に加えるカードを1枚選び、そのカードのみ相手に公開します。

faqs.question: 登場時効果で、セキュリティから手札に加えるカードが黄のカード以外だった場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: ≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫を行わずにシャッフルのみを行ってください。

sourceNotes: ブースターパック NEW EVOLUTION [BT-01]BOX購入特典

localized.name: 高石タケル
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下のとき、3にする。
【登場時】自分のセキュリティの内容を全て確認して、その中の1枚をオープンして手札に加える。そのカードが黄のカードのとき、≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫（自分はデッキの上からカードを1枚セキュリティの上に置く）。その後、自分のセキュリティをシャッフルする。

faqs.question: 自分のバトルエリアに、このカードと、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の両方が登場していたら、効果の発揮はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 好きな順番で処理を行えます。例として、メモリーが1でターンを開始したとき、このカードの処理を先に行ってメモリーを3にした後で、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の効果を発揮して、メモリーを4以上にできます。

localized.name: 리키
localized.mainEffect:
【자신의 턴 개시 시】 메모리가 2 이하일 때, 3으로 한다.
【등장 시】 자신의 시큐리티의 내용을 전부 확인하고, 그 중 1장을 오픈하고 패에 추가한다. 그 카드가 옐로우 카드일 때, 〈리커버리 +1 《덱》〉 (자신은 덱 위에서 카드를 1장 시큐리티 위에 놓는다). 그 후, 자신의 시큐리티를 셔플한다.

faqs.question: 등장 시 효과의 「내용을 전부 확인하고~」라는 것은 어떤 것인가요?
faqs.answer: 상대방에게는 공개하지 않고 자신만 자신의 시큐리티 카드를 전부 볼 수 있습니다. 그런 다음 패에 추가할 카드를 1장 선택하여 그 카드만을 상대방에게 공개합니다.

faqs.question: 등장 시 효과로 시큐리티에서 패에 추가하여 카드가 옐로인 카드 이외인 경우, 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 〈리커버리 +1 《덱》〉 을 진행하지 않고 셔플만 합니다.

localized.name: Izzy Izumi
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If you have a level 5 or higher green Digimon in play, you can suspend this Tamer to reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a Digimon card, add it to your hand. Otherwise place it at the bottom of your deck.

faqs.question: What timing does [Main] occur at?
faqs.answer: Like Main effects on Option cards, you can activate these effects at any time during your main phase. However, you can't activate them to interrupt an attack or another effect.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's Main effect if I have a level 5 or higher green Digimon in my Breeding Area?
faqs.answer: No, Digimon in breeding areas aren't checked by this effect.

localized.name: 泉光子郎
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】緑のLv.5以上の自分のデジモンがいるとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、自分のデッキの上から1枚オープンする。そのカードがデジモンカードなら手札に加える。残ったカードはデッキの下に戻す。

faqs.question: 「メイン」とはどのタイミングですか？
faqs.answer: オプションカードのメイン効果のように、メインフェイズであれば好きなタイミングで発揮が可能です。ただし、他の効果やアタックに割り込んで発揮することはできません。

faqs.question: 育成エリアに緑のLv.5以上のデジモンがいる場合もメイン効果は使えますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、育成エリアにいるデジモンは参照しません。

faqs.question: I have both this card and [ST2-12 Matt Ishida] in play. How do I activate their effects?
faqs.answer: You can resolve their effects in any order. For example, if you're starting the turn at 1 memory, you can resolve this card's effect first to go up to 3 memory, then activate [ST2-12 Matt Ishida]'s effect to go to 4 memory and above.

faqs.question: What timing does [Main] occur at?
faqs.answer: Like Main effects on Option cards, you can activate these effects at any time during your main phase. However, you can't activate them to interrupt an attack or another effect.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's Main effect if I have a level 5 or higher green Digimon in my Breeding Area?
faqs.answer: No, Digimon in breeding areas aren't checked by this effect.

faqs.question: Does this card's Start of Your Turn effect activate if it is suspended?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does. Unless otherwise specified, cards don't lose their effects when suspended.

faqs.question: During my breeding phase, I hatch a level 2 Digimon from my Digi-Egg deck. I then digivolve that Digimon into a level 3 Digimon during my main phase. If I use this card's effect to move that Digimon to my battle area, can I attack with it immediately?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can. Hatching Digimon and moving them to the battle area doesn't count as playing them, so you can attack with them immediately.

localized.name: 太刀川ミミ
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下のとき、3にする。
【メイン】緑のLv.5以上の自分のデジモンがいるとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、空いている自分の育成エリアにデジタマカード1枚を孵化させるか、育成エリアのLv.3以上の自分のデジモン1体をバトルエリアに移動する。

faqs.question: 自分のバトルエリアに、このカードと、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の両方が登場していたら、効果の発揮はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 好きな順番で処理を行えます。例として、メモリーが1でターンを開始したとき、このカードの処理を先に行ってメモリーを3にした後で、「ST2-12 石田ヤマト」の効果を発揮して、メモリーを4以上にできます。

faqs.question: 「メイン」とはどのタイミングですか？
faqs.answer: オプションカードのメイン効果のように、メインフェイズであれば好きなタイミングで発揮が可能です。ただし、他の効果やアタックに割り込んで発揮することはできません。

faqs.question: 育成エリアに緑のLv.5以上のデジモンがいる場合もメイン効果は使えますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、育成エリアにいるデジモンは参照しません。

faqs.question: レストしているこのカードの【自分のターン開始時】効果は発揮されますか？
faqs.answer: はい。発揮されます。レスト状態でも効果が失われるわけではありません。

faqs.question:
育成フェイズにデジタマデッキから孵化したLv.2デジモンを、そのターンのメインフェイズでLv.3に進化させました。
さらにそのデジモンをこのカードの効果でバトルエリアに移動させた場合、そのデジモンはすぐにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、孵化や移動は登場ではないので、アタックできます。

localized.name: 이미나
localized.mainEffect:
【자신의 턴 개시 시】 메모리가 2 이하일 때, 3으로 한다.
【메인】 그린의 Lv.5 이상인 자신의 디지몬이 있을 때, 이 테이머를 레스트시키는 것으로, 비어 있는 자신의 육성 에어리어에 디지타마 카드 1장을 부화시키거나, 육성 에어리어의 Lv.3 이상인 자신의 디지몬 1마리를 배틀 에어리어로 이동한다.

faqs.question: 육성 에어리어에 그린인 Lv.5 이상의 디지몬이 있는 경우에도 메인 효과를 사용할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 육성 에어리어에 있는 디지몬은 참조하지 않습니다.

faqs.question:
육성 페이즈에 디지타마 덱에서 부화한 Lv.2 디지몬을 그 턴 메인 페이즈에서 Lv.3으로 진화하였습니다.
추가로 그 디지몬을 이 카드의 효과로 배틀 에어리어에 이동시켰을 경우, 그 디지몬은 바로 어택할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 부화나 이동은 등장이 아니므로 어택할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: このカードの効果を得たデジモンでアタックしました。このとき、アタックしたデジモンが他の効果で進化したあとに、このカードの効果で得た【アタック時】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.question: このカードを使用した後で登場したデジモンは、このカードの効果を受けられますか？
faqs.answer: はい、受けられます。

faqs.question: このカードを2枚使用した場合、自分のデジモンは相手のデジモン1体をDP-2000する効果を、1回のアタックで2回発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

localized.name: 헤븐즈 리퍼
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 이 턴 동안, 자신의 디지몬 전부는, 「【어택 시】 이 턴 동안, 상대의 디지몬 1마리의 DP를 -2000 한다.」의 효과를 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 사용한 후, 자신의 디지몬이 진화하더라도 효과는 계속해서 받나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 효과는 지속됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과 발휘 후, 「BT1-089 이미나」의 효과로 육성 에어리어에서 디지몬을 배틀 에어리어로 이동시켰습니다. 이 카드의 효과는 그 디지몬에게도 발휘되나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 발휘됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드로 인해 어택 시 효과를 어택의 대상이 되는 상대 디지몬에게 대하여 발휘하고, DP를 0으로 하여 소멸시켰습니다. 어택은 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 배틀은 진행하지 않고, 어택은 종료됩니다. 만약 다른 어택 시 효과나 「자신의 디지몬이 어택 했을 때」 효과, 리액션으로 발휘하는 효과가 있을 경우는 그 효과들을 발휘한 뒤 종료합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 사용한 후, 등장한 디지몬은 이 카드의 효과를 받나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 받습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 2장 사용했을 경우, 자신의 디지몬은 상대 디지몬 1체를 DP-2000하는 효과를 1회 어택으로 2번 발휘하나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 2번 발휘합니다.

localized.name: 天堂斩裂刃
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】本回合中,我方所有数码宝贝获得“【攻击时】本回合中,对方1只数码宝贝的DP-2000。”的效果。

localized.name: Blast Fire
localized.mainEffect: [Main] Change the original DP of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to 3000 until the end of your opponent's next turn.

faqs.question: What does "original DP" refer to?
faqs.answer: The DP value printed on a card is its original DP. This card's effect temporarily allows you to treat the DP value printed on an opponent's Digimon as if it were 3000.

faqs.question: I use this card's effect to change the original DP of an opponent's Digimon to 3000. I then use [ST3-11 Seraphimon]'s effect to give an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP. If the opponent's Digimon drops to 0 DP, is it deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes, when a Digimon's DP becomes 0, it's deleted.

faqs.question: This card's effect has set a Digimon's original DP to 3000. If [ST1-13 Shadow Wing] is used to give that Digimon +3000 DP, is its DP now 6000?
faqs.answer: Yes, effects that increase or decrease DP work as normal, raising the Digimon's DP to 6000.

faqs.question: If I use this card's effect on a Digimon that's already getting +1000 DP from an effect, does its DP become 3000?
faqs.answer: No, its original DP becomes 3000. 3000 DP and 1000 DP (from the effect) add up to 4000 DP.

faqs.question: I digivolve a Digimon while this card's effect is active. What happens to the Digimon's DP?
faqs.answer: Even after digivolving, the Digimon's DP is treated as 3000 until the end of the turn.

sourceNotes: ブースターパック NEW EVOLUTION [BT-01]

localized.name: ブラストファイア
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】次の相手のターン終了時まで、相手のデジモン1体の元々のDPを3000に変更する。

faqs.question: 「元々のDP」とは、どういう意味ですか？
faqs.answer: そのカードに書かれているDPの数値です。このカードの効果は、対象のデジモンのカードに書かれているDPの数値を、一時的に3000として扱うようにします。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で、相手のデジモンの元のDPを3000にしました。その後、「ST3-11 セラフィモン」の効果で、その相手のデジモンをDPを-4000しました。対象のデジモンはDP0になって消滅しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、DPが0になったので消滅します。

faqs.question: このカードの効果によって元々のDPが3000になったデジモンに対し、「ST1-13 シャドーウィング」を使用したら、DP+3000されてDP6000になりますか？
faqs.answer: はい、DPを増減する効果は通常通り発揮しますので、DP6000になります。

faqs.question: そのデジモン自身をDP+1000する効果を持つデジモンに対してこのカードの効果を発揮させたら、DP3000になりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、元々のDPが3000になり、そこに効果による+1000が加わるので、DP4000となります。

faqs.question: このカードの効果の対象になったデジモンが進化した場合、DPはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 進化を行っても、カードに書かれたDPは3000として扱うので、ターン終了時まではDP3000のままとなります。

localized.name: 블래스트 화이어
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 다음 상대의 턴 종료시까지, 상대의 디지몬 1마리의 원래 DP를 3000으로 변경한다.

faqs.question: 「본래 DP」란 무슨 의미인가요?
faqs.answer: 그 카드에 적혀있는 DP 수치를 말합니다. 이 카드의 효과는 대상 디지몬 카드에 적혀 있는 DP 수치를 일시적으로 3000으로 취급하도록 합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 상대 디지몬의 본래 DP를 3000으로 했습니다. 그 후, 「ST3-11 세라피몬」의 효과로, 그 상대의 디지몬을 DP를 -4000 했습니다. 대상 디지몬은 DP 0이 되어 소멸됩니까?
faqs.answer: 네, DP가 0이 되었으므로 소멸합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 인해 본래 DP가 3000이 된 디지몬에 대해 「ST1-13 섀도우 윙」을 사용하면 DP+3000 이 되어 DP6000이 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 네, DP를 더하거나 빼는 효과는 평소와 같이 발휘하기 때문에, DP는 6000이 됩니다.

faqs.question: 그 디지몬 자신을 DP+1000하는 효과를 가진 디지몬에 대해 이 카드의 효과를 발휘하게 한다면 DP 3000이 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 본래 DP가 3000이 되고 거기에 효과에 따른 +1000이 더해지므로 DP 4000이 됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과의 대상이 된 디지몬이 진화한 경우 DP는 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 진화를 해도 카드에 적힌 DP는 3000으로 취급하므로 턴 종료 시까지는 DP 3000인 채로 유지됩니다.

localized.mainEffect: [Main] For the turn, the next time you would digivolve one of your green Digimon from level 5 to level 6, decrease the digivolution cost by 4.

faqs.question: I have a level 6 Digimon with a digivolution cost of 3, and use this card's effect to reduce that cost by 4, to -1. Can I digivolve into that Digimon by gaining a memory?
faqs.answer: No, digivolution costs can't be reduced to less than zero. You can digivolve the card for free, but you can't gain memory with effects that reduce digivolution costs.

faqs.question: Does activating this card's effect also reduce the digivolution cost of cards in my breeding area?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't. Since the card doesn't specify breeding areas, the effect doesn't apply to Digimon there.

faqs.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 5 green Digimon digivolving to level 6 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: スマッシュポテト
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】このターンの間、次に緑の自分のデジモンがLv.5からLv.6に進化するときに支払う進化コストを-4する。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、進化コスト3のLv.6デジモンに進化するとき、コストを-4すると進化コスト-1になるので、メモリーを+1して進化させるのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、進化コスト0として進化を行ってください。進化コストはマイナスにはならず、0が最低となります。

faqs.question: このカードの効果発揮後、育成エリアで進化させる場合も、コストは下がりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、下がりません。育成エリアのデジモンの進化では、この効果は発揮できません。

faqs.question: このカードを使用した後、自分のデジモンを進化を行う効果でLv.5の緑の自分のデジモンをLv.6に進化させるとき、進化コストをマイナスできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 스매시 포테이토
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 이 턴 동안, 다음에 그린인 자신의 디지몬이 Lv.5에서 Lv.6으로 진화할 때에 지불하는 진화 코스트를 -4 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 진화비용 3인 Lv.6 디지몬으로 진화할 때 비용을 -4 하면 진화비용 -1이 되므로 메모리를 +1하여 진화시키는 것입니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 진화비용 0으로 진화를 진행해주세요. 진화 비용은 마이너스가 되지 않고 0이 최저가 됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과 발휘 후 육성 에어리어에서 진화시키는 경우에도 비용이 낮아집니까?

localized.mainEffect: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend both 1 of my opponent's Digimon, and 2 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less?
faqs.answer: No. You can either suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, regardless of DP, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. You can't mix and match.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less, and no other Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, this card's effect allows you to pick 1 Digimon and suspend it, regardless of DP.

localized.name: ギガブラスター
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】相手のデジモン1体か、DP5000以下の相手のデジモン2体をレストさせる。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、相手のデジモン1体とDP5000以下のデジモン2体をレストさせることができるのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、DPに関係なく相手のデジモン1体をレストするか、DP5000以下の相手のデジモン2体をレストさせるかのどちらかを選んで行います。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、DP5000以下の相手のデジモン1体だけをレストさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる」効果を選択し、それでDP5000以下の相手のデジモンを対象として指定することで可能です。

localized.name: 기가 블래스터
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 상대의 디지몬 1마리 또는, DP 5000 이하인 상대의 디지몬 2마리를 레스트시킨다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 상대의 디지몬 1개와 DP 5000 이하의 디지몬 2마리를 레스트시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, DP에 관계없이 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시키거나, DP 5000 이하의 상대의 디지몬 2마리를 레스트시키는 것, 둘 중 하나를 선택하여 실시합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 DP 5000 이하의 상대 디지몬 1개만을 레스트시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 「상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시키는」 효과를 선택하여, 이걸로 DP 5000 이하의 상대의 디지몬을 대상으로 지정하는 것으로 가능합니다.

localized.name: 千兆冲击波
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】将对方的1只数码宝贝,或2只DP不高于5000的数码宝贝转换为休息状态。

localized.name: Dimension Scissor
localized.mainEffect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gains the following effect for the turn: "When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, unsuspend it."

faqs.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. Can I unsuspend it over and over again every time I use it to delete an opponent's Digimon in battle?
faqs.answer: Yes. The effect has no limit to the number of times it can be used. As long as you keep deleting your opponent's Digimon, you can keep using the effect to unsuspend this card.

faqs.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. If it deletes an opponent's Security Digimon in battle, can I unsuspend it?
faqs.answer: No, the effect doesn't activate in battles with Security Digimon.

faqs.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack with it, and my opponent blocks it. If my Digimon deletes the opponent's blocking Digimon and survives, can I unsuspend it?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives, you can unsuspend it, even if the opposing Digimon had <Blocker>.

faqs.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack an opponent's Digimon with it, and an effect causes one of my opponent's other Digimon to be deleted during the battle. Do I still get to unsuspend my attacking Digimon?
faqs.answer: No. You can only unsuspend the Digimon with this effect if it deletes the Digimon it's currently attacking. Other Digimon don't count.

sourceNotes: ブースターパック NEW EVOLUTION [BT-01]

localized.name: ディメンションシザー
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】このターンの間、自分のデジモン1体は、「このデジモンがバトルで相手のデジモンだけを消滅させたとき、このデジモンをアクティブにする。」の効果を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンは、相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させるたびに何回でもアクティブになりますか？
faqs.answer: はい、この効果に回数制限はないため、レストしている相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させ続ける限りアクティブにできます。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンが、相手のセキュリティデジモンをバトルで消滅させたときもアクティブになりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、セキュリティデジモンとのバトルでは発揮しません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンが、相手プレイヤーにアタックし、ブロックされました。ブロックしたデジモンをバトルで消滅させた場合もアクティブになりますか？
faqs.answer: はい、ブロックされた場合でも、バトルで相手のデジモンを消滅させれば、アクティブになります。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンがアタックし、バトルしている相手のデジモン以外のデジモンを、何らかの効果で消滅させました。このとき、アタックした自分のデジモンをアクティブにできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バトルしているデジモン以外を消滅させてもアクティブにすることはできません。

localized.name: 디멘션 시저
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 이 턴 동안, 자신의 디지몬 1마리는, 「이 디지몬이 배틀에서 상대의 디지몬만을 소멸시켰을 때, 이 디지몬을 액티브로 한다.」의 효과를 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬은 상대방 디지몬을 배틀에서 소멸시킬 때마다 몇 번이라도 액티브할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 이 효과에 횟수 제한은 없기 때문에 레스트하고 있는 상대의 디지몬을 배틀에서 계속 소멸시키는 한 액티브 할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬이 상대방의 시큐리티 디지몬을 배틀에서 소멸시켰을 때도 활성화됩니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 시큐리티 디지몬과의 배틀에서는 발휘하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬이 상대 플레이어에게 공격하여 블록되었습니다. 블록한 디지몬을 배틀에서 소멸시킨 경우에도 액티브됩니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 블록된 경우에도 배틀에서 상대의 디지몬을 소멸시키면 액티브됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬이 공격하여 배틀하고 있는 상대 디지몬 이외의 디지몬을 어떤 효과로 소멸시켰습니다. 이때, 공격한 자신의 디지몬을 액티브 할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 배틀하고 있는 디지몬 이외의 것을 소멸시켜도 액티브할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: Does this card's security effect also prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their unsuspend phase?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과의 대상이 된 디지몬이 진화했습니다. 어택이나 블록을 할 수 있나요?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 시큐리티 효과는 레스트 상태인 상대 테이머도 액티브 페이즈에 활성화되지 않도록 하나요?

[Digivolve] 0 from Lv.2 w/[Xros Heart] in traits
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card―both with [Xros Heart] in their traits―among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Shoutmon] in its name, it gains ＜Rush＞. (This Digimon may attack the turn it was played.)

faqs.question: Is it true that both the Digimon card and the Tamer card must have the [Xros Heart] trait in order for this card's effect to be able to add them to my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's correct.

faqs.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

faqs.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both Digimon and Tamer cards with the [Xros Heart] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
faqs.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

sourceNotes: ブースターパック クロスエンカウンター [BT-10]

localized.name: シャウトモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】『特徴に「クロスハート」を持つLv.2』から0
【登場時】自分のデッキの上から3枚オープンする。その中の特徴に「クロスハート」を持つデジモンカードとテイマーカード1枚ずつを手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。
【消滅時】≪セーブ≫（このカードを自分のテイマーの下に置ける）
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンが名称に「シャウトモン」を含む間、このデジモンは≪速攻≫（このデジモンは登場したターンでもアタックできる）を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、デジモンカードだけでなく、テイマーカードも特徴に「クロスハート」を持つカードだけが手札に加えられるのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、その通りです。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、オープンした3枚のカードの中に、特徴に「クロスハート」を持つデジモンカードと、テイマーカードが両方ないと手札に加えられないのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、特徴に「クロスハート」を持つデジモンカードか、特徴に「クロスハート」を持つテイマーカードのどちらかしかなかったときでも、手札に加えます。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で、オープンした3枚のカードの中に、特徴に「クロスハート」を持つデジモンカードと、テイマーカードが両方あった場合、どちらか片方のみを手札に加え、片方をデッキの下に戻す事は可能ですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの効果は、「手札に加える」なので、可能な限り手札に加える必要があります。

localized.name: 샤우트몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】『특징으로 「크로스 하트」를 가진 Lv.2』에서 0【등장 시】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 그중 특징으로 「크로스 하트」를 가진 디지몬 카드와 테이머 카드 1장씩을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 【소멸 시】《세이브》(이 카드를 자신의 테이머 아래에 놓을 수 있다)
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】이 디지몬이 명칭에 「샤우트몬」을 포함하는 동안, 이 디지몬은 《속공》(이 디지몬은 등장한 턴에도 어택할 수 있다)을 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 디지몬 카드뿐만 아니라 테이머 카드도 특징에 「크로스 하트」를 가진 카드만을 패에 넣을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 맞습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 오픈한 3장의 카드 중에 특징에 「크로스 하트」를 가진 디지몬 카드와 테이머 카드가 모두 있지 않다면 패에 넣을 수 없습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 특징에 「크로스 하트」를 가진 디지몬 카드나 특징에 「크로스 하트」를 가진 테이머 카드 중 한 쪽만 있어도 패에 넣을 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 오픈한 3장의 카드 중에 특징에 「크로스 하트」를 가진 디지몬 카드와 테이머 카드가 모두 있을 경우, 어느 한 쪽만을 패에 넣고 한 쪽을 덱 밑에 돌릴 수 있습니까?

localized.mainEffect:
＜Material Save 2＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place 2 cards in this Digimon's DigiXros requirements from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)

faqs.question: Can I choose not to activate this card's [End of Attack] effect by not performing "placing all digivolution cards from under this Digimon under 1 of your Tamers", thus preventing this Digimon from being deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect if this Digimon doesn't have any digivolution cards?

faqs.question: If I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect, can I unsuspend a different Tamer than the Tamer under which I placed the digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

【アタック終了時】このデジモンの進化元全てを自分のテイマー1体の下に置くことで、自分のテイマー1体をアクティブにし、このデジモンを消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック終了時】効果は、「このデジモンの進化元全てを自分のテイマー1体の下に置く」をしないことで、このデジモンを消滅させないことができますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック終了時】効果は、このデジモンに進化元が1枚もないときに発揮させることはできますか？

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック終了時】効果でアクティブにするテイマーは、進化元のカードを置いたテイマーとは別のテイマーを指定できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【어택 종료 시】효과는 「이 디지몬의 진화원 전부를 자신의 테이머 1명의 밑에 놓는」을 하지 않는 것으로 이 디지몬을 소멸시키지 않을 수 있습니까?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【어택 종료 시】효과는 이 디지몬에 진화원이 1장도 없을 때 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 「이 디지몬의 진화원 전부를 자신의 테이머 1명의 밑에 놓는다」가 실행되지 않기 때문에 진화원의 카드가 없을 때에는 발휘할 수 없습니다.

faqs.answer: 네. 가능합니다.

localized.name: Canoweissmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] 3 from Lv.4 w/[Gammamon] in name
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers becomes suspended, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, if this Digimon has 12000 DP or more, it gains ＜Security Attack +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question: If more than 1 of my Tamers suspend at the same time, does this card's "+2000 DP" effect activate multiple times?
faqs.answer: No, even if multiple Tamers suspend at the same time, this effect will only give +2000 DP.

faqs.question: I digivolve a Digimon with [Gammamon] in its name and a [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect into this card. Can I activate the [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's [All Turns] effect and attack?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on your opponent's side, you can activate <Blitz>.

faqs.question: I digivolve a [BT8-013 BetelGammamon] into a [BT8-084 Kimeramon] and place this card as one of [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s digivolution cards with its [When Digivolving] effect. Can I now activate [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's inherited effect and attack?
faqs.answer: No, you can't. If this card is added to digivolution cards by [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, you get [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s <Blitz> effect through this card, but the time to trigger <Blitz> has already passed, so <Blitz> doesn't activate.

faqs.question: If I have multiple digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names, does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect give me all of their effects?
faqs.answer: Yes, you gain all the effects from every applicable card, even if there are multiple of them.

faqs.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect allow me to activate the inherited effect of a digivolution card with [Gammamon] in its name as an effect of this card?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect don't affect the inherited effects of digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names.

faqs.question: Due to an effect, this Digimon has another [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and a [BT8-008 Gammamon] under it as its digivolution cards. If I play a red Tamer, how exactly does [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s "When you play a red Tamer, <Draw 1> (Draw 1 card from your deck)" effect work in this situation?
faqs.answer: This card's effect and inherited effect mean that this Digimon gains [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s effects twice, so <Draw 1> is activated twice and you draw a total of 2 cards.

localized.name: カノーヴァイスモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】『名称に「ガンマモン」を含むLv.4』から3
【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］自分のテイマーがレストしたとき、このターンの間、このデジモンをDP+2000。その後、このデジモンがDP12000以上のとき、このターンの間、このデジモンは≪セキュリティアタック+1≫（このデジモンがチェックする枚数+1）を得る。
【お互いのターン】このデジモンは、このデジモンの進化元にある名称に「ガンマモン」を含むカードの効果全てを得る。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】このデジモンは、このデジモンの進化元にある名称に「ガンマモン」を含むカードの効果全てを得る。

faqs.question: 自分のテイマーが同時に複数体レストしたとき、このカードの「DP+2000」の効果は複数回発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、テイマーが同時に複数体レストしても、この効果ではDP+2000しかされません。

faqs.question: 【進化時】≪進撃≫の効果を持つ、名称に「ガンマモン」を含むデジモンからこのカードに進化した場合、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果によって、【進化時】≪進撃≫の効果を発揮してアタックできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、メモリーが相手側の1以上になっていれば、≪進撃≫を発揮できます。

faqs.question: 「BT8-013 ベテルガンマモン」から「BT8-084 キメラモン」に進化し、【進化時】効果でトラッシュのこのカードを「BT8-084 キメラモン」の進化元に置きました。このカードの進化元効果によって、「BT8-013 ベテルガンマモン」の【進化時】≪進撃≫の効果を発揮してアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「BT8-084 キメラモン」の【進化時】効果によってこのカードが進化元に追加された場合、このカードによって「BT8-013 ベテルガンマモン」の≪進撃≫を得ますが、その≪進撃≫が誘発するタイミングは過ぎてしまっているため、≪進撃≫は発揮できません。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果・進化元効果は、進化元の名称に「ガンマモン」を含むカードが複数あった場合でも、それら全ての効果を得られるのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、複数対象となるカードがあっても、それらの効果を全てを得ます。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果・進化元効果は、進化元の名称に「ガンマモン」を含むカードの持つ進化元効果も、このカードの効果として発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、名称に「ガンマモン」を含むカードの持つ進化元効果は、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果・進化元効果の対象にはなりません。

faqs.question:
何らかの効果によって、このカードの進化元として、もう1枚「BT10-011 カノーヴァイスモン」が、さらにその下に「BT8-008 ガンマモン」がある自分のデジモンがいます。
この状態で自分が赤のテイマーを登場させたとき、「BT8-008 ガンマモン」の「[ターンに1回]赤の自分のテイマーが登場したとき、≪1ドロー≫（自分のデッキからカードを1枚引く）」の効果は、どのように発揮されますか？2022/07/15 更新
faqs.answer: このカードの効果と進化元効果で、このデジモンが「BT8-008 ガンマモン」の効果を2つ持っていることになるので、≪1ドロー≫が2回発揮し、合計で２枚カードを引きます。

localized.name: 카노바이스몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】『명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함하는 Lv.4』에서 3【자신의 턴】［턴에 1회］자신의 테이머가 레스트했을 때, 이 턴 동안 이 디지몬을 DP+2000. 그 후, 이 디지몬이 DP 12000 이상일 때, 이 턴 동안 이 디지몬은 《시큐리티 어택+1》 (이 디지몬이 체크하는 매수+1)을 얻는다. 【서로의 턴】이 디지몬은 이 디지몬의 진화원에 있는 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함하는 카드의 효과 전부를 얻는다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】이 디지몬은 이 디지몬의 진화원에 있는 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함하는 카드의 효과 전부를 얻는다.

faqs.question: 자신의 테이머가 동시에 여러 명 레스트했을 때, 이 카드의 「DP +2000」효과는 여러 번 발휘합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 테이머가 동시에 여러 명 레스트해도 이 효과로는 DP +2000밖에 안됩니다.

faqs.question: 【진화 시】≪진격≫효과를 가진, 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함한 디지몬에서 이 카드로 진화했을 경우, 이 카드의 【서로의 턴】효과에 의해 【진화 시】≪진격≫효과를 발휘하여 어택할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 메모리가 상대 쪽에 1 이상이 되었다면 ≪진격≫을 발휘할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 「BT8-013 베텔감마몬」에서 「BT8-084 키메라몬」으로 진화하고 【진화 시】효과로 트래시의 이 카드를 「BT8-084 키메라몬」의 진화원에 놓였습니다. 이 카드의 진화원 효과에 의해 「BT8-013 베텔감마몬」의 【진화 시】≪진격≫효과를 발휘하여 어택할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer:
아니요. 할 수 없습니다.
「BT8-084 키메라몬」의 【진화 시】효과로 인해 이 카드가 진화원에 추가되었을 경우, 이 카드에 의해 「BT8-013 베텔감마몬」의 ≪진격≫을 얻습니다만, 그 ≪진격≫이 유발하는 타이밍은 지나갔기 때문에 ≪진격≫은 발휘할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【서로의 턴】효과・진화원 효과는 진화원의 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함한 카드가 여럿 있을 경우에도 그 전부를 효과를 얻을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 대상이 되는 카드가 여럿 있더라도 그 효과를 전부 얻습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【서로의 턴】효과・진화원 효과는 진화원의 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함한 카드가 가진 진화원 효과도 이 카드의 효과로 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 명칭에 「감마몬」을 포함한 카드가 가진 진화원 효과는 이 카드의 【서로의 턴】효과・진화원 효과의 대상이 되지 않습니다.

faqs.question:
무언가의 효과에 의해 이 카드의 진화원으로 또 1장 「BT10-011 카노바이스몬」이, 더하여 그 밑에 「BT8-008 감마몬」이 있는 자신의 디지몬이 있습니다.
이 상황에서 자신이 레드인 테이머를 등장시켰을 때, 「BT8-008 감마몬」의 「【턴에 1회】레드인 자신의 테이머가 등장시켰을 때, ≪1드로우≫（자신의 덱에서 카드를 1장 뽑는다）」 효과는 어떻게 발휘됩니까?
faqs.answer: 이 카드의 효과와 진화원 효과로 이 디지몬이 「BT8-008 감마몬」 효과를 2개 갖고 있기 때문에 ≪1드로우≫가 2회 발휘하여 합계로 2장 카드를 뽑습니다.

【登場時】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の特徴に「ブルーフレア」を持つカード2枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。自分の「蒼沼キリハ」がいるなら、代わりに自分のトラッシュから、「メタルグレイモン」1枚を手札に戻せる。
【消滅時】≪セーブ≫（このカードを自分のテイマーの下に置ける）
localized.sourceEffect: 【アタック時】［ターンに1回］このデジモンが特徴に「ブルーフレア」を持ち、相手のデジモンが2体以上いるなら、このデジモンをアクティブにする。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、自分の「蒼沼キリハ」がいるとき、「自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の特徴に「ブルーフレア」を持つカード2枚を手札に加える」と「自分のトラッシュから、「メタルグレイモン」1枚を手札に戻せる」のどちらかを選んで行えるのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、どちらかを選んで行えます。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、オープンした4枚のカードの中に、特徴に「ブルーフレア」を持つカードが1枚しかなかった場合でも、手札に加えられますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
その場合、可能な限り手札に加えます。

localized.name: 그레이몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 특징으로 「블루 플레어」를 가진 카드 2장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 자신의 「차도혁」이 있을 때, 대신 자신의 트래시에서 「메탈그레이몬」 1장을 패로 되돌릴 수 있다. 【소멸 시】《세이브》(이 카드를 자신의 테이머 아래에 놓을 수 있다)
localized.sourceEffect: 【어택 시】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬이 특징으로 「블루 플레어」를 가지고, 상대 디지몬이 2마리 이상 있을 때, 이 디지몬을 액티브로 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】효과는 자신의 「차도혁」이 있을 때, 「자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 특징으로 「블루 플레어」를 가진 카드 2장을 패에 추가한다」와 「자신의 「차도혁」이 있을 때, 대신 자신의 트래시에서 「메탈그레이몬」 1장을 패로 되돌릴 수 있다.」 중 어느 쪽도 선택할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 어느 쪽이건 선택할 수 있습니다.

localized.name: 暴龙兽
localized.mainEffect:
【登场时】翻开我方卡组最上方的4张卡牌。将其中2张拥有“蓝色闪耀”特征的卡牌加入手牌。剩余的卡牌可自选顺序放回到卡组最下方。当我方的场上存在“苍沼切羽”时,可以改为从我方的废弃区中将1张“机械暴龙兽”放回到手牌中。

faqs.question: In order to <Draw 2> from this card's [When Digivolving] effect, do I need to have 6 or fewer cards in my hand after drawing the digivolution bonus card?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's right. <Draw 2> does not activate if you have 7 or more cards in your hand after drawing the digivolution bonus.

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、進化元のない相手のデジモンを対象にすることはできますか？
