localized.name: Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida
localized.mainEffect:
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon is played or digivolves, by suspending this Tamer, if you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory. If you have one with [Garurumon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name may attack a player.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to gain 2 memory if I have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and a Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's correct.

faqs.question: When I play a Digimon with [Greymon] or [Garurumon] in its name, then its DP becomes 0 and is deleted upon play due to a persistent effect, can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if the played Digimon is removed before the effect activates, it triggers because the "when [...] Digimon is played" condition is met, then the effect can activate. However, the "if you have a Digimon with [XX] in its name" condition is no longer met once the Digimon is removed, therefore you don't gain 1 memory.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack using my Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name even when it's suspended?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [End of Your Turn] effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

faqs.question: I attacked using BT5-086 [Omnimon]'s <Blitz> and unsuspended it using the other [When Digivolving] effect. After the attack ends, can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack again?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If BT5-086 [Omnimon] digivolves during the main phase, you can use the [End of Your Turn] effect to attack again after the attack from <Blitz> ends.

faqs.question: When I have 2 copies of this Tamer and 2 unsuspended Digimon with [Omnimon] in their names, can I activate the [End of Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and attack using both of the Digimon with [Omnimon] in their names?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
The effect will trigger on both copies, but after the attack declaration is made for the 1st [Omnimon] and effects such as [When Attacking] effects have finished activating, the effect on the 2nd copy of this card that was pending activation will activate before the counter timing. However, a new attack declaration can't be made during an attack, and only the 1st [Omnimon]'s attack can be performed as a result.

localized.name: 八神太一&石田ヤマト
localized.mainEffect:
【お互いのターン】自分のデジモンが登場/進化したとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、名称に「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。名称に「ガルルモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］名称に「オメガモン」を含む自分のデジモン1体でプレイヤーにアタックできる。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、名称に「グレイモン」を含むデジモンと名称に「ガルルモン」を含むデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+2できるのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、その通りです。

faqs.question: 名称に「グレイモン」か「ガルルモン」を含むデジモンを登場させました。このとき、常在型のDPマイナスする効果によって登場させたデジモンのDPが0になって消滅した場合、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮する前に登場したデジモンがいなくなっても、「デジモンが登場したとき」の条件で誘発しているため、発揮することができます。ただし、いなくなったことで「「○○」を含むデジモンがいるなら」の条件を満たせないため、メモリー+1することはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、名称に「オメガモン」を含む自分のデジモンがレスト状態でもアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果では、アタックできない状態にあるデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。

faqs.question: 「BT5-086 オメガモン」の≪進撃≫効果でアタックし、もう1つの【進化時】効果でアクティブになりました。アタックが終了した後に、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果で再度アタックすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
メインフェイズに「BT5-086 オメガモン」に進化した場合、≪進撃≫によるアタックが終了した後に、【自分のターン終了時】の効果でアタックすることができます。

faqs.question: このテイマーが2体いて、アクティブ状態の名称に「オメガモン」を含む自分のデジモンが2体いるとき、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】をそれぞれ発揮して、「オメガモン」を含むデジモン2体でそれぞれアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
効果は2体とも誘発しますが、1体目の「オメガモン」でアタック宣言し、【アタック時】効果などを発揮し終わった後、カウンタータイミングの前に発揮待ちだった2体目のこのカードの効果が発揮します。ですが、アタック中に新たなアタック宣言はできないため、結果として最初にアタックした「オメガモン」のアタックだけが行われます。

localized.name: Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When one of your level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, by suspending this Tamer, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from that Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] 1 of your [Free] trait Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to suspend this Tamer when my level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, even if I don't have any level 4 or lower Digimon cards in that Digimon's digivolution cards?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if the part after the conditions specified with "by X" in an effect can't be resolved, the effect can still activate.

faqs.question: When my level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to play a level 4 or lower Digimon card with <Retaliation> in its inherited effects from that Digimon's digivolution cards. Can I use <Retaliation> to delete the battled opponent's Digimon at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
The card is removed from digivolution cards before <Retaliation> can activate.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack even when the [Free] trait Digimon is suspended?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [End of Your Turn] effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

faqs.question: When I have 2 copies of this Tamer and 2 unsuspended [Free] trait Digimon, can I activate the [End of Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and attack using both of the [Free] trait Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
The effect will trigger on both copies, but after the attack declaration is made for the 1st Digimon and effects such as [When Attacking] effects have finished activating, the effect on the 2nd copy of this card that was pending activation will activate before the counter timing. However, a new attack declaration can't be made during an attack, and only the 1st Digimon's attack can be performed as a result.

localized.name: 本宮大輔&一乗寺賢
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下なら、3にする。
【お互いのターン】特徴に「フリー」を持つLv.5以上の自分のデジモンがバトルで消滅するとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、そのデジモンの進化元から、Lv.4以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
【自分のターン終了時】特徴に「フリー」を持つ自分のデジモン1体で相手のデジモンにアタックできる。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、特徴に「フリー」を持つLv.5以上の自分のデジモンがバトルで消滅するとき、そのデジモンの進化元にLv.4以下のデジモンカードがいなくても、このテイマーをレストさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
「ことで」の効果で指定された条件は、その後に記載されている効果を解決できない状態でも発揮できます。

faqs.question: 特徴に「フリー」を持つLv.5以上の自分のデジモンがバトルに敗北して消滅するとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果でそのデジモンの進化元から、進化元効果に≪道連れ≫を持つLv.4以下のデジモンカードを登場させました。この時、バトルした相手のデジモンを≪道連れ≫の効果で消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
≪道連れ≫が発揮する前に進化元からいなくなっているため、効果を発揮できません。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、特徴に「フリー」を持つデジモンがレスト状態でもアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果では、アタックできない状態にあるデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。

faqs.question: このテイマーが2体いて、アクティブ状態の特徴に「フリー」を持つ自分のデジモンが2体いるとき、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】をそれぞれ発揮して、特徴に「フリー」を持つデジモン2体でそれぞれアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
効果は2体とも誘発しますが、1体目のデジモンでアタック宣言し、【アタック時】効果などを発揮し終わった後、カウンタータイミングの前に発揮待ちだった2体目のこのカードの効果が発揮します。ですが、アタック中に新たなアタック宣言はできないため、結果として最初にアタックしたデジモンのアタックだけが行われます。

localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Main] By placing this Tamer and 1 [Kyubimon] and 1 [Taomon] from your trash as 1 of your [Renamon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [Sakuyamon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring its digivolution requirements. faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to place this Tamer and 1 [Kyubimon] and 1 [Taomon] from my trash as my [Renamon]'s bottom digivolution cards, but then choose to not digivolve into [Sakuyamon]?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect reads "may digivolve," so you can choose whether or not to digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve 1 of my [Renamon] into EX4-030 [Kuzuhamon]?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
EX4-030 [Kuzuhamon] is treated as if it has [Sakuyamon] in its name. This effect doesn't treat it as if it has the name [Sakuyamon], therefore digivolution isn't possible.

「進化できる」効果なので、条件を満たした後、進化するかどうかは選択できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、自分の「レナモン」1体から「EX4-030 クズハモン」に進化することはできますか？

いいえ、できません。

【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。
【メイン】このテイマーと自分のトラッシュの「キュウビモン」と「タオモン」1枚ずつを自分の「レナモン」1体の進化元の下に置くことで、そのデジモンを手札の「サクヤモン」に進化条件を無視して進化コスト4で進化できる。この効果で進化したなら、自分のトラッシュから、オプションカード1枚を手札に戻せる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、このテイマーと自分のトラッシュの「キュウビモン」と「タオモン」1枚ずつを自分の「レナモン」1体の進化元の下に置き、「サクヤモン」に進化させない、ということはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
「進化できる」効果なので、条件を満たした後、進化するかどうかは選択できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、自分の「レナモン」1体から「EX4-030 クズハモン」に進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「EX4-030 クズハモン」は名称に「サクヤモン」を含むものとして扱います。これは名称「サクヤモン」として扱える効果ではないので、進化することはできません。

localized.name: Marcus Damon
localized.mainEffect:
[On Play] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve and gains ＜Blocker＞.
[All Turns] When this Tamer becomes suspended, 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. If you have a Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both. 
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?May. 8, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect. 
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten. 
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

localized.name: 大門大
localized.mainEffect:
【登場時】相手のターン終了まで、自分の「大門大」1体はデジモン・DP3000としても扱い、進化できず、≪ブロッカー≫を得る。
【お互いのターン】このテイマーがレストしたとき、ターン終了まで、自分のデジモン1体をDP+3000。名称に「アグモン」/「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でテイマーをデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合、テイマーではなくなりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、デジモンとテイマー両方として扱います。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でテイマーをデジモンとしても扱うようになった場合、そのカードが発揮した効果の種類はデジモンの効果とテイマーの効果両方として扱われますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、両方の効果として扱います。
デジモンとテイマー両方として扱われていますので、発揮した効果はデジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方として扱います。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとしても扱うようになったテイマーは、他の効果でDPが0になった場合、ルールチェックで消滅しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、ルールチェックのタイミングで消滅します。

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとしても扱うようになったテイマーが、あとから他の効果で「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果を受けた場合、どうなりますか？2026/05/08 更新
faqs.answer:
誘発した効果で「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果を受けた場合、登場コスト・Lv.・DPは、あとから受けた効果に上書きされます。

[Your Turn] When an effect places a Tamer card in one of your Digimon's digivolution cards, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] If this Tamer is suspended, 1 of your Digimon with a Tamer card in its digivolution cards may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name in the trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name in the trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

localized.name: 龍泉寺智則
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン】効果で自分のデジモンの進化元にテイマーカードが置かれたとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、メモリー+1。
【相手のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］このテイマーがレスト状態なら、進化元にテイマーカードがある自分のデジモン1体をトラッシュの名称に「デクス」を含むデジモンカードにコストを支払わずに進化できる。

localized.name: 류센지 토모노리
localized.mainEffect: 【자신의 턴】자신의 디지몬의 진화원에 테이머 카드가 효과로 놓였을 때, 이 테이머를 레스트시키는 것으로, 메모리 +1. 【상대의 턴 종료 시】［턴에 1회］이 테이머가 레스트 상태라면, 진화원에 테이머 카드가 있는 자신의 디지몬 1마리를 트래시의 명칭에 「데크스」를 포함하는 디지몬 카드로 코스트를 지불하지 않고 진화시킬 수 있다.

localized.name: 龙泉寺智则
localized.mainEffect:
【我方的回合】当我方数码宝贝的进化源中因效果被放置驯兽师卡牌时,可将此驯兽师转换为休息状态,并使内存值+1。
【对方的回合结束时】[每回合1次]若此驯兽师处于休息状态,则可以不支付费用将我方1只进化源中存在驯兽师卡牌的数码宝贝进化成废弃区中的名称中包含“死X”的数码宝贝卡牌。

[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Main] ＜Mind Link＞ with 1 of your Digimon with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait. (Place this Tamer as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card if there are no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.) ⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [Eiji Nagasumi].

localized.name: クラッカー・ファング
localized.mainEffect:
【セキュリティ】このカードをコストを支払わずに登場させる。
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下なら、3にする。
【メイン】特徴に「魔獣型」/「SoC」を持つ自分のデジモン1体に≪マインドリンク≫（このテイマーを、進化元にテイマーカードが無いそのデジモンの進化元の下に置く）。
〈ルール〉名称:「永住瑛士」としても扱う。
localized.sourceEffect:
【お互いのターン】このデジモンが特徴に「魔獣型」/「SoC」を持つ間、このデジモンは≪連携≫と≪ブロッカー≫を得る。
【お互いのターン終了時】このデジモンの進化元から、「永住瑛士」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果の【お互いのターン終了時】効果は、このカードがデジモンの進化元にあるとき、このカード自身を登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 크래커 팽
localized.mainEffect: 【시큐리티】이 카드를 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다. 【자신의 턴 개시 시】메모리가 2 이하라면, 3으로 한다. 【메인】특징으로 「마수형」/「SoC」를 가진 자신의 디지몬 1마리에게 《마인드 링크》(이 테이머를 진화원에 테이머 카드가 없는 디지몬의 진화원 아래에 놓는다). 〈룰〉명칭: 「나가스미 에이지」로도 취급한다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】특징으로 「마수형」/「SoC」를 가진 이 디지몬은 《연계》와 《블로커》를 얻는다. 【서로의 턴 종료 시】이 디지몬의 진화원에서 「나가스미 에이지」 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

localized.name: 破解者·利齿
localized.mainEffect:
【安防】不支付费用登场此卡牌。

【我方的回合开始时】若内存值不多于2,则将内存值变为3。

【主要】与我方1只拥有“魔兽型”/“SoC”特征的数码宝贝《意识链接》（将此驯兽师置于该进化源中没有驯兽师卡牌的数码宝贝的进化源最下方）。

〈规则〉名称:也视为“永住瑛士”。
localized.sourceEffect:
【双方的回合】此数码宝贝拥有“魔兽型”/“SoC”特征的期间,此数码宝贝获得≪联协≫和≪阻挡者≫效果。
【双方的回合结束时】可以从此数码宝贝的进化源中,不支付费用登场1张“永住瑛士”。

localized.name: Menoa Bellucci
localized.mainEffect:
[On Play] By trashing 1 [Morphomon] or [Eosmon] in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
[All Turns] While you have [Eosmon], none of your opponent's Tamers' [On Play] effects activate.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your [Eosmon] would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by deleting 1 of your other [Eosmon], prevent it from leaving.

faqs.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also prevent [Main] effects from activating if they have multiple activation timings such as [On Play] [Main]?
faqs.answer:
No, they can activate. 
This card's [All Turns] effect only prevents effects from activating at the [On Play] timing. Effects can still activate at the [Main] timing.

faqs.question: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when that Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

localized.mainEffect:
【登場時】自分の手札から、「モルフォモン」/「エオスモン」1枚を破棄することで、≪2ドロー≫。
【お互いのターン】自分の「エオスモン」がいる間、相手のテイマー全ての【登場時】効果は発揮しない。
【相手のターン】［ターンに1回］自分の「エオスモン」が相手の効果でバトルエリアを離れるとき、他の自分の「エオスモン」1体を消滅させることで、離れない。

faqs.question: 【登場時】【メイン】効果のように、複数のタイミングを持つ効果を【メイン】のタイミングで発揮する場合も、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で発揮しなくなりますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できます。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は【登場時】のタイミングで発揮する効果が発揮しない効果なので、【メイン】のタイミングであれば、発揮します。

faqs.question: このカードの「バトルエリアを離れるとき」とは、具体的にどういうときを指すのですか？
faqs.answer: 「バトルエリアを離れるとき」は、そのデジモンが、「トラッシュに置かれる」「手札・デッキに戻る」「セキュリティに置かれる」「育成エリアに移動する」「他のカードの下に置かれる」のいずれかのときを指します。

faqs.question: Is this card's [All Turns] effect triggered by "play into an empty space in your breeding area without paying the cost" effects?

No, it doesn't trigger. 
Effects that play into the breeding area aren't considered hatching, so it doesn't trigger this effect.

localized.mainEffect:

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、自分のトラッシュからデジモンカード1枚を手札に戻さずに、特徴に「十闘士」を持つデジモンカード1枚か進化元効果を持つテイマーカード1枚を登場させることはできますか？

faqs.question: このカードの「進化元効果を持つテイマーカード」とは具体的にどういうカードなのですか？
faqs.answer:
テイマーカードの下段テキストに「進化元効果」が記載されているカードです。
下段テキストに【セキュリティ】効果が記載されているテイマーカードは、「進化元効果を持つテイマーカード」ではありません。

localized.name: Miraculous Mega Knight
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Agumon] or [Gabumon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your level 6 Digimon with [Greymon] or [Garurumon] in its name would leave the battle area outside of a battle, ＜Delay＞.
・That Digimon and a card in the hand may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name in the hand.

faqs.question: If I use this card's <Delay> to DNA digivolve to DNA digivolve using 2 Digimon including one that would leave the battle area, does the DNA digivolved Digimon leave the battle area?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't leave the battle area. 
DNA digivolution results in a digivolution into a new Digimon that is considered a different Digimon from the one that would leave the battle area.

faqs.question: With this card's <Delay> effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn't have [DNA Digivolution]?
faqs.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can't DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn't have [DNA Digivolution].

faqs.question: Does this card's <Delay> effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?
faqs.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can't DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren't specified in [DNA Digivolution].

faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] would be deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, but if you use this card's effect to digivolve first, the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] will be negated and won't activate.

faqs.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect can't be activated because it doesn't trigger when the Digimon is deleted by an opponent's effect.

faqs.question: When a Digimon with BT16-025 [Paildramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, and the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] can be activated, even if you use this card's effect to digivolve first.

faqs.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted at the same time other than by one of my effects, can I digivolve all of those Digimon and prevent them from being deleted?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
1 digivolution can only be performed on 1 Digimon. You can't perform separate digivolutions on multiple cards at the same time. 
Therefore, when multiples of your Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of your effects, you can only use this card's effect to digivolve 1 of those Digimon. 
In addition, only the digivolved Digimon is prevented from being deleted.

faqs.question:
[All Turns] When my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of my effects during my opponent's turn, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve that Digimon into EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode]. 
Can I then use <Blitz> in EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode]'s [When Digivolving] effect to attack?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Only the turn player can attack. 
In this case, your EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] can't attack because it isn't your turn.

localized.mainEffect:
[Main] 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 5 or higher Digimon card with the [Free] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 4. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by your effects, ＜Delay＞.
・By digivolving one of those Digimon into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost, they aren't deleted.

faqs.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a level 5 or higher Digimon card with the [Free] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] would be deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, but if you use this card's effect to digivolve first, the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] will be negated and won't activate.

faqs.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect can't be activated because it doesn't trigger when the Digimon is deleted by an opponent's effect.

faqs.question: When a Digimon with BT16-025 [Paildramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, and the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] can be activated, even if you use this card's effect to digivolve first.

faqs.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted at the same time other than by one of my effects, can I digivolve all of those Digimon and prevent them from being deleted?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
1 digivolution can only be performed on 1 Digimon. You can't perform separate digivolutions on multiple cards at the same time. 
Therefore, when multiples of your Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of your effects, you can only use this card's effect to digivolve 1 of those Digimon. 
In addition, only the digivolved Digimon is prevented from being deleted.

faqs.question:
[All Turns] When my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of my effects during my opponent's turn, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve that Digimon into EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode]. 
Can I then use <Blitz> in EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode]'s [When Digivolving] effect to attack?Jun. 21, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Only the turn player can attack. 
In this case, your EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] can't attack because it isn't your turn.

localized.name: 始祖への回帰
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデジモン1体を手札の特徴に「フリー」を持つLv.5以上のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-4で進化できる。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【お互いのターン】特徴に「フリー」を持つ自分のデジモンが自分の効果以外で消滅するとき、≪ディレイ≫。
・そのデジモンを手札の名称に「インペリアルドラモン」を含むデジモンカードにコストを支払わずに進化させることで、消滅しない。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、手札の特徴に「フリー」を持つLv.5以上のデジモンカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【メイン】効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、手札の名称に「インペリアルドラモン」を含むデジモンカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: 「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」が相手の効果で消滅するとき、このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で進化させた後に、「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」が持っていた≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫を発揮できますか？2024/06/21 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できません。
≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫とこのカードの≪ディレイ≫効果は同時誘発となりますが、先にこのカードの効果で進化した場合、誘発していた「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」の≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫がなくなっているため、発揮できません。

faqs.question: 「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」が相手の効果で消滅するとき、このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で進化させた後に、「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」の進化元効果の≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫を発揮できますか？2024/05/24 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できません。
相手の効果で消滅する時点で、「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」の進化元効果の≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫は誘発していないため、発揮できません。

faqs.question: 進化元に「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」を持つデジモンが相手の効果で消滅するとき、このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で進化させた後に、「BT16-025 パイルドラモン」の進化元効果の≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫を発揮できますか？2024/05/24 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫とこのカードの≪ディレイ≫効果は同時誘発となり、先にこのカードの効果で進化した場合でも、そのあとに、同時誘発している≪パーティション《青Lv.4&緑Lv.4》≫を発揮できます。

faqs.question: 自分の特徴に「フリー」を持つデジモンが自分の効果以外で複数体同時に消滅するとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮させた場合、それら全てのデジモンを進化させ、消滅しなくすることはできますか？2024/06/21 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
進化は、1回の進化につき1体だけ行えます。同時に複数体のカードを、別々に進化させることはできません。
そのため、特徴に「フリー」を持つデジモンが自分の効果以外で複数体消滅するとき、このカードの効果で進化させることができるのはその中の1体のみです。
また、進化させたデジモンのみが消滅しません。

faqs.question:
相手のターン中、自分の特徴に「フリー」を持つデジモンが自分の効果以外で消滅するとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果でそのデジモンを「EX3-063 インペリアルドラモン:ドラゴンモード」に進化させました。
このとき、「EX3-063 インペリアルドラモン:ドラゴンモード」の【進化時】効果の≪進撃≫でアタックできますか？2024/06/21 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
アタックは、ターンプレイヤーのみ行うことができます。
この状況の場合、自分のターンではないため、自分の「EX3-063 インペリアルドラモン:ドラゴンモード」をアタックさせることはできません。

localized.name: Hacker Pride
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・By placing the top card of 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text on top of your security stack, gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to place a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text and no digivolution cards on top of my security stack?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
"Top card" refers to 1 or more cards with cards underneath it.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to place a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text that has just 1 Tamer card under it on top of the security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
After you place it on top of the security stack, the Tamer card will become the top card and it will remain in the battle area as a Tamer.

localized.name: ハッカーの矜持
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から3枚オープンする。その中の「パルスモン」の記述があるカード1枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫
・「パルスモン」の記述があるLv.4以上の自分のデジモンに重ねられているカードを上から1枚自分のセキュリティの上に置くことで、メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、進化元を持たない「パルスモン」の記述があるデジモンカードを自分のセキュリティの上に置けますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、置けません。
1枚以上、下にカードが置かれているカードでなければ、「重ねられているカード」ではありません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、下にテイマーカード1枚だけがある「パルスモン」の記述があるデジモンカードをセキュリティの上に置けますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、置けます。
セキュリティの上に置いたことでテイマーカードが一番上になるので、そのカードはテイマーとしてバトルエリアに残ります。

localized.name: 해커의 긍지
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 그중 「펄스몬」이 기술되어 있는 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【메인】《딜레이》 ・「펄스몬」이 기술되어 있는 Lv.4 이상의 자신의 디지몬에 겹쳐져 있는 카드를 위에서부터 1장 시큐리티 위에 놓는 것으로, 메모리 +2.

localized.name: 黑客的骄傲
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。将其中1张记述有“脉冲兽”的卡牌加入手牌。剩余的卡牌放回到卡组最下方。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。
【主要】《延迟》
·可将重叠在我方记述有“脉冲兽”的Lv.4或更高等级的数码宝贝最上方的1张卡牌置于我方安防区最上方,并使内存值+2。

localized.name: Awakening of the Sun
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] or [Rhythm] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Tamers is deleted or returned to the hand, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name, what area does the card with [ShineGreymon] in its name come from?
faqs.answer:
It comes from the cards in your hand. 
This card's <Delay> effect has been changed to "1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost." 
Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.

localized.name: Doomsday Clock
localized.mainEffect:
[Security] Add this card to the hand.
[Main] Play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. Then, place this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name and without [Doomsday Clock] in its digivolution cards. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv. 6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
[Start of Your Turn] If your battle area has 4 placed [Doomsday Clock]s, you win the game.
localized.sourceEffect:
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by deleting 1 of your other [Diaboromon], prevent it from leaving.
[End of Opponent's Turn] Place 1 [Doomsday Clock] from this Digimon's digivolution cards in the battle area.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to place this card in the digivolution cards of a [Diaboromon] Token that was played by this effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Cards can't be placed under tokens.

faqs.question: What does "you win the game" in this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: When this effect activates, the player that activated the effect wins the game.

faqs.question: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when that Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

faqs.question: Can I use the [End of Opponent's Turn] effect in this card's inherited effects to place this card itself in the battle area when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: 終末のトケイ
localized.mainEffect:
【セキュリティ】このカードを手札に加える。
【メイン】「ディアボロモン」（デジモン・14コスト・Lv.6・白・究極体・不明・種族不明・DP3000）のトークン1体をコストを支払わずに登場させる。その後、このカードを進化元に「終末のトケイ」がない名称に「ディアボロモン」を含む自分のデジモン1体の進化元の下に置く。
【自分のターン開始時】自分のバトルエリアに置かれている「終末のトケイ」が4枚あるなら、自分はゲームに勝利する。
localized.sourceEffect:
【お互いのターン】このデジモンが相手の効果でバトルエリアを離れるとき、他の自分の「ディアボロモン」1体を消滅させることで、離れない。
【相手のターン終了時】このデジモンの進化元から、「終末のトケイ」1枚をバトルエリアに置く。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、この効果で登場させた「ディアボロモン」トークンの進化元にこのカードを置くことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
トークンの下にカードを置くことはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン開始時】効果の「自分はゲームに勝利する。」とは、どういう意味ですか？
faqs.answer: この効果を発揮したら、発揮したプレイヤーがゲームに勝利する効果です。

faqs.question: このカードの「バトルエリアを離れるとき」とは、具体的にどういうときを指すのですか？
faqs.answer: 「バトルエリアを離れるとき」は、そのデジモンが、「トラッシュに置かれる」「手札・デッキに戻る」「セキュリティに置かれる」「育成エリアに移動する」「他のカードの下に置かれる」のいずれかのときを指します。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果の【相手のターン終了時】効果は、このカードがデジモンの進化元にあるとき、このカード自身をバトルエリアに置くことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 종말의 시계
localized.mainEffect: 【시큐리티】이 카드를 패에 추가한다. 【메인】「디아블로몬」(디지몬・14 코스트・Lv.6・화이트・궁극체・불명・종족불명・DP 3000)토큰 1마리를 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다. 그 후, 이 카드를 진화원에 「종말의 시계」가 없는 명칭에 「디아블로몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬의 진화원 아래에 놓는다. 【자신의 턴 개시 시】배틀 에어리어에 자신의 「종말의 시계」가 4장 있다면, 자신은 게임에서 승리한다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】이 디지몬이 상대의 효과로 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 다른 자신의 「디아블로몬」 1마리를 소멸시키는 것으로, 벗어나지 않는다. 【상대의 턴 종료 시】이 디지몬의 진화원에서 「종말의 시계」 1장을 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다.

faqs.answer:

sourceNotes: ブースターパック シークレットクライシス  [BT-17]

localized.name: グレイモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】名称に「アグモン」を含むLv.3:コスト2
【進化時】このデジモンの名称が「コロモン」なら、ターン終了まで、このデジモンをDP+3000。その後、このデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
【お互いのターン】このデジモンはこのデジモンの進化元にあるLv.3以下のカードの名称全てを得る。
【消滅時】自分の手札から、名称に「八神太一」/「八神ヒカリ」を含むテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場するか、自分の育成エリアに孵化できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【消滅時】自分の手札から、名称に「八神太一」/「八神ヒカリ」を含むテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場するか、自分の育成エリアに孵化できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
『自分の手札から「八神太一」か「八神ヒカリ」を含むテイマーカードを登場させる』か、『育成エリアに孵化できる』のどちらかを選んで処理できる効果です。
この効果はどちらかを選んで処理するか、発揮せずどれも処理しないことが可能です。

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

sourceAttributes.type: 幼虫型/X抗体/ローヤルベース

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

localized.mainEffect: [All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects.

faqs.question: What does the "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: With this effect, your opponent's memory will no longer increase by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects the opponent player.

faqs.question: Can I use the [All Turns] effect on BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] to gain memory if it's treated as a Digimon and suspends while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can gain memory. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

localized.mainEffect: 【お互いのターン】相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない。

faqs.question: 「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 相手はテイマーの効果を除く、全ての効果でメモリーがプラスできなくなる効果です。この効果は、相手プレイヤーに影響を及ぼします。

faqs.question: 相手の「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」効果が発揮されている間、デジモンとして扱われている「BT17-087 大門大」がレストしたとき、「BT17-087 大門大」の【お互いのターン】効果でメモリーをプラスできないのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモンとテイマーの両方として扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

faqs.question: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
faqs.answer:
No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

faqs.question: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you do.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?

localized.name: 카이젤그레이몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】특징으로 「하이브리드체」를 가진 카드가 아래에 5장 있는 「우정훈」 코스트 5【진화 시】이 디지몬의 진화원의 색 1색마다 상대의 디지몬의 진화원을 선택하여 1장 파기하고, 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시킨다. 그 후, 이 디지몬으로 어택할 수 있다. 【자신의 턴】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬이 배틀에서 상대의 디지몬을 소멸시켰을 때, 이 디지몬을 액티브로 하고, 턴 종료까지 《S 어택 +1》을 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화 조건은 특징으로 「하이브리드체」를 가진 카드가 아래에 5장보다 많은 「우정훈」에서도, 진화 코스트5로 진화할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 다른 카드 효과로 ≪관통≫을 얻어 있는 이 카드가 어택한 배틀로 상대의 디지몬을 소멸시켰을 때, 이 카드의 【자신의 턴】효과를 발휘하고 ≪관통≫으로 체크합니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 【자신의 턴】효과를 발휘하고 ≪관통≫으로 체크합니다. 이 카드의 【자신의 턴】효과와 ≪관통≫은 동시 유발하지만 발휘한 ≪관통≫은 어택 종료 시의 직전에 처리되기 때문에 이 카드의 【자신의 턴】효과로 ≪S어택+1≫을 얻은 뒤 ≪관통≫으로 체크합니다.

faqs.question: 「BT18-088 우정훈&선우현」에서 이 카드로 진화하여 메모리가 상대측의 1이상이 되어 있는 상황입니다. 이때, 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과로 어택하여 이 카드의 【자신의 턴】효과로 액티브됩니다. 그 뒤에 이 카드의 진화원에 있는 「BT18-088 우정훈&선우현」의 진화원의 【자신의 턴 종료 시】효과로, 플레이어에 어택할 수는 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 어택할 수 있습니다. 이 카드로 진화하여 그것에 의해 일어나는 처리가 전부 해결되기까지 아직 턴 종료 조건을 만족하지 않습니다. 이 상황의 경우, 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과와 【자신의 턴】효과나 그것에 의해 일어나는 효과 등을 전부 해결하고, 턴 종료 조건을 만족합니다. 그 뒤에 턴 종료 시가 되어, 「BT18-088 우정훈&선우현」 【자신의 턴 종료 시】효과가 유발합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】 효과는 이 카드의 진화원의 색이 3색 있을 경우, 상대 디지몬의 진화원을 골라 3장 파기하고, 상대의 디지몬을 3마리 선택하고 레스트시킵니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 이 카드의 진화원의 색 1색 당, 상대 디지몬의 진화원을 골라 1장 파기하고, 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시킵니다.

localized.mainEffect:

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if DNA digivolving, by returning 1 of each Digimon card with different levels from your opponent's trash to the top of the deck, gain 1 memory for each returned card.

<DigiXros -2> [Kimeramon]×[Machinedramon]

faqs.question:
My opponent has just 1 level 3 Digimon card in their trash. 
When DNA digivolving into this card and using this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 1 of each Digimon card with different levels from my opponent's trash to the top of the deck, can I return just 1 of those level 3 Digimon cards to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
My opponent has 1 level 3 Digimon card and 1 level 4 Digimon card in their trash. 
When DNA digivolving into this card and using this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 1 of each Digimon card with different levels from my opponent's trash to the top of the deck, can I return just 1 level 3 Digimon card to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If they have Digimon cards with different levels, you must choose and return 1 of each when possible. 
However, if you don't process this effect, you don't return any cards to the top of the deck.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?Mar. 13, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to return just 1 [Kimeramon] or 1 [Machinedramon] from my trash?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
In order for the conditions for this card's [On Deletion] effect to be met, you must return 1 [Kimeramon] and 1 [Machinedramon].

localized.name: ミレニアモン
localized.mainEffect:
【ジョグレス】「キメラモン」+「ムゲンドラモン」:コスト0
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。その後、ジョグレス進化していたなら、相手のトラッシュから、Lv.の異なるデジモンカード1枚ずつをデッキの上に戻すことで、戻した1枚ごとに、メモリー+1。
【消滅時】自分のトラッシュから、「キメラモン」と「ムゲンドラモン」1枚ずつをデッキの下に戻すことで、自分のトラッシュから、「ミレニアモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
≪≪デジクロス-2≫≫:「キメラモン」×「ムゲンドラモン」

faqs.question:
相手のトラッシュがLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみの状況です。
このカードにジョグレス進化し、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で相手のトラッシュからLv.の異なるデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻す際、そのLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみでもデッキの上に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question:
相手のトラッシュにLv.3とLv.4のデジモンカードが1枚ずつある状況です。
このカードにジョグレス進化し、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で相手のトラッシュからLv.の異なるデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻す際、そのLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみをデッキの上に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
Lv.の異なるデジモンカードがある場合、それらを可能な限り選び、デッキの上に戻します。
ただし、この効果を処理しない場合は、1枚もデッキの上に戻しません。

faqs.question:
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮して、1つ目の処理で相手のデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、「離れるとき」などの他の即時型効果でこのカードがバトルエリアから離れました。
そのあとに、この効果の「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？2026/03/13 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮した場合、発揮したカードが効果の途中でその場所を離れた場合でも、最後まで解決します。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果の条件は、自分のトラッシュから「キメラモン」か「ムゲンドラモン」のどちらか1枚だけ戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【消滅時】効果の条件の場合、「キメラモン」1枚と「ムゲンドラモン」1枚の両方を戻す必要があります。

【ジョグレス】「キメラモン」+「ムゲンドラモン」:コスト0
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。その後、ジョグレス進化していたなら、相手のトラッシュから、Lv.の異なるデジモンカード1枚ずつをデッキの上に戻すことで、戻した1枚ごとに、メモリー+1。
【消滅時】自分のトラッシュから、「キメラモン」と「ムゲンドラモン」1枚ずつをデッキの下に戻すことで、自分のトラッシュから、「ミレニアモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
≪≪デジクロス-2≫≫:「キメラモン」×「ムゲンドラモン」

faqs.question:
相手のトラッシュがLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみの状況です。
このカードにジョグレス進化し、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で相手のトラッシュからLv.の異なるデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻す際、そのLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみでもデッキの上に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question:
相手のトラッシュにLv.3とLv.4のデジモンカードが1枚ずつある状況です。
このカードにジョグレス進化し、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で相手のトラッシュからLv.の異なるデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻す際、そのLv.3のデジモンカード1枚のみをデッキの上に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
Lv.の異なるデジモンカードがある場合、それらを可能な限り選び、デッキの上に戻します。
ただし、この効果を処理しない場合は、1枚もデッキの上に戻しません。

faqs.question:
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮して、1つ目の処理で相手のデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、「離れるとき」などの他の即時型効果でこのカードがバトルエリアから離れました。
そのあとに、この効果の「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？2026/03/13 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮した場合、発揮したカードが効果の途中でその場所を離れた場合でも、最後まで解決します。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果の条件は、自分のトラッシュから「キメラモン」か「ムゲンドラモン」のどちらか1枚だけ戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【消滅時】効果の条件の場合、「キメラモン」1枚と「ムゲンドラモン」1枚の両方を戻す必要があります。

localized.name: 밀레니엄몬
localized.mainEffect: 【조그레스】「키메라몬」+「파워드라몬」 코스트 0【등장 시】【진화 시】상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 그 후, 조그레스 진화하고 있었다면, 상대의 트래시에서 Lv.이 서로 다른 디지몬 카드 1장씩을 덱 위로 되돌리는 것으로, 되돌린 1장마다 메모리 +1. 【소멸 시】자신의 트래시에서 「키메라몬」과 「파워드라몬」 1장씩을 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로, 자신의 트래시에서 「밀레니엄몬」 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.≪디지크로스 -2≫ 「키메라몬」×「파워드라몬」

faqs.question: 이 카드로 조그레스 진화하여 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로 상대의 트래시에서 Lv.가 다른 디지몬 카드를 덱 위로 되돌릴 때, 디지타마 카드를 덱 위로 되돌릴 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 되돌릴 카드는 디지몬 카드뿐입니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드로 조그레스 진화하여 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로 상대의 트래시에서 Lv.가 다른 디지몬 카드를 덱 위로 되돌릴 때, Lv.을 갖지 않는 디지몬 카드를 덱 위로 되돌릴 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 되돌릴 카드는 Lv.을 가진 디지몬 카드뿐입니다. 「Lv.-」 디지몬 카드를 되돌릴 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【소멸 시】효과로 자신의 트래시에서 「키메라몬」과 「파워드라몬」을 덱 아래로 되돌릴 때, 이 카드의 진화원에 있을 「키메라몬」과 「파워드라몬」을 덱 아래로 되돌릴 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 이 카드의 진화원에 있을 카드는 소멸한 시점에 동시에 트래시에 놓여 있기 때문에 덱 아래로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【소멸 시】효과의 조건은 자신의 트래시에서 「키메라몬」이나 「파워드라몬」 어느 쪽 1장만 되돌릴 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 「것으로」 조건은 그 내용을 일부만 실행할 수 없습니다. 이 【소멸 시】효과의 조건의 경우, 「키메라몬」 1장과 「파워드라몬」 1장인 양쪽을 되돌릴 필요가 있습니다.

localized.name: Kumamon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Tommy Himi]: Cost 2/[Korikakumon]: Cost 0
[When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon or Tamers may digivolve into a blue or red Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1. ⟨Rule⟩ Trait: Has [Ice-Snow] Type.
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: チャックモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「氷見友樹」:コスト2/「ブリザーモン」:コスト0
【進化時】相手のデジモン1体の進化元を下から2枚破棄する。
【アタック時】［ターンに1回］自分のデジモン/テイマー1体を手札の特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つ青/赤のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-1で進化できる。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「氷雪型」を持つ。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】このデジモンが自分の効果以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、進化元効果を持つテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

faqs.question: If an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards obtains a digivolution card after this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, can that Digimon suspend?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can suspend. 
This card's "none of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can suspend" effect only affects Digimon with no digivolution cards. 
If a Digimon later obtains a digivolution card, this effect will no longer affect it.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: If cards that are targets of this effect are found in my security stack, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?
faqs.answer:
No, you can also choose to not add them to your hand. 
If you don't add them, you shuffle your security stack without gaining <Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫>.

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？

そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、セキュリティを確認した中に対象のカードがあれば、可能な限り手札に加えますか？

いいえ、加えないことも選択することができます。
加えなかった場合、≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫をせず、セキュリティをシャッフルします。

faqs.question: What does the "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
Such effects change the original DP shown on the target card to the predetermined value shown in the effect. 
For example, if a Digimon has an original DP of 8000 and it's chosen as the target for a "[Main] Change the original DP of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to 3000 until the end of their turn" effect, that Digimon's original DP will become 3000 instead of 8000.

faqs.question: What happens if a Digimon that got +1000 DP has its original DP changed by the "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect?
faqs.answer:
Its original DP is changed, then +1000 is added to the changed DP. 
Values added to DP don't affect the original DP.

faqs.question: What happens if a Digimon has its original DP changed and is then affected by a "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect again?
faqs.answer: The original DP is changed to the most recent value.

faqs.question: Can a Digimon without DP be affected by the "change 1 Digimon's original DP" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
Effects that change information can't change information that a card didn't originally have. 
For example, if a Digimon has its original DP changed by an effect and then its top card becomes a card without DP due to a <De-Digivolve> effect, it will no longer be affected by the effect that changes the original DP.

faqs.question: 「元々のDPを変更する」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードに記載されている元々のDPを、その効果で決められた数値に変更する効果です。
例えば、元々のDPが8000のデジモンを「【メイン】次の相手のターン終了時まで、相手のデジモン1体の元々のDPを3000に変更する。」で選んだ場合、そのデジモンの元々のDPが8000ではなく3000になります。

faqs.question: DPが+1000されているデジモンのDPを、「元々のDPを変更する」効果で変更した場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
元々のDPが変更され、そのDPの数値に+1000します。
加えられている数値は元々のDPには含みません。

faqs.question: 元々のDPが効果で変更されているデジモンのDPを、再度「元々のDPを変更する」効果で変更した場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 最後に変更された数値に上書きされます。

faqs.question: DPを持たないデジモンのDPを「元々のDPを変更する」効果で変更できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
カードの情報を変更する効果で、元々カードが持たない情報を変更することはできません。
例えば、効果で元々のDPが変更されているデジモンが、≪退化≫でDPを持たないカードになった場合、そのカードのDPは変更できません。

faqs.question: 「원래 DP를 바꾼다」는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 그 카드로 기재되어 있는 원래 DP를 그 효과에 정해진 수치로 바꾸는 효과입니다. 예를 들어, 원래 DP가 8000인 디지몬을 「【메인】다음 상대의 턴 종료 시까지 상대의 디지몬 1마리의 원래 DP를 3000으로 바꾼다.」로 선택한 경우, 그 디지몬의 원래 DP가 8000이 아니라 3000으로 됩니다.

faqs.question: DP가 +1000되어 있는 디지몬의 DP를 「원래 DP를 바꾼다」 효과로 변경한 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 원래 DP가 변경되어 그 DP 수치에서 +1000합니다. 부여되어 있는 수치는 원래 DP에는 포함되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 원래 DP가 효과로 변경되어 있는 디지몬의 DP를 다시 「원래 DP를 바꾼다」 효과로 변경한 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 마지막에 변경된 수치로 덮어씌워집니다.

faqs.question: DP를 갖지 않는 디지몬의 DP를 「원래 DP를 바꾼다」 효과로 변경할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 카드의 정보를 바꾸는 효과로, 원래 카드가 갖지 않는 정보를 바꿀 수 없습니다. 예를 들어, 효과로 원래 DP가 변경되어 있는 디지몬이 ≪퇴화≫로 DP를 갖지 않는 카드가 되었을 경우, 그 카드의 DP는 변경할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
faqs.answer:
No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

faqs.question: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you do.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: マグナガルルモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つカードが下に5枚ある「源輝二」:コスト5
【進化時】【相手のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］このデジモンの進化元から、デジモンカード1枚をセキュリティの下に置くことで、置いたカードと同じLv.の相手のデジモン全てを消滅させる。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］デジモンがアタックしたとき、自分のセキュリティを上から1枚手札に加えることで、このデジモンをアクティブにする。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化する進化条件は進化元となるテイマーをデジモンとしても扱い進化しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、テイマーからそのまま進化します。デジモンが進化するとは扱わず、「デジモンが進化するとき」効果や「デジモンが進化したとき」効果は誘発しません。
また、「デジモンが進化できない」効果が発揮された場合でも、この進化条件でテイマーから進化できます。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化した場合でも、進化ドローは行いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化ドローを行います。
どのような進化の場合でも、進化ドローは行います。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

localized.name: 아기벌몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】특징으로 「로얄 베이스」를 가진 Lv.2 : 코스트 0[시큐리티]【서로의 턴】특징으로 「로얄 베이스」를 가진 자신의 디지몬 전부를 DP +1000. 【등장 시】자신의 패에서 특징으로 「로얄 베이스」를 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 시큐리티 아래에 앞면으로 놓는 것으로, 자신의 시큐리티를 위에서부터 1장 패에 추가한다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】이 디지몬을 DP +1000.

faqs.question: 효과로 시큐리티에 앞면으로 놓인 카드는 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 앞면인 시큐리티가 되어, 공개된 상태가 됩니다. 앞면이 되어 있는 것 이외의 룰은 원래 시큐리티와 다르지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 앞면으로 놓인 시큐리티를 체크하는 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 공개된 채로 체크되었습니다. 공개되어 있다는 점을 제외하면 룰은 원래 체크와 다르지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 앞면으로 놓인 시큐리티가 체크되었을 경우, 그 카드의 【시큐리티】효과는 유발합니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 유발합니다.

faqs.question: 앞면으로 놓인 시큐리티를 포함한 시큐리티를 셔플하는 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 앞면이 되어 있는 시큐리티를 앞면으로 되돌려서 셔플합니다. 셔플한 뒤에 그 카드를 앞면으로는 하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「織本泉」:コスト2/「シューツモン」:コスト0
【進化時】相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。
【アタック時】［ターンに1回］自分のデジモン/テイマー1体を手札の特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つ緑/赤のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-1で進化できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】このデジモンが自分の効果以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、進化元効果を持つテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
faqs.answer:
No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

faqs.question: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you do.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question:
I have 2 face-up security cards. 
If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, do I perform <De-Digivolve 2>?
faqs.answer:
No. You perform <De-Digivolve 1> twice, not <De-Digivolve 2>. 
When performing <De-Digivolve 2>, the top 2 cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but when performing <De-Digivolve 1> twice, the top 2 cards are trashed 1 at a time. 
For example, if using <De-Digivolve 2> to simultaneously trash the top 2 cards of a suspended Digimon and the 2nd card trashed is BT15-047 [Kabuterimon], its effect won't activate. However, if performing <De-Digivolve 1> twice and the Digimon becomes BT15-047 [Kabuterimon] after the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1> trashes a card, it won't be affected by the 2nd instance of <De-Digivolve 1> and won't be trashed.

faqs.question:
表向きのセキュリティが2枚ある状況です。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮した場合、≪退化2≫するのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、≪退化2≫ではなく、2回≪退化1≫をします。
≪退化2≫をする場合は上に重ねられたカードが2枚同時に破棄されたものとして扱いますが、2回≪退化1≫をする場合は上に重ねられたカードを1枚ずつ破棄します。
例えば、レスト状態のデジモンを≪退化2≫で上からカードを2枚同時に破棄するときに、破棄される2枚目の「BT15-047 カブテリモン」の効果は発揮されませんが、2回≪退化1≫をする場合は、1回目の≪退化1≫で破棄したあと、そのデジモンが「BT15-047 カブテリモン」になった場合、2回目の≪退化1≫の効果を受けないため、破棄されません。

faqs.answer: 아니요, ≪퇴화2≫이 아니라 2회 ≪퇴화1≫을 합니다. ≪퇴화2≫를 하는 경우는 위에 겹쳐져 있는 카드가 2장 동시에 파기된 것으로도 취급하지만, 2회 ≪퇴화1≫을 하는 경우는 위에 겹쳐져 있는 카드를 1장씩 파기합니다. 예를 들어, 레스트 상태인 디지몬을 ≪퇴화2≫로 위에서 카드를 2장 동시에 파기할 때 파기되는 2장째인 「BT15-047 캅테리몬」 효과는 발휘되지 않지만, 2회 ≪퇴화1≫을 하는 경우는 1회 째인 ≪퇴화1≫로 파기한 뒤, 그 디지몬이 「BT15-047 캅테리몬」이 된 경우, 2회 째인 ≪퇴화1≫ 효과를 받지 않기 때문에 파기되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: When a Tamer would digivolve using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, is it considered a Digimon that would digivolve?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered a Digimon that would digivolve. 
When a Tamer would digivolve using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects don't trigger.

faqs.question: When a Tamer digivolves using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, is it considered a Digimon that digivolves?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered a Digimon that digivolves. 
When a Tamer digivolves using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

faqs.question: このカードの[手札]【メイン】効果でテイマーから進化する場合、デジモンが進化するとして扱われますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、デジモンが進化するとはみなされません。
このカードの[手札]【メイン】効果でテイマーから進化するときに、「デジモンが進化するとき」は誘発しません。

faqs.question: このカードの[手札]【メイン】効果でテイマーから進化した場合、デジモンが進化したとして扱われますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、デジモンが進化したとはみなされません。
このカードの[手札]【メイン】効果でテイマーから進化したときに、「デジモンが進化したとき」は誘発しません。

localized.mainEffect: 【진화】특징으로 「하이브리드체」를 가진 그린/레드인 Lv.4 : 코스트 3［패］【메인】자신의 트래시에서 「페어리몬」과 「슈츠몬」 1장씩을 그린/레드인 자신의 테이머 1명의 아래에 놓는 것으로, 그 테이머를 이 카드로 진화 조건을 무시하고 진화 코스트 3으로 진화시킨다. 《돌진》 【진화 시】상대의 디지몬/테이머 1마리(명)를 레스트시킨다. 상대의 턴 종료까지 그 디지몬/테이머는 액티브가 되지 않는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과는 어떻게 발휘합니까?
faqs.answer: [패] 아이콘이 있는 효과는 패에서 공개하는 효과를 발휘할 수 있습니다. 이 효과의 경우, 메인 페이즈에 발휘할 수 있어, 패의 이 카드를 공개하고 효과를 처리합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과의 조건은 자신의 트래시에서 「페어리몬」이나 「슈츠몬」 어느 쪽 1장만을 테이머의 아래에 놓을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 「것으로」 조건은 그 내용을 일부만 실행할 수 없습니다. 이 [패]【메인】효과의 조건의 경우, 「페어리몬」 1장과 「슈츠몬」 1장인 양쪽을 테이머의 아래에 놓을 필요가 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 테이머에서 진화하기 [패]【메인】효과는 진화원이 되는 테이머를 디지몬으로도 취급하여 진화합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 테이머에서 그대로 진화합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화할 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로는 보지 않습니다. 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화할 때 「디지몬이 진화할 때」는 유발하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화한 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로는 보지 않습니다. 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화했을 때 「디지몬이 진화했을 때」는 유발하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: What does the "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: With this effect, your opponent's memory will no longer increase by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects the opponent player.

Yes, you can gain memory. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

いいえ、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモンとテイマーの両方として扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

localized.mainEffect: 【登場時】【進化時】自分の手札から、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカード1枚を破棄することで、相手のターン終了まで、自分のデジモン1体は相手の効果で消滅しない。

localized.name: 斗士兽
localized.mainEffect: 【登场时】【进化时】可从我方的手牌中,丢弃1张记述有“骑士兽”的卡牌,直到对方的回合结束为止,我方的1只数码宝贝不会因对方效果而被消灭。
localized.sourceEffect: 【双方的回合】此数码宝贝的DP+1000。

localized.name: Beetlemon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [J.P. Shibayama]: Cost 2/[MetalKabuterimon]: Cost 0
[When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon can't be deleted by their effects.
[When Attacking] 1 of your Digimon or Tamers may digivolve into a black or yellow Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: ブリッツモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「柴山純平」:コスト2/「ボルグモン」: コスト0
【進化時】相手のターン終了まで、このデジモンは相手の効果で消滅しない。
【アタック時】自分のデジモン/テイマー1体を手札の特徴に「ハイブリッド体」を持つ黒/黄のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-1で進化できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】このデジモンが自分の効果以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、進化元効果を持つテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

localized.mainEffect: 【진화】「안도영」 코스트 2/「보르그몬」 코스트 0【진화 시】상대의 턴 종료까지 이 디지몬은 상대의 효과로 소멸하지 않는다. 【어택 시】자신의 디지몬/테이머 1마리(명)를 패의 특징으로 「하이브리드체」를 가진 블랙/옐로인 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -1 하여 진화시킬 수 있다.

localized.mainEffect:

localized.name: 스내치몬

faqs.question: Do I have to choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you don't have to choose an opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: If I choose an opponent's Digimon that can't attack for this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect, does my opponent attack with that Digimon?
faqs.answer: No, they can't attack using a Digimon that can't attack.

faqs.question:
An opponent's Digimon is attacking using an effect at the end of their turn. 
If I choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect, does my opponent attack with that Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, your opponent can't attack using that Digimon. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In such cases, even if you choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect when there is already an attacking Digimon, your opponent can't attack with the chosen Digimon.

faqs.question: Can I choose a Digimon that isn't affected by effects for this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect and have it attack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can choose a Digimon that isn't affected by effects for this and have it attack. 
Such Digimon aren't affected by effects, but they can be chosen. 
In addition, "your opponent attacks with the chosen Digimon" in this card's [End of Opponent's Turn] effect affects a player, therefore your opponent must attack with the chosen Digimon if it can attack.

localized.mainEffect:
≪ブロッカー≫

faqs.question: このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果は、相手のデジモンを選ばないことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、選ばないことが可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果で、相手のアタックできないデジモンを選んだ場合でも、相手はそのデジモンをアタックさせますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、アタックできないデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。

faqs.question:
相手のターン終了時、相手のデジモンが効果でアタックしている状況です。
このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果で、相手のデジモンを選んだ場合、相手はそのデジモンをアタックさせますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、相手はそのデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。アタック中、新たにアタックの宣言はできません。
この状況の場合、アタックしているデジモンがいるときに、このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果で相手のデジモンを選んでも、相手はそのデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。

faqs.question: 効果を受けないデジモンを、このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果で選び、アタックさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、効果を受けないデジモンを選び、アタックさせることができます。
効果を受けないデジモンは、効果の影響を受けませんが、選ぶことはできます。
また、このカードの【相手のターン終了時】効果の「相手は、選んだデジモンをアタックさせる」はプレイヤーに影響を及ぼすため、相手は選んだデジモンがアタックできるのであれば、アタックさせなければなりません。

faqs.answer: 아니요, 상대는 그 디지몬을 어택시킬 수 없습니다. 어택 중, 새롭게 어택의 선언은 할 수 없습니다. 이 상황의 경우, 어택하고 있는 디지몬이 있을 때 이 카드의 【상대의 턴 종료 시】효과로 상대의 디지몬을 골라도, 상대는 그 디지몬을 어택시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 효과를 받지 않는 디지몬을 이 카드의 【상대의 턴 종료 시】효과로 선택하고 어택시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 효과를 받지 않는 디지몬을 선택하고 어택시킬 수 있습니다. 효과를 받지 않는 디지몬은, 효과의 영향을 받지 않습니다만, 선택할 수 있습니다. 또 이 카드의 【상대의 턴 종료 시】효과의 「상대는 선택한 디지몬을 어택시킨다」는 플레이어에 영향을 끼치을 때문에 상대는 선택한 디지몬이 어택할 수 있다면 어택해야 합니다.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: When a Tamer would digivolve using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, is it considered a Digimon that would digivolve?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered a Digimon that would digivolve. 
When a Tamer would digivolve using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects don't trigger.

faqs.question: When a Tamer digivolves using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, is it considered a Digimon that digivolves?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered a Digimon that digivolves. 
When a Tamer digivolves using this card's [Hand] [Main] effect, "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.

faqs.answer:
いいえ、デジモンが進化するとはみなされません。

faqs.question: このカードの[手札]【メイン】効果でテイマーから進化した場合、デジモンが進化したとして扱われますか？

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과는 어떻게 발휘합니까?
faqs.answer: [패] 아이콘이 있는 효과는 패에서 공개하는 효과를 발휘할 수 있습니다. 이 효과의 경우, 메인 페이즈에 발휘할 수 있어, 패의 이 카드를 공개하고 효과를 처리합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과의 조건은 자신의 트래시에서 「블리츠몬」이나 「보르그몬」 어느 쪽 1장만을 테이머의 아래에 놓을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 할 수 없습니다. 「것으로」 조건은 그 내용을 일부만 실행할 수 없습니다. 이 [패]【메인】효과의 조건의 경우, 「블리츠몬」 1장과 「보르그몬」 1장인 양쪽을 테이머의 아래에 놓을 필요가 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 테이머에서 진화하기 [패]【메인】효과는 진화원이 되는 테이머를 디지몬으로도 취급하여 진화합니까?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화할 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화한 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로는 보지 않습니다. 이 카드의 [패]【메인】효과로 테이머에서 진화했을 때 「디지몬이 진화했을 때」는 유발하지 않습니다.

faqs.question:
When this card would be played, I deleted my BT18-015 [Kimeramon], then I played this card. 
At such times, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trigger simultaneously with BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, they trigger simultaneously. 
However, if you activate BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect first and then DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] using [Kimeramon] and this card while its [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect has triggered, this card will be removed from the battle area before the [On Play] effect can activate.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand, do the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met for [Millenniummon]?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met. 
In addition, DNA digivolution can't be performed unless the [Millenniummon] has DNA digivolution.

faqs.question: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect allow my [Kimeramon] and the BT18-073 [Machinedramon] itself that activated the effect in the trash to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, that's correct. 
The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card is placed in the trash, therefore this card itself in the trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.

faqs.question: What are the areas where [Kimeramon] and [Machinedramon] can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand using this card's [On Deletion] effect?Nov. 22, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: Your [Kimeramon] in the battle area and [Machinedramon] in your trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「合成型」を持つLv.5:コスト3
このカードが登場するとき、特徴に「合成型」を持つ自分のデジモン1体を消滅させることで、支払う登場コスト-4。
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン全てを≪退化1≫。
【消滅時】自分の「キメラモン」1体とトラッシュの「ムゲンドラモン」1枚で手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化できる。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「合成型」を持つ。
localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン】［ターンに1回］相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、アタックの対象を特徴に「合成型」/「邪神型」を持つ自分のデジモン1体に変更できる。

faqs.question:
このカードが登場するとき、自分の「BT18-015 キメラモン」を消滅させ、このカードを登場させました。
このとき、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果と、「BT18-015 キメラモン」の【消滅時】効果は、同時誘発ですか？
faqs.answer:
はい、同時誘発です。
ただし、「BT18-015 キメラモン」の【消滅時】を先に発揮し、【登場時】【進化時】効果が誘発しているこのカードと「キメラモン」で「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化した場合、【登場時】効果は発揮する前にこのカードがバトルエリアから離れるため、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果で、手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化する場合、その「ミレニアモン」のジョグレスの進化条件を満たしていなければなりませんか？
faqs.answer:
はい、ジョグレスの進化条件は満たす必要があります。
また、ジョグレスが無い「ミレニアモン」にはジョグレス進化できません。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果は、自分の「キメラモン」と、この効果を発揮したトラッシュの「BT18-073 ムゲンドラモン」自身で手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
【消滅時】効果は、そのカードがトラッシュに置かれてから発揮されるため、トラッシュのこのカード自身で手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化することができます。

faqs.question: このカードの【消滅時】効果は、どの場所にある「キメラモン」と「ムゲンドラモン」で、手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化できるのですか？2024/11/22 更新
faqs.answer: バトルエリアの自分の「キメラモン」と、自分のトラッシュの「ムゲンドラモン」で、手札の「ミレニアモン」にジョグレス進化することができます。

faqs.question: 이 카드가 등장할 때, 자신의 「BT18-015 키메라몬」을 소멸시켜, 이 카드를 등장시켰습니다. 이때, 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과와 「BT18-015 키메라몬」 【소멸 시】 효과는 동시 유발합니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 동시 유발입니다. 단, 「BT18-015 키메라몬」 【소멸 시】을 먼저 발휘하여 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과가 유발하여 있는 이 카드와 「키메라몬」으로 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화한 경우, 【등장 시】 효과는 발휘하기 전에 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에서 벗어날 때문에 발휘시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【소멸 시】효과로, 패의 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화할 경우, 그 「밀레니엄몬」 조그레스의 진화 조건을 만족해야합니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 조그레스의 진화 조건은 만족할 필요가 있습니다. 또 조그레스가 없는 「밀레니엄몬」으로는 조그레스 진화할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【소멸 시】 효과는 자신의 「키메라몬」과 이 효과를 발휘한 트래시의 「BT18-073 파워드라몬」자신으로패의 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다. 【소멸 시】 효과는 그 카드가 트래시에 놓인 상태에서 발휘되기 때문에 트래시의 이 카드 자신으로 패의 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【소멸 시】 효과는 어느 장소에 있는 「키메라몬」과 「파워드라몬」으로 패의 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 배틀 에어리어의 자신 「키메라몬」과 자신의 트래시의 「파워드라몬」으로 패의 「밀레니엄몬」으로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니다.

このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で登場できるカードは、『黒の登場コスト7以下のカード』です。
例えば、登場コストを持ち、そのコストが7以下の黒の、デジモンカードやテイマーカードを登場させることができます。

localized.name: 에이션트와이즈몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】【진화 시】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈할 수 있다. 그중 블랙인 등장 코스트 7 이하의 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다. 나머지는 파기한다. 【서로의 턴】이 디지몬이 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 이 디지몬의 진화원에서 블랙인 Lv.4 이하의 디지몬 카드 1장을 패로 되돌리거나, 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.≪디지크로스 -2≫ 「머큐레몬」×「세피로트몬」 등장할 때, 패/배틀 에어리어에서 이 카드 아래에 놓을 수 있다. 1장마다 등장 코스트를 마이너스한다

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과는 어떤 카드를 등장할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로 등장할 수 있는 카드는 『블랙인 등장 코스트 7 이하인 카드』입니다. 예를 들어, 등장 코스트를 가진, 그 코스트가 7 이하인 블랙인 디지몬 카드나 테이머 카드를 등장시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: Duskmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Koichi Kimura]: Cost 2/[Velgrmon]: Cost 1
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, change the original color of 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers to 1 non-white color.
[When Attacking] 1 of your Digimon or Tamers may digivolve into a level 4 card with the [Hybrid] trait in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
localized.sourceEffect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: What does the "change the original color" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
Such effects change the original color shown on the target card to the predetermined color shown in the effect. 
For example, if a Digimon's original color is red and it's chosen as the target for a "[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, change the original color of 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers to 1 non-white color" effect, then you choose a non-white color, and that Digimon's original color will become that color.

faqs.question: What happens if a Digimon that gained a color has its original color changed by the "change the original color" effect?
faqs.answer:
Its original color is changed, and it retains the gained color. 
Gained colors don't affect the original color.

faqs.question: What happens if a Digimon has its original color changed and is then affected by a "change the original color" effect again?
faqs.answer: The original color is changed to the most recent color.

faqs.question: What original colors can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect change an opponent's Digimon or Tamer to?
faqs.answer: The original color can be changed to any 1 color from among red, blue, yellow, green, black, or purple.

faqs.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, do the digivolution requirements have to be met?
faqs.answer: Yes, the digivolution requirements have to be met.

localized.mainEffect: 【진화】「선우윤」 코스트 2/「베르그몬」 코스트 1【등장 시】【진화 시】상대의 턴 종료까지 상대의 디지몬/테이머 1마리(명)의 원래 색을 화이트 이외의 1색으로 변경한다. 【어택 시】자신의 디지몬/테이머 1마리(명)를 트래시의 특징으로 「하이브리드체」를 가진 Lv.4의 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -1 하여 진화시킬 수 있다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【소멸 시】자신의 트래시에서 등장 코스트 4 이하의 테이머 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 테이머에서 진화하는 진화 조건은 진화원이 되는 테이머를 디지몬으로도 취급하여 진화합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 테이머에서 그대로 진화합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화 조건에 테이머에서 진화할 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로는 보지 않습니다. 이 카드의 진화 조건에 테이머에서 진화할 때 「디지몬이 진화할 때」는 유발하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화 조건에 테이머에서 진화한 경우, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 디지몬이 진화하는 것으로는 보지 않습니다. 이 카드의 진화 조건에 테이머에서 진화했을 때 「디지몬이 진화했을 때」는 유발하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 「원래 색을 바꾼다」는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 그 카드의 원래 색을 그 효과로 결정된 색으로 바꾸는 효과입니다. 예를 들어, 원래 색이 레드인 디지몬을 「【등장 시】【진화 시】상대의 턴 종료 시까지 상대의 디지몬/테이머 1마리/명의 원래 색을 화이트이외의 1색으로 바꾼다.」로 선택한 경우, 화이트이외의 색을 선택하고, 그 디지몬의 원래 색이 선택한 색이 됩니다.

faqs.question: 색을 얻어 있는 디지몬의 색을 「원래 색을 바꾼다」 효과로 변경한 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 원래 색이 변경되어 얻어 있는 색은 추가된 그대로 입니다. 얻어 있는 색은 원래 색으로는 포함되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 원래 색이 효과로 변경되어 있는 디지몬의 색을 다시 「원래 색을 바꾼다」 효과로 변경한 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 마지막에 변경된 색으로 덮어씌워집니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과는 상대의 디지몬이나 테이머의 원래 색을 어느 색으로 변경할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 레드/블루/옐로/그린/블랙/퍼플 중 어느 1색으로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【어택 시】효과로 디지몬이나 테이머를 진화시키는 경우, 진화 조건을 만족하고 있어야합니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 진화 조건은 만족해야 합니다.

3 cards.

はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question:
相手の赤と青のデジモン1体と、相手の赤と黄のテイマー1体がいる状況です。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮した場合、お互いのデッキの上から何枚破棄しますか？
faqs.answer:
3枚です。
この状況の場合、相手のデジモンとテイマーの色が「赤と青と黄」の3つなので、お互いのデッキの上から3枚破棄します。
