faqs.question: What's a token?
faqs.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect by deleting a [Diaboromon] token when this Digimon is about to be deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when one of my [Diaboromon] tokens is about to be deleted?
faqs.answer: No. this card's [All Turns] effect only takes effect when this Digimon is deleted. You can't activate it when a [Diaboromon] token is deleted.

faqs.question: I have this Digimon and a [Diaboromon] token in play in my battle area when my opponent uses [BT1-084 Omnimon]'s [On Evolution] effect to choose [Diaboromon]. Are this Digimon and my [Diaboromon] token both deleted due to having the same name?
faqs.answer: Yes. The token is considered a Digimon with the specified name, and is deleted.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when this Digimon is about to be deleted in a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: ディアボロモン
localized.mainEffect:
【アタック時】「ディアボロモン」（デジモン・14コスト・Lv.6・白・究極体・不明・種族不明・DP3000）のトークン1体をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
【お互いのターン】このデジモンがバトルで消滅するとき、他の自分の「ディアボロモン」1体を消滅させることで、このデジモンは消滅しない。

faqs.question: 「トークン」とは何ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果によって登場する、デジモンやテイマーとして扱われる特殊なカードのことです。このカードの効果では、名称が「ディアボロモン」のデジモンとして扱うトークンを登場させることができます。
トークンに関しての詳しいルールは、ルールマニュアルをご確認ください。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このデジモンが消滅したとき、「ディアボロモン」のトークンを消滅させることで発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、自分の「ディアボロモン」のトークンが消滅するときに発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このデジモン自身が消滅するときのみ有効です。「ディアボロモン」トークンが消滅するときは発揮できません。

faqs.question: このデジモンと「ディアボロモン」トークンが両方バトルエリアにいるとき、相手が「BT1-084 オメガモン」の【進化時】効果で「ディアボロモン」を指定しました。この場合、このデジモンと「ディアボロモン」トークンは同じ名称のデジモンとして、両方とも消滅するのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、トークンであっても同じ名称のデジモンとして扱いますので、消滅します。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このデジモンが相手のセキュリティデジモンとのバトルで消滅したときに発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.answer: 효과에 의해 등장하거나 디지몬이나 테이머로서 취급하는 특수한 카드를 말합니다. 이 카드의 효과는 명칭에 「디아블로몬」인 디지몬으로서 취급하는 토큰을 등장시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.answer: 네, 토큰이더라도 같은 명칭의 디지몬으로서 취급하므로 소멸합니다.

localized.name: BlackWarGreymon
localized.mainEffect:
While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more in play, reduce the memory cost to play this card from your hand by 6.
[When Attacking] If you attack your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, unsuspend this Digimon.

faqs.question: This card's [When Attacking] effect refers to "your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP." Does this strictly refer to my opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, or does it refer to when I attack an opponent's Digimon with the highest DP out of all Digimon in play, including my own?
faqs.answer: It refers strictly to your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP they control. The effect doesn't check the DP of your Digimon.

faqs.question: My opponent has multiple Digimon tied for highest DP. If I attack any one of them, does this card's [When Attacking] effect let me unsuspend this Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your opponent has multiple Digimon tied for highest DP, attacking any of them allows you to unsuspend this Digimon.

faqs.question: My opponent's Digimon with the highest DP is unsuspended. If I attack their unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP, can I unsuspend this Digimon?
faqs.answer: No, this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect only lets you unsuspend this Digimon when attacking your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, regardless of whether it's suspended or not.

localized.name: ブラックウォーグレイモン
localized.mainEffect:
DP10000以上の相手のデジモンがいる間、手札のこのカードを登場させるとき、支払う登場コストを-6する。
【アタック時】最もDPの高い相手のデジモンにアタックしたとき、このデジモンをアクティブにする。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果にある、「最もDPの高い相手のデジモン」とは、「相手のデジモンの中で最もDPの高いデジモン」ということですか？ それとも「自分のデジモンも含めた中で、もっともDPの高いデジモンが相手のデジモンで、そのデジモンにアタックした場合」でしょうか？
faqs.answer: 「相手のデジモンの中で最もDPの高いデジモン」になります。自分のデジモンのDPは参照しません。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果で、最もDPの高い相手のデジモンが複数いる場合、そのいずれかにアタックすることで、このデジモンをアクティブにできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、最もDPの高い相手のデジモンが複数いるときは、そのどれにでもアタックすることでアクティブになります。

faqs.question: 最もDPの高い相手のデジモンがアクティブ状態のとき、レスト状態の相手のデジモンの中で最もDPの高い相手のデジモンにアタックすることで、このデジモンをアクティブにできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、アクティブ状態・レスト状態に関係なく、最もDPの高い相手のデジモンにアタックしたのでなければ、このデジモンの【アタック時】の効果ではアクティブにはなりません。

faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

localized.sourceEffect: [On Deletion] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Ghost] trait from your trash to the hand.

faqs.question:
This card's inherited effect and BT20-063 [Ghostmon]'s inherited effect triggered simultaneously when BT20-068 [Bakemon] with this card and BT20-063 [Ghostmon] in its digivolution cards was deleted. 
At such times, if I activate this card's effect first and BT20-068 [Bakemon] is returned from the trash to the hand, can I then activate BT20-063 [Ghostmon]'s inherited effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. 
If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if BT20-068 [Bakemon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT20-068 [Bakemon]. 
If the deleted BT20-068 [Bakemon] leaves the trash, the inherited [On Deletion] effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

faqs.question:

faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card.

At such times, if I activate this card's effect first and BT20-063 [Ghostmon] is returned from the trash to the hand, can I then activate BT20-063 [Ghostmon]'s inherited effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. 
You can activate BT20-063 [Ghostmon]'s inherited effect even if BT20-063 [Ghostmon] is returned from this card's digivolution cards to the hand.

faqs.question:
このカードと「BT20-063 ゴースモン」を進化元に持つ「BT20-068 バケモン」が消滅したとき、このカードの進化元効果と「BT20-063 ゴースモン」の進化元効果が同時誘発しました。
このとき、このカードの効果から先に発揮して、トラッシュの「BT20-068 バケモン」を手札に戻した場合、そのあとに「BT20-063 ゴースモン」の進化元効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できません。
デジモンが消滅し、進化元の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、発揮待ちになるのはその進化元を持っていたデジモンカードです。
発揮待ちのカードが発揮する前にその領域を離れた場合、その効果を発揮させることはできません。
この状況の場合、「BT20-068 バケモン」が消滅し、進化元の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、その効果が発揮待ちになるのは「BT20-068 バケモン」のカードです。
消滅した「BT20-068 バケモン」のカードがトラッシュから離れた場合、発揮待ちとなっていた進化元効果の【消滅時】効果は、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give <Piercing> and +4000 DP to 1 of my Digimon, but then choose to not attack with this card?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
I use BT16-077 [Dinobeemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to play this card, give <Rush> to BT16-077 [Dinobeemon], and attack a player. 
Can I then use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to attack with this card?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, BT16-077 [Dinobeemon] is already attacking using its [When Digivolving] effect. 
This card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using this effect, even if you activate it.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to DNA digivolve using 2 Digimon including one that would leave the battle area, does the DNA digivolved Digimon leave the battle area?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't leave the battle area. 
DNA digivolution results in a digivolution into a new Digimon that is considered a different Digimon from the one that would leave the battle area.

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、自分のデジモン1体に≪貫通≫とDP+4000を付与したあとに、このカードでアタックしないことはできますか？

faqs.question:
「BT16-077 ディノビーモン」の【進化時】効果で、このカードを登場させ、そのまま「BT16-077 ディノビーモン」に≪速攻≫を付与してプレイヤーにアタックしました。
そのあとに、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、このカードでアタックすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、アタックできません。アタック中、新たにアタックの宣言はできません。
この状況の場合、「BT16-077 ディノビーモン」の【進化時】効果で「BT16-077 ディノビーモン」でアタックします。
カウンタータイミングになる前に、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果が発揮できますが、アタック中にアタック宣言はできないため、発揮させてもアタックすることができません。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、離れるデジモンを含めたデジモン2体でジョグレス進化した場合、ジョグレス進化したそのデジモンはバトルエリアを離れますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、バトルエリアを離れません。
ジョグレス進化は、新しいデジモンとして進化するため、離れるデジモンとは別のデジモンとなります。

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can process it. 
Even if [Jesmon] or [X Antibody] isn't in this card's digivolution cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will allow 1 of your Digimon to attack.

faqs.question: What does "isn't affected by [...] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be chosen.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
However, it won't be affected by it.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking].

faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン】効果は、どのカードが登場したときに誘発しますか？

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？2025/06/13 更新

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: What cards can be unsuspended by this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer: 1 of your Digimon with [Dracomon] in its text or 1 of your Digimon with [Examon] in its text.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: What cards will trigger this card's inherited effect when they would leave the battle area?
faqs.answer: A card with [Dracomon] in its text or a card with [Examon] in its text.

faqs.question: If I activate this card's inherited effect when multiples of my Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle at the same time, are all of those Digimon prevented from leaving?
faqs.answer:
Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. 
This card's inherited effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text or the [SEEKERS] trait?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't trigger.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?Jan. 24, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, you can't activate it.

faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by doing X" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

【登場時】【進化時】相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体の【進化時】効果は発揮せず、DP-3000。
localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン】［ターンに1回］相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、アタックの対象をこのデジモンに変更できる。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【進化時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
【進化時】効果が誘発した場合や「【進化時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【進化時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で発揮する場合であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードの【進化時】効果を、他の効果で発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、その効果は[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect suspend a different card from the one that's given "can't unsuspend"?Jan. 24, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, it can.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?Jan. 24, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, then I attacked using that Digimon. 
At such times, in what order can I activate that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect and [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

faqs.question: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect prevent both my opponent's Digimon and Tamers from activating [On Play] effects or unsuspending until the end of their turn?
faqs.answer: That's correct, both your opponent's Digimon and Tamers are prevented from activating [On Play] effects or unsuspending.

faqs.question: What does "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [On Play] effects on cards from activating. 
Triggered [On Play] effects can no longer activate when a card is played or when effects such as "activate that card's [On Play]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [On Play] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it's triggered upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can it activate its own [On Play] effect using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects"?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can another card's [On Play] effect be activated using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects as an effect of this card"?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: Can I use "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects as an effect of this card" on a card that isn't affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" to activate the [On Play] effect on another card that's affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects"?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can I perform just the "by doing X" condition in its [On Play] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card digivolved into a card that has an [On Play] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect while "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" was activated. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card is played?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [On Play] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。

faqs.question:
I used this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, then I attacked using that Digimon. 
At such times, in what order can I activate that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect and [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

faqs.question:
Only the top card of my opponent's security card is face up. 
If this card's [When Digivolving] effect activates, what security card is flipped to face up?
faqs.answer: The 2nd card from the top of their security stack is flipped to face up.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question:
相手のセキュリティの1番上のカードのみが表向きになっている状況です。
このカードの【進化時】効果を発揮した場合、セキュリティのどのカードを表向きにしますか？
faqs.answer: セキュリティの上から2枚目のカードを表向きにします。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

What happens if this card's {Security} [End of Opponent's Turn] effect then plays this card, my security stack is reduced to 0 cards, and the attack against the player is successful?Jun. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: You lose the game.

faqs.question: What happens if this card has just BT15-086 [Marvin Jackson] in its digivolution cards, it performs a security check on a face-up security card, and this card's [Your Turn] effect activates?Jun. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: This card stacked on top is trashed, causing this Digimon to become a Tamer, therefore the attacking Digimon is considered to be removed.

localized.name: Invisimon
localized.mainEffect:
[Security] [End of Opponent's Turn] Play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon and flip your opponent's top face-down security card face up. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards.
[Your Turn] When your Digimon check face-up security cards, you may place this Digimon's top stacked card face up as the bottom security card.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: If I attack with this card, an opponent's face-up security card is checked for the security check, then this card's [Your Turn] effect activates and I place the top card of this Digimon face-up at the bottom of the security stack, does the [End of Attack] effect on the Digimon under this card trigger?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

localized.name: インビジモン
localized.mainEffect:
［セキュリティ］【相手のターン終了時】このカードをコストを支払わずに登場させる。
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン1体を≪退化2≫し、相手の裏向きのセキュリティを上から1枚表向きにする。その後、進化元の枚数が1枚以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
【自分のターン】自分のデジモンが表向きのセキュリティをチェックしたとき、このデジモンに重ねられているカードを上から1枚セキュリティの下に表向きで置ける。

sourceAttributes.type: サイボーグ型/リベレイター

faqs.question:
相手のターン終了時、効果で相手のデジモンがプレイヤーにアタックしました。
そのあとに、このカードの{セキュリティ}【相手のターン終了時】効果でこのカードが登場してセキュリティが0枚になり、そのアタックがプレイヤーに成立した場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: ゲームに敗北します。

faqs.question: 進化元に「BT15-086 マーヴィン・ジャクソン」のみを持つこのカードで表向きのセキュリティをチェックし、このカードの【自分のターン】効果を発揮した場合、どうなりますか？2026/01/30 更新
faqs.answer: 重ねられているこのカードが無くなりテイマーになるため、アタックしているデジモンがいなくなります。

faqs.question: What does "isn't affected by [...] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be chosen.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be given an effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
However, it won't be affected by it.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」効果で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」を付与されても、DPをマイナスされません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？2025/03/27 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？2025/06/13 更新
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question:
A Digimon's DP became 0 from this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. 
At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the rest of this effect's processing is resolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon's DP became 0 from this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. 
At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the rest of this effect's processing is resolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、デジモンのDPが０になりました。
このとき、この効果の残りの処理より先に、そのデジモンは消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？

【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。

faqs.question: Which effect activates first, a [When Digivolving] effect on an opponent's Digimon that digivolved, or this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player activates their effect first.

faqs.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
faqs.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training]. 
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to choose 1 of my opponent's Digimon twice and give it -20000 DP?Jan. 24, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A Digimon's DP became 0 from this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. 
At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the rest of this effect's processing is resolved?Jan. 24, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

faqs.question: Can I return just 2 cards from my trash to the deck for the condition of this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
You must return the specified number of cards from your trash to the deck for the condition of this card's [All Turns] effect.

localized.mainEffect:
≪Sアタック+1≫≪再起動≫≪ブロッカー≫
【お互いのターン】このデジモンが効果でバトルエリアを離れるとき、自分のトラッシュから、名称に「デクス」を含むカード3枚をデッキの下に戻すことで、離れない。
【お互いのターン終了時】［ターンに1回］最もLv.の低いデジモン全てを消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果の条件は、自分のトラッシュのカードを2枚だけデッキに戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【お互いのターン】効果の条件の場合、指定された枚数分、自分のトラッシュのカードをデッキに戻す必要があります。

localized.name: Omekamon
localized.mainEffect:
＜Blocker＞
[On Play] If you have 1 or fewer security cards, this Digimon may digivolve into [Omnimon (X Antibody)] in the hand, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] You may place this card as the bottom digivolution card of your [King Drasil_7D6] in the breeding area. ⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [X Antibody].
localized.sourceEffect: [Breeding] [Opponent's Turn] When your security stack is removed from, by suspending this Digimon, play 1 [Omekamon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.

faqs.question: What is a [Breeding] effect?
faqs.answer:
A [Breeding] effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question:
I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards in my breeding area. 
Can I use this card's inherited effect to suspend that Digimon and play this card itself from digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

≪ブロッカー≫

localized.sourceEffect: ［育成］【相手のターン】自分のセキュリティが減ったとき、このデジモンをレストさせることで、このデジモンの進化元から、「オメカモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場させる。

sourceAttributes.type: パペット型/X抗体/リベレイター

faqs.question: [育成]効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードが育成エリアにある間、誘発・発揮できる効果です。
育成エリア以外の場所では、誘発・発揮できません。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？
faqs.answer:
【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。
【セキュリティ】効果はチェックされた場合、発揮待ちにならずに即座に発揮されます。
それ以外の誘発した効果は、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。

faqs.question:
自分の育成エリアに、このカードを進化元に持つデジモンがいる状況です。
このカードの進化元効果で、そのデジモンをレストさせ、進化元のこのカード自身を登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、登場させることができます。

localized.name: Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Sistermon Ciel]: Cost 1
[Trash] [All Turns] When any of your Digimon are played, 1 of your [Sistermon Ciel]s may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until the end of their turn.
[End of All Turns] Place this Digimon's top stacked card as the top security card.

faqs.question: What is a [Trash] effect?
faqs.answer:
A [Trash] effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

faqs.question: When I play a [Sistermon Ciel], in what order can I activate that Digimon's [On Play] effect and this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question: When I play a [Sistermon Ciel], can I activate this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect first, digivolve that Digimon into this card, then activate the [On Play] effect on the played [Sistermon Ciel]?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

localized.mainEffect:
【进化】“修女兽天蓝”:费用1

[废弃区]【双方的回合】当我方的数码宝贝登场时,可以不支付费用将我方的1只“修女兽天蓝”进化成此卡牌。

【登场时】【进化时】直到对方的回合结束为止,对方的1只数码宝贝/驯兽师无法转换为休息状态。

localized.name: Shoto Kazama
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Shoto Kazama] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits from your trash without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and, until the end of their turn, 1 of your Digimon with the [Vortex Warriors] trait gets +2000 DP.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You can only process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if you return this card to the bottom of the deck.

faqs.question: At the start of my main phase, this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect plays a card. Can I then activate the [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the played card?
faqs.answer: No, you can't activate it.

【我方的回合结束时】可将此驯兽师转换为休息状态,并将对方的1只数码宝贝转换为休息状态,且直到对方的回合结束为止,我方1只拥有“旋风战士”特征的数码宝贝DP+2000。

localized.name: Altea
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 play cost 4 or lower black Digimon card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from your hand or trash as any of your [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait Digimon's bottom digivolution card, flip your opponent's top face-down security card face up.

faqs.question: What cards to be placed in digivolution cards will fulfill the condition for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect?
faqs.answer: 1 black Digimon card with the [Cyborg] trait and a play cost of 4 or less or 1 black Digimon card with the [Machine] trait and a play cost of 4 or less.

faqs.question:
Only the top card of my opponent's security card is face up. 
If this card's [When Digivolving] effect activates, what security card is flipped to face up?
faqs.answer: The 2nd card from the top of their security stack is flipped to face up.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

localized.name: アルテア
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下なら、3にする。
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「サイボーグ型」/「マシーン型」を持つ黒の登場コスト4以下のデジモンカード1枚を特徴に「サイボーグ型」/「マシーン型」を持つ自分のデジモンの進化元の下に置くことで、相手の裏向きのセキュリティを上から1枚表向きにする。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】効果は、どのカードを進化元に置くことが条件ですか？
faqs.answer: 『特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つ黒の登場コスト4以下のデジモンカード』か『特徴に「マシーン型」を持つ黒の登場コスト4以下のデジモンカード』1枚です。

faqs.question:
相手のセキュリティの1番上のカードのみが表向きになっている状況です。
このカードの【進化時】効果を発揮した場合、セキュリティのどのカードを表向きにしますか？
faqs.answer: セキュリティの上から2枚目のカードを表向きにします。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] If you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon may attack a player.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

localized.mainEffect:
【自分のターン開始時】メモリーが2以下なら、3にする。
【自分のターン終了時】自分の手札が4枚以下なら、このテイマーをレストさせることで、特徴に「魔竜型」/「邪竜型」を持つ自分のデジモン1体でプレイヤーにアタックできる。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに自分のこのカードが2枚ある状況です。
自分のターン終了時、1枚目のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックしました。そのあとに、2枚目のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、2枚目の効果ではアタックできません。アタック中、新たにアタックの宣言はできません。
この状況の場合、自分のターン終了時に2枚のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果が同時誘発し、1枚目の【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックします。
カウンタータイミングになる前に、2枚目の【自分のターン終了時】効果が発揮できますが、アタック中にアタック宣言はできないため、発揮させても2枚目の効果ではアタックすることができません。

faqs.question: What cards can be played using this card's [Main] effect?
faqs.answer: 1 Digimon card with [Dracomon] in its text or 1 Digimon card with [Examon] in its text.

faqs.question: What cards trigger this card's [All Turns] effect when they would leave the battle area?
faqs.answer: Any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] in their texts or any of your Digimon with [Examon] in their texts.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: If I use this card's <Delay> to DNA digivolve to DNA digivolve using 2 Digimon including one that would leave the battle area, does the DNA digivolved Digimon leave the battle area?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't leave the battle area. 
DNA digivolution results in a digivolution into a new Digimon that is considered a different Digimon from the one that would leave the battle area.

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、登場できるカードはどれですか？

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、どのカードが離れるときに誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 『「ドラコモン」の記述があるデジモンカード』か『「エグザモン」の記述があるデジモンカード』1枚です。

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？2025/06/13 更新
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、離れるデジモンを含めたデジモン2体でジョグレス進化した場合、ジョグレス進化したそのデジモンはバトルエリアを離れますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、バトルエリアを離れません。
ジョグレス進化は、新しいデジモンとして進化するため、離れるデジモンとは別のデジモンとなります。

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: What is a [Trash] effect?
faqs.answer:
A [Trash] effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

sourceNotes: ブースタ－パック OVER THE X [BT-20]

localized.name: ブラックサバス
localized.mainEffect:
［トラッシュ］【メイン】自分の手札が4枚以下なら、6コスト支払うことで、このカードをデッキの下に戻し、アクティブ状態の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
【メイン】自分の手札1枚を破棄する。その後、Lv.4以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: [トラッシュ]効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードがトラッシュにある間、誘発・発揮できる効果です。
トラッシュ以外の場所では、誘発・発揮できません。

localized.name: 블랙 사바스
localized.mainEffect: ［트래시］【메인】자신의 패가 4장 이하라면, 6 코스트 지불하는 것으로, 이 카드를 덱 아래로 되돌리고, 액티브 상태인 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 【메인】자신의 패 1장을 파기한다. 그 후, Lv.4 이하의 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.

localized.name: 黑色安息日
localized.mainEffect:
[废弃区]【主要】若我方持有的手牌不多于4张,则可支付6费用,并将此卡牌放回到卡组最下方,且消灭对方1只活跃状态的数码宝贝。

【主要】丢弃我方的1张手牌。此后,消灭对方1只等级不高于Lv.4的数码宝贝。

localized.name: The Apostle of Doom Descends!
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 4. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your [DexDorugoramon] would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞.
・By returning 1 [Dorumon] from those Digimon's digivolution cards to the hand, you may play 1 [DeathXmon] from your trash without paying the cost.

sourceNotes: ブースタ－パック OVER THE X [BT-20]

localized.name: 破滅の使徒降臨!!
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデジモン1体をトラッシュの名称に「デクス」を含むLv.6以下のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-4で進化できる。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【お互いのターン】自分の「デクスドルゴラモン」がバトルエリアを離れるとき、≪ディレイ≫。
・そのデジモンの進化元から、「ドルモン」1枚を手札に戻すことで、自分のトラッシュから、「デクスモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

localized.name: 파멸의 사도 강림!!
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 디지몬 1마리를 트래시의 명칭에 「데크스」를 포함하는 Lv.6 이하의 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -4 하여 진화시킬 수 있다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【서로의 턴】자신의 「데크스도루고라몬」이 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 《딜레이》. ・그 디지몬의 진화원에서 「도루몬」 1장을 패로 되돌리는 것으로, 자신의 트래시에서 「데크스몬」 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

localized.name: 破灭的使徒降临!!
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】可以将我方1只数码宝贝以需支付的进化费用-4进化成废弃区中的名称中包含“死X”且等级不高于Lv.6的数码宝贝卡牌。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【双方的回合】当我方的“死X多路战龙兽”将要离开战斗区时,《延迟》。

·可从该数码宝贝的进化源中,将1张“多路兽”放回到手牌中,并可以从我方的废弃区中,不支付费用登场1张“死X兽”。

localized.name: Apparition Legion
localized.mainEffect: [Main] By returning 9 levels' total worth of Digimon cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Ghost] trait Digimon card of each returned card's level from your trash without paying the costs. Then, the Digimon this effect played gain ＜Rush＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to return Digimon cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck until the total of their levels is 8 or less?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
In the case of this card's [Main] effect, you must return Digimon cards to the bottom of the deck until the total value is the specified level.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to return a level 3 and a level 6 Digimon card from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, what level of Digimon cards can I play from my trash?
faqs.answer:
You can play level 3 and level 6 Digimon cards. 
1 of each card with the same level as the returned cards can be played.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to return 3 level 3 Digimon cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, can I play 3 level 3 Digimon cards from my trash?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
1 of each card with the same level as the returned cards can be played.

sourceNotes: ブースタ－パック OVER THE X [BT-20]

localized.name: アパリションレギオン
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】相手のトラッシュから、デジモンカードをLv.合計9になるようにデッキの下に戻すことで、自分のトラッシュから、特徴に「ゴースト型」を持ち、戻したカードと同じLv.のデジモンカード1枚ずつをコストを支払わずに登場できる。その後、この効果で登場したデジモンは相手のターン終了まで、≪速攻≫と≪ブロッカー≫を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、相手のトラッシュのカードをLv.合計8以下になるようにデッキの下に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
このカードの【メイン】効果の場合、指定されたLv.合計分、デッキの下に戻す必要があります。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、相手のトラッシュのLv.3とLv.6のデジモンカードをデッキに戻した場合、自分のトラッシュからどのLv.のデジモンカードを登場させることができますか？
faqs.answer:
Lv.3とLv.6のデジモンカードを登場させることができます。
戻したカードと同じLv.のカードを1枚ずつ登場させることができます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、相手のトラッシュのLv.3のデジモンカード3枚をデッキに戻した場合、自分のトラッシュからLv.3のデジモンカード3枚を登場させることができますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、登場させることができます。
戻したカードと同じLv.のカードを1枚ずつ登場させることができます。

localized.name: 애퍼리션 레기온
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】상대의 트래시에서 디지몬 카드를 Lv. 합계 9가 되도록 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로, 자신의 트래시에서 특징으로 「고스트형」을 가지고, 되돌린 카드와 같은 Lv.의 디지몬 카드 1장씩을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다. 그 후, 이 효과로 등장한 디지몬은 상대의 턴 종료까지 《속공》과 《블로커》를 얻는다.

localized.name: 恶灵军团
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】可从对方的废弃区中,将Lv.数值合计为9的数码宝贝卡牌放回到其卡组最下方,并可以从我方的废弃区中,不支付费用登场拥有“幽灵型”特征且与被放回的卡牌相同Lv.的数码宝贝卡牌各1张。此后,直到对方的回合结束为止,通过此效果登场的数码宝贝获得《速攻》和《阻挡者》效果。

localized.name: Singularity of Chaos
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a Digimon with [Chaosmon] in its name or the [ACCEL] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Gain 1 memory and add this card to the hand.
[Main] You may play 1 Digimon card with the [ACCEL] trait from your hand with the play cost reduced by 4. Then, place this card as any of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
localized.sourceEffect: [End of Opponent's Turn] If this Digimon has [Chaosmon] in its name, trash your opponent's top security card and this Digimon gets -30000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: If BT20-037 [Chaosmon: Valdur Arm] has this card, a yellow level 6 card, and a green level 6 card in its digivolution cards, then this card's inherited effect causes its DP to become 0 and it's deleted, does BT20-037 [Chaosmon: Valdur Arm]'s <Partition (Yellow Lv.6 + Green/Black Lv.6)> trigger?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it triggers. 
When deletion occurs by DP becoming 0, it's considered deletion by the rules, therefore <Partition>'s trigger conditions are met.

sourceNotes: ブースタ－パック OVER THE X [BT-20]

localized.name: 混沌の特異点
localized.mainEffect:
名称に「カオスモン」を含むか特徴に「アクセル」を持つ自分のデジモンがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
【セキュリティ】メモリー+1し、このカードを手札に加える。
【メイン】自分の手札から、特徴に「アクセル」を持つデジモンカード1枚を支払う登場コスト-4で登場できる。その後、このカードを自分のデジモンの進化元の下に置く。
localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン終了時】このデジモンが名称に「カオスモン」を含むなら、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄し、ターン終了まで、このデジモンをDP-30000。

faqs.question: このカードと黄のLv.6のカードと緑のLv.6のカードを進化元に持つ「BT20-037 カオスモン」が、このカードの進化元効果でDPが0になり消滅する場合、「BT20-037 カオスモン」の≪パーティション《黄Lv.6&緑/黒Lv.6》≫は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、誘発します。
DPが0になることによって消滅する場合、ルールによる消滅となるため、≪パーティション≫の誘発条件を満たします。

localized.name: 혼돈의 특이점
localized.mainEffect: 명칭에 「카오스몬」을 포함하거나 특징으로 「액셀」을 가진 자신의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 카드는 색 조건을 무시할 수 있다. 【시큐리티】메모리 +1 하고, 이 카드를 패에 추가한다. 【메인】자신의 패에서 특징으로 「액셀」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 지불하는 등장 코스트 -4 하여 등장시킬 수 있다. 그 후, 이 카드를 자신의 디지몬의 진화원 아래에 놓는다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【상대의 턴 종료 시】이 디지몬이 명칭에 「카오스몬」을 포함한다면, 상대의 시큐리티를 위에서부터 1장 파기하고, 턴 종료까지 이 디지몬을 DP -30000.

localized.name: 混沌的特异点
localized.mainEffect:
我方场上存在名称中包含“混沌兽”或拥有“ACCEL”特征的数码宝贝期间,此卡牌可以无视颜色条件。

【安防】内存值+1,且此卡牌加入手牌。

【主要】可以从我方的手牌中,以需支付的登场费用-4登场1张拥有“ACCEL”特征的数码宝贝卡牌。此后,将此卡牌置于我方数码宝贝的进化源最下方。
localized.sourceEffect: 【对方的回合结束时】若此数码宝贝的名称中包含“混沌兽”,则丢弃对方安防区最上方的1张卡牌,且直到回合结束为止,此数码宝贝的DP-30000。

localized.name: The Last Guardian
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Cool Boy] and 1 card with the [Royal Knight] or [X Antibody] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Omnimon] in their names would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of those Digimon doesn't leave.

localized.name: 최후의 수호자
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 그중 「쿨 보이」 1장과 특징으로 「로얄 나이츠」/「X항체」를 가진 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【서로의 턴】명칭에 「오메가몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬이 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 《딜레이》. ・그 디지몬 1마리는 벗어나지 않는다.

localized.mainEffect:

·使其中的1只数码宝贝不会离开。

localized.mainEffect:

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Omnimon]: Cost 2
＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Omnimon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, choose 1 of both players' Digimon and delete all other Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn and attack without suspending.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question:
I have this card and BT20-060 [Alphamon: Ouryuken ACE] in the battle area. 
I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to give <Rush> to this card itself, then I use this card to attack a player. 
If the attack causes a security check on my opponent, BT20-060 [Alphamon: Ouryuken ACE]'s effect gives me +3 memory, and the turn doesn't end, does this card still have <Rush>?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it still has it. 
The text reads "for the turn," so it will last until the turn ends and switches to your opponent's turn.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

[Digivolve] [Omnimon]: Cost 2
＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Omnimon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, choose 1 of both players' Digimon and delete all other Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn and attack without suspending.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question:
I have this card and BT20-060 [Alphamon: Ouryuken ACE] in the battle area. 
I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to give <Rush> to this card itself, then I use this card to attack a player. 
If the attack causes a security check on my opponent, BT20-060 [Alphamon: Ouryuken ACE]'s effect gives me +3 memory, and the turn doesn't end, does this card still have <Rush>?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it still has it. 
The text reads "for the turn," so it will last until the turn ends and switches to your opponent's turn.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

localized.name: オメガモンX抗体
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「オメガモン」:コスト2
≪突進≫≪貫通≫≪ブロッカー≫
【登場時】【進化時】このデジモンの進化元に「オメガモン」/「X抗体」があるなら、お互いのデジモン1体ずつを選び、選んだデジモン以外のデジモン全てを消滅させる。その後、相手のデジモン1体をデッキの下に戻す。
【自分のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］ターン終了まで、自分のデジモン1体は≪速攻≫を得て、そのデジモンでレストせずにアタックできる。

sourceAttributes.type: 聖騎士型/X抗体/ロイヤルナイツ/リベレイター

faqs.question:
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果を発揮して、1つ目の処理で相手のデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、「離れるとき」などの他の即時型効果でこのカードがバトルエリアから離れました。
そのあとに、この効果の「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮した場合、発揮したカードが効果の途中でその場所を離れた場合でも、最後まで解決します。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに自分のこのカードと「BT20-060 アルファモン:王竜剣ACE」がいる状況です。
このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でこのカード自身に≪速攻≫を付与し、このカードでプレイヤーにアタックしました。
そのアタックで、相手のセキュリティをチェックし、「BT20-060 アルファモン:王竜剣ACE」の効果でメモリーが+3されターンが終了しなかった場合、このカードに≪速攻≫は付与されたままですか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与されたままです。
「ターン終了まで」は、ターンが終了し相手にターンが交代するまで続きます。

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards attacks, and a security check was performed on my opponent's security stack. 
If the attacking Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards digivolves into a Digimon with <Security A. +1> using this card's inherited effect, is another security check performed?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, another security check is performed.

faqs.question: I use a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards to perform a security check on my opponent's security stack, then I use this Digimon's inherited effect to digivolve into BT21-024 [Cyberdramon]. What card is trashed by BT21-024 [Cyberdramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect at such times?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
The top card of the security stack. 
Upon a security check, the checked card is already considered to be removed from the security stack, therefore that card won't be trashed.

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [BurningGreymon]: Cost 0
[When Digivolving] You may place 1 [Hybrid] or [Hero] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card or under any of your red Tamers with inherited effects.
[When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a red [Hybrid] or [Hero] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +2000 DP.

faqs.question: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
faqs.answer:
No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

faqs.question: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you do.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

faqs.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it does not.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: アグニモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ヴリトラモン」:コスト0
【進化時】自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「ハイブリッド体」/「ヒーロー」を持つデジモンカード1枚をこのデジモンの進化元の下か進化元効果を持つ赤の自分のテイマーの下に置ける。
【アタック時】このデジモンを手札の特徴に「ハイブリッド体」/「ヒーロー」を持つ赤のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-1で進化できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンをDP+2000。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化する進化条件は進化元となるテイマーをデジモンとしても扱い進化しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、テイマーからそのまま進化します。デジモンが進化するとは扱わず、「デジモンが進化するとき」効果や「デジモンが進化したとき」効果は誘発しません。
また、「デジモンが進化できない」効果が発揮された場合でも、この進化条件でテイマーから進化できます。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化した場合でも、進化ドローは行いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化ドローを行います。
どのような進化の場合でも、進化ドローは行います。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: はい、得ます。

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: I link BT21-018 [DoGatchmon] with this card and use its effect to attack. Can I then use the effect on the linked BT21-018 [DoGatchmon] to attack?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't use the effect on the linked BT21-018 [DoGatchmon] to attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, this card's [Your Turn] effect and BT21-018 [DoGatchmon]'s [When Linking] effect trigger simultaneously, and this card's [Your Turn] effect is used to attack. 
BT21-018 [DoGatchmon]'s [When Linking] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the linked BT21-018 [DoGatchmon]'s [When Linking] effect, even if you activate it.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Gammamon] in its text from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less.
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Gammamon] in its text would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by trashing 3 Digimon cards from its digivolution cards, it doesn't leave.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 2 digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's inherited effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this inherited effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.

localized.name: カノーヴァイスモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ガンマモン」の記述があるLv.4:コスト3
【登場時】【進化時】自分の手札から、「ガンマモン」の記述があるデジモンカード1枚をこのデジモンの進化元の下に置くことで、DP7000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］「ガンマモン」の記述があるこのデジモンが相手の効果でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、デジモンカード3枚を破棄することで、離れない。

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果の条件は、進化元のカードを2枚だけ破棄することはできますか？2025/04/04 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この進化元効果の条件の場合、指定された枚数分、進化元を破棄する必要があります。

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

【進化】「ガンマモン」の記述があるLv.5/特徴に「ヒーロー」を持つLv.5:コスト3
≪Sアタック+1≫≪突進≫
【進化時】【アタック時】自分の手札から、「ガンマモン」の記述があるか特徴に「ヒーロー」を持つデジモンカード1枚をこのデジモンの進化元の下に置くことで、最もDPの低い相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。
例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

localized.name: Medusamon
localized.mainEffect:
＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Progress＞ (While attacking, your opponent's effects don't affect this Digimon.)
[When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted or their security stack is removed from, they play 1 [Petrification] Token. (Digimon/white/3000 DP/[Your Turn] This Digimon can't suspend. [On Deletion] Trash your top security card.)

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: Which player's token does this card's [All Turns] effect play as an opponent's Digimon?Feb. 6, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
The token of the player that activated this card's [All Turns] effect is played as an opponent's Digimon. 
If the token played by this effect is removed from the field or the game ends, the token is returned to that player.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to play a [Petrification] Token during the turn I activated BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s [Main] effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
This card's [All Turns] effect plays one of your cards. 
Cards can be played by your effects even after a "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" effect has activated.

localized.name: メデューサモン
localized.mainEffect:
≪Sアタック+1≫≪プログレス≫（アタック中のこのデジモンは相手の効果を受けない）
【進化時】【アタック終了時】［ターンに1回］最もDPの低い相手のデジモン1体を消滅できる。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］相手のデジモンが消滅したときか相手のセキュリティが減ったとき、相手は「石化」（デジモン・白・DP3000・【自分のターン】このデジモンはレストできない。【消滅時】自分のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。）トークン1体を登場させる。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？
faqs.answer:
【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。
【セキュリティ】効果はチェックされた場合、発揮待ちにならずに即座に発揮されます。
それ以外の誘発した効果は、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、どちらのプレイヤーが用意したトークンを相手のデジモンとして登場させますか？2026/01/30 更新
faqs.answer:
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮させたプレイヤーが用意したトークンを相手のデジモンとして登場させます。
この効果で登場したトークンがエリアから離れたり、ゲームが終了したら、そのトークンは用意したプレイヤーの元に戻します。

faqs.question: 自分が「BT8-097 紅焔」の【メイン】効果を発揮したターンに、自分のこのカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、「石化」トークンを登場させることができますか？2025/04/04 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、登場させることができます。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、自分がカードを登場させる効果です。
「相手は効果でデジモンを登場できない」効果が発揮されたあとでも、自分の効果では登場させることができます。

faqs.question: What happens if a Digimon with 10 or fewer cards stacked with it is chosen for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer:
The top card is trashed until there are no more stacked cards. 
Once there is 1 card left, it isn't considered to have "stacked cards," therefore no more are trashed.

faqs.question: What happens if this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trashes stacked cards and the Digimon becomes a Digimon without DP?
faqs.answer:
It's trashed upon the rule check timing. 
This trashing isn't considered trashing from the battle area.

faqs.question: I used a DUAL card with the name [ShineGreymon] on its Digimon side as an Option card from my hand. Can I then use Arts Digivolve to digivolve this card into the card I used, ignoring digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A used Option card is treated as not being in any area until its [Main] effect has been resolved and the card would be trashed. 
You can't ignore digivolution requirements because it isn't treated as a card in the hand.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
faqs.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect. 
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten. 
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?Mar. 13, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: 「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとしても扱うようになったテイマーが、あとから他の効果で「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果を受けた場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
誘発した効果で「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果を受けた場合、登場コスト・Lv.・DPは、あとから受けた効果に上書きされます。
ただし、常に発揮されている効果で「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果を受けている場合、常に発揮されている効果に上書きされます。
≪速攻≫など、それ以外の効果も得た場合は、その効果は追加で得ます。

faqs.question: 相手の「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」効果が発揮されている間、「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとして扱われているテイマーの効果でメモリーをプラスできますか？2026/03/13 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモンとテイマー両方として扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

faqs.question: 相手の「デジモンの効果を受けない」カードを、「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとして扱われているテイマーの効果で選んだ場合、選ばれた相手のデジモンは効果の影響を受けますか？2026/03/13 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、効果の影響を受けません。
デジモンとテイマー両方として扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方を含むため、選ばれた相手のデジモンは効果の影響を受けません。

faqs.question: 相手の「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」効果が発揮されている間、「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとして扱われているテイマーの効果でメモリーをプラスできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモン及びテイマーとして扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.answer: The BT21-054 [Shotmon] linked with this card is trashed upon the rule check timing.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

[When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't trash this Digimon's stacked cards. Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ for every 2 [Vemmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 [Vemmon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by returning 2 [Vemmon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, end that attack.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

localized.name: デストロモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ベムモン」:コスト6
【進化時】相手のターン終了まで、このデジモンに重ねられているカードは相手の効果で破棄されない。その後、相手のデジモン1体をこのデジモンの進化元の「ベムモン」2枚ごとに、≪退化1≫。
【お互いのターン】このデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、「ベムモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン】［ターンに1回］相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、このデジモンの進化元から、「ベムモン」2枚をデッキの下に戻すことで、そのアタックを終了する。

faqs.question: 「アタックを終了する」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: この効果を発揮した場合、現在のタイミングが「アタック終了時」になります。例えば、「アタック宣言」のタイミングでこの効果を発揮した場合、「アタック宣言」のタイミングから「アタック終了時」になります。「カウンタータイミング」「ブロックタイミング」には進行されず、アタックは成立しません。

faqs.question: 効果を受けないデジモンのアタックを、「アタックを終了する」効果で終了させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、アタックを終了させることができます。
アタックを終了させる効果は、タイミングを変更する効果なので、アタックしているデジモンには影響を及ぼしていません。
