faqs.question:
A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards attacks, and another effect trashes a card from my hand. 
At such times, if I activate this card's inherited effect and perform a digivolution into P-209 [Titamon], can I then activate P-209 [Titamon]'s <Alliance>?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
<Alliance> is an effect that triggers upon an attack. You can't activate it if the Digimon doesn't have <Alliance> upon the attack declaration.

faqs.question:
I trash 2 copies of this card from my hand, then I have 5 cards in my hand. 
At such times, if I activate the 1st effect on the 1st copy of this card and have 6 cards in my hand, can I then use the 1st effect on the 2nd copy of this card to <Draw 1> again?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must have 5 or fewer cards in your hand upon the actual activation timing for this card's 1st effect.

faqs.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card. 
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

faqs.question: What Digimon are referred to as "other Digimon" by this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
It refers to Digimon other than the Digimon that would leave the battle area. 
However, if multiple Digimon would leave, you can place Digimon other than 1 of those Digimon in the security stack to meet the conditions.

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Beastkin]/[Dark Dragon]/[TS] trait: Cost 3
When this card would be played, if you have an [Iliad] trait Digimon or Tamer, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Iliad] trait card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ for each of your Digimon.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your [Iliad] trait Digimon gain ＜Reboot＞ and ＜Blocker＞.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect to <De-Digivolve> my opponent's Digimon even if I don't play a card from my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Even if you don't play a card, you <De-Digivolve> your opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: If I have 2 Digimon, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect activate <De-Digivolve 1> twice? Or does <De-Digivolve 2> activate once?
faqs.answer:
<De-Digivolve 1> activates twice. <De-Digivolve 2> doesn't activate once. 
Even if a Tamer card or Option card becomes the top card after trashing the top card, <De-Digivolve> can trash a card regardless of its card category, therefore you go on to trash the 2nd card. However, if a card with an "isn't affected by effects" becomes the top card after the first <De-Digivolve 1>, it won't be affected by the second <De-Digivolve 1> and won't be trashed.

faqs.question:
All of my Digimon get -5000 DP. I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect to play a Digimon with 5000 DP or less. 
At such times, is the played Digimon deleted before the part of the effect after "then"?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

localized.name: ミネルヴァモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「獣人型」/「魔竜型」/「TS」を持つLv.5:コスト3
このカードが登場するとき、特徴に「イリアス」を持つ自分のデジモン/テイマーがいるなら、支払う登場コスト-5。

sourceAttributes.type: 神人型/オリンポス十二神/イリアス/TS

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【消滅時】効果は、手札のカードを登場させなかった場合でも、相手のデジモンを≪退化≫させますか？
faqs.answer: はい、登場させなかった場合でも、相手のデジモンを≪退化≫させます。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【消滅時】効果で、自分のデジモンが2体いる場合、≪退化1≫が2回発揮するのですか？それとも≪退化2≫が1回発揮するのでしょうか？
faqs.answer:
≪退化1≫を2回発揮することになります。≪退化2≫を1回発揮する訳ではありません。
上から1枚破棄したことで、テイマーカードやオプションカードが1番上になったとしても、≪退化≫はカードカテゴリーに関わらず破棄できるので、そのまま2枚目の破棄を続けて行います。ただし、≪退化1≫したことによって「効果を受けない」カードになった場合などは、≪退化1≫の効果を受けないため、破棄されません。

faqs.question:
自分のデジモン全てがDP-5000されている状況です。このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【消滅時】効果で、DP5000以下のデジモンを登場させました。
このとき、「その後」以降の効果より先に、登場させたデジモンは消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【消滅時】効果を全て解決したあとに、その時点でDP0のデジモンが全て同時に消滅します。

At such times, if I activate the 1st effect on the 1st copy of this card and have 6 cards in my hand, can I then use the 1st effect on the 2nd copy of this card to <Draw 1> again?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must have 5 or fewer cards in your hand upon the actual activation timing for this card's 1st effect.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card. 
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

faqs.question:
自分のデジモンにこのカードがリンクしている状況です。
「BT7-107 ヤミからの呼び声」の【メイン】効果でそのデジモンを消滅させ、消滅させたそのデジモンカードを手札に戻した場合、そのあとにこのカードのリンク効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できません。
デジモンが消滅し、リンク効果の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、発揮待ちになるのはそのリンクカードを持っていたデジモンカードです。
発揮待ちのカードが発揮する前にその領域を離れた場合、その効果を発揮させることはできません。
この状況の場合、このカードとリンクしていたデジモンが消滅し、リンク効果の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、その効果が発揮待ちになるのはリンクしていたデジモンカードです。
消滅し発揮待ちとなっていたデジモンカードがトラッシュから離れた場合、発揮待ちとなっていたリンク効果の【消滅時】効果は、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card. 
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

faqs.question:
自分のデジモンにこのカードがリンクしている状況です。
「BT7-107 ヤミからの呼び声」の【メイン】効果でそのデジモンを消滅させ、消滅させたそのデジモンカードを手札に戻した場合、そのあとにこのカードのリンク効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮できません。
デジモンが消滅し、リンク効果の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、発揮待ちになるのはそのリンクカードを持っていたデジモンカードです。
発揮待ちのカードが発揮する前にその領域を離れた場合、その効果を発揮させることはできません。
この状況の場合、このカードとリンクしていたデジモンが消滅し、リンク効果の【消滅時】効果が誘発した場合、その効果が発揮待ちになるのはリンクしていたデジモンカードです。
消滅し発揮待ちとなっていたデジモンカードがトラッシュから離れた場合、発揮待ちとなっていたリンク効果の【消滅時】効果は、発揮させることはできません。

The processing shown after "instead" in the effect replaces the standard processing.

faqs.question: What is a {Trash} effect?
faqs.answer:
A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in my trash, 2 of my Digimon with the [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait are in the battle area, and I have 4 cards in my hand. 
At the end of my turn, the {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card in the trash trigger simultanesouly. I activate the effect on the 1st copy and digivolve 1 of my Digimon with the [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait into this card. 
After that, I perform the digivolution bonus draw, and I now have 5 cards in my hand. Can I then activate the {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effect that triggered simultaneously on the other copy of this card?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must have 4 or fewer cards in your hand upon the actual activation timing for this card's {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effect.

localized.name: Owen Dreadnought
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Owen Dreadnought] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 [Elizamon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, that Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, it may attack.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You can only process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if you return this card to the bottom of the deck.

faqs.question: At the start of my main phase, this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect plays a card. Can I then activate the [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the played card?
faqs.answer: No, you can't activate it.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you don't suspend this card, you can't process the part after "then" in its [Your Turn] effect.

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

localized.name: 結城ダン&結城カナン
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】メモリーが4以下なら、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン終了時】このテイマーをレストさせることで、自分の手札から、使用コストが相手側のメモリー以下の特徴に「TS」を持つオプションカード1枚をコストを支払わずに使用できる。その後、特徴に「TS」を持つ自分のデジモン1体でアタックできる。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが4以下」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の4から右側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、「ことで」の条件を満たさなくても、「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果の場合、このカードをレストさせなければ、「その後」以降の効果を処理できません。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、オプションカードを使用したあとに、自分のデジモンでアタックしないことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 4 or less memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 4 or further to the right on your side.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: What cards can be played by this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect?
faqs.answer: 1 [Asuna Shiroki], 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [TS] trait, or 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Three Musketeers] in its text.

faqs.question: At the start of my turn, this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect plays a card. Can I then activate the [Start of Your Turn] effect on the played card?
faqs.answer: No, you can't activate it.

【我方的回合开始时】若内存值不多于4,则可将此驯兽师放回到卡组的最下方,并可以从我方的废弃区中,不支付费用登场1张“城木明日奈”或1张等级不高于Lv.4,且记述有“三枪手”或拥有“TS”特征的数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Unique Emblem: Blazing Conductor
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Elizamon] or [Owen Dreadnought] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Owen Dreadnought]s suspend, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait and the [LIBERATOR] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.

faqs.question: If I would use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into a [Reptile] trait Digimon card or a Digimon card with just the [Dragonkin] trait or [LIBERATOR] trait?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
It can only digivolve into a [Reptile] trait card or a card with both the [Dragonkin] and [LIBERATOR] traits.

localized.mainEffect:

特徴に「爬虫類型」または「竜人型」と「リベレイター」の両方を持つカードにのみ進化させることができます。

localized.mainEffect:

localized.name: アビス・サンクチュアリ 玉座の間
localized.mainEffect:
自分の表向きのセキュリティがない間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
［セキュリティ］【お互いのターン】特徴に「TS」を持つ青/黄の自分のデジモン全ては≪ブロッカー≫を得る。自分の「ネプトゥーンモン」/「ウェヌスモン」がいる間、特徴に「TS」を持つ青/黄の自分のデジモン全ては≪連携≫を得る。
【メイン】自分のセキュリティを下から1枚手札に加え、このカードをセキュリティの下に表向きで置く。その後、自分の手札から、特徴に「TS」を持つ青/黄のデジモンカード1枚を支払う登場コスト-3で登場できる。

faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

localized.name: 深海神殿 王座之间
localized.mainEffect:
我方场上不存在正面朝上的安防卡牌期间,此卡牌可以无视颜色条件。

{安防}【双方的回合】我方所有拥有“TS”特征的蓝色/黄色数码宝贝获得《阻挡者》效果。我方的场上存在“尼普顿兽”/“维纳斯兽”期间,我方所有拥有“TS”特征的蓝色/黄色数码宝贝获得《联协》效果。

【主要】将我方安防区最下方的1张卡牌加入手牌,并将此卡牌正面朝上置于安防区的最下方。此后,可以从我方的手牌中,以需支付的登场费用-3登场1张拥有“TS”特征的蓝色/黄色数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Tidal Stream
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a [TS] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] Return all of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the hand. If this effect returned, 1 of your [TS] trait Digimon unsuspends. Then, you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost.
localized.sourceEffect:
DP+2000
＜Link＞ [TS] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Return 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the hand.

faqs.question: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.

faqs.question:
This card is linked to a Digimon. 
If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
faqs.answer: It's considered a Digimon effect.

faqs.question:
Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. 
Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can link it. 
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

faqs.question: Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question:
I used BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to use this card, and I used its [Main] effect to link this card to my Digimon. 
If I then use the part of BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect after "then" to have the linked Digimon attack, can I activate this card's link effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: タイダルストリーム
localized.mainEffect:
エリアに特徴に「TS」を持つ自分のデジモン/テイマーがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
【セキュリティ】このカードの【メイン】効果を発揮する。
【メイン】最もLv.の低い相手のデジモン全てを手札に戻す。この効果で戻したなら、特徴に「TS」を持つ自分のデジモン1体をアクティブにする。その後、このカードをエリアの自分のデジモン1体にコストを支払わずにリンクできる。

〈リンク〉特徴「TS」:コスト3（手札/バトルエリアから、このカードをバトルエリアの指定のデジモンに横向きで差し込む）
【アタック時】［ターンに1回］最もLv.の低い相手のデジモン1体を手札に戻す。

faqs.answer: バトルエリアか育成エリアに、指定のカードがいる状況を指します。

このカードがデジモンにリンクしている状況です。
このカードがリンク効果を発揮した場合、その効果は「デジモンの効果」と「オプションカードの効果」のどちらになりますか？
faqs.answer: 「デジモンの効果」です。

効果でオプションカードを使用できない状況です。
このカードのリンクコストを支払って、自分のデジモンにリンクさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、リンクさせることができます。
カードをリンクさせる場合はオプションカードの使用ではないため、使用できない状況でもリンクさせることは可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果でリンクする場合、育成エリアのデジモンにもリンクさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、育成エリアのデジモンにもリンクさせることができます。

faqs.question:
「BT24-085 結城ダン&結城カナン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果で、このカードを使用し、【メイン】効果で自分のデジモンにこのカードをリンクさせました。
そのあとに、「BT24-085 結城ダン&結城カナン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果の「その後」以降の効果で、リンクさせたそのデジモンでアタックした場合、このカードのリンク効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮させることができます。

localized.name: Temple of Beginnings
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Add your top security card to the hand and ＜Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When your security stack is removed from, ＜Delay＞.
・You may place the top stacked card of any of your Digimon with [Aegiochusmon] or [Jupitermon] in their names as the top security card.

faqs.question: I have 0 security cards. Can I activate this card's [Main] effect and perform <Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫> without adding a security card to the hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: What does this card's <Delay> effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: This effect allows you to choose one of your Digimon with [Aegiochusmon] or [Jupitermon] in its name and place its top stacked card as your top security card.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to place one of Digimon with [Aegiochusmon] or [Jupitermon] in its name that doesn't have any cards under it on top of the security stack?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Only 1 card isn't considered "stacked cards."

localized.name: はじまりの神殿
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のセキュリティを上から1枚手札に加え、≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【お互いのターン】自分のセキュリティが減ったとき、≪ディレイ≫。
・名称に「アイギオテュースモン」/「ユピテルモン」を含む自分のデジモンに重ねられているカードを上から1枚セキュリティの上に置ける。

faqs.question: セキュリティが0枚の状況です。このカードの【メイン】効果を発揮して、セキュリティを手札に加えずに≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫をすることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？
faqs.answer:
【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。
【セキュリティ】効果はチェックされた場合、発揮待ちにならずに即座に発揮されます。
それ以外の誘発した効果は、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 名称に「アイギオテュースモン」か「ユピテルモン」を含む自分のデジモンを選び、そのデジモンに重ねられているカードを上から1枚、セキュリティの上に置くことができる効果です。

faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
1枚だけのカードは重ねられているカードではありません。

faqs.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?May. 8, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: If I activate this card's 2nd [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon or Tamers with the [TS] trait would leave the battle area at the same time, are all of those Digimon and Tamers prevented from leaving?
faqs.answer:
Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. 
This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.

localized.name: ユピテルモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「TS」を持つLv.5:コスト5
【進化】名称に「アイギオテュースモン」を含むLv.5:自分のセキュリティ1枚ごとに、コスト1
【登場時】【進化時】自分のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄し、相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-13000。その後、自分のセキュリティが1枚以下なら、≪リカバリー+2《デッキ》≫。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］自分のセキュリティが減ったとき、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］特徴に「TS」を持つ自分のデジモン/テイマーがバトルエリアを離れるとき、自分のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄することで、離れない。

sourceAttributes.type: 神人型/オリンポス十二神/イリアス/TS

faqs.question:
自分のセキュリティが0枚の状況です。
このカードの3つ目の進化条件で、名称に「アイギオテュースモン」を含むLv.5から進化する場合、何コストで進化できますか？
faqs.answer: 0コストで進化することができます。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、自分のセキュリティが0枚で破棄できなかった場合でも、相手のデジモン1体をDPマイナスすることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question:
このカードの効果で、相手のデジモンのDPが0になりました。
このとき、DPが0になったデジモンはその時点で消滅しますか？2026/05/08 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。
発揮した効果を全て解決したあとルールチェックになり、その時点でDPが0のデジモン全てが同時に消滅します。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？
faqs.answer:
【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。
【セキュリティ】効果はチェックされた場合、発揮待ちにならずに即座に発揮されます。
それ以外の誘発した効果は、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。

faqs.question: 特徴に「TS」を持つ自分のデジモンかテイマーが複数体同時にバトルエリアを離れるとき、このカードの2つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮した場合、それら全てのデジモンとテイマーが離れなくなりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、それら全てのデジモンが離れなくなります。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、カードを選ばず、全体に影響を及ぼす効果です。

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if your opponent has 5 or more memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 5 or further to the right on your opponent's side.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if your opponent has 5 or less memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 5 or further to the left from your opponent's point of view.

faqs.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: 「メモリーが相手側の5以上」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが相手側の5から右側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが相手側の5以下」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが相手側の5から左側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

localized.name: Marsmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[TS] trait: Cost 3
When this card would be played, if there is a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [TS] trait Digimon win a battle, trash your opponent's top security card.

faqs.question: What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect directly performs a battle. 
If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle, as with the standard rules.

faqs.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
faqs.answer:
Yes, they can battle. 
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle. 
If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

faqs.question:
During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, the attacking Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. 
Then, if the attack target successfully becomes an opponent's Digimon and it's also deleted in battle, do I use that Digimon's <Piercing> to perform 2 checks?
faqs.answer:
No, you only perform 1 security check for <Piercing>. 
Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. 
However, if the number of checks is modified by <Security A.>, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.

faqs.question:
During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to have that Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. 
Then, if the attack target successfully becomes an opponent's Digimon, it loses the battle, but an effect prevents it from being deleted, can I still activate that Digimon's <Piercing>?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
<Piercing> is an effect that triggers and activates if an opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle during the attack, and it's processed immediately before the end of attack timing. 
<Piercing> will still trigger if the Digimon with <Piercing> successfully attacks a Digimon, even if another battle occurs during this battle.

faqs.question: When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
faqs.answer:
It triggers when the battle is won. 
When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.

faqs.question: Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. 
At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
faqs.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. 
At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the loser Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
faqs.answer: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. 
At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be activated.

【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】ターン終了まで、自分のデジモン1体をDP+3000。その後、自分のデジモン1体と相手のデジモン1体でバトルできる。
【お互いのターン】[ターン1回]特徴「TS」を持つ自分のデジモンがバトルに勝ったとき、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。

sourceAttributes.type: 神人型/オリンポス十二神/イリアス/TS

faqs.question: 「バトルできる」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
「バトル」を直接行わせる効果です。
この効果を発揮させた場合、通常のルール通り選んだデジモン同士をバトルさせます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つデジモンを含む2体を「バトルできる」効果で選び、バトルさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、バトルさせることができます。
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを効果で選ぶこと自体は可能です。また、「バトル」自体はDPを比べるルールであり効果ではないため、効果を受けないデジモンも選び、バトルさせることができます。
バトルで負けた場合は、通常のルール通り消滅します。

faqs.question:
≪貫通≫を持つ自分のデジモンのアタック中、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮して、アタック中のデジモンと相手のデジモンでバトルし相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させました。
そのあとに、アタックの対象が相手のデジモンに成立し、そのバトルでも相手のデジモンを消滅させた場合、そのデジモンの≪貫通≫で2回チェックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、≪貫通≫によるセキュリティチェックは1回のみです。
≪貫通≫を複数回発揮しても、1回のアタック中にセキュリティチェックできるのは1回のみです。
ただし、≪Sアタック≫でチェックする枚数が増減している場合、1回のセキュリティチェックでその枚数分チェックを繰り返します。

faqs.question:
≪貫通≫を持つ自分のデジモンのアタック中、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果でそのデジモンと相手のデジモンでバトルし相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させました。
そのあとに、アタックの対象が相手のデジモンに成立し、バトルで負けた相手のデジモンが効果で消滅しなかった場合でも、そのデジモンの≪貫通≫を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
≪貫通≫は、アタック中に相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させた場合に誘発・発揮し、アタック終了時の直前に処理する効果です。
≪貫通≫を持つデジモンのアタック中、デジモンにアタックが成立した際のバトル以外でバトルした場合でもその≪貫通≫が誘発します。

faqs.question: 「バトルに勝ったとき」とは、いつ誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
バトルで勝ったときに誘発します。
この効果を持つ自分のデジモンがバトルした際、相手のデジモンが負けて消滅したあとに「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を発揮できます。

faqs.question: 「バトルに勝ったとき」効果は、セキュリティデジモンとのバトルに勝ったときにも誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負け消滅しました。
このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンが消滅したことによって誘発した効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発となるので、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンの「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、バトル相手のデジモンが効果で消滅しなかった場合でも、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮することができます。

faqs.question: 「バトルできる」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
「バトル」を直接行わせる効果です。
この効果を発揮させた場合、通常のルール通り選んだデジモン同士をバトルさせます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つデジモンを含む2体を「バトルできる」効果で選び、バトルさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、バトルさせることができます。
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを効果で選ぶこと自体は可能です。また、「バトル」自体はDPを比べるルールであり効果ではないため、効果を受けないデジモンも選び、バトルさせることができます。
バトルで負けた場合は、通常のルール通り消滅します。

faqs.question:
≪貫通≫を持つ自分のデジモンのアタック中、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮して、アタック中のデジモンと相手のデジモンでバトルし相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させました。
そのあとに、アタックの対象が相手のデジモンに成立し、そのバトルでも相手のデジモンを消滅させた場合、そのデジモンの≪貫通≫で2回チェックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、≪貫通≫によるセキュリティチェックは1回のみです。
≪貫通≫を複数回発揮しても、1回のアタック中にセキュリティチェックできるのは1回のみです。
ただし、≪Sアタック≫でチェックする枚数が増減している場合、1回のセキュリティチェックでその枚数分チェックを繰り返します。

faqs.question:
≪貫通≫を持つ自分のデジモンのアタック中、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果でそのデジモンと相手のデジモンでバトルし相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させました。
そのあとに、アタックの対象が相手のデジモンに成立し、バトルで負けた相手のデジモンが効果で消滅しなかった場合でも、そのデジモンの≪貫通≫を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
≪貫通≫は、アタック中に相手のデジモンをバトルで消滅させた場合に誘発・発揮し、アタック終了時の直前に処理する効果です。
≪貫通≫を持つデジモンのアタック中、デジモンにアタックが成立した際のバトル以外でバトルした場合でもその≪貫通≫が誘発します。

faqs.question: 「バトルに勝ったとき」とは、いつ誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
バトルで勝ったときに誘発します。
この効果を持つ自分のデジモンがバトルした際、相手のデジモンが負けて消滅したあとに「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を発揮できます。

faqs.question: 「バトルに勝ったとき」効果は、セキュリティデジモンとのバトルに勝ったときにも誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負け消滅しました。
このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンが消滅したことによって誘発した効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発となるので、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンの「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、バトル相手のデジモンが効果で消滅しなかった場合でも、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 1 face-down card from under a Tamer for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards under your Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I trash a total of 2 face-down cards from under multiple Tamers for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a green Digimon card with the [TS] trait?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't trigger.

faqs.question: When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
faqs.answer:
It triggers when the battle is won. 
When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.

faqs.question: Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. 
At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
faqs.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. 
At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the loser Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
faqs.answer: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

faqs.question:
A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. 
At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be activated.

このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンが消滅したことによって誘発した効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発となるので、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果と、バトルに負けたデジモンの「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 「消滅するとき」効果や「バトルエリアを離れるとき」効果から発揮することができます。

faqs.question:
「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を持つデジモンがバトルに勝ち、バトル相手のデジモンがバトルに負けました。
このとき、バトル相手のデジモンが効果で消滅しなかった場合でも、「バトルに勝ったとき」効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮することができます。

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Glowing Dawn] trait: Cost 3
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing the bottom face-down card under any of your Tamers, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[When Digivolving] This Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question: What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect directly performs a battle. 
If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle, as with the standard rules.

faqs.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
faqs.answer:
Yes, they can battle. 
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle. 
If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

faqs.answer: 同時誘発になるので、プレイヤーが発揮する順を選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「バトルできる」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
「バトル」を直接行わせる効果です。
この効果を発揮させた場合、通常のルール通り選んだデジモン同士をバトルさせます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つデジモンを含む2体を「バトルできる」効果で選び、バトルさせることはできますか？

はい、バトルさせることができます。

バトルで負けた場合は、通常のルール通り消滅します。

「バトル」を直接行わせる効果です。
この効果を発揮させた場合、通常のルール通り選んだデジモン同士をバトルさせます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つデジモンを含む2体を「バトルできる」効果で選び、バトルさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、バトルさせることができます。
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを効果で選ぶこと自体は可能です。また、「バトル」自体はDPを比べるルールであり効果ではないため、効果を受けないデジモンも選び、バトルさせることができます。
バトルで負けた場合は、通常のルール通り消滅します。

【双方的回合】[每回合1次]当数码宝贝通过效果登场/进化时,将对方的1只数码宝贝《退化1》。此后,可以用此数码宝贝和对方的1只数码宝贝进行战斗。

localized.name: Ceresmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Vegetation]/[TS] trait: Cost 3
When this card would be played, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend up to 2 Digimon. Then, none of your suspended [Vegetation] or [TS] trait Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon effects until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP until their turn ends for each suspended Digimon. ⟨Rule⟩ Trait: Has [Vegetation] Type.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, they can suspend.

faqs.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

localized.name: ケレスモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴「植物型」/「TS」を持つLv.5:コスト3
このカードが登場するとき、レスト状態のデジモンが2体以上いるなら、支払うコスト-5。
【登場時】【進化時】デジモン2体までをレストできる。その後、相手のターン終了まで、特徴「植物型」/「TS」を持つレスト状態の自分のデジモン全ては相手のデジモンの効果を受けない。
【お互いのターン】[ターン1回]デジモンがレストしたとき、相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をレスト状態のデジモン1体ごとに、DP-3000。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「植物型」を持つ。

sourceAttributes.type: 神人型/オリンポス十二神/イリアス/TS

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、自分か相手のどちらのデジモンでもレストできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、レストできます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:

例えば、「ナイトモン」の記述があるカードの場合、名称が「ダークナイトモン」のカードや、効果に「ナイトモン」と書かれているカードを指します。

faqs.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played or when one of my Digimon in the battle area would digivolve into this card?

faqs.question:
Only suspended Digimon are in the battle area. 
Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when a Digimon is played or digivolves?

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when a method other than an effect played or digivolved a Digimon. 
Can I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect again when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?
faqs.answer:

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash BT25-085 [BeelStarmon/Fly Bullet] from my Digimon's digivolution cards, then use the trashed card?Jun. 19, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash an Option card from digivolution cards and then use the trashed Option card. 
Can I then activate the used Option card's "when this card is trashed from digivolution cards" effect?Jun. 19, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A used Option card is treated as not being in any area until its [Main] effect has been resolved and the card would be trashed. 
Upon the timing when a card is no longer considered a card in the trash, it will be considered to be placed in a different area, therefore the effect can't activate.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you don't trash 1 card in your hand, you can't process the part after "after" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 1 card in my hand for this card's 1st [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this 1st [All Turns] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards in your hand.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's 1st [All Turns] effect when this card's DP becomes 0 and it would be deleted by a rule check, then it was prevented from being deleted. 
Can I then activate the 2nd [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't. After deletion is prevented by activating the 1st [All Turns] effect, a rule check occurs again, and this card is deleted because it has 0 DP. The 2nd [All Turns] effect can't activate because this card is deleted before it can activate.

faqs.question: When "trash 1 card in your hand" is performed twice, does a "when your hand is trashed from" effect trigger twice?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers twice.

faqs.question: When "trashing 2 cards in your hand" is performed once, does a "when your hand is trashed from" effect trigger twice?
faqs.answer: No, it only triggers once.

【お互いのターン】自分の手札が破棄されたとき、最もDPの低い相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果は、「ことで」の条件を満たさなくても、「さらに」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果の場合、自分の手札1枚を破棄しなければ、「さらに」以降の効果を処理できません。

faqs.question: このカードの1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果の条件は、自分の手札を1枚だけ破棄することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果の条件の場合、指定された枚数分、自分の手札を破棄する必要があります。

faqs.question:
このカードのDPが0になり、ルールチェックで消滅するとき、このカードの1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、そのルールチェックで消滅しませんでした。
そのあとに、2つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して消滅しなくなったあと、再度ルールチェックになりDPが0のこのカードが消滅します。2つ目の【お互いのターン】効果は発揮する前に消滅したため、発揮できません。

faqs.question: 「自分の手札を1枚破棄する」を2回行ったとき、「自分の手札が破棄されたとき」効果は2回誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、2回誘発します。

faqs.question: 「自分の手札を2枚破棄する」を1回行ったとき、「自分の手札が破棄されたとき」効果は2回誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、誘発するのは1回のみです。

localized.name: Dan Yuki
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 4 or less memory, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, 1 of your [TS] trait Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn for each memory your opponent has. After, that Digimon may attack.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 4 or less memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 4 or further to the right on your side.

faqs.question: How much DP does this card's [End of Your Turn] effect add when my opponent has 5 memory?
faqs.answer: It adds 5000 DP.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [End of Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you don't suspend this Tamer, you can't process the part after "after" in its [End of Your Turn] effect.

faqs.question:
I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. 
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. 
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

localized.name: 結城ダン
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】メモリーが4以下なら、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン終了時】このテイマーをレストさせることで、ターン終了まで、特徴「TS」を持つ自分のデジモン1体を相手側のメモリー1ごとに、DP+1000。さらに、そのデジモンでアタックできる。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが4以下」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の4から右側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: メモリーが相手側の5のとき、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でDPをプラスする数値はいくつになりますか？
faqs.answer: DP+5000になります。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、「ことで」の条件を満たさなくても、「さらに」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果の場合、このテイマーをレストさせなければ、「さらに」以降の効果を処理できません。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに自分のこのカードが2枚ある状況です。
自分のターン終了時、1枚目のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックしました。そのあとに、2枚目のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、2枚目の効果ではアタックできません。アタック中、新たにアタックの宣言はできません。
この状況の場合、自分のターン終了時に2枚のこのカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果が同時誘発し、1枚目の【自分のターン終了時】効果でアタックします。
カウンタータイミングになる前に、2枚目の【自分のターン終了時】効果が発揮できますが、アタック中にアタック宣言はできないため、発揮させても2枚目の効果ではアタックすることができません。

localized.name: Thomas H. Norstein
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When effects add cards to your opponent's hand, by suspending this Tamer, you may place the top 2 cards of your deck face down under this Tamer.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon would digivolve into a [DATA SQUAD] trait Digimon card, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, reduce the cost by 1.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
faqs.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Only the player of those cards can search/look at them. 
The opponent player can't search/look at them.

faqs.question: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
faqs.answer: It's placed face-up in the trash.

faqs.question: When I place multiple cards from the top of my deck face down under a Tamer without looking at them, in what order do I place them?
faqs.answer: You place them 1 at a time under the Tamer starting with the top card of your deck.

faqs.question:

faqs.question: デッキの上のカードを複数枚、裏向きのまま自分のテイマーの下に置く場合、どの順番で置きますか？

localized.name: Asuna Shiroki
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in its text or the [TS] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ and gain 1 memory.
[Main] By suspending this Tamer and trashing 1 Option card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Three Musketeers] in its text or the [TS] trait in the hand or trash with the cost reduced by 1.

faqs.question: After suspending this Tamer for this card's [Main] effect, can I choose to not trash an Option card from my hand or my Digimon's digivolution cards?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to suspend this Tamer and trash an Option card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question:
2 copies of this card are in the battle area. 
Can I activate the [Main] effect on both copies of this card and digivolve my Digimon into 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in its text or the [TS] trait with the digivolution cost reduced by 2?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You can't activate multiple digivolving effects at the same time.

localized.name: 城木明日奈
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】自分の手札から、「三銃士」の記述があるカードか特徴「TS」を持つカード1枚を破棄することで、≪1ドロー≫、メモリー+1。
【メイン】このテイマーをレストさせ、自分の手札かデジモンの進化元から、オプションカード1枚を破棄することで、自分のデジモン1体を手札/トラッシュの「三銃士」の記述があるか特徴「TS」を持つデジモンカードに支払うコスト-1で進化できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、このテイマーをレストさせた後、自分の手札かデジモンの進化元からオプションカードを破棄しないことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【メイン】効果の条件の場合、このテイマーをレストさせ、自分の手札かデジモンの進化元からオプションカードを破棄する必要があります。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアにこのカードが2枚ある状況です。
このカード2枚の【メイン】効果を発揮して、自分のデジモンを「三銃士」の記述があるか特徴「TS」を持つカード1枚に、支払う進化コストを合計-2して進化させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
進化させる効果を複数同時に発揮させることはできません。

localized.name: Ignition Flare
localized.mainEffect:
＜Use Req. ([TS] Trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. If this effect didn't delete, trash 1 of your opponent's Option cards in the battle area. Then, you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost.
localized.sourceEffect:
DP+2000
＜Link＞ [TS] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much DP as this Digimon or less.

faqs.question: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect. 
It can't trash a DUAL card that is treated as a Digimon through digivolution or other card in the battle area other than one placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.

faqs.question:
My opponent has a Digimon. 
Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by not choosing a card to delete?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If your opponent has Digimon, you must choose the card with the lowest DP among them and delete it.

faqs.question:
My opponent has a Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion. 
Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by choosing an opponent's Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
This card is linked to a Digimon. 
If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
faqs.answer: It's considered a Digimon effect.

faqs.question:
Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. 
Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can link it. 
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

faqs.question: Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question:
I used BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to use this card, and I used its [Main] effect to link this card to my Digimon. 
If I then use the part of BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect after "then" to have the linked Digimon attack, can I activate this card's link effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I use a "you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost" effect to link to a Digimon even if it doesn't have DP and is in the breeding area?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
However, a Digimon without DP won't be considered to have DP from link DP.

localized.name: イグニッションフレア
localized.mainEffect:
≪使用条件《特徴「TS」》≫（指定のカードで色条件を無視できる）
【セキュリティ】このカードの【メイン】効果を発揮する。
【メイン】最もDPの低い相手のデジモン全てを消滅させる。この効果で消滅しなかったなら、バトルエリアの相手のオプションカード1枚を破棄する。その後、このカードをエリアの自分のデジモン1体にコストを支払わずリンクできる。
localized.sourceEffect:
DP+2000
〈リンク〉特徴「TS」:コスト3（手札/バトルエリアから、このカードをバトルエリアの指定のデジモンに横向きで差し込む）
【アタック時】[ターン1回]このデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: 「バトルエリアのオプションカードを破棄する」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
「バトルエリアに置く」効果で置かれたオプションカードを破棄する効果です。
進化でデジモンとして扱われているデュアルカードなど、「バトルエリアに置く」効果以外でバトルエリアにあるカードは破棄できません。

faqs.question:
相手のデジモンがいる状況です。
このカードの【メイン】効果で、消滅させるカードを選ばずに「この効果で消滅しなかったなら」の条件を満たすことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
相手のデジモンがいるのであれば、その中で最もDPの低いカード全てを選び、消滅させなければなりません。

faqs.question:
消滅しない効果を持つ相手のデジモンがいる状況です。
このカードの【メイン】効果で、消滅しない効果を持つ相手のデジモンを選び、「この効果で消滅しなかったなら」の条件を満たすことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question:
このカードがデジモンにリンクしている状況です。
このカードがリンク効果を発揮した場合、その効果は「デジモンの効果」と「オプションカードの効果」のどちらになりますか？
faqs.answer: 「デジモンの効果」です。

faqs.question:
効果でオプションカードを使用できない状況です。
このカードのリンクコストを支払って、自分のデジモンにリンクさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、リンクさせることができます。
カードをリンクさせる場合はオプションカードの使用ではないため、使用できない状況でもリンクさせることは可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果でリンクする場合、育成エリアのデジモンにもリンクさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、育成エリアのデジモンにもリンクさせることができます。

faqs.question:
「BT24-085 結城ダン&結城カナン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果で、このカードを使用し、【メイン】効果で自分のデジモンにこのカードをリンクさせました。
そのあとに、「BT24-085 結城ダン&結城カナン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果の「その後」以降の効果で、リンクさせたそのデジモンでアタックした場合、このカードのリンク効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「エリアの自分のデジモン1体にコストを支払わずにリンクできる」効果は、育成エリアのDPを持たないデジモンにもリンクできますか？

はい、発揮できます。
この場合、手札に加えるセキュリティがないため、セキュリティを手札に加えず、このカードをセキュリティに置きます。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

faqs.question:
This card is linked to a Digimon. 
If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?

faqs.question:
Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. 
Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can link it. 
Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.

faqs.question: Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question: Can I use a "you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost" effect to link to a Digimon even if it doesn't have DP and is in the breeding area?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
However, a Digimon without DP won't be considered to have DP from link DP.

localized.name: Factorial Area
localized.mainEffect:
While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your black or red [TS] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞. While you have [Vulcanusmon], they also gain ＜Link +1＞.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand and place this card face up as the bottom security card. Then, you may play 1 black or red [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand with the cost reduced by 3.

faqs.question: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's met.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, those cards are left face-down.

localized.name: GraceNovamon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[TS] trait: Cost 5
[DNA Digivolve] Red Lv.6 + Blue Lv.6: Cost 0
＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Iceclad＞ ＜Partition ([Apollomon] & [Dianamon])＞
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[When Attacking] [Counter] [Once Per Turn] For each of this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may trash any 1 digivolution card from your opponent's Digimon. Then, you may end this attack. ⟨Rule⟩ Trait: Has [Olympos XII].

faqs.question: After activating this card's [Counter] effect, can I activate another [Counter] effect?
faqs.answer: No. Only one [Counter] effect can be activated per an attack.

faqs.question:
An opponent's Digimon attacks, and its [When Attacking] effect causes a Digimon to be played by an effect. 
I then activate the [All Turns] effect on my BT25-028 [Dianamon] and DNA digivolve into this card. 
Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] [Counter] effect during the counter timing after that?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
This card attacks, and its [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and [When Attacking] [Counter] effect trigger simultaneously. 
If I activate the [When Attacking] [Counter] effect first and end this attack, can I then activate the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
However, if there is an [End of Attack] effect, it will be a derived triggering effect, therefore that effect will activate before the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the counter timing, the counter timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

faqs.question: If an attack is ended by an "end the attack" effect, do [End of Attack] effects still trigger?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] [Counter] effect during the counter timing after that?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
This card attacks, and its [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and [When Attacking] [Counter] effect trigger simultaneously. 
If I activate the [When Attacking] [Counter] effect first and end this attack, can I then activate the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
However, if there is an [End of Attack] effect, it will be a derived triggering effect, therefore that effect will activate before the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the counter timing, the counter timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

faqs.question: If an attack is ended by an "end the attack" effect, do [End of Attack] effects still trigger?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

≪Sアタック+1≫≪氷装≫≪パーティション《「アポロモン」&「ディアナモン」》≫
【進化時】【アタック時】このデジモンの進化元枚数以下の相手のデジモン1体をデッキの下に戻す。
【アタック時】【カウンター】[ターン1回]このデジモンの進化元1枚ごとに、相手のデジモンの進化元を選んで1枚破棄できる。その後、このアタックを終了できる。
〈ルール〉特徴:「オリンポス十二神」を持つ。

faqs.question: 【カウンター】効果を発揮したあとに、他の【カウンター】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。【カウンター】効果は、1回のアタック中に1回のみ発揮できます。

faqs.question:
相手のデジモンがアタックし、【アタック時】効果でデジモンが効果で登場しました。
このとき、自分の「BT25-028 ディアナモン」の【お互いのターン効果】を発揮して、このカードにジョグレス進化しました。
そのあとのカウンタータイミングで、このカードの【アタック時】【カウンター】効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.question:
このカードでアタックし、【進化時】【アタック時】効果と【アタック時】【カウンター】効果が同時誘発しました。
先に【アタック時】【カウンター】効果から発揮して、このアタックを終了させた場合、そのあとに【進化時】【アタック時】を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
ただし、【アタック終了時】効果がある場合は、その効果が派生誘発するため、【進化時】【アタック時】効果より先にその効果を発揮します。

faqs.question: 「アタックを終了する」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: この効果を発揮した場合、現在のタイミングが「アタック終了時」になります。例えば、「アタック宣言」のタイミングでこの効果を発揮した場合、「アタック宣言」のタイミングから「アタック終了時」になります。「カウンタータイミング」「ブロックタイミング」には進行されず、アタックは成立しません。

faqs.question: 効果を受けないデジモンのアタックを、「アタックを終了する」効果で終了させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、アタックを終了させることができます。
アタックを終了させる効果は、タイミングを変更する効果なので、アタックしているデジモンには影響を及ぼしていません。

faqs.question: 「アタックを終了する」効果でアタックを終了させた場合、【アタック終了時】効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

localized.name: ShineGreymon: Burst Mode
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 5
[Burst Digivolve] [ShineGreymon]: Cost 0 by returning 1 [Marcus Damon] to the hand.
＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Blocker＞ ＜Barrier＞
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.
[Your Turn] All of your [Marcus Damon]s are also treated as 12000 DP Digimon and gain ＜Rush＞.

faqs.question: Does a burst digivolve without notes also trash the top card of the stack at the end of the turn it digivolved, as with normal burst digivolve?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you trash it. 
The standard rules apply even when notes aren't shown.

faqs.question:
I used [Final Shining Burst], and its [Main] effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
After trashing the used Option card or digivolving by Arts Digivolve, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted upon the rule check. Then, if the deleted card has an [On Deletion] effect, it will trigger simultaneously with this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
I have a [Marcus Damon] that is treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP. 
My Digimon in the battle area digivolves into this card, and I use this card's [All Turns] effect to increase that [Marcus Damon]'s DP to 12000 and give it <Rush>. 
What happens to that [Marcus Damon] if this card is then removed from the battle area?
faqs.answer:
It will be treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP, and it will lose <Rush>. 
This card's [All Turns] effect is always activated while it's in the battle area. 
As soon as this card is removed from the battle area, the effect will be lost, and the [Marcus Damon] will be treated as it was before.

faqs.question: Can I reference this card as an Option card with the traits shown on this card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
This card is treated as an Option card with the [DATA SQUAD] trait.

faqs.question: What does "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
A [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side will activate. 
Activated effects on the Option side are treated as Option card effects.

faqs.question: Is an "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" effect considered to be using an Option card?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered to be using an Option card. 
This effect directly activates a [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect to activate the [Main] effect on the Option side and give -15000 DP to a Digimon that isn't affected by Digimon effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect on the Option side is activated, it's considered to be an Option card effect. 
Because it isn't a Digimon effect, the DP will be reduced by -15000.

faqs.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP. 
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it. 
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both. 
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
faqs.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect. 
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten. 
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
faqs.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect. 
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten. 
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

faqs.question: Does a burst digivolve without notes also trash the top card of the stack at the end of the turn it digivolved, as with normal burst digivolve?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you trash it. 
The standard rules apply even when notes aren't shown.

faqs.question:
I used [Final Shining Burst], and its [Main] effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
After trashing the used Option card or digivolving by Arts Digivolve, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted upon the rule check. Then, if the deleted card has an [On Deletion] effect, it will trigger simultaneously with this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
I have a [Marcus Damon] that is treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP. 
My Digimon in the battle area digivolves into this card, and I use this card's [All Turns] effect to increase that [Marcus Damon]'s DP to 12000 and give it <Rush>. 
What happens to that [Marcus Damon] if this card is then removed from the battle area?
faqs.answer:
It will be treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP, and it will lose <Rush>. 
This card's [All Turns] effect is always activated while it's in the battle area. 
As soon as this card is removed from the battle area, the effect will be lost, and the [Marcus Damon] will be treated as it was before.

faqs.question: Can I reference this card as an Option card with the traits shown on this card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
This card is treated as an Option card with the [DATA SQUAD] trait.

faqs.question: What does "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
A [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side will activate. 
Activated effects on the Option side are treated as Option card effects.

faqs.question: Is an "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" effect considered to be using an Option card?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't considered to be using an Option card. 
This effect directly activates a [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect to activate the [Main] effect on the Option side and give -15000 DP to a Digimon that isn't affected by Digimon effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect on the Option side is activated, it's considered to be an Option card effect. 
Because it isn't a Digimon effect, the DP will be reduced by -15000.

faqs.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP. 
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it. 
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both. 
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

faqs.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
