localized.mainEffect: 【메인】특징으로 「천사형」/「대천사형」/「3대천사」를 가진 자신의 디지몬 1마리를 액티브로 한다. 자신의 「도미니몬」이 있다면, 대신 특징으로 「천사형」/「대천사형」/「3대천사」를 가진 자신의 디지몬 전부를 액티브로 한다.

localized.name: 最终圣剑
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】将我方1只拥有“天使型”/“大天使型”/“三大天使”特征的数码宝贝转换为活跃状态。若我方的场上存在“主天使兽”,则改为将我方所有拥有“天使型”/“大天使型”/“三大天使”特征的数码宝贝转换为活跃状态。

localized.name: Descent of the Three Great Angels
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with the [Angel] or [Archangel] trait is deleted, ＜Delay＞.
・Search your security stack. You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Three Great Angels] trait among them without paying the cost. Then, shuffle your security stack.

faqs.question: Can I use this card to place this card in the battle area without placing 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from the hand at the bottom of my security stack?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's correct.

sourceNotes: テーマブースター インファナル・アセンション [EX-06]

localized.name: 三大天使降臨
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分の手札から、特徴に「天使型」/「大天使型」/「三大天使」を持つデジモンカード1枚を自分のセキュリティの下に置ける。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【お互いのターン】特徴に「天使型」/「大天使型」を持つ自分のデジモンが消滅したとき、≪ディレイ≫。
・自分のセキュリティを全て確認する。その中の特徴に「三大天使」を持つデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。その後、自分のセキュリティをシャッフルする。

faqs.question: このカードを使用して、自分の手札から特徴に「天使型」/「大天使型」/「三大天使」を持つデジモンカード1枚を自分のセキュリティの下に置かなかった場合でも、このカードをバトルエリアに置けますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 3대천사 강림
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 패에서 특징으로 「천사형」/「대천사형」/「3대천사」를 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 시큐리티 아래에 놓을 수 있다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【서로의 턴】특징으로 「천사형」/「대천사형」을 가진 자신의 디지몬이 소멸했을 때, 《딜레이》. ・자신의 시큐리티를 전부 확인한다. 그중 특징으로 「3대천사」를 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다. 그 후, 자신의 시큐리티를 셔플한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 사용하고 자신의 패에서 특징으로 「천사형」/「대천사형」/「3대천사」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 자신의 시큐리티의 아래에 놓지 않았을 경우에도 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

localized.name: 三大天使降临
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】可以从我方的手牌中,将1张拥有“天使型”/“大天使型”/“三大天使”特征的数码宝贝卡牌置于我方安防区最下方。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【双方的回合】当我方拥有“天使型”/“大天使型”特征的数码宝贝被消灭时,《延迟》。

·确认我方所有的安防卡牌内容。可以不支付费用登场其中1张拥有“三大天使”特征的数码宝贝卡牌。此后,将我方的安防卡牌进行洗牌。

localized.name: Rise of the Seven Great Demon Lords
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may place 1 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash as the bottom digivolution card of your [Gate of Deadly Sins] in the breeding area. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait Digimon is deleted, ＜Delay＞.
・You may play 1 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait Digimon card from the digivolution cards of your [Gate of Deadly Sins] in the breeding area without paying the cost.

faqs.question: Can I use this card to place this card in the battle area without placing 1 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait Digimon card from my hand or trash as the bottom digivolution card of my [Gate of Deadly Sins] in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's correct.

sourceNotes: テーマブースター インファナル・アセンション [EX-06]

localized.name: 七大魔王降臨
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「七大魔王」を持つデジモンカード1枚を育成エリアの自分の「大罪の門」の進化元の下に置ける。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【お互いのターン】特徴に「七大魔王」を持つ自分のデジモンが消滅したとき、≪ディレイ≫。
・育成エリアの自分の「大罪の門」の進化元から、特徴に「七大魔王」を持つデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: このカードを使用して、自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「七大魔王」を持つデジモンカード1枚を育成エリアの自分の「大罪の門」の進化元の下に置かなかった場合でも、このカードをバトルエリアに置けますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 7대마왕 강림
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 패/트래시에서 특징으로 「7대마왕」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 육성 에어리어의 자신의 「대죄의 문」의 진화원 아래에 놓을 수 있다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【서로의 턴】특징으로 「7대마왕」을 가진 자신의 디지몬이 소멸했을 때, 《딜레이》. ・육성 에어리어의 자신의 「대죄의 문」의 진화원에서 특징으로 「7대마왕」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 사용하고 자신의 패/트래시에서 특징으로 「칠대마왕」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 육성 에어리어의 자신 「대죄의 문」의 진화원의 아래에 놓지 않았을 경우에도 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

localized.name: 七大魔王降临
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】可以从我方的手牌/废弃区中,将1张拥有“七大魔王”特征的数码宝贝卡牌置于我方养成区中“大罪之门”的进化源最下方。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【双方的回合】当我方拥有“七大魔王”特征的数码宝贝被消灭时,《延迟》。

·可以从我方养成区中“大罪之门”的进化源中,不支付费用登场1张拥有“七大魔王”特征的数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Phantom Pain
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gains "[End of Your Turn] Delete this Digimon." Then, place this card in the battle area.
[End of Opponent's Turn] If you have a Digimon with [Lilithmon] in its name, ＜Delay＞.
・Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.

faqs.question: What happens if this card's [Main] effect is given to a Digimon that activated a "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects until the end of your opponent's turn" effect?
faqs.answer:
A Digimon with a "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect can also be chosen as a target for this effect, therefore your opponent's Digimon will be affected by this card's effect as soon as it loses the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect. 
As a result, it's deleted at the [End of Your Turn] timing.

sourceNotes: テーマブースター インファナル・アセンション [EX-06]

localized.name: ファントムペイン
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体に「【自分のターン終了時】このデジモンを消滅させる。」の効果を与える。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【相手のターン終了時】名称に「リリスモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、≪ディレイ≫。
・アクティブ状態の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: 「相手のターン終了まで、このデジモンは相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」の効果を発揮したデジモンに対して、このカードの【メイン】効果を与えた場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
「相手の効果を受けない」デジモンも効果の対象として選択できますので、その相手のデジモンの「このデジモンは相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」が効果を失った時点で、このカードによって与えられた効果を受けることになります。
結果として、【自分のターン終了時】に消滅します。

localized.name: 팬텀 페인
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】상대의 턴 종료까지 상대의 디지몬 1마리에게 「【자신의 턴 종료 시】이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.」의 효과를 준다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【상대의 턴 종료 시】명칭에 「리리스몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬이 있다면, 《딜레이》. ・액티브 상태인 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.

faqs.question: 「상대의 턴 종료 시까지 이 디지몬은 상대 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다」 효과를 발휘한 디지몬에 대하여 이 카드의 【메인】효과를 부여한 경우, 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 「상대의 효과를 받지 않는다」디지몬을 효과의 대상으로서 선택할 수 있으므로 그 상대 디지몬의 「이 디지몬은 상대 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다」가 효과를 잃은 시점에 이 카드에 의해 부여된 효과를 받게 됩니다. 결과적으로 【자신의 턴 종료 시】에 소멸합니다.

localized.name: 幻痛
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】直到对方的回合结束为止,给与对方的1只数码宝贝“【我方的回合结束时】消灭此数码宝贝。”效果。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【对方的回合结束时】若我方场上存在名称中包含“莉莉丝兽”的数码宝贝,则《延迟》。

·消灭对方1只活跃状态的数码宝贝。

localized.name: 幻痛
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】直到对方的回合结束为止,给与对方的1只数码宝贝“【我方的回合结束时】消灭此数码宝贝。”效果。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【对方的回合结束时】若我方场上存在名称中包含“莉莉丝兽”的数码宝贝,则《延迟》。

·消灭对方1只活跃状态的数码宝贝。

localized.name: Pandemonium Lost
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or higher a level as the number of cards in their hand.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can process it. 
Even if your opponent doesn't have 5 or more cards in their hand, this card's [Main] effect will delete 1 of their Digimon with a level equal to or higher than the number of cards in their hand.

sourceNotes: テーマブースター インファナル・アセンション [EX-06]

localized.name: パンデモニウムロスト
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】相手の手札が5枚以上なら、相手は相手の手札を1枚破棄する。その後、相手の手札の枚数以上のLv.の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、1つ目の処理の「～なら」の条件を満たしていなくても、「その後」以降の処理を行うことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、処理することができます。
このカードの【メイン】効果の場合、相手の手札が5枚より少なくても、相手の手札枚数以上のLv.の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させます。

localized.name: 팬더모디엄 로스트
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】상대의 패가 5장 이상이라면, 상대는 본인의 패 1장을 파기한다. 그 후, 상대의 패 매수 이상의 Lv.의 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.

localized.name: 暗狱殿破灭
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】若对方持有5张或更多手牌,则对方丢弃其1张手牌。此后,消灭对方1只Lv.数值为对方手牌张数或更高的数码宝贝。

localized.name: Mega Digimon Assembly!
localized.mainEffect:
While your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] 1 of your level 6 Digimon and 1 card in the hand may DNA digivolve into a level 7 Digimon card in the hand.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to DNA digivolve using 1 of my Digimon that isn't specified for DNA digivolution and a card in the hand?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You can't ignore the requirements specified for DNA digivolution when using this card's [Main] effect.

sourceNotes: テーマブースター インファナル・アセンション [EX-06]

localized.name: 究極合成デジモンへの結合!
localized.mainEffect:
Lv.6以上の相手のデジモンがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
【メイン】Lv.6の自分のデジモン1体と手札のカード1枚で、手札のLv.7のデジモンカードにジョグレス進化できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、ジョグレスで指定されていない自分のデジモン1体と手札のカード1枚でジョグレス進化できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【メイン】効果では、ジョグレスで指定されている条件を無視することはできません。

localized.name: 궁극합성 디지몬으로 결합!
localized.mainEffect: Lv.6 이상의 상대의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 카드는 색 조건을 무시할 수 있다. 【메인】Lv.6의 자신의 디지몬 1마리와 패의 카드 1장으로, 패의 Lv.7의 디지몬 카드로 조그레스 진화할 수 있다.

localized.name: 结合成为究极合成数码宝贝!
localized.mainEffect:
对方场上存在Lv.6或更高等级的数码宝贝期间,此卡牌可以无视颜色条件。

【主要】可以将我方1只Lv.6的数码宝贝和手牌中的1张卡牌,合步进化成手牌中Lv.7的数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Ogudomon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 or higher w/[Seven Great Demon Lords] trait: Cost 6
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may place up to 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. If 4 or more were placed, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
[When Attacking] By returning 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, delete 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, trash the top 7 cards of their security stack. For each card this effect deleted, reduce the number of security cards trashed by 1.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [When Attacking] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question: Does "if 4 or more were placed" in this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect mean that the effect activates if I first place 4 or more cards for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect? Or does it activate if 4 or more [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names are in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: It activates if 4 or more cards are first placed for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect. Even if you have 4 or more [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names in digivolution cards, the effect won't activate unless you first place 4 or more cards for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.

faqs.question: If I return 1 to 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, can I use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to delete the same number of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you activate this effect, you must return 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck in order to delete 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to trash 7 cards from my opponent's security stack without deleting their Digimon or Tamers?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Deleting 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers is mandatory for this effect.

faqs.question: When I would use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to delete 7 of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers, if an opponent's Digimon isn't deleted due to an "isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect or other reason, does that mean that the number of security cards trashed isn't reduced by 1 for that Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes. If it isn't deleted, then the number of security cards trashed isn't reduced by 1.

[Digivolve] Lv.5 or higher w/[Seven Great Demon Lords] trait: Cost 6
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may place up to 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. If 4 or more were placed, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
[When Attacking] By returning 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, delete 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, trash the top 7 cards of their security stack. For each card this effect deleted, reduce the number of security cards trashed by 1.

faqs.question:
I activated this card's [When Attacking] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. 
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

faqs.question: Does "if 4 or more were placed" in this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect mean that the effect activates if I first place 4 or more cards for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect? Or does it activate if 4 or more [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names are in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: It activates if 4 or more cards are first placed for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect. Even if you have 4 or more [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names in digivolution cards, the effect won't activate unless you first place 4 or more cards for the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.

faqs.question: If I return 1 to 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, can I use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to delete the same number of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you activate this effect, you must return 7 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck in order to delete 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to trash 7 cards from my opponent's security stack without deleting their Digimon or Tamers?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Deleting 7 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers is mandatory for this effect.

faqs.question: When I would use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to delete 7 of my opponent's Digimon or Tamers, if an opponent's Digimon isn't deleted due to an "isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect or other reason, does that mean that the number of security cards trashed isn't reduced by 1 for that Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes. If it isn't deleted, then the number of security cards trashed isn't reduced by 1.

localized.name: オグドモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「七大魔王」を持つLv.5以上:コスト6
【進化時】【アタック時】自分のトラッシュから、特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカード7枚までをこのデジモンの進化元の下に置ける。4枚以上置いたなら、相手のデジモン/テイマー1体を消滅させる。
【アタック時】このデジモンの進化元から、特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカード7枚をデッキの下に戻すことで、相手のデジモン/テイマー7体を消滅させる。その後、相手のセキュリティを上から7枚破棄する。この効果で消滅した1体ごとに、破棄するセキュリティ枚数-1。

faqs.question:
このカードの【アタック時】効果を発揮して、1つ目の処理で相手のデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、「離れるとき」などの他の即時型効果でこのカードがバトルエリアから離れました。
そのあとに、この効果の「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
効果を発揮した場合、発揮したカードが効果の途中でその場所を離れた場合でも、最後まで解決します。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果の「4枚以上置いたなら」は、1回の【進化時】【アタック時】効果で4枚以上置いた場合に発揮するのですか？それとも、進化元に特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカードが4枚以上あれば、発揮するのですか？
faqs.answer: 1回の【進化時】【アタック時】効果で4枚以上置いたときになります。進化元に特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカードが4枚以上あっても、1回の【進化時】【アタック時】効果で4枚以上置かなければ、発揮しません。

faqs.question: このカードの2つ目の【アタック時】効果は、特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカードを1～7枚デッキの下に戻すことで、戻した枚数だけ相手のデジモン/テイマーを消滅させられるのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
この効果を発揮させる場合、このデジモンの進化元から、特徴に「七大魔王」を持ち名称の異なるカード7枚をデッキの下に戻さなければならず、戻した場合、相手のデジモン/テイマー7体を消滅させます。

faqs.question: このカードの2つ目の【アタック時】効果は、相手のデジモン/テイマーをあえて消滅させないことで、セキュリティを7枚破棄させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
相手のデジモン/テイマー7体を消滅させることは強制です。

faqs.question: このカードの2つ目の【アタック時】効果で相手のデジモン/テイマーを消滅させるとき、相手のデジモンが「効果を受けない」等の効果で消滅させられなかった場合、破棄するセキュリティ枚数は-1されませんか？
faqs.answer: はい、消滅していないのであれば、破棄するセキュリティ枚数は-1されません。

localized.mainEffect:
[Your Turn] When one of your [Holy Beast], [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon is played, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory. Then, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into [Angewomon] or [LadyDevimon] in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve into [Angewomon] or [LadyDevimon] in the trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You can't ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's [Your Turn] effect.

faqs.question: Can an opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less be played if I activate a "your opponent can't play Digimon with 6000 DP or less" effect, and in the same turn, I activate an effect such as EX5-060 [Dragomon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect that plays an opponent's Digimon card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be played. 
"Your opponent can't play Digimon" is an effect that prevents your opponent's actions or effects from playing Digimon. Your effects can still play an opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.

faqs.question: Can my Digimon with 6000 DP or less be played if I activate a "your opponent can't play Digimon with 6000 DP or less" effect, and in the same turn, my opponent activates an effect such as EX5-060 [Dragomon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect that plays an opponent's Digimon card?

faqs.question: バトルエリアのこのカードを、「EX3-014 ドルビックモン」のデジクロスで選んだとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮できますか？2026/06/19 更新
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.question: 自分が「相手はDP6000以下のデジモンを登場できない」効果を発揮したターン、自分が「EX5-060 ダゴモン」の【登場時】【進化時】効果などの、相手のデジモンカードを登場させる効果を発揮して、DP6000以下の相手のデジモンを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、登場させることができます。
「相手はデジモンを登場できない」は、相手の行動や効果でデジモンが登場できなくなる効果です。自分の効果でDP6000以下の相手のデジモンを登場させることはできます。

localized.name: 볼케닉드라몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】【어택 시】가장 DP가 낮은 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 【진화 시】상대의 턴 종료까지 상대는 DP 6000 이하의 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 없으며, 이동시킬 수 없다. 【서로의 턴】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬이 자신의 효과 이외로 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 자신의 패에서 특징으로 「기룡형」/「천룡형」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과로, 상대는 어떤 디지몬을 등장할 수 없고, 어떤 디지몬을 이동할 수 없습니까?
faqs.answer: 상대는 『DP 6000 이하인 디지몬』을 등장할 수 없고, 『DP 6000 이하인 디지몬』을 이동할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과가 발휘된 턴, 자신은 「EX5-058 옥타몬」 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로, 「후지츠몬」토큰을 상대의 배틀 에어리어에 등장시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 등장시킬 수 있습니다. 이 카드의 【진화 시】 효과는 상대 플레이어가 DP 6000 이하인 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 없고, 이동할 수 없게 되기 효과입니다. 「EX5-058 옥타몬」 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과는 자신이 등장시키는 효과이므로 등장시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과가 발휘된 다음 상대의 턴, 상대는 「P-143 두리몬」 【자신의 턴 종료 시】효과로, 배틀 에어리어에서 육성 에어리어에 이동할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이동할 수 없습니다. 이 카드의 【진화 시】 효과는 효과로도 이동시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 배틀 에어리어의 이 카드를 디지크로스로 아래에 놓았을 때, 이 카드의 【서로의 턴】효과를 발휘했습니다. 이 【서로의 턴】효과로 등장한 디지몬을 그 디지크로스로 아래에 놓을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 그 디지크로스로 아래에 놓을 수 없습니다. 디지크로스는 디지크로스의 선언과 동시에 디지크로스로 아래에 놓고 싶은 카드를 선택합니다. 아래에 놓은 시점에 추가로 아래에 놓고 싶은 카드를 선택할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 「상대는 〇〇을 등장할 수 없는」는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 상대에 의해 〇〇이 등장할 수 없어지는 효과입니다. 이 카드의 경우, 상대의 행동이나 효과로 DP 6000 이하인 디지몬 카드를 등장시킬 수 없게 됩니다. 이 효과는 상대 플레이어에 영향을 미칩니다.

faqs.question: 자신이 「상대는 〇〇을 등장할 수 없는」 효과를 발휘한 턴, 상대는 덱을 오픈하고 지정된 카드를 등장시키는 효과를 발휘한 경우, 덱을 오픈한 뒤에 등장하지 않을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 상대는 덱을 오픈한 뒤에 지정된 카드는 등장하지 않을 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 자신이 「상대는 DP 6000 이하인 디지몬을 등장할 수 없는」 효과를 발휘한 턴, 자신이 「EX5-060 드라고몬」 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과 등의 상대의 디지몬 카드를 등장시키는 효과를 발휘하여 DP 6000 이하인 상대의 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 등장시킬 수 있습니다. 「상대는 디지몬을 등장할 수 없다」는 상대의 행동이나 효과로 디지몬이 등장할 수 없어지는 효과입니다. 자신의 효과로 DP 6000 이하인 상대의 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 자신이 「상대는 DP 6000 이하인 디지몬을 등장할 수 없는」 효과를 발휘한 턴, 상대는 「EX5-060 드라고몬」 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과 등의 상대의 디지몬 카드를 등장시키는 효과를 발휘하여 DP 6000 이하인 자신의 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 등장시킬 수 없습니다. 「상대는 디지몬을 등장할 수 없다」는 상대의 행동이나 효과로 디지몬이 등장할 수 없어지는 효과입니다. 상대의 효과로 DP 6000 이하인 자신의 디지몬을 등장시킬 수 없습니다.

localized.name: Otamamon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[NSp] trait: Cost 0
[All Turns] Players can't reduce play costs.

faqs.question: What does "players can't reduce play costs" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: This effect prevents costs from being reduced when play costs are to be paid. This effect affects both players.

faqs.question: What does "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
"Play this card without paying the cost" effects aren't effects that reduce the play cost.

faqs.question: What does "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
No, play costs can't be reduced. 
A "players can't reduce play costs" effect isn't an effect that affects cards that activate play-cost-reducing effects, it's an effect that affects players. Therefore, the target players can't reduce play costs.

faqs.question: What does "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, DigiXrosing is possible. 
However, it isn't possible to reduce play costs through DigiXrosing. Therefore, a player can't declare to play a card in a state where its play cost can't be paid.

localized.name: オタマモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「NSp」を持つLv.2:コスト0
【お互いのターン】お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。

faqs.question: 「お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 登場コストを支払う際、そのコストをマイナスすることができなくなる効果です。この効果は、お互いのプレイヤーに影響を及ぼします。

faqs.question: 「お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。」効果が発揮されている間、「コストを支払わずに登場させる」効果で登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、登場させることができます。
コストを支払わずに登場させる効果は、登場コストをマイナスする効果ではありません。

faqs.question: 「お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。」効果が発揮されている間、育成エリアのデジモンの効果で登場コストをマイナスすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、登場コストをマイナスすることはできません。
「お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。」効果は、登場コストをマイナスする効果を発揮しているカードに影響を及ぼすのではなく、お互いのプレイヤーに影響を及ぼすため、対象のプレイヤーは登場コストをマイナスすることはできません。

faqs.question: 「お互いは支払う登場コストをマイナスできない。」効果が発揮されている間、デジクロスすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、デジクロスすることができます。
ただし、デジクロスによって登場コストをマイナスすることはできません。それによって、コストを支払えない状況では、そのカードの登場を宣言することはできません。

localized.name: 올챙몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】특징으로 「NSp」를 가진 Lv.2 : 코스트 0【서로의 턴】서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.

faqs.question: 「서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.」라는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 등장 코스트를 지불할 때, 그 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없게 되기 효과입니다. 이 효과는 양 플레이어에 영향을 미칩니다.

faqs.question: 「서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.」 효과가 발휘하고 있는 동안, 「코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다」 효과로 등장시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 등장시킬 수 있습니다. 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시키는 효과는 등장 코스트를 마이너스하는 효과로는 아닙니다.

faqs.question: 「서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.」 효과가 발휘하고 있는 동안, 육성 에어리어의 디지몬의 효과로 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없습니다. 「서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.」 효과는 등장 코스트를 마이너스하는 효과를 발휘되고 있는 카드로 영향을 끼치는 것이 아니라, 양 플레이어에 영향을 끼치을 때문에 대상의 플레이어는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 「서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.」 효과가 발휘하고 있는 동안, 디지크로스할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 디지크로스할 수 있습니다. 단, 디지크로스에 의해 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없습니다. 그것에 의해 코스트를 지불할 수 없는 상황에는 그 카드의 등장을 선언할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: If the Digimon chosen for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can't be suspended, does it still gain "that Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn"?

localized.name: トリケラモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「NSp」を持つLv.4:コスト3
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。相手のターン終了まで、そのデジモンはアクティブにならない。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「恐竜型」を持つ。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］このデジモンがバトルで相手のデジモンを消滅させたとき、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、選んだデジモンをレストさせられなかった場合、「相手ターン終了までそのデジモンはアクティブにならない」は付与されませんか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、付与されます。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、相手のデジモン1体を選び、選んだデジモンをレストさせる処理と、選んだデジモンに「相手ターン終了までそのデジモンはアクティブにならない」を付与する処理です。

faqs.question: If I choose this card in my battle area with the DigiXros effect on [EX3-014 Dorbickmon], can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can my opponent digivolve a level 4 or lower Digimon in the breeding area during their next turn after this card's [When Digivolving] effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, they can digivolve it. 
This card's [When Digivolving] effect only affects your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon in the battle area. It doesn't affect Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question: Can my opponent digivolve a level 4 or lower Digimon that was played after this card's [When Digivolving] effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
No, they can't digivolve it. 
This card's [When Digivolving] effect also affects Digimon that were played after it activated.

faqs.question: I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when this card in the battle area was placed for a DigiXros. Can I place the card that was played by this [All Turns] effect for that DigiXros?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't place it for that DigiXros. 
You declare the DigiXros at the same time as when you choose the cards to place for the DigiXros. Once placed, additional cards to place can't be chosen.

This card's [When Digivolving] effect only affects your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon in the battle area. It doesn't affect Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question: Can my opponent digivolve a level 4 or lower Digimon that was played after this card's [When Digivolving] effect has activated?
faqs.answer:
No, they can't digivolve it. 
This card's [When Digivolving] effect also affects Digimon that were played after it activated.

faqs.question: I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when this card in the battle area was placed for a DigiXros. Can I place the card that was played by this [All Turns] effect for that DigiXros?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't place it for that DigiXros. 
You declare the DigiXros at the same time as when you choose the cards to place for the DigiXros. Once placed, additional cards to place can't be chosen.

localized.mainEffect:

【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］このデジモンが自分の効果以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、自分のトラッシュから、特徴に「岩竜型」/「地竜型」を持つデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: バトルエリアのこのカードを、「EX3-014 ドルビックモン」のデジクロスで選んだとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果が発揮された次の相手のターン、相手は育成エリアにいるLv.4以下のデジモンを進化させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化させることができます。
このカードの【進化時】効果は、バトルエリアにいる相手のLv.4以下のデジモン全てに影響を及ぼす効果です。育成エリアには影響を及ぼしません。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果が発揮されたあと、相手は新しく登場したLv.4デジモンを進化させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、進化させることはできません。
このカードの【進化時】効果は、後から登場したデジモンにも影響を及ぼします。

faqs.question: バトルエリアのこのカードをデジクロスで下に置くとき、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果を発揮しました。この【お互いのターン】効果で登場したデジモンを、そのデジクロスで下に置くことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、そのデジクロスで下に置くことはできません。
デジクロスは、デジクロスの宣言と同時に、デジクロスで下に置きたいカードを選びます。下に置く時点で、追加で下に置きたいカードを選ぶことはできません。

localized.name: 메탈릭드라몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】【어택 시】상대의 디지몬 1마리를 《퇴화 4》. 【진화 시】상대의 턴 종료까지 Lv.4 이하의 상대의 디지몬 전부는 진화할 수 없다. 【서로의 턴】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬이 자신의 효과 이외로 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 자신의 트래시에서 특징으로 「암룡형」/「지룡형」을 가진 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과가 발휘된 다음 상대의 턴, 상대는 배틀 에어리어에 있는 효과를 받지 않는 Lv.4 이하인 디지몬을 진화시킬 수 있습니까?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과가 발휘된 다음 상대의 턴, 상대는 육성 에어리어에 있는 Lv.4 이하인 디지몬을 진화시킬 수 있습니까?

faqs.answer: 아니요, 그 디지크로스로 아래에 놓을 수 없습니다. 디지크로스는 디지크로스의 선언과 동시에 디지크로스로 아래에 놓고 싶은 카드를 선택합니다. 아래에 놓은 시점에 추가로 아래에 놓고 싶은 카드를 선택할 수 없습니다.

localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, end that attack.

faqs.question: I tried to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon attacked, but I couldn't delete the other Digimon due to another effect. Can I end that attack at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't end that attack. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. In this case, if you can't delete 1 of your other Digimon, then you can't end the attack.

faqs.question: What does "end that attack" mean, exactly?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End that attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン】［ターンに1回］相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、他の自分のデジモン1体を消滅させることで、そのアタックを終了する。

faqs.question: 相手のデジモンがアタックしたときに、このカードの進化元効果で他のデジモンを消滅させようとしましたが、他の効果でそのデジモンが消滅しませんでした。このとき、そのアタックを終了させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:

faqs.question: 「어택을 종료한다」는 어떤 효과입니까?

localized.name: BlackGatomon
localized.mainEffect: [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card in your hand, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and ＜Retaliation＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, end that attack.

faqs.question: I tried to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon attacked, but I couldn't delete the other Digimon due to another effect. Can I end that attack at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't end that attack. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. In this case, if you can't delete 1 of your other Digimon, then you can't end the attack.

faqs.question: What does "end that attack" mean, exactly?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end that attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End that attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

faqs.answer: 이 효과를 발휘한 경우, 현재의 타이밍이 「어택 종료 시」가 됩니다. 예를 들어, 「어택 선언」 타이밍에 이 효과를 발휘한 경우, 「어택 선언」 타이밍에 「어택 종료 시」가 됩니다. 「카운터 타이밍」「블록 타이밍」에는 진행하지 않고 어택은 성립하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 효과를 받지 않는 디지몬의 어택을 「어택을 종료한다」 효과로 종료시킬 수 있습니까?

faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로, 「【어택 종료 시】이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.」을 효과를 받지 않는 디지몬으로 부여할 수 있습니까?

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로, 「【어택 종료 시】이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.」을 부여된 디지몬이 소멸할 때, 그 디지몬의 ≪파티션≫은 유발합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 유발하지 않습니다. 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】효과로 부여된 「【어택 종료 시】이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.」가 유발한 경우, 그 효과는 자신이 유발・발휘하는 것이 되기 때문에 ≪파티션≫은 유발하지 않습니다.

sourceAttributes.type: Demon Lord/X Antibody/Seven Great Demon Lords

faqs.question: I attempted to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect when this card would leave the battle area other than in battle, but I couldn't delete that Digimon due to another effect. Does this card leave the battle area at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it leaves the battle area. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. 
In such cases, this card leaves the battle area if the deletion isn't possible.

faqs.question:
I tried to delete my opponent's EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)] using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect. 
At such times, if my opponent tries to delete this card using the 1st [All Turns] effect on the chosen EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], does this card's 1st [All Turns] effect trigger again?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger. 
As soon as the player chooses to activate an [X Per Turn] effect, it will count toward 1 use of [X Per Turn]. In this case, as soon as you attempt to delete another Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect, it will count toward [1 Per Turn], and the effect won't trigger again during that turn.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, if [Lilithmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, by deleting 1 other Digimon, it doesn't leave.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When other Digimon are deleted, if it's your turn, you may play 1 level 4 or lower purple Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost. If it's your opponent's, trash their top security card.

sourceAttributes.type: Demon Lord/X Antibody/Seven Great Demon Lords

faqs.question: I attempted to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect when this card would leave the battle area other than in battle, but I couldn't delete that Digimon due to another effect. Does this card leave the battle area at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it leaves the battle area. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. 
In such cases, this card leaves the battle area if the deletion isn't possible.

faqs.question:
I tried to delete my opponent's EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)] using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect. 
At such times, if my opponent tries to delete this card using the 1st [All Turns] effect on the chosen EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], does this card's 1st [All Turns] effect trigger again?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger. 
As soon as the player chooses to activate an [X Per Turn] effect, it will count toward 1 use of [X Per Turn]. In this case, as soon as you attempt to delete another Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect, it will count toward [1 Per Turn], and the effect won't trigger again during that turn.

localized.name: リリスモンX抗体
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「リリスモン」:コスト1
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］このデジモンがバトル以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元に「リリスモン」/「X抗体」があるなら、他のデジモン1体を消滅させることで、離れない。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］他のデジモンが消滅したとき、自分のターンなら、自分のトラッシュから、紫のLv.4以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。相手のターンなら、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードがバトル以外でバトルエリアを離れるときに、このカードの1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果で他のデジモンを消滅させようとしましたが、他の効果でそのデジモンが消滅しませんでした。このとき、このカードはバトルエリアを離れなくなりますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、バトルエリアを離れます。
「させることで」の条件は、その内容を実行できなければそれ以降の処理はできません。この状況の場合、消滅させることができなければ、バトルエリアを離れます。

faqs.question:
このカードの1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果で、相手の「EX7-061 リリスモンX抗体」を消滅させようとしました。
このとき、相手は選ばれた「EX7-061 リリスモンX抗体」の1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮し、1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果を発揮しているこのカードを消滅させようとした場合、再度1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、誘発しません。
[ターンにX回]は、発揮することを選択した時点でその回数を1回消費します。この状況の場合、このカードの1つ目の【お互いのターン】効果で他のデジモンを消滅させようとした時点で、その効果の[ターンに1回]が消費され、そのターン中はそれ以降誘発しません。

localized.name: 리리스몬 X항체
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】「리리스몬」 코스트 1【서로의 턴】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬이 배틀 이외로 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때, 이 디지몬의 진화원에 「리리스몬」/「X항체」가 있다면, 다른 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시키는 것으로, 벗어나지 않는다. 【서로의 턴】［턴에 1회］다른 디지몬이 소멸했을 때, 자신의 턴이라면, 자신의 트래시에서 퍼플인 Lv.4 이하의 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다. 상대의 턴이라면, 상대의 시큐리티를 위에서부터 1장 파기한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 이외로 배틀 에어리어를 벗어날 때 이 카드의 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과로 다른 디지몬을 소멸시키고자 했습니다만, 다른 효과로 그 디지몬이 소멸하지 않았습니다. 이때, 이 카드는 배틀 에어리어를 벗어나지 않게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 배틀 에어리어를 벗어납니다. 「시키는 것으로」 조건은 그 내용을 실행하지 않으면 그 이후의 처리는 할 수 없습니다. 이 상황의 경우, 소멸시킬 수 없다면 배틀 에어리어를 벗어납니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과로, 상대의 「EX7-061 리리스몬 X항체」를 소멸시키려 했습니다. 이때, 상대는 선택된 「EX7-061 리리스몬 X항체」 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과를 발휘하여 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과를 발휘되고 있는 이 카드를 소멸시키려한 경우, 다시 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과는 유발합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 유발하지 않습니다. [턴에 X회]는, 발휘하기 것을 선택한 시점에 그 횟수를 1회 소비합니다. 이 상황의 경우, 이 카드의 첫 번째 【서로의 턴】효과로 다른 디지몬을 소멸시키려한 시점에 그 효과의 [턴에 1회]가 소비되어 그 턴 중에는 그 이후 유발하지 않습니다.

localized.name: Shoto Kazama
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until the end of your opponent's turn. If it has the [Vortex Warriors] trait, it unsuspends.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to unsuspend my Digimon with the [Vortex Warriors] trait, can I then activate <Vortex> on that Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
<Vortex> triggers simultaneously with [End of Your Turn] effects, therefore you can choose the activation order of these effects.

faqs.question: Can I activate <Vortex> on my Digimon with the [Vortex Warriors] trait, then activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
<Vortex> triggers simultaneously with [End of Your Turn] effects, therefore you can choose the activation order of these effects. 
In this case, you can activate <Vortex> and make an attack declaration, this card's effect that triggered simultaneously will activate, then the counter timing will occur.

Even if this effect trashed, this card's [Main] effect will prevent all of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards from attacking until the end of their turn.

faqs.question: What is a {Trash} effect?
faqs.answer:
A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

faqs.question: When one of my Digimon digivolves into [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], in what order can I activate this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect and the effects that trigger upon digivolution into that Digimon?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.

faqs.question:
I have this card in the battle area, and it's suspended. 
Can my opponent's BT8-018 [Marsmon] attack their unsuspended Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't attack. 
If a "can" or "may" effect activates at the same timing as a "can't" effect, the "can't" effect takes precedence.

faqs.question:
I have this card in the battle area, and it's suspended. 
If my opponent's Digimon attacks my suspended Digimon, can my opponent use <Raid> on the attacking Digimon to switch the target of the attack to my unsuspended Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, they can. 
This card's [Opponent's Turn] effect only allows suspended Digimon to be chosen as the attack target upon the attack declaration. 
After attacking a suspended Digmon, it will be possible to use <Raid> to switch the target of the attack to an opponent's unsuspended Digimon.

faqs.question:
I have this card in the battle area, and it's suspended. 
If an opponent's Digimon isn't affected by effects, can it attack Digimon other than suspended Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can attack them.

相手の「BT8-018 マルスモン」は、アクティブ状態の相手のデジモンにアタックすることができますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、アタックできません。
「できる」効果と「できない」効果が同時にあるときは、「できない」効果が優先されます。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアにレスト状態の自分のこのカードがいる状況です。
相手のデジモンがレスト状態の自分のデジモンにアタックし、相手は、アタックしたデジモンの≪突進≫で、アクティブ状態の自分のデジモンにアタックの対象を変更することができますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、変更することができます。
このカードの【相手のターン】効果は、アタック宣言と同時に選ぶアタックの対象を、レスト状態のデジモンだけしか選べなくなる効果です。
レスト状態のデジモンにアタックしたあとに、≪突進≫の効果でアクティブ状態の相手のデジモンにアタックの対象を変更することは可能です。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアにレスト状態の自分のこのカードがいる状況です。
効果を受けない相手のデジモンは、レスト状態のデジモン以外にアタックできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's met.

faqs.question:
My Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards attacked, an opponent's Digimon with digivolution cards was deleted in the battle, and after that battle, my opponent doesn't have any Digimon with digivolution cards. 
This Digimon gains <Piercing> from this card's inherited effect at such times, but does the <Piercing> trigger simultaneously?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it triggers. 
If an effect's trigger conditions are met when the effect is gained, that effect will trigger. 
In this case, your opponent no longer has Digimon with digivolution cards at the same timing as when your opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle, therefore you can activate <Piercing>.

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by doing X" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?Feb. 28, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

localized.mainEffect:

≪氷装≫（このデジモンのセキュリティデジモン以外とのバトルではDPではなく進化元枚数を比べる）
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモンの進化元を選んで2枚破棄する。その後、相手のターン終了まで、進化元を持たない相手のデジモン1体はレストできず、【進化時】効果は発揮しない。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】進化元を持つ相手のデジモンがいない間、特徴に「氷雪型」を持つこのデジモンは、≪貫通≫と≪Sアタック+1≫を得る。

faqs.question: 「XXの相手のデジモンがいない間」は、相手のデジモンが1体もいない間も条件を満たしますか？
faqs.answer: はい、満たします。

faqs.question:
進化元にこのカードがある自分のデジモンでアタックし、バトルで進化元を持つ相手のデジモンを消滅させ、そのバトルによって、進化元を持つ相手のデジモンが1体もいなくなりました。
このとき、このカードの進化元効果で≪貫通≫を得ますが、同時にその≪貫通≫は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、誘発します。
効果を得ると同時に効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発します。
この状況の場合、進化元を持つ相手のデジモンがいなくなった時点と、バトルで相手のデジモンを消滅させた時点が同時のため、≪貫通≫を発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【進化時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
【進化時】効果が誘発した場合や「【進化時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【進化時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で発揮する場合であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードの【進化時】効果を、他の効果で発揮させることはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、その効果は[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。

いいえ、消費しません。

faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.

faqs.question:
I have this card in the battle area. 
An opponent's Digimon digivolved into a Digimon card that has <Blitz>, and I now have 1 or more memory. Can that Digimon use <Blitz> to attack at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't attack. 
This card's [All Turns] effect will activate as soon as you have 1 or more memory, therefore none of your opponent's Digimon can suspend, and they can't attack unless they can suspend.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「DS」を持つLv.5:コスト3
［手札］【カウンター】≪ブラスト進化≫（自分のデジモンをこのカードにコストを支払わずに進化できる）
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン1体を≪退化1≫。その後、登場コスト7以下の相手のデジモン1体をデッキの下に戻す。
【お互いのターン】メモリーが1以上の間、相手のデジモン全てはレストできない。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「水棲型」を持つ。
localized.sourceEffect: ≪オーバーフロー《-4》≫（エリアかカードの下から、それ以外の場所に送られる場合、メモリー-4）

faqs.question: 「メモリーが1以上」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の1から左側である状態を指します。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに自分のこのカードがいる状況です。
相手のデジモンが≪進撃≫を持つデジモンカードに進化し、メモリーが1以上になりました。このとき、そのデジモンは≪進撃≫の効果でアタックすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、アタックすることはできません。
メモリーが1以上になった時点で、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果が発揮されているため、相手のデジモン全てはレストすることができず、レストさせることができないのであればアタックすることはできません。

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 1 or less" memory refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the right on your side.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be chosen.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: What does "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [On Play] effects on cards from activating. 
Triggered [On Play] effects can no longer activate when a card is played or when effects such as "activate that card's [On Play]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [On Play] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it's triggered upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can it activate its own [On Play] effect using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects"?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can another card's [On Play] effect be activated using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects as an effect of this card"?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: Can I use "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects as an effect of this card" on a card that isn't affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" to activate the [On Play] effect on another card that's affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects"?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can I perform just the "by doing X" condition in its [On Play] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card digivolved into a card that has an [On Play] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect while "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" was activated. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card is played?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [On Play] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: What does "isn't affected by [...] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

localized.name: Aegisdramon
localized.mainEffect:
[DNA Digivolve] Blue/purple Lv.6 + black/yellow Lv.6: Cost 0
[DNA Digivolve] [Plesiomon] + Lv.5 w/[Seadramon] in name: Cost 0
[When Digivolving] Return up to 14 play cost's total worth of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck. If DNA digivolving, you may play up to 12 play cost's total worth of [DS] trait cards from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the costs.
[All Turns] While you have 1 or more memory, none of your [DS] trait Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects. While you have 1 or less, none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects. ⟨Rule⟩ Trait: Has [Aquatic] Type.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 1 or less" memory refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the right on your side.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be chosen.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: What does "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [On Play] effects on cards from activating. 
Triggered [On Play] effects can no longer activate when a card is played or when effects such as "activate that card's [On Play]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [On Play] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it's triggered upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [On Play] effects," can it activate its own [On Play] effect using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [On Play] effects"?

faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: イージスドラモン
localized.mainEffect:
【ジョグレス】青/紫Lv.6+黒/黄Lv.6:コスト0
【ジョグレス】「プレシオモン」+名称に「シードラモン」を含むLv.5:コスト0
【進化時】登場コスト合計14まで、相手のデジモンをデッキの下に戻す。ジョグレス進化していたなら、このデジモンの進化元から、特徴に「DS」を持つカードを登場コスト合計12まで、コストを支払わずに登場できる。
【お互いのターン】メモリーが1以上の間、特徴に「DS」を持つ自分のデジモン全ては相手のデジモンの効果を受けない。メモリーが1以下の間、相手のデジモン全ての【登場時】効果は発揮しない。
〈ルール〉特徴:タイプ「水棲型」を持つ。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが1以上」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の1から左側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが1以下」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の1から右側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？2025/03/27 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？2025/06/13 更新
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【登場時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
カードが登場して【登場時】効果が誘発した場合や「【登場時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【登場時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【登場時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で誘発した効果であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードは、自身の【登場時】効果を「【登場時】効果1つを発揮する」効果で発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードは、他のカードの【登場時】効果を「【登場時】効果1つをこのカードの効果として発揮する」効果で発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」が付与されていないカードの「【登場時】効果1つをこのカードの効果として発揮する」効果で、「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されている他のカードの【登場時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【登場時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【登場時】効果は発揮しない」が発揮されている間、【登場時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードが登場しました。
このとき、そのカードが登場したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？2025/03/27 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
登場したタイミングでは【登場時】効果の発揮ができないため、[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」効果で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」を付与されても、DPをマイナスされません。

faqs.question: What does the "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: With this effect, your opponent's memory will no longer increase by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects the opponent player.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「NSo」を持つLv.2:コスト0

faqs.question: 「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 相手はテイマーの効果を除く、全ての効果でメモリーがプラスできなくなる効果です。この効果は、相手プレイヤーに影響を及ぼします。

faqs.question: 相手の「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」効果が発揮されている間、「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとして扱われているテイマーの効果でメモリーをプラスできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモン及びテイマーとして扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

localized.name: Renamon (X Antibody)
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Renamon]: Cost 0
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name from your trash to the hand.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use Option cards with a use cost of 2 or more, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
faqs.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

faqs.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger. 
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

faqs.question:
An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. 
When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger. 
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

faqs.question:
An Option card has an original use cost of 2 or more, and I use it when the cost to pay is reduced to 1 or less. 
At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it triggers. 
If the card's cost to pay is reduced and not the use cost itself, it's considered to be using an Option card with its original value as its use cost. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect triggers.

faqs.question:
I used an effect to use an Option card with an original use cost of 2 or more without paying the cost. 
At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of X or more" effect trigger?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

localized.name: レナモンX抗体
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「レナモン」:コスト0
【登場時】【進化時】自分のトラッシュから、名称に「プラグイン」を含むオプションカード1枚を手札に戻す。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］自分が使用コスト2以上のオプションカードを使用したとき、ターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-2000。

faqs.question: 「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果が誘発した場合、どのタイミングで発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 使用したオプションカードの【メイン】効果を発揮したあとに発揮できます。

faqs.question: 使用以外でオプションカードの効果を発揮した場合、「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、誘発しません。
【セキュリティ】効果や≪ディレイ≫などで、使用せずにオプションカードの効果を発揮した場合は、「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question:
「BT2-099 グロリアスバースト」や「BT8-097 紅焔」の1つ目の効果のような、手札で使用コストがマイナスされ、コストが1以下になっている状況です。
そのカードを使用したとき、このカードの「使用コスト2以上のオプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、誘発しません。
手札のそのカードのコスト自体がマイナスされているカードを使用した場合は、マイナスされたあとのコストのオプションカードを使用したこととなります。そのため、「使用コスト2以上のオプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question:
元々の使用コストが2以上のオプションカードを、支払うコストがマイナスされ1コスト以下で使用しました。
このとき、このカードの「使用コスト2以上のオプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、誘発します。
支払うコストだけがマイナスされている場合、使用コスト自体がマイナスされてはいないので、使用コストが元々の数値のオプションカードを使用したこととなります。そのため、「使用コスト2以上のオプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発します。

faqs.question:
元々の使用コストが2以上のオプションカードを、効果でコストを支払わずに使用しました。
このとき、このカードの「使用コストX以上のオプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?Dec. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by doing X" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「DS」を持つLv.5:コスト3
【セキュリティ】バトル終了時、ターン終了まで、相手のデジモン2体に≪Sアタック-1≫を与える。その後、このカードを手札に加える。
【お互いのターン】メモリーが1以上の間、相手のデジモン全ての【進化時】効果は発揮しない。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが1以上」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の1から左側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【進化時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
【進化時】効果が誘発した場合や「【進化時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【進化時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で発揮する場合であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードの【進化時】効果を、他の効果で発揮させることはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？2025/12/25 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、その効果は[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？2025/03/27 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

faqs.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's met.

faqs.question:
My opponent has no Digimon with as much or more DP as this card in the battle area. 
This card performs a security check, the [Security] effect on the 1st card checked activates, and my opponent now has a Digimon with as much or more DP as this card. 
Can I then use the <Security A. +1> gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect to perform a 2nd security check?
faqs.answer:
No, a 2nd security check can't be performed using that <Security A. +1>. 
The <Security A. +1> gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect is lost as soon as your opponent has a Digimon with as much or more DP as this card, therefore you can't use the gained <Security A. +1> to perform a security check.

faqs.question: 「XXの相手のデジモンがいない間」は、相手のデジモンが1体もいない間も条件を満たしますか？
faqs.answer: はい、満たします。

faqs.question:
バトルエリアにこのカードのDP以上の相手のデジモンがいない状況です。
このカードがセキュリティをチェックし、1枚目のチェックでチェックされたカードの【セキュリティ】効果が発揮され、このカードのDP以上の相手のデジモンがいる状態になりました。
このとき、このカードの【自分のターン】効果で得ていた≪Sアタック+1≫で、2枚目のチェックをすることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その≪Sアタック+1≫で、2枚目のチェックはできません。
このカードの【自分のターン】効果で得ている≪Sアタック+1≫は、このカードのDP以上の相手のデジモンがいる状態になった時点で失われ、得ていた≪Sアタック+1≫によるチェックはできません。

localized.name: Pyramidimon
localized.mainEffect:
＜Fragment ≪3≫＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing any 3 of its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing any 3 digivolution cards with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait from your Digimon, this Digimon unsuspends and gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may place up to 3 cards with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash a total of 3 digivolution cards from my multiple different Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 2 digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to place Digi-Egg cards with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait from my trash as digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect but choose to not to place cards with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait from my trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If this card's [End of Your Turn] effect activates, you must place at least 1 card in digivolution cards. 
However, if you choose to not activate this effect, it won't activate and you don't place any cards in digivolution cards.

faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If this card's [End of Your Turn] effect activates, you must place at least 1 card in digivolution cards. 
However, if you choose to not activate this effect, it won't activate and you don't place any cards in digivolution cards.

localized.name: Myotismon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[NSo] trait: Cost 3
[When Attacking] You may play 1 [NSo] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 3 or less from your trash without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [NSo] trait, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with the [NSo] trait in the hand. Then, that DNA digivolved Digimon may attack.
localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon unsuspends.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card itself is played?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when a card digivolves into this card itself?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question:
This card attacks, and I use its [When Attacking] effect to play an [NSo] trait Digimon. 
If I then use this card's [Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve using 2 of my Digimon, can I use that Digimon to attack?
faqs.answer: No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, then I attacked using that Digimon. 
At such times, in what order can I activate that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect and [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

localized.name: ヴァンデモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「NSo」を持つLv.4:コスト3
【アタック時】自分のトラッシュから、特徴に「NSo」を持つ登場コスト3以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。
【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］自分のデジモンが登場/進化したとき、そのデジモンが特徴に「NSo」を持つなら、自分のデジモン2体で手札の特徴に「NSo」を持つデジモンカードにジョグレス進化できる。その後、ジョグレス進化したそのデジモンでアタックできる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【アタック時】［ターンに1回］他の自分のデジモン1体を消滅させることで、このデジモンをアクティブにする。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン】効果は、このカード自身が登場したときに誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン】効果は、このカード自身に進化したときに誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question:
このカードでアタックし、このカードの【アタック時】効果で特徴に「NSo」を持つデジモンを登場させました。
そのあと、このカードの【自分のターン】効果で、自分のデジモン2体でジョグレス進化した場合、そのデジモンをアタックさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、アタックさせることはできません。アタック中、新たにアタックの宣言はできません。

faqs.question:
このカードの【自分のターン】効果でジョグレス進化し、そのデジモンでアタックしました。
このとき、そのデジモンの持つ【進化時】効果と【アタック時】効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発になるので、プレイヤーが発揮する順を選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: If my opponent doesn't trash a card in their hand and I don't play a Digimon card from my trash for this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect, does that mean it doesn't count toward a use of [Once Per Turn]?
faqs.answer:
No, it counts toward a use of [Once Per Turn]. 
The "your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand" effect allows your opponent to choose whether or not they will discard a card in their hand. 
The effect will be considered to have activated when they choose whether or not to discard it, therefore it counts as a use of [Once Per Turn].

faqs.question:
When multiple "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects trigger, I activated the 1st effect, then the digivolved Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect triggered. 
At such times, in what order can I activate the other "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects and that [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer:
The [When Digivolving] effect activates first. 
As soon as your Digimon attacks, the "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects trigger simultaneously. 
You activate the 1st effect, digivolve a Digimon, then its [When Digivolving] effect triggers, and you therefore activate it first due to the derived trigger rule.

localized.mainEffect:
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン】名称に「ティラノモン」を含む自分のデジモンがアタックしたとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、そのデジモンを手札の名称に「ティラノモン」を含むか特徴に「恐竜型」を持つデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-1で進化できる。

faqs.question:
「自分のデジモンがアタックしたとき、そのデジモンを進化できる」効果が複数誘発したとき、その効果1つ目を発揮して、進化したデジモンの【進化時】効果が誘発しました。
このとき、まだ発揮していない「自分のデジモンがアタックしたとき」効果と、その【進化時】効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
【進化時】効果から先に発揮します。
自分のデジモンがアタックした時点で、「自分のデジモンがアタックしたとき」効果が同時誘発します。
その効果1つ目を発揮して、そのデジモンを進化して【進化時】効果が新しく誘発するため、派生誘発のルールによってその効果を先に発揮させます。

localized.name: Deep Savers
localized.mainEffect:
While you have no face-up security cards, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] While you have 1 or more memory, none of your [DS] trait Digimon can be deleted in battle.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.

faqs.question: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's met.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question:
I have this card placed face-up in my security stack. 
An opponent's Digimon digivolved, and I now have 1 or more memory. 
If my opponent's digivolved Digimon activates an effect and my Digimon with the [DS] trait attacks at such times, can this card's [All Turns] effect prevent my Digimon from being deleted in that battle?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is not deleted. 
This card's [All Turns] effect will activate as soon as you have 1 or more memory, therefore none of your Digimon with the [DS] trait will be deleted in battle.

localized.name: ディープセイバーズ
localized.mainEffect:
自分の表向きのセキュリティがない間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
［セキュリティ］【お互いのターン】メモリーが1以上の間、特徴に「DS」を持つ自分のデジモン全てはバトルで消滅しない。
【メイン】自分のセキュリティを下から1枚手札に加える。その後、このカードをセキュリティの下に表向きで置く。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが0枚のとき、「表向きのセキュリティがない間」の条件を満たしますか？
faqs.answer: はい、満たします。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、自分のセキュリティが0枚のときでも発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
この場合、手札に加えるセキュリティがないため、セキュリティを手札に加えず、このカードをセキュリティに置きます。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが1以上」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが自分側の1から左側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

faqs.question:
自分のセキュリティにこのカードが表向きで置かれている状況です。
相手のデジモンが進化し、メモリーが1以上になりました。
このとき、進化した相手のデジモンが効果を発揮して、特徴に「DS」を持つ自分のデジモンにアタックした場合、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、自分のデジモンはそのバトルで消滅しませんか？
faqs.answer:
はい、消滅しません。
メモリーが1以上になった時点で、このカードの【お互いのターン】効果が発揮されているため、特徴に「DS」を持つ自分のデジモン全てはバトルで消滅しません。

localized.name: Nightmare Soldiers
localized.mainEffect:
While you have no face-up security cards, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your level 4 or higher Digimon with the [NSo] trait gain ＜Scapegoat＞.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.

faqs.question: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question: {トラッシュ}効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードがトラッシュにある間、誘発・発揮できる効果です。
トラッシュ以外の場所では、誘発・発揮できません。

faqs.question: 自分のデジモンが「バルバモンX抗体」に進化したとき、そのデジモンに進化したときに誘発した効果と、このカードの{トラッシュ}【自分のターン】効果は、どの順で発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発となるので、プレイヤーが発揮する順を選ぶことができます。

localized.name: 세븐스 ･ 쥬얼라이즈
localized.mainEffect: ［트래시］【자신의 턴】자신의 디지몬이 「발바몬 X항체」로 진화했을 때, 이 카드를 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로, 이 카드의 【메인】 효과를 발휘한다. 【메인】상대의 패가 5장 이상이라면, 상대는 본인의 패 1장을 파기한다. 그 후, Lv.7 이하의 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 상대의 패 3장마다 이 효과의 Lv. 상한 -1.

localized.name: 七之宝石化
localized.mainEffect:
[废弃区]【我方的回合】当我方的数码宝贝进化成“巴尔巴兽X抗体”时,可将此卡牌放回到卡组最下方,并发动此卡牌的【主要】效果。

【主要】若对方持有5张或更多手牌,则对方丢弃其1张手牌。此后,消灭对方1只等级不高于Lv.7的数码宝贝。对方每持有3张手牌,此效果的Lv.数值上限-1。

localized.name: Gallantmon (X Antibody)
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Gallantmon]: Cost 1
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] If [Gallantmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gets +4000 DP and 1 of their Digimon gets -4000 DP.
[When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's 10000 DP or lower Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, trash their top security card and this Digimon unsuspends.
[All Turns] While you have 0 or less memory, this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects.

faqs.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order do they activate?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question:
My opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or less. 
Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect by not choosing a card to delete?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or less, you must choose that card and delete it.

faqs.question:
My opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or less. 
Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect by choosing an opponent's Digimon with 10000 DP or less and an effect that prevents deletion?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 0 or less" memory refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 0 or further to the right.

faqs.question: What does "isn't affected by [...] effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be chosen.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?Apr. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?Jun. 13, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
