sourceNotes: エクストラブースター CHAIN OF LIBERATION [EX-08]

localized.name: デュークモンX抗体
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「デュークモン」:コスト1
【進化時】【アタック時】このデジモンの進化元に「デュークモン」/「X抗体」があるなら、相手のターン終了まで、このデジモンをDP+4000し、相手のデジモン1体をDP-4000。
【進化時】【アタック終了時】［ターンに1回］DP10000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。この効果で消滅しなかったなら、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄し、このデジモンをアクティブにする。
【お互いのターン】メモリーが0以下の間、このデジモンは相手のデジモンの効果を受けない。

sourceAttributes.type: 聖騎士型/X抗体/ロイヤルナイツ

faqs.question: このカードは進化したときに誘発する効果を複数持ちますが、どの順で発揮することができますか？
faqs.answer: 同時誘発になるので、プレイヤーが発揮する順を選ぶことができます。

faqs.question:
DP10000以下の相手のデジモンがいる状況です。
このカードの【進化時】【アタック終了時】効果で、消滅させるカードを選ばずに「この効果で消滅しなかったなら」の条件を満たすことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
DP10000以下の相手のデジモンがいるのであれば、そのカードを選び、消滅させなければなりません。

faqs.question:
DP10000以下の相手のデジモンがいる状況です。
このカードの【進化時】【アタック終了時】効果で、消滅しない効果を持つDP10000以下の相手のデジモンを選び、「この効果で消滅しなかったなら」の条件を満たすことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: 「メモリーが0以下」とは、メモリーがどの状態であることを指しますか？
faqs.answer: メモリーが0から右側である状態を指します。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」効果で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」を付与されても、DPをマイナスされません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？2025/03/27 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？2025/06/13 更新
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

＜Alliance＞ ＜Vortex＞

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon are played, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.

faqs.question:
There is one Digimon without effects and one Digimon that isn't affected by effects in the battle area, and no others.
Can I declare I'm playing this card, choose those two Digimon as targets to suspend, then only suspend the Digimon without effects?
faqs.answer:
No, you cannot.
If you cannot suspend two Digimon for the conditions of this card's first effect, then pay its original play cost to play it.
Furthermore, if the card's original play cost can't be paid and there are not two Digimon that can be suspended for its first effect, then you cannot declare you are playing it.

faqs.question: Am I able to suspend only 1 Digimon and use this card's first conditional effect?
faqs.answer:

localized.name: メディーバルデュークモン
localized.mainEffect:
このカードが登場するとき、デジモン2体をレストさせることで、支払う登場コスト-4。
≪連携≫≪ヴォルテクス≫
【進化時】デジモン1体をレストできる。その後、DP8000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅できる。レスト状態の他のデジモン1体ごとに、このDP消滅効果の上限+3000。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］デジモンが登場したとき、このデジモンの【進化時】効果1つを発揮できる。

sourceAttributes.type: 戦士型/ウィッチェルニー/ヴォルテクスウォリアー

faqs.question:
バトルエリアに、効果を持たないデジモン1体と、効果を受けないデジモン1体のみがいる状況です。
このカードの登場を宣言し、そのデジモン2体をレストさせる対象に選び、効果を持たないデジモンのみをレストさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの1つ目の効果の条件でデジモン2体をレストさせることができない場合、このカードの元々の登場コストを支払って登場させます。
また、このカードの元々の登場コストも支払えず、このカードの1つ目の効果でレストさせることができるデジモン2体がいない場合は、このカードの登場の宣言自体ができません。

faqs.question: このカードの1つ目の効果の条件は、デジモンを1体だけレストさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この1つ目の効果の条件の場合、指定された体数、デジモンをレストさせる必要があります。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このカード自身が登場したときに誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、自分か相手のどちらのデジモンが登場したときにも誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question:
メモリーが0で、バトルエリアに「BT8-071 サイケモン」を含む相手のデジモン2体がいる状況です。
このカードの登場を宣言し、「BT8-071 サイケモン」を含む相手のデジモン2体をレストさせることはできますか？2025/02/28 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「BT8-071 サイケモン」の効果で登場コストをマイナスできずコストを支払えない状況のため、このカードの登場を宣言すること自体ができません。

faqs.question:
メモリーが1以上で、バトルエリアに「BT8-071 サイケモン」を含む相手のデジモン2体がいる状況です。
このカードの登場を宣言し、「BT8-071 サイケモン」を含む相手のデジモン2体をレストさせることはできますか？2025/02/28 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
「BT8-071 サイケモン」の効果で登場コストをマイナスできませんが、元々の登場コスト分のコストを支払えるため、このカードの登場を宣言することができます。
登場を宣言したあとに1つ目の効果でデジモン2体をレストさせることはできますが、登場コストをマイナスできないため、元々の登場コストである11コストを支払って登場させることとなります。

localized.name: Negamon
localized.mainEffect:
{Breeding} [Main] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Negamon] in its text from your hand with the play cost reduced by 2. For each [Negamon] in your trash or your Digimon's digivolution cards, further reduce it by 1. Then, place this Digimon as the played Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
{Breeding} [All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve and effects can't delete or trash it.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with [Negamon] in its text.

faqs.question: If I have 1 [Negamon] in my trash and 1 [Negamon] in my Digimon's digivolution cards, does this card's {Breeding} [Main] effect have a total cost reduction value of 2?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it reduces the cost by 2. 
This effect further reduces the cost by 1 for each [Negamon] in your trash or your Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question: What does this card's {Breeding} [All Turns] effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: When this card is in the breeding area during either player's turn, it can't digivolve and effects can't delete or trash it.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: What is a {Breeding} effect?
faqs.answer:
A {Breeding} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

localized.name: Gabumon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[DM] trait: Cost 0
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with the [DM] trait to the hand and place 1 card with the [Ver.2] trait face down as the bottom digivolution card of any of your Digimon with the [DM] trait. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)

faqs.question: If this card's [On Play] effect only reveals 1 card with the [DM] trait, but that card has the [Ver.2] trait, can I choose to place it in the digivolution cards of my Digimon without adding it to the hand?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must first choose a card to add to the hand, add it, then choose from the remaining revealed cards to place in digivolution cards.

faqs.question: When this card is played without paying the cost, can I use its 1st effect to trash a specified card from my hand?

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

localized.name: Omnimon Alter-S
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[DM] trait: Cost 5 
[DNA Digivolve] Blue Lv.6 + red Lv.6: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.
[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, your opponent's effects don't affect this Digimon for the turn. Then, delete all of their Digimon with the highest level.
[End of Attack] You may play 1 card with [Greymon] in its name or the [Ver.1] trait and 1 card with [Garurumon] in its name or the [Ver.2] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the costs. If this effect played, place this Digimon as your top security card.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can process it. 
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [When Digivolving] effect deletes all of your opponent's Digimon with the highest level.

faqs.question: What combinations of digivolution cards can be played by this card's [End of Attack] effect?
faqs.answer:
The following combinations are possible. 
●1 card with [Greymon] in its name and 1 card with [Garurumon] in its name
●1 card with [Greymon] in its name and 1 card with the [Ver.2] trait
●1 card with the [Ver.1] trait and 1 card with [Garurumon] in its name
●1 card with the [Ver.1] trait and 1 card with the [Ver.2] trait

faqs.question: At the end of an attack by this card that has 1 card with [Greymon] in its name and 1 card with [Garurumon] in its name in its digivolution cards, can I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect and play just the card with [Greymon] in its name from this Digimon's digivolution cards?Mar. 13, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If this card's [End of Attack] effect activates, you must play the specified cards whenever possible.

faqs.question: At the end of an attack by this card that has just 1 card with [Greymon] in its name in its digivolution cards, can I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect and play just the card with [Greymon] in its name from this Digimon's digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, just that card can be played.

faqs.question: What does "none of your [...] Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP."

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

localized.name: オメガモン Alter-S
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「DM」を持つLv.6:コスト5
【ジョグレス】青Lv.6+赤Lv.6:コスト0
【進化時】ジョグレス進化していたなら、ターン終了まで、このデジモンは相手の効果を受けない。その後、最もLv.の高い相手のデジモン全てを消滅させる。
【アタック終了時】このデジモンの進化元から、名称に「グレイモン」を含むか特徴に「Ver.1」を持つカード1枚と名称に「ガルルモン」を含むか特徴に「Ver.2」を持つカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。この効果で登場したなら、このデジモンをセキュリティの上に置く。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果は、1つ目の処理の「～なら」の条件を満たしていなくても、「その後」以降の処理を行うことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、処理することができます。
このカードの【進化時】効果の場合、ジョグレス進化していなくても、最もLv.の高い相手のデジモン全てを消滅させます。

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック終了時】効果は、進化元のカードをどの組み合わせで登場させることができますか？
faqs.answer:
以下の組み合わせで登場できます。
●名称に「グレイモン」を含むカード1枚&名称に「ガルルモン」を含むカード1枚
●名称に「グレイモン」を含むカード1枚&特徴に「Ver.2」を持つカード1枚
●特徴に「Ver.1」を持つカード1枚&名称に「ガルルモン」を含むカード1枚
●特徴に「Ver.1」を持つカード1枚&特徴に「Ver.2」を持つカード1枚

faqs.question: 進化元に名称に「グレイモン」を含むカードと名称に「ガルルモン」を含むカードが1枚ずつあるこのカードのアタック終了時に、このカードの【アタック終了時】効果を発揮して、このデジモンの進化元から名称に「グレイモン」を含むカードだけを登場させることはできますか？2026/03/13 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【アタック終了時】効果を発揮した場合、指定のカードを可能な限り登場させます。

faqs.question: 進化元に名称に「グレイモン」を含むカード1枚のみがあるこのカードのアタック終了時に、このカードの【アタック終了時】効果を発揮して、このデジモンの進化元から名称に「グレイモン」を含むカードだけを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、登場させることができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: I tried to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon attacked, but I couldn't delete the other Digimon due to another effect. Can I end that attack at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't end that attack. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. In this case, if you can't delete 1 of your other Digimon, then you can't end the attack.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

faqs.question: 相手のデジモンがアタックしたときに、このカードの進化元効果で他のデジモンを消滅させようとしましたが、他の効果でそのデジモンが消滅しませんでした。このとき、そのアタックを終了させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、アタックを終了させることはできません。
「させることで」の条件は、その内容を実行できなければそれ以降の処理はできません。この状況の場合、消滅させることができなければ、アタックを終了させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「アタックを終了する」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: この効果を発揮した場合、現在のタイミングが「アタック終了時」になります。例えば、「アタック宣言」のタイミングでこの効果を発揮した場合、「アタック宣言」のタイミングから「アタック終了時」になります。「カウンタータイミング」「ブロックタイミング」には進行されず、アタックは成立しません。

faqs.question: 効果を受けないデジモンのアタックを、「アタックを終了する」効果で終了させることはできますか？

はい、アタックを終了させることができます。
アタックを終了させる効果は、タイミングを変更する効果なので、アタックしているデジモンには影響を及ぼしていません。

localized.name: Kokeshimon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Puppet] trait: Cost 2
[When Digivolving] [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card in your hand, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, end that attack.

faqs.question: I tried to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon attacked, but I couldn't delete the other Digimon due to another effect. Can I end that attack at such times?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't end that attack. 
If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. In this case, if you can't delete 1 of your other Digimon, then you can't end the attack.

faqs.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

faqs.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
faqs.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended. 
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

faqs.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Abbadomon]: Cost 4
{Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by returning 4 [Negamon] from your trash or your Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck, this Digimon moves to the battle area.
＜Collision＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞
[When Moving] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By placing 3 level 6 or lower Digimon cards with [Negamon] in their texts from your trash as this Digimon's top digivolution cards, delete all of your opponent's lowest level Digimon.

faqs.question: If I have 2 [Negamon] in my trash and 2 [Negamon] in my Digimon's digivolution cards, can I place them at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck for the conditions of this card's {Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
This effect's conditions allow you to place 4 total [Negamon] from your trash or your Digimon's digivolution cards at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck.

faqs.question: Can I return just 3 cards from my trash or my Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck for the conditions of this card's {Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this {Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] effect require you to return the specified number of cards to the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck.

faqs.question: Can I place just 2 cards from my trash as this Digimon's top digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's [When Moving] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [When Moving] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to place the specified number of cards as this Digimon's top digivolution cards.

faqs.question:
This card was in the breeding area. 
When an opponent's Digimon attacks, I activated this card's {Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] effect and moved it to the battle area. 
At such times, can I activate this card's [When Moving] effect and then perform a block?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question: What is a {Breeding} effect?
faqs.answer:
A {Breeding} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Cyborg]/[DM] trait: Cost 3
When this card would be played, by trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Ver.4] trait card from your hand, reduce the play cost by 2.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete 2 of your opponent's play cost 4 or lower Digimon. For each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards, add 1 to this effect's play cost maximum.
localized.sourceEffect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By unsuspending this Digimon, delete 1 of your Digimon with the lowest level.

faqs.question: When this card is played without paying the cost, can I use its 1st effect to trash a specified card from my hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if you trash it, you play this card without paying the cost.

faqs.question:
At the end of an attack by EX9-073 [Machinedramon] that has this card in its digivolution cards, I use this card's inherited effect to unsuspend EX9-073 [Machinedramon] and then try to delete it. 
At such times, can I activate EX9-073 [Machinedramon]'s [All Turns] effect and prevent it from being removed?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida
localized.mainEffect:
[On Play] You may return 1 Digimon card with [Greymon], [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name from your trash to the hand. If this effect didn't return, ＜Draw 1＞.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory if you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name. Then, gain 1 memory if you have a Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name.

faqs.question: Can I <Draw 1> if I choose to not return a card from my trash to the hand for this card's [On Play] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you <Draw 1> if you choose to not return a card from your trash to the hand.

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [All Turns] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you don't suspend this card, the part after "then" in its [All Turns] effect can't give you 1 memory.

localized.mainEffect:
【登場時】自分のトラッシュから、名称に「グレイモン」/「ガルルモン」/「オメガモン」を含むデジモンカード1枚を手札に戻せる。この効果で戻らなかったなら、≪1ドロー≫。
【お互いのターン】自分のデジモンが登場/進化したとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、名称に「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。その後、名称に「ガルルモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+1。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果で、自分のトラッシュのカードを手札に戻さないことを選択し、≪1ドロー≫することはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、手札に戻さないことを選択した場合、≪1ドロー≫します。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、「ことで」の条件を満たさなくても、「その後」以降の効果を処理できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果の場合、このカードをレストさせなければ、「その後」以降の効果でメモリーをプラスすることはできません。

faqs.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

faqs.question:
2 copies of this card are in the battle area. 
The [Start of Your Main Phase] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously, and I activate that effect on the 1st copy of this card. 
At such times, in what order do the already triggered [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the 2nd copy of this card and the triggered [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card activate?
faqs.answer:
The [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card will derived trigger, so you can choose whether they will activate, and then you can activate them. 
Then, the [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the 2nd copy of this card can activate. 
The [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the 2nd copy of this card triggers the [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card again, therefore if this card is unsuspended, you can also activate the [Your Turn] effects during this timing.

·可丢弃我方1只拥有“DM”特征的数码宝贝最下方的2张正面朝下的进化源,并将该数码宝贝转换为活跃状态。

localized.name: File Island
localized.mainEffect:
While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your [DM] trait Digimon get +1000 DP for each of their face-down digivolution cards.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.

faqs.question: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's met.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

localized.name: ファイル島
localized.mainEffect:
自分の表向きのセキュリティがない間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
［セキュリティ］【お互いのターン】特徴に「DM」を持つ自分のデジモン全てをそのデジモンの裏向きの進化元1枚ごとに、DP+1000。
【メイン】自分のセキュリティを下から1枚手札に加える。その後、このカードをセキュリティの下に表向きで置く。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが0枚のとき、「表向きのセキュリティがない間」の条件を満たしますか？
faqs.answer: はい、満たします。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、自分のセキュリティが0枚のときでも発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
この場合、手札に加えるセキュリティがないため、セキュリティを手札に加えず、このカードをセキュリティに置きます。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

localized.name: Machinedramon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[DM] trait: Cost 3
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 5 [Cyborg] or [Ver.5] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's top digivolution card, activate 1 [On Play] effect on the placed card as an effect of this Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing its bottom 2 face-down or [Cyborg] trait digivolution cards, it doesn't leave.
【Assembly -6】 4 level 5 [Cyborg] trait Digimon cards w/different names
When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.

faqs.question:
My opponent's BT20-037 [Chaosmon: Valdur Arm]'s [When Digivolving] effect is preventing my [On Play] effects from activating. 
When this card attacks or my Digimon digivolves into it, can I use its [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] to place a card from my hand or trash as this Digimon's top digivolution card, then activate the placed card's [On Play] effect?
faqs.answer: You can place the card, but you can't activate any of its [On Play] effects.

faqs.question:
Just 1 face-down card and 1 [Cyborg] trait card are in this card's digivolution cards. 
Can I trash those 2 digivolution cards for this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
By trashing 2 total [Cyborg] trait cards and/or bottom face-down cards, this card's [All Turns] effect prevents this Digimon from leaving. Possible combinations of cards to trash include 2 [Cyborg] trait cards, 1 [Cyborg] trait card and 1 face-down card, or 2 face-down cards.

localized.name: ムゲンドラモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「DM」を持つLv.5:コスト3
【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】［ターンに1回］自分の手札/トラッシュから、特徴に「サイボーグ型」/「Ver.5」を持つLv.5のカード1枚をこのデジモンの進化元の上に置くことで、置いたカードの【登場時】効果1つをこのデジモンの効果として発揮する。
【お互いのターン】このデジモンがバトルエリアを離れるとき、このデジモンの進化元から、特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つか裏向きのカードを下から2枚破棄することで、離れない。
【アセンブリ-6】名称の異なる特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つLv.5のデジモンカード4枚
登場するとき、トラッシュから指定の枚数このカードの下に置くことで、登場コストをマイナスする

faqs.question:
相手の「BT20-037 カオスモン:ヴァロドゥルアーム」の【進化時】効果で、自分の【登場時】効果が発揮できない状況です。
自分のデジモンをこのカードに進化させたときか、このカードでアタックしたときに、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果で、手札かトラッシュのカードをこのデジモンの進化元の上に置き、置いたカードの【登場時】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer: 置くことはできますが、置いたカードの【登場時】効果を発揮することはできません。

faqs.question:
このカードの進化元が裏向きのカード1枚、特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つカード1枚のみ置かれている状況です。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、進化元のそれらのカード2枚を破棄することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、破棄することができます。
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つカードか裏向きのカードを下から2枚破棄することで離れなくなります。特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つカード2枚の組み合わせや、特徴に「サイボーグ型」を持つカードと裏向きのカード2枚の組み合わせで破棄できます。

faqs.question: What does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer:
It allows you to place 1 level 4 or lower [DM] trait Digimon card from your trash as this Digimon's top digivolution card. 
Then, you choose and delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the same color as any of this Digimon's digivolution cards. If this Digimon has 6 or more colors in its digivolution cards, you instead choose and delete 1 of each of your opponent's Digimon with different colors. 
If you will delete 1 of each of your opponent's Digimon with different colors, you must choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon for each of the colors (red, blue, yellow, green, black, purple, and white) and delete it whenever possible.

faqs.question:
This Digimon has 6 or more colors in its digivolution cards. 
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to choose 1 of my opponent's 2-color Digimon twice and delete it twice?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you will delete 1 of each of your opponent's Digimon with different colors for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, you must choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon for each of the colors (red, blue, yellow, green, black, purple, and white) and delete it whenever possible. 
You can't choose 1 Digimon multiple times.

faqs.question:
This Digimon has 6 or more colors in its digivolution cards, and my opponent has a red single-color Digimon and a red/blue 2-color Digimon. 
Can I choose my opponent's red/blue Digimon for red, but not choose or delete their red single-color Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you will delete 1 of each of your opponent's Digimon with different colors for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, you must choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon for each of the colors (red, blue, yellow, green, black, purple, and white) and delete it whenever possible. 
If they have a red single-color Digimon and a red/blue 2-color Digimon, you must reference the different colors and delete 1 of each whenever possible.

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、どういった効果ですか？

自分のトラッシュの特徴に「DM」を持つLv.4以下のデジモンカード1枚をこのカードの進化元の上に置けます。

このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で色の異なる相手のデジモン1体ずつを消滅させる場合、赤・青・黄・緑・黒・紫・白の相手のデジモンを1体ずつ可能な限り選び、選んだデジモンを消滅させます。
1体のデジモンを複数回選ぶことはできません。

このカードの進化元が6色以上の状況で、赤1色の相手のデジモンと赤と青2色の相手のデジモンがいる状況です。

faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で色の異なる相手のデジモン1体ずつを消滅させる場合、赤・青・黄・緑・黒・紫・白の相手のデジモンを1体ずつ可能な限り選び、選んだデジモンを消滅させます。

faqs.question: If there are 7 cards in my hand and I have 2 of this Digimon at the start of my main phase, can I draw a total of 2 cards from both instances of this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
At the start of your main phase, the [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on 2 of this Digimon simultaneously trigger, then the player determines the activation order. However, because your hand increases to 8 cards from <Draw 1> on the 1st Digimon, the effect's conditions aren't met for the 2nd Digimon, so the effect doesn't activate. As a result, you only draw 1 card.

faqs.question: If I have 7 cards in my hand upon an attack by my Digimon with 2 of this card in its digivolution cards, can I draw a total of 2 cards from both instances of this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Upon the attack declaration, the inherited effects on the 2 copies of this card simultaneously trigger, then the player determines the activation order. However, because your hand increases to 8 cards from <Draw 1> on the 1st card, the effect's conditions aren't met for the 2nd card, so the effect doesn't activate. As a result, you only draw 1 card.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 2마리 있을 때, 자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시에 자신의 패가 7장이었다면 각각 효과로 합계 2장 드로우 할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 불가능합니다.
자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시에 이 디지몬 2마리의 【자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시】효과가 동시 유발하고, 발휘 순서를 플레이어가 결정하여 순서대로 발휘하게됩니다만, 1마리째의 효과로 《1 드로우》하는 것으로 패가 8장이 되기 때문에 2마리째의 효과는 조건을 만족하지 못하여 발휘되지 않습니다. 결과적으로 1장만 드로우하게 됩니다.

faqs.answer:
아니요, 불가능합니다.
어택을 선언했을 때에 이 카드 2장의 진화원 효과가 동시 유발하고, 발휘 순서를 플레이어가 결정하여 순서대로 발휘하게됩니다만, 1마리째의 효과로 《1 드로우》하는 것으로 패가 8장이 되기 때문에 2마리째의 효과는 조건을 만족하지 못하여 발휘되지 않습니다. 결과적으로 1장만 드로우하게 됩니다.

faqs.question: Does this card's [When Attacking] effect prevent deletion in battles against Security Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is not deleted.

faqs.question: Does this card's [When Attacking] effect prevent deletion even when my opponent's deleted Digimon has <Retaliation>?

faqs.question: If I have 7 cards in my hand upon an attack by my Digimon with 2 of this card in its digivolution cards, can I draw a total of 2 cards from both instances of this card's effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Upon the attack declaration, the inherited effects on the 2 copies of this card simultaneously trigger, then the player determines the activation order. However, because your hand increases to 8 cards from <Draw 1> on the 1st card, the effect's conditions aren't met for the 2nd card, so the effect doesn't activate. As a result, you only draw 1 card.

The digivolution cost is only reduced by 2 when it would digivolve into a card with [Angoramon] in its text.

faqs.question: When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Angoramon] in its text, I used this card's effect to suspend this Digimon and reduce the digivolution cost by 2. At such times, can I use this card's "when this Digimon becomes suspended" effect to give this Digimon <Rush>?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
As soon as the digivolution is complete, this card becomes a digivolution card, and its effects can no longer activate.

localized.name: Quantumon
localized.mainEffect:
[When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon on top of its owner's security stack, reveal all of your opponent's security cards, and place 1 card among them on top of your opponent's deck. Shuffle the rest and return them to the security stack.
[Start of Opponent's Turn] Declare 1 card category. Then, reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. If it's of that category, this Digimon isn't affected by that category's effects, other than this Digimon's effects, for the turn. Return the revealed cards to the top or bottom of your opponent's deck.

faqs.question:
What does this card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect do, exactly? 
(*This card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect has been changed to "[Start of Opponent's Turn] Declare 1 card category. Then, reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. If that card is of the declared category, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of that card category for the turn. Return the revealed card to the top or the bottom of your opponent's deck.")
faqs.answer:
You choose and declare 1 card category. Then, you reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. 
If that card is of the declared category, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of that card category for the turn. 
The revealed card is returned to the top or the bottom of your opponent's deck.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect to declare a card category such as Digi-Egg cards that can't be placed in decks?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect to prevent Tamer effects from affecting this card. 
At such times, is this Digimon unaffected by inherited effects on Tamer cards in the digivolution cards of my opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, it's affected by such effects. 
Inherited effects are gained and activated by Digimon, therefore such effects are considered Digimon effects. 
In this case, inherited effects on Tamer cards in digivolution cards of Digimon are considered Digimon effects, therefore they will affect this card.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect to prevent Digimon effects from affecting this card. 
At such times, does this card still gain the inherited effects on Digimon cards in its digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it gains inherited effects.

faqs.question:
I used this card's [Start of Opponent's Turn] effect to prevent Digimon effects from affecting this card. 
At such times, is this card no longer affected by effects on my other Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it isn't affected. 
Effects activated by Security Digimon are considered Digimon effects.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the security stack, reveal all cards in my opponent's security stack, and place 1 card among them at the top of my opponent's deck?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by placing 1 Digimon on top of its owner's security stack" condition. A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return my token played as a Digimon from the battle area to the hand, reveal all cards in my opponent's security stack, and place 1 card among them at the top of my opponent's deck?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If your token is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, it will ultimately be removed from the game instead of being placed in the security stack according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by placing 1 Digimon on top of its owner's security stack" condition. A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

faqs.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's [When Digivolving] effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't trigger.

A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

faqs.question:
このカードの【相手のターン開始時】効果で、このカードはテイマーの効果を受けなくなりました。

faqs.answer:
いいえ、受けます。

このとき、このカードは相手のセキュリティデジモンの効果も受けませんか？
faqs.answer:
はい、受けません。
セキュリティデジモンが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果になります。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果は、バトルエリアにいる自分の「EX2-007 マザー デ・リーパー」をセキュリティに戻して、相手のセキュリティ全てをオープンし、その中から1枚を相手のデッキの上に置くことはできますか？2023/10/17 更新
faqs.answer:

faqs.answer: はい、受けません。

localized.name: 퀀타몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화 시】디지몬 1마리를 시큐리티 위에 놓는 것으로, 상대의 시큐리티 전부를 오픈하고, 그중 1장을 덱 위에 놓는다. 나머지는 셔플하여 시큐리티로 되돌린다. 【상대의 턴 개시 시】카드 카테고리 1개를 선언한다. 그 후, 상대의 덱 위에서부터 1장 오픈하고, 그 카드가 선언한 카드 카테고리라면, 턴 종료까지 이 디지몬은 이 디지몬 이외의 선언한 카드 카테고리의 효과를 받지 않는다. 오픈한 카드는 상대의 덱 위 또는 아래로 되돌린다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【상대의 턴 개시 시】 효과는 어떤 효과인가요?
faqs.answer:
어떠한 카드 카테고리를 1개 선언합니다. 그 후, 상대의 덱 가장 위 1장을 오픈합니다.
오픈한 카드가 선언한 카드 카테고리와 같다면, 턴 종료까지 이 디지몬은 이 디지몬 이외의 선언한 카드 카테고리의 효과를 받지 않게 됩니다.
오픈한 카드는 이 카드를 플레이한 플레이어가 상대의 덱 위 또는 아래 중 원하는 곳으로 되돌립니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【상대의 턴 개시 시】 효과로 디지타마 카드 등, 덱에 넣을 수 없는 카드 카테고리를 선언할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 선언 가능합니다.

faqs.question:
이 카드의 【상대의 턴 개시 시】 효과로 이 카드는 테이머의 효과를 받지 않게 되었습니다.
이 때, 이 카드는 상대의 디지몬의 진화원에 있는 테이머 카드의 효과를 받나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 받습니다.
진화원 효과는 그 진화원을 갖고 있는 디지몬이 발휘하는 것이므로 디지몬의 효과로 처리됩니다.

faqs.answer: 아니요, 진화원 효과는 받을 수 있습니다.

오픈한 카드는 이 카드를 플레이한 플레이어가 상대의 덱 위 또는 아래 중 원하는 곳으로 되돌립니다.

faqs.answer: 네, 선언 가능합니다.

localized.name: Agumon - Bond of Bravery ACE
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] While you have 2 or fewer security cards, [Agumon]: Cost 3
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete up to this Digimon's DP's total worth of your opponent's Digimon.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have a Tamer, trash your opponent's top security card.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)

faqs.question: Is "[Digivolve] While you have 2 or fewer security cards, [Agumon]: Cost 3" a digivolution requirement added by an effect while I have 2 or fewer security cards?
faqs.answer:
No, this is a standard digivolution requirement for a Digimon card. 
It references the number of your security cards, but it's not an effect.

faqs.question: Can I use <Blast Digivolve> to digivolve my [Agumon] into this card in the hand when I have 2 or fewer security cards and an opponent's Digimon attacks?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Digivolution is possible as long as you have 2 or fewer security cards when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If an opponent's Digimon attacks when I have 2 or fewer security cards, then an effect adds a card to my security stack so my security stack has 3 or more cards when I use <Blast Digivolve>, can my [Agumon] digivolve into this card in the hand?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
Digivolution from [Agumon] isn't possible because the digivolution requirements aren't met when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If an opponent's Digimon attacks when I have 3 security cards, then an effect removes a card from my security stack so my security stack has 2 or fewer cards when I use <Blast Digivolve>, can my [Agumon] digivolve into this card in the hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
Digivolution from [Agumon] is possible as long as the digivolution requirements are met when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If I use an effect such as P-103 [Offense Training]'s <Delay> that digivolves a Digimon, can my [Agumon] digivolve into this card in the hand when I have 2 or fewer security cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can.

faqs.question: What does "[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete your opponent's Digimon up to a total DP equal to this Digimon's DP" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect allows you to choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to the same as this Digimon's DP or less, then you delete all of them. 
For example, if this Digimon has 14000 DP when its [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, you can choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose DP adds up to a total of 14000 or less, such as 1 with 10000 DP and 1 with 4000 DP, or 2 of their Digimon with 7000 DP each, then you delete them.

faqs.question: Can I intentionally choose targets whose total DP adds up to a lower value than this Digimon's DP?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can choose any targets as long as their total DP adds up to a value less than or equal to this Digimon's DP. However, you must choose at least 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP is equal to or less than this Digimon's DP.

localized.name: アグモン -勇気の絆-ACE
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】自分のセキュリティが2枚以下の間、「アグモン」:コスト3
［手札］【カウンター】≪ブラスト進化≫（自分のデジモンをこのカードにコストを支払わずに進化できる）
【登場時】【進化時】DP合計このデジモンのDPまで、相手のデジモンを消滅させる。
【アタック時】［ターンに1回］自分のテイマーがいるなら、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。
localized.sourceEffect: ≪オーバーフロー《-5》≫（バトルエリアかカードの下から、それ以外の場所に送られる場合、メモリー-5）

faqs.question: 『〔進化〕自分のセキュリティが2枚以下の間、「アグモン」:コスト3』は、自分のセキュリティが2枚以下の間、効果で追加される進化条件ですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、デジモンカードが持つ、通常の進化条件です。
セキュリティの枚数を参照しますが、効果ではありません。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが2枚以下で相手のデジモンからアタックされたとき、≪ブラスト進化≫で自分の「アグモン」から手札のこのカードに進化できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
≪ブラスト進化≫する時点で自分のセキュリティが2枚以下であれば、進化できます。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが2枚以下のときに相手のデジモンがアタックしました。その後、効果で自分のセキュリティが増え、≪ブラスト進化≫する時点でセキュリティが3枚以上になった場合、自分の「アグモン」から手札のこのカードに進化できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
≪ブラスト進化≫する時点で進化条件を満たしていないため、「アグモン」から進化することはできません。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが3枚のときに相手のデジモンがアタックしました。その後、効果で自分のセキュリティが減り、≪ブラスト進化≫する時点でセキュリティが2枚以下になった場合、自分の「アグモン」から手札のこのカードに進化できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
≪ブラスト進化≫する時点で進化条件を満たしていれば、「アグモン」から進化することができます。

faqs.question: 自分のセキュリティが2枚以下のとき、「P-103 オフェンス・トレーニング」の≪ディレイ≫効果のような、デジモンを進化させる効果で自分の「アグモン」を手札のこのカードに進化させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: 「【登場時】【進化時】DP合計このデジモンのDPまで、相手のデジモンを消滅させる。」とは、具体的にどういう事でしょうか？
faqs.answer:
DPの合計がこのデジモンのDP以下になるように相手のデジモンを好きな数だけ選び、選んだ相手のデジモンを消滅させる効果です。
例えば、このデジモンの【登場時】【進化時】効果が発揮した時点のDPが14000なら、「DP10000のデジモン1体+DP4000のデジモン1体」や、「DP7000のデジモン2体」のように、DPの合計が14000以下になるように相手のデジモンを好きな数だけ選び、そのデジモンを消滅させます。

faqs.question: DP合計がこのデジモンのDP以下になるように、わざと少なく対象を選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、DP合計がこのデジモンのDP以下になるのであれば自由に選べます。ただし、DP合計がこのデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモンを、最低1体は選択してください。

faqs.question: Is "[Digivolve] While you have 2 or fewer security cards, [Gabumon]: Cost 3" a digivolution requirement added by an effect while I have 2 or fewer security cards?
faqs.answer:
No, this is a standard digivolution requirement for a Digimon card. 
It references the number of your security cards, but it's not an effect.

faqs.question: Can I use <Blast Digivolve> to digivolve my [Gabumon] into this card in the hand when I have 2 or fewer security cards and an opponent's Digimon attacks?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Digivolution is possible as long as you have 2 or fewer security cards when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If an opponent's Digimon attacks when I have 2 or fewer security cards, then an effect adds a card to my security stack so my security stack has 3 or more cards when I use <Blast Digivolve>, can my [Gabumon] digivolve into this card in the hand?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
Digivolution from [Gabumon] isn't possible because the digivolution requirements aren't met when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If an opponent's Digimon attacks when I have 3 security cards, then an effect removes a card from my security stack so my security stack has 2 or fewer cards when I use <Blast Digivolve>, can my [Gabumon] digivolve into this card in the hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Digivolution from [Gabumon] is possible as long as the digivolution requirements are met when you use <Blast Digivolve>.

faqs.question: If I use an effect such as P-103 [Offense Training]'s <Delay> that digivolves a Digimon, can my [Gabumon] digivolve into this card in the hand when I have 2 or fewer security cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
An Option card's use cost is 5 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. 
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place that card as a security card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If a card's use cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand and the use cost is 5 or less, this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can place that card as a security card.

faqs.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
faqs.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

faqs.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger. 
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

faqs.question: What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Such effects increase the maximum value shown for DP-based deletion effects. 
For example, while "[Your Turn] Add 1000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activated, "[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less" will allow you to delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

faqs.question: If "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activating, can the maximum be increased for an effect such as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP" that references a Digimon's DP for deletion?May. 24, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it can't be increased. 
You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

faqs.answer:

faqs.question: 「DP消滅効果の上限+X000」効果が発揮されている間、「このデジモンのDP以下の相手のデジモンを消滅させる。」などの、デジモンのDPを参照して消滅させる効果の上限をプラスすることはできますか？2024/05/24 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、プラスできません。
数値が記述されていないDP消滅効果の上限をプラスすることはできません。

localized.name: Red Scramble
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] 1 of your red Digimon may digivolve into a red Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon, ＜Delay＞.
・Return 1 red Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 red Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [Main] effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect if I don't have any red Digimon cards in my trash?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to play a red Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from my trash without returning a Digimon card from my trash to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must perform "return 1 red Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck" whenever possible.

localized.name: Blue Scramble
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] 1 of your blue Digimon may digivolve into a blue Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon, ＜Delay＞.
・Return 1 blue Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 blue Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [Main] effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect if I don't have any blue Digimon cards in my trash?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to play a blue Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from my trash without returning a Digimon card from my trash to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must perform "return 1 blue Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck" whenever possible.

localized.name: ブルー・スクランブル
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】青の自分のデジモン1体を手札の青のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-3で進化できる。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【自分のターン開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、≪ディレイ≫。
・自分のトラッシュから、青のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す。その後、自分のデジモンがいないなら、自分のトラッシュから、青のDP2000以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【メイン】効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【メイン】の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードは自分のトラッシュに青のデジモンカードが1枚もないときでも、≪ディレイ≫を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、トラッシュのデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻さずに、トラッシュから青のDP2000以下のデジモンカードを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「自分のトラッシュから、青のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す」は、可能な限り行う必要があります。

[Main] 1 of your yellow Digimon may digivolve into a yellow Digimon card in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon, ＜Delay＞.
・Return 1 yellow Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 yellow Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [Main] effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect if I don't have any yellow Digimon cards in my trash?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to play a yellow Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from my trash without returning a Digimon card from my trash to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must perform "return 1 yellow Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck" whenever possible.

sourceNotes: リミテッドカードセット2024 [LM-03]

localized.name: イエロー・スクランブル
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】黄の自分のデジモン1体を手札の黄のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-3で進化できる。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【自分のターン開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、≪ディレイ≫。
・自分のトラッシュから、黄のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す。その後、自分のデジモンがいないなら、自分のトラッシュから、黄のDP2000以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【メイン】効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【メイン】の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードは自分のトラッシュに黄のデジモンカードが1枚もないときでも、≪ディレイ≫を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、トラッシュのデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻さずに、トラッシュから黄のDP2000以下のデジモンカードを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「自分のトラッシュから、黄のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す」は、可能な限り行う必要があります。

localized.mainEffect:

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【メイン】の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードは自分のトラッシュに緑のデジモンカードが1枚もないときでも、≪ディレイ≫を発揮できますか？

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、トラッシュのデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻さずに、トラッシュから緑のDP2000以下のデジモンカードを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「自分のトラッシュから、緑のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す」は、可能な限り行う必要があります。

【メイン】黒の自分のデジモン1体を手札の黒のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-3で進化できる。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【自分のターン開始時】相手のデジモンがいるなら、≪ディレイ≫。
・自分のトラッシュから、黒のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す。その後、自分のデジモンがいないなら、自分のトラッシュから、黒のDP2000以下のデジモンカード1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【メイン】効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【メイン】の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードは自分のトラッシュに黒のデジモンカードが1枚もないときでも、≪ディレイ≫を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫効果で、トラッシュのデジモンカードをデッキの上に戻さずに、トラッシュから黒のDP2000以下のデジモンカードを登場させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「自分のトラッシュから、黒のデジモンカード1枚をデッキの上に戻す」は、可能な限り行う必要があります。

localized.mainEffect: 【메인】블랙인 자신의 디지몬 1마리를 패의 블랙인 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -3 하여 진화시킬 수 있다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【자신의 턴 개시 시】상대의 디지몬이 있다면, 《딜레이》. ・자신의 트래시에서 블랙인 디지몬 카드 1장을 덱 위로 되돌린다. 그 후, 자신의 디지몬이 없다면, 자신의 트래시에서 블랙인 DP 2000 이하의 디지몬 카드 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

localized.name: 黑色·出动
localized.mainEffect:
【主要】可以将我方1只黑色数码宝贝以需支付的进化费用-3进化成手牌中的黑色数码宝贝卡牌。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【我方的回合开始时】若对方的场上存在数码宝贝,则《延迟》。

·从我方的废弃区中,将1张黑色数码宝贝卡牌放回到卡组最上方。此后,若我方场上不存在数码宝贝,则可以从我方的废弃区中,不支付费用登场1张DP不高于2000的黑色数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Purple Scramble
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] 1 of your purple Digimon may digivolve into a purple Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon, ＜Delay＞.
・Return 1 purple Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 purple Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [Main] effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect if I don't have any purple Digimon cards in my trash?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to play a purple Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from my trash without returning a Digimon card from my trash to the top of the deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You must perform "return 1 purple Digimon card from your trash to the top of the deck" whenever possible.

localized.mainEffect:
Black also meets this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 red or black Digimon card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: What does this card's 1st effect do, exactly?

faqs.question: Does this card's 1st effect mean that this card's color requirements are met even when I have a black Digimon in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, the color requirements are met when you have a black Digimon in the breeding area.

localized.mainEffect:
このカードは黒でも色条件を満たせる。
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から3枚オープンする。その中の赤/黒のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。

faqs.question: このカードの1つ目の効果は、どういった効果ですか？

faqs.answer: はい、育成エリアに黒のデジモンがいても色条件を満たします。

localized.mainEffect:
このカードは紫でも色条件を満たせる。
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から3枚オープンする。その中の黄/紫のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードの1つ目の効果は、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 通常、色条件を満たすには、そのオプションカードと同じ色を持つ自分のデジモンかテイマーがエリアにいなければなりませんが、このカードはこの効果によって紫の自分のデジモンやテイマーがエリアにいる場合でも色条件を満たすことができます。

faqs.question: このカードは1つ目の効果によって、育成エリアに紫のデジモンがいても色条件を満たすのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、育成エリアに紫のデジモンがいても色条件を満たします。

Green also meets this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple or green Digimon card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: What does this card's 1st effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: To meet color requirements, normally you must have a Digimon or Tamer in your area that's the same color as the corresponding Option card. However, with this effect, this card's color requirements are met when you have a green Digimon or Tamer in the area.

faqs.question: Does this card's 1st effect mean that this card's color requirements are met even when I have a green Digimon in the breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, the color requirements are met when you have a green Digimon in the breeding area.

localized.mainEffect:
このカードは緑でも色条件を満たせる。

localized.name: Rasielmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Angel]/[Archangel] trait: Cost 3
＜Security A. +1＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, until their turn ends, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't activate [When Digivolving] effects or unsuspend.
[On Deletion] Place this card as the bottom security card. ⟨Rule⟩ Trait: Has [Three Great Angels].

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴に「天使型」/「大天使型」を持つLv.5:コスト3
≪Sアタック+1≫
【登場時】【進化時】相手のデジモン/テイマー1体をレストさせる。その後、相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン/テイマー1体の【進化時】効果は発揮せず、アクティブにならない。
【消滅時】このカードをセキュリティの下に置く。
〈ルール〉特徴:「三大天使」を持つ。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【進化時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
【進化時】効果が誘発した場合や「【進化時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【進化時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で発揮する場合であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードの【進化時】効果を、他の効果で発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、その効果は[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] If you have a blue Tamer, you may trash the top 3 cards of your deck to give this Digimon +2000 DP for the turn.
localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking] You may place 3 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order to activate ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

faqs.question: Do I always have to activate this card's effect when I attack?
faqs.answer: No. The effect is voluntary.

faqs.question: If I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck, can I activate this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's When Attacking effect to trash 6 cards from the top of my deck and give this card +4000 DP?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: I attack with this card and activate its When Attacking effect to get +2000 DP. I then unsuspend this card using a card effect and attack again. Can I use the When Attacking effect again to get an additional +2000 DP?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's inherited effect when I have 2 or less non-Digi-Egg cards in my trash?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: When using this card's inherited effect to return cards from my trash to the bottom of my deck, is my opponent allowed to check what cards I am returning to my deck?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cards in your trash are considered public information, so please let your opponent confirm which cards you're returning to your deck before you do so.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's inherited effect to return 3 non-Digi-Egg cards to the bottom of my deck but not activate <Draw 1>?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

localized.sourceEffect: 【アタック時】自分のトラッシュからデジタマカード以外のカード3枚を好きな順番でデッキの下に戻すことで、≪1ドロー≫（自分のデッキからカードを1枚引く）。

faqs.question: Can I use this card's effect if I have a Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name in my breeding area?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't check Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question: If I have two copies of this Tamer as well as one [Veedramon] in play in my battle area, can I active the effects of both Tamers?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If I have one [Veedramon] in play in my battle area, can I activate this card's effect to make a Digimon that doesn't have [Veedramon] in its name get +1000 DP?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: 八神太一（デジモンアドベンチャー Vテイマー01）

【メイン】名称に「ブイドラモン」を含む自分のデジモンがいるとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、以下の効果から1つを発揮する。

・このターンの間、自分のデジモン1体のDPを+1000する。

faqs.question: 【メイン】とはどのタイミングですか？
faqs.answer:
オプションカードのメイン効果のように、自分のターンのメインフェイズであれば好きなタイミングで発揮が可能です。
ただし、他の効果やアタックに割り込んで発揮することはできません。

faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 怨毒吸血魔兽
localized.mainEffect: 【消灭时】可以从我方的废弃区中,不支付费用登场1张等级不高于Lv.4的紫色数码宝贝卡牌。通过此效果登场的数码宝贝不发动【登场时】效果。

localized.name: A New World
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If you have [Mimi Tachikawa] in play, you may play a [Palmon] from your hand without paying its memory cost to return 1 of your [Mimi Tachikawa] cards to its owner's hand.

faqs.question: If I have a [Mimi Tachikawa] in play, can I use this card's effect to play a [Palmon] from my hand without paying its memory cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

sourceNotes: テイマー交流会2020年10月参加記念品

localized.name: 新たな世界
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】自分の「太刀川ミミ」がいるとき、自分の手札から、「パルモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場させることで、自分の「太刀川ミミ」1体を手札に戻す。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、自分の「太刀川ミミ」がいれば、手札の「パルモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場させることができるのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、その通りです。

localized.name: 새로운 세계
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 자신의 「이미나」가 있을 때, 자신의 패에서, 「팔몬」1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시키는 것으로, 자신의 「이미나」1명을 패로 되돌린다.

localized.name: 新世界
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】当我方场上存在“太刀川美美”时,可从我方的手牌中不支付费用登场1张“巴鲁兽”,并将我方的1张“太刀川美美”放回到手牌中。

localized.name: DNA Digivolution - Hearts United
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If you have [Davis Motomiya] and [Ken Ichijoji] in play, you may place 1 [ExVeemon] and 1 [Stingmon] from your hand at the bottom of your deck in any order to play 1 [Paildramon] from your hand without paying its memory cost.

faqs.question: If I only have either [ExVeemon] or [Stingmon] in my hand, can I use this card?
faqs.answer:
You can use this card, but unless you place both [ExVeemon] and [Stingmon] at the bottom of your deck from your hand, you can't use this card's effect to play a [Paildramon] from your hand without paying its memory cost.
You also can't use this card to place only [ExVeemon] or [ExVeemon] at the bottom of your deck from your hand.

sourceNotes: テイマー交流会2020年11月参加記念品

localized.name: ジョグレス進化 今、心をひとつに
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】自分の「本宮大輔」と「一乗寺賢」がいるとき、自分の手札の「エクスブイモン」と「スティングモン」1枚ずつを好きな順番でデッキの下に戻すことで、自分の手札から、「パイルドラモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場させる。

faqs.question: 自分の手札に「エクスブイモン」か「スティングモン」のどちらかしかないとき、このカードを使用できますか？
faqs.answer:
使用はできますが、自分の手札から「エクスブイモン」と「スティングモン」の両方を1枚ずつデッキの下に戻さない限り、自分の手札から、「パイルドラモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場させることはできません。
また、「エクスブイモン」か「スティングモン」どちらか1枚だけをデッキの下に戻すこともできません。

localized.name: 조그레스 진화 지금, 마음을 하나로
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 자신의 「최산해」와 「서정우」가 있을 때, 자신의 패의 「엑스브이몬」과 「스팅몬」 1장씩을 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로, 자신의 패에서, 「파일드라몬」 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다.

localized.name: 合步进化 现在,心将合二为一
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】当我方场上存在“本宫大辅”和“一乘寺贤”时,可将我方手牌中的1张“XV兽”和1张“飞虫兽”自选顺序放回到卡组最下方,并不支付费用从我方手牌中登场1张“机甲龙兽”。

localized.name: Patamon's Confession
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If you have [T.K. Takaishi] in play, place 1 of your [Patamon] at the bottom of your security stack face down. Trash that Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Can I use this card if I don't have a [Patamon] in play?
faqs.answer: You can, but you won't be able to place any cards at the bottom of your security stack.

sourceNotes: テイマー交流会2020年12月参加記念品

localized.name: パタモンの告白
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】自分の「高石タケル」がいるとき、自分の「パタモン」1体を自分のセキュリティの下に裏向きで置く。そのデジモンの進化元は破棄する。

faqs.question: 自分の「パタモン」がいないとき、このカードを使用できますか？
faqs.answer: 使用はできますが、セキュリティの下にカードを置くことはできません。

localized.name: 파닥몬의 고백
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 「리키」가 있을 때, 자신의 「파닥몬」 1마리를 자신의 시큐리티의 아래에 뒷면으로 놓는다. 그 디지몬의 진화원은 파기한다.

faqs.question: 자신의 「파닥몬」이 없을 때, 이 카드를 사용할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 사용은 가능합니다만, 시큐리티 밑에 카드를 놓지 못합니다.

localized.name: 巴达兽的告白
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】当我方场上存在“高石岳”时,将我方1只“巴达兽”正面朝下置于安防区最下方。丢弃该数码宝贝的所有进化源。

localized.name: Tai's Growing Up!
localized.mainEffect: [Main] If you have [Tai Kamiya] in play, you may place 1 of your [Agumon] cards at the bottom of its owner's deck to trigger ＜Draw 3＞. (Draw 3 cards from your deck.) Trash that Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Can I use this card and activate its effect if I have a [P-012 Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] in play?
faqs.answer: No. This card's effect requires you to have a card named [Tai Kamiya] in play. [Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] isn't an exact match, so it can't be used to meet this card's requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's effect to place a card that has [Agumon] in its name (like [ToyAgumon], [Agumon Expert], or [BushiAgumon]) at the bottom of my deck to <Draw 3>?
faqs.answer: No. The card name has to be [Agumon] for you to be able to place it at the bottom of your deck.

sourceNotes: テイマー交流会2021年1月参加記念品

localized.name: 太一、おっきくなったね
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】自分の「八神 太一」がいるとき、自分の「アグモン」1体をデッキの下に戻すことで、≪3ドロー≫（自分のデッキからカードを3枚引く）。そのデジモンの進化元は破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、「P-012 八神太一（デジモンアドベンチャー Vテイマー01）」がいるときに使用して効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードは名称が「八神太一」のカードでなければ条件を満たしませんので、「P-012 八神太一（デジモンアドベンチャー Vテイマー01）」では条件を満たすことはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果は、「トイアグモン」「アグモン博士」「ブシアグモン」などカード名に「アグモン」を含むカードをデッキの下に戻して≪3ドロー≫できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの効果は、名称が「アグモン」のカードのみ条件を満たします。「アグモン博士」や「トイアグモン」など、名称に「アグモン」を含んでいても一致していないカードをデッキの下に戻すことはできません。

localized.name: 태일아, 많이 컸구나
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 자신의 「신태일」이 있을 때, 자신의 「아구몬」 1마리를 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로, ≪3드로우≫ (자신의 덱에서 카드를 3장 드로우한다). 그 디지몬의 진화원은 파기한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 「P-012 신태일(V테이머)」이 있을 때에 사용하여 효과를 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드는 명칭이 「신태일」인 카드가 아니라면 조건을 만족하지 않음으로 「P-012 신태일(V테이머)」로는 조건을 만족하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과는 「토이아구몬」「아구몬 박사」「무사아구몬」 등, 카드명에 「아구몬」을 포함한 카드를 덱 아래로 되돌리는 것으로 ≪3드로우≫할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드의 효과는 명칭이 「아구몬」인 카드만이 조건을 만족합니다. 「아구몬 박사」나 「토이아구몬」 등, 명칭에 「아구몬」을 포함하고 있어도 일치하지 않는 카드를 덱 아래로 되돌릴 수 없습니다.

localized.name: Agunimon
localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] This Digimon can digivolve into an [AncientGreymon] in your hand for a memory cost of 2, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If it does, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] When digivolving this Digimon into an [AncientGreymon] in your hand, reduce its digivolution cost by 2.

faqs.question: After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon], I digivolve (or de-digivolve) it into another Digimon. Do I still have to delete it at the end of the turn?
faqs.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving or de-digivolving, so you still have to delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.

faqs.question:
After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon], I use [BT5-109 Mega Digimon Fusion!] to digivolve it into a level 7 Digimon.
At the end of the turn, which effect takes precedence: This card's "delete this Digimon at the end of the turn" effect, or [Mega Digimon Fusion!]'s "return the Digimon that digivolved with this effect to the bottom of its owner's deck" effect?
faqs.answer: They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

faqs.question: After using [BT3-109 Back for Revenge!] on this Digimon, I use this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon]. When this Digimon is deleted at the end of the turn, which Digimon does [Back for Revenge!]'s effect allow me to re-play to my battle area? This card, or [AncientGreymon]?
faqs.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving, so [AncientGreymon] is the Digimon re-played in your battle area.

localized.name: アグニモン
localized.mainEffect: 【アタック時】このデジモンを手札の「エンシェントグレイモン」に進化条件を無視して進化コスト2で進化できる。そうしたとき、このターン終了時、このデジモンは消滅する。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンが手札の「エンシェントグレイモン」に進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-2。

faqs.question: このデジモンが効果で「エンシェントグレイモン」に進化した後、別のデジモンに進化したり、または≪退化≫して別のデジモンになった場合、ターン終了時に消滅する効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 進化後、もしくは退化後のデジモンに効果を引き継ぐので、ターン終了時に消滅します。

faqs.question:
このデジモンが効果で「エンシェントグレイモン」に進化した後、「BT5-109 究極合体デジモンへの融合!」を使用してLv.7デジモンに進化しました。
ターン終了時、このカードの「このデジモンはこのターン終了時に消滅する」と、「BT5-109 究極合体デジモンへの融合!」の「このターン終了時、この効果で進化した自分のデジモンをデッキの下に戻す」の効果は、どちらか優先されますか？
faqs.answer: 同時タイミングの誘発となるため、好きな順で発揮できます。先に発揮したほうが優先されます。

faqs.question: このデジモンに「BT3-109 リターンマッチだ!」を使用した後、このデジモンの効果で「エンシェントグレイモン」に進化しました。ターン終了時にこのデジモンが消滅したとき、「BT3-109 リターンマッチだ!」の効果でバトルエリアに登場するのは、このカードと「エンシェントグレイモン」のどちらになりますか？
faqs.answer: 進化後のデジモンに効果を引き継ぐので、「エンシェントグレイモン」が登場します。

localized.name: 아그니몬
localized.mainEffect: 【어택 시】 이 디지몬은 진화조건을 무시하고 진화 코스트 2를 지불하여 패의 「에이션트그레이몬」으로 진화할 수 있다. 그렇게 했을 때 이 턴 종료시, 이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】 이 디지몬이 패의 「에이션트그레이몬」으로 진화할 때, 지불하는 진화 코스트를 -2 한다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 효과로 「에이션트그레이몬」으로 진화한 후에 다른 디지몬으로 진화했거나 ≪퇴화≫하여 다른 디지몬이 되었을 경우, 턴 종료 시에 소멸하는 효과는 어떻게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 진화 후, 혹은 퇴화 후의 디지몬에 효과를 인계하기 때문에 턴 종료 시에 소멸합니다.

faqs.question:
이 디지몬이 효과로 「에이션트그레이몬」으로 진화한 후에 「BT5-109 궁극합체 디지몬으로 융합!」을 사용하여 Lv. 7 디지몬으로 진화했습니다. 
턴 종료 시, 이 카드의 「이 턴 종료시, 이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다」와 「BT5-109 궁극합체 디지몬으로 융합!」의 「이 턴 종료 시, 이 효과로 진화한 자신의 디지몬을 덱 아래로 되돌린다」 효과 중 어느 쪽을 우선해야합니까?
faqs.answer: 동시 타이밍에 유발하기 때문에 임의의 순서대로 발휘됩니다. 먼저 발휘한 쪽이 우선됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬에 「BT3-109 리턴 매치다!」를 사용한 후에 이 디지몬의 효과로 「에이션트그레이몬」으로 진화했습니다. 턴 종료 시에 이 디지몬이 소멸했을 때, 「BT3-109 리턴 매치다!」의 효과로 배틀 에어리어에 등장하는 것은 이 카드와 「에이션트그레이몬」 중 어느 쪽입니까?
faqs.answer: 진화 후의 디지몬에 효과를 인계하기 때문에 「에이션트그레이몬」이 등장합니다.

faqs.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving, so [AncientGarurumon] is the Digimon re-played in your battle area.

localized.name: ヴォルフモン
localized.mainEffect: 【進化時】このデジモンを手札の「エンシェントガルルモン」に進化条件を無視して進化コスト1で進化できる。そうしたとき、このターン終了時、このデジモンは消滅する。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンが手札の「エンシェントガルルモン」に進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-2。

faqs.question: このデジモンが効果で「エンシェントガルルモン」に進化した後、別のデジモンに進化したり、または≪退化≫して別のデジモンになった場合、ターン終了時に消滅する効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 進化後、もしくは退化後のデジモンに効果を引き継ぐので、ターン終了時に消滅します。

faqs.question:
このデジモンが効果で「エンシェントガルルモン」に進化した後、「BT5-109 究極合体デジモンへの融合!」を使用してLv.7デジモンに進化しました。
ターン終了時、このカードの「このデジモンはこのターン終了時に消滅する」と、「BT5-109 究極合体デジモンへの融合!」の「このターン終了時、この効果で進化した自分のデジモンをデッキの下に戻す」の効果は、どちらか優先されますか？
faqs.answer: 同時タイミングの誘発となるため、好きな順で発揮できます。先に発揮したほうが優先されます。

faqs.question: このデジモンに「BT3-109 リターンマッチだ!」を使用した後、このデジモンの効果で「エンシェントガルルモン」に進化しました。ターン終了時にこのデジモンが消滅したとき、「BT3-109 リターンマッチだ!」の効果でバトルエリアに登場するのは、このカードと「エンシェントガルルモン」のどちらになりますか？
faqs.answer: 進化後のデジモンに効果を引き継ぐので、「エンシェントガルルモン」が登場します。

localized.name: 볼프몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화 시】 이 디지몬은 진화조건을 무시하고 진화 코스트 2를 지불하여 패의 「에이션트가루몬」으로 진화할 수 있다. 그렇게 했을 때 이 턴 종료시, 이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】 이 디지몬이 패의 「에이션트가루몬」으로 진화할 때, 지불하는 진화 코스트를 -2한다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 효과로 「에이션트가루몬」으로 진화한 후에 다른 디지몬으로 진화했거나 혹은 ≪퇴화≫하여 다른 디지몬이 되었을 경우, 턴 종료 시에 소멸하는 효과는 어떻게됩니까?
faqs.answer: 진화 후, 혹은 퇴화 후의 디지몬에 효과를 인계하기 때문에 턴 종료 시에 소멸합니다.

faqs.question:
이 디지몬이 효과로 「에이션트가루몬」으로 진화한 후에 「BT5-109 궁극합체 디지몬으로 융합!」을 사용하여 Lv. 7 디지몬으로 진화했습니다. 
턴 종료 시, 이 카드의 「이 턴 종료시, 이 디지몬을 소멸시킨다」와 「BT5-109 궁극합체 디지몬으로 융합!」의「이 턴 종료 시, 이 효과로 진화한 자신의 디지몬을 덱 아래로 되돌린다」 효과 중 어느 쪽을 우선해야합니까?
faqs.answer: 동시 타이밍에 유발하기 때문에 임의의 순서대로 발휘됩니다. 먼저 발휘한 쪽이 우선됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬에 「BT3-109 리턴 매치다!」를 사용한 후에 이 디지몬의 효과로 「에이션트가루몬」으로 진화했습니다. 턴 종료 시에 이 디지몬이 소멸했을 때, 「BT3-109 리턴 매치다!」의 효과로 배틀 에어리어에 등장하는 것은 이 카드와 「에이션트가루몬」 중 어느 쪽입니까?
faqs.answer: 진화 후의 디지몬에 효과를 인계하기 때문에 「에이션트가루몬」이 등장합니다.

localized.name: Gatomon
localized.mainEffect:
[Opponent's Turn] While you have a purple Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
[On Play] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, trigger ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)

faqs.question: I have this Digimon and 1 purple Digimon in play. My opponent's Digimon attacks, and its [When Attacking] effect deletes my purple Digimon. Can this Digimon now block the attack?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't.
If your purple Digimon was deleted by a [When Attacking] effect, then this Digimon won't have <Blocker> when reaction timing arrives, and won't be able to activate <Blocker> to block the attack.

localized.name: テイルモン
localized.mainEffect:
【相手のターン】紫の自分のデジモンがいる間、このデジモンは≪ブロッカー≫（相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、このデジモンがアクティブ状態ならレストさせることでアタックの対象をこのデジモンにする）を得る。
【登場時】自分のセキュリティが3枚以下のとき、≪リカバリー+1《デッキ》≫（自分のデッキの上からカードを1枚セキュリティの上に置く）。

faqs.question: 自分側にこのデジモンと紫のデジモンが1体ずついるとき、相手のデジモンがアタックし、【アタック時】効果によって紫のデジモンが消滅してしまいました。その場合、このデジモンはブロックを行えますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、行えません。
相手の【アタック時】効果で紫のデジモンが消滅したのであれば、ブロックタイミングの時点ではこのデジモンは≪ブロッカー≫を持っておらず、ブロックを行えません。

localized.name: 가트몬
localized.mainEffect:
【상대의 턴】 퍼플인 자신의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 디지몬은 《블록커》(상대의 디지몬이 어택했을 때, 이 디지몬이 액티브 상태라면 레스트 시키는 것으로 어택의 대상을 이 디지몬으로 한다)를 얻는다. 
【등장 시】 자신의 시큐리티가 3장 이하일 때, <리커버리 +1 《덱》>(자신의 덱 위에서부터 카드를 1장 시큐리티 위에 놓는다).

faqs.question: 자신 측에 이 디지몬과 퍼플인 디지몬이 1마리씩 있을 때 상대의 디지몬이 어택하고, 【어택 시】 효과에 의해 퍼플인 디지몬이 소멸해버렸습니다. 그 경우, 이 디지몬은 블록할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer:
아니요. 할 수 없습니다. 
상대의 【어택 시】 효과로 퍼플인 디지몬이 소멸한 경우에는 블록 타이밍의 시점으로는 이 디지몬은 ≪블로커≫를 갖고 있지 않아 블록할 수 없습니다.
