localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】 이 디지몬이 발휘한 《디지버스트》로 이 카드가 파기되었을 때, 이 턴 동안 자신의 디지몬 1마리는 《재밍》(이 디지몬은 시큐리티 디지몬과의 배틀에서는 소멸하지 않는다)을 얻는다.

localized.name: 팔몬
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】이 카드가 《디지버스트》로 파기되었을 때, 턴 종료까지 자신의 디지몬 1마리는 《재밍》(이 디지몬은 시큐리티 디지몬과의 배틀에서는 소멸하지 않는다)을 얻는다.

localized.name: 巴鲁兽
localized.sourceEffect: 【我方的回合】当此卡牌因此数码宝贝发动的《数码爆裂》效果而被丢弃时,本回合中,我方的1只数码宝贝获得《干扰》（此数码宝贝在与安防数码宝贝的战斗中不会被消灭）效果。

localized.name: Sunarizamon
localized.mainEffect: [Your Turn] All of your black Digimon with 13000 DP or more gain ＜Piercing＞. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is black and has 13000 DP or more, this Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

faqs.question: I have this Digimon in play, and attack with a black Digimon with 12000 DP, whose [When Attacking] effect grants itself +1000 DP, bringing its total DP up to 13000. Does this Digimon's effect allow that black Digimon to have <Piercing> during the battle?
faqs.answer: Yes. This Digimon's effect becomes active as soon as your black Digimon reaches 13000 DP or more. Your black Digimon will conduct its battle with <Piercing>.

faqs.question: I attack with a black Digimon with 12000 DP, whose [When Attacking] effect grants itself +1000 DP, bringing its total DP up to 13000. If this Digimon is in its digivolution cards, does this Digimon's inherited effect allow the black Digimon to have <Security Attack +1> during its battle?
faqs.answer: Yes. This Digimon's inherited effect becomes active as soon as your black Digimon reaches 13000 DP or more. Your black Digimon will conduct its battle with <Security Attack +1>.

faqs.question: This card is in the digivolution cards of a black Digimon with 13000 DP, which I use to attack my opponent. The first card flipped over during the security check causes the black Digimon to <De-Digivolve>, resulting in it having 12000 DP or less. Does the black Digimon still get extra security checks from <Security Attack +1>?
faqs.answer: This card's inherited effect is a [Your Turn] effect, so your black Digimon will lose <Security Attack +1> as soon as it drops below 13000 DP. If the Digimon has no other effects to increase the number of security checks, the attack will end without performing any further checks.

sourceNotes: 1周年記念プロモーションパック配布キャンペーン

localized.name: スナリザモン
localized.mainEffect: 【自分のターン】黒のDP13000以上の自分のデジモン全ては≪貫通≫（このデジモンがアタックしたバトルで相手のデジモンを消滅させたとき、アタック終了前にチェックする）を得る。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンが黒のDP13000以上の間、このデジモンは≪セキュリティアタック+1≫（このデジモンがチェックする枚数+1）を得る。

faqs.question: このデジモンがいるとき、DP12000の黒の自分のデジモンがアタックして、【アタック時】効果でDP+1000され、DP13000になりました。そのデジモンは、このカードの効果によって≪貫通≫を得た状態でバトルができますか？
faqs.answer: はい、この効果は自分の黒のデジモンがDP13000以上になった時点で発揮するので、≪貫通≫を得た状態でバトルができます。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つDP12000の黒のデジモンでアタックして、【アタック時】効果でDP+1000され、DP13000になりました。そのデジモンは、このカードの進化元効果によって≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を得た状態でバトルができますか？
faqs.answer: はい、この進化元効果はこのカードを進化元に持つ黒のデジモンがDP13000以上になった時点で発揮するので、≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を得た状態でバトルを行います。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つDP13000の黒のデジモンでプレイヤーにアタックして、最初にセキュリティからめくられたオプションカードによって≪退化≫の効果を受けてしまい、DP12000以下になってしまいました。このカードの進化元効果によって得た≪セキュリティアタック+1≫はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: このカードの進化元効果は【自分のターン】効果ですので、DP13000未満になった時点で効果は失われ、≪セキュリティアタック+1≫はなくなってしまいます。他にチェックする枚数を増やす効果がなければ、それ以上のチェックはできず、アタックは終了します。

localized.name: 샌드리자몬
localized.mainEffect: 【자신의 턴】 블랙인 DP 13000 이상의 자신의 디지몬 전부는 《관통》(이 디지몬이 어택한 배틀에서 상대의 디지몬만을 소멸시켰을 때, 이 디지몬은 시큐리티를 체크한다)을 얻는다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】 블랙인 DP 13000 이상인 동안, 이 디지몬은 《시큐리티 어택+1》(이 디지몬이 체크하는 시큐리티의 매수 +1)을 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 있을 때 DP 12000인 블랙인 자신의 디지몬이 어택하고, 【어택 시】 효과로 DP+1000되어 DP13000이 되었습니다. 그 디지몬은 이 카드의 효과에 의해 ≪관통≫을 얻은 상태로 배틀을 할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이 효과는 자신의 블랙인 디지몬이 DP13000 이상이 된 시점에 발휘하기 때문에 ≪관통≫을 얻은 상태로 배틀합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 진화원에 가진 DP12000인 블랙인 디지몬으로 어택하고, 【어택 시】 효과로 DP+1000되어 DP13000이 되었습니다. 그 디지몬은 이 카드의 진화원 효과에 의해 ≪시큐리티 어택 +1≫을 얻은 상태로 배틀할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이 진화원 효과는 이 카드를 진화원을 가진 블랙인 디지몬이 DP13000 이상이 되었을 시점에 발휘하기 때문에 ≪시큐리티 어택 +1≫을 얻은 상태로 배틀을 실행합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 진화원으로 가진 DP 13000의 블랙인 디지몬으로 플레이어에게 어택하고, 처음 시큐리티에서 뒤집힌 옵션 카드에 의해 ≪퇴화≫ 효과를 받아 DP 12000 이하가 되었습니다. 이 카드의 진화원 효과에 의해 얻은 ≪시큐리티 어택 +1≫은 어떻게됩니까?
faqs.answer: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 【자신의 턴】 효과이므로 DP13000 미만이 되었을 시점에 효과는 잃고 ≪시큐리티 어택 +1≫은 없어집니다. 다른 체크할 장수를 늘린다는 효과가 없다면 그 이상의 체크는 불가능하고 어택은 종료됩니다.

localized.mainEffect: 【我方的回合】我方所有DP13000或更高的黑色数码宝贝获得《贯通》（当此数码宝贝进行攻击的战斗中仅有对方的数码宝贝被消灭时,此数码宝贝将判定安防卡牌）效果。
localized.sourceEffect: 【我方的回合】此数码宝贝为黑色且DP13000或更高的期间,此数码宝贝获得《安防攻击+1》（此数码宝贝判定安防卡牌的张数+1）效果。

localized.mainEffect: 【我方的回合】我方所有DP13000或更高的黑色数码宝贝获得《贯通》（当此数码宝贝进行攻击的战斗中仅有对方的数码宝贝被消灭时,在攻击结束前进行判定）效果。

localized.name: DemiDevimon
localized.sourceEffect: [On Deletion] If you have 7 or more Digimon cards with [Devimon] in their names in your trash, you may play 1 [DanDevimon] from your trash without paying its memory cost.

faqs.question: I have 6 cards with [Devimon] in their names in my trash. If a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted, can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to play a [DanDevimon] from my trash without paying its memory cost?
faqs.answer: Yes. This card moving to your trash will cause you to have 7 Digimon cards with [Devimon] in their names in your trash. As such, you will be able to activate this card's [On Deletion] effect to play a [DanDevimon] from your trash.

sourceNotes: 1周年記念プロモーションパック配布キャンペーン

localized.name: ピコデビモン
localized.sourceEffect: 【消滅時】自分のトラッシュに名称に「デビモン」を含むデジモンカードが7枚以上あるとき、自分のトラッシュから、「ダンデビモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できる。

faqs.question: 自分のトラッシュに名称に「デビモン」を含むデジモンカードが6枚あるとき、このカードを進化元に持つデジモンが消滅したら、このカードの【消滅時】効果で自分のトラッシュから、「ダンデビモン」1枚をコストを支払わずに登場できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、このカードがトラッシュに移動することで、自分のトラッシュに名称に「デビモン」を含むデジモンカードが7枚になるので、このカードの【消滅時】効果で「ダンデビモン」を登場させることができます。

sourceNotes: 부스터 팩 그레이트 레전드 [BTK-04] 박스 프로모카드

localized.name: 피코데블몬
localized.sourceEffect: 【소멸 시】 자신의 트래시에 명칭에 「데블몬」을 포함하는 디지몬 카드가 7장 이상 있을 경우, 자신의 트래시에서 「단데블몬」 1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 자신의 트래시에 명칭에 「데블몬」을 포함한 디지몬카드가 6장 있을 때, 이 카드를 진화원을 가진 디지몬이 소멸했다면, 이 카드의 【소멸 시】 효과로 자신의 트래시에서 「단데블몬」1장을 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이 카드가 트래시에 이동하는 것으로 자신의 트래시에 명칭에 「데블몬」을 포함한 디지몬카드가 7장이 되었으므로 이 카드의 【소멸 시】 효과로 「단데블몬」을 등장시킬 수 있습니다.

【消灭时】当我方废弃区中有7张或更多名称中包含“恶魔兽”的数码宝贝卡牌时,可以从我方的废弃区中不支付费用登场1张“但丁恶魔兽”。

localized.name: Red Memory Boost!
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 red Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I use a red Option card even if I have no other red Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer: No. Having this card in your battle area doesn't fulfill color requirements.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I activate this card's <Delay> effect even if I have no other red Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if this card is in your battle area, you can activate <Delay>, regardless of color requirements.
Color requirements only matter when using Option cards.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ デュークモン [ST-7]、スタートデッキ アルフォースブイドラモン [ST-8]

localized.name: レッド・メモリーブースト!!
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の赤のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に赤のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、赤のオプションカードは使用できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードがバトルエリアにあっても、色条件は満たしません。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に赤のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、このカードの≪ディレイ≫は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、すでにバトルエリアにこのカードが置かれている場合は、色条件に関係なく≪ディレイ≫を発揮できます。色条件は、手札からオプションカードを使用するときだけ必要です。

localized.name: 레드・메모리 부스트!!
localized.mainEffect:
【메인】 자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 레드인 디지몬 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 남은 카드는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다.
【메인】≪딜레이≫(배틀 에어리어에 있는 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 이하의 효과를 발휘한다. 이 효과는 이 카드를 놓은 턴에는 발휘할 수 없다)
・메모리를 +2 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 레드인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 레드인 옵션 카드는 사용할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 있더라도, 색조건은 만족하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 레드인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 이 카드의 ≪딜레이≫는 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이미 배틀 에어리어에 이 카드가 놓여 있을 경우에는 색조건과 관계 없이 ≪딜레이≫가 발휘됩니다. 색조건은 패에서 옵션 카드를 사용할 때에만 필요합니다.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I activate this card's <Delay> effect even if I have no other blue Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if this card is in your battle area, you can activate <Delay>, regardless of color requirements.
Color requirements only matter when using Option cards.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ デュークモン [ST-7]、スタートデッキ アルフォースブイドラモン [ST-8]

localized.name: ブルー・メモリーブースト!!
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の青のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に青のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、青のオプションカードは使用できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードがバトルエリアにあっても、色条件は満たしません。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に青のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、このカードの≪ディレイ≫は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、すでにバトルエリアにこのカードが置かれている場合は、色条件に関係なく≪ディレイ≫を発揮できます。色条件は、手札からオプションカードを使用するときだけ必要です。

localized.name: 블루・메모리 부스트!!
localized.mainEffect:
【메인】 자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 블루인 디지몬 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 남은 카드는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다.
【메인】≪딜레이≫(배틀 에어리어에 있는 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 이하의 효과를 발휘한다. 이 효과는 이 카드를 놓은 턴에는 발휘할 수 없다)
・메모리를 +2 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 블루인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 블루인 옵션 카드는 사용할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 있더라도, 색조건은 만족하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 블루인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 이 카드의 ≪딜레이≫는 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이미 배틀 에어리어에 이 카드가 놓여 있을 경우에는 색조건과 관계 없이 ≪딜레이≫가 발휘됩니다. 색조건은 패에서 옵션 카드를 사용할 때에만 필요합니다.

sourceNotes:
Starter Deck GALLANTMON [ST-7]
Starter Deck ULFORCEVEEDRAMON [ST-8]

localized.name: Yellow Memory Boost!
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I use a yellow Option card even if I have no other yellow Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer: No. Having this card in your battle area doesn't fulfill color requirements.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I activate this card's <Delay> effect even if I have no other yellow Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if this card is in your battle area, you can activate <Delay>, regardless of color requirements.
Color requirements only matter when using Option cards.

localized.name: イエロー・メモリーブースト!!
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の黄のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に黄のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、黄のオプションカードは使用できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードがバトルエリアにあっても、色条件は満たしません。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に黄のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、このカードの≪ディレイ≫は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、すでにバトルエリアにこのカードが置かれている場合は、色条件に関係なく≪ディレイ≫を発揮できます。色条件は、手札からオプションカードを使用するときだけ必要です。

localized.name: 옐로・메모리 부스트!!
localized.mainEffect:
【메인】 자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 옐로인 디지몬 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 남은 카드는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다.
【메인】≪딜레이≫(배틀 에어리어에 있는 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 이하의 효과를 발휘한다. 이 효과는 이 카드를 놓은 턴에는 발휘할 수 없다)
・메모리를 +2 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 옐로인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 옐로인 옵션 카드는 사용할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 있더라도, 색조건은 만족하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 옐로인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 이 카드의 ≪딜레이≫는 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이미 배틀 에어리어에 이 카드가 놓여 있을 경우에는 색조건과 관계 없이 ≪딜레이≫가 발휘됩니다. 색조건은 패에서 옵션 카드를 사용할 때에만 필요합니다.

sourceNotes:
Starter Deck GALLANTMON [ST-7]
Starter Deck ULFORCEVEEDRAMON [ST-8]

localized.name: Green Memory Boost!
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 green Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I use a green Option card even if I have no other green Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer: No. Having this card in your battle area doesn't fulfill color requirements.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I activate this card's <Delay> effect even if I have no other green Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if this card is in your battle area, you can activate <Delay>, regardless of color requirements.
Color requirements only matter when using Option cards.

localized.name: グリーン・メモリーブースト!!
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の緑のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に緑のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、緑のオプションカードは使用できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードがバトルエリアにあっても、色条件は満たしません。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に緑のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、このカードの≪ディレイ≫は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、すでにバトルエリアにこのカードが置かれている場合は、色条件に関係なく≪ディレイ≫を発揮できます。色条件は、手札からオプションカードを使用するときだけ必要です。

localized.name: Black Memory Boost!
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 black Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
・Gain 2 memory.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I use a black Option card even if I have no other black Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer: No. Having this card in your battle area doesn't fulfill color requirements.

faqs.question: When I place this card in my battle area, can I activate this card's <Delay> effect even if I have no other black Digimon or Tamers in play?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if this card is in your battle area, you can activate <Delay>, regardless of color requirements.
Color requirements only matter when using Option cards.

【メイン】自分のデッキの上から4枚オープンする。その中の紫のデジモンカード1枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・メモリー+2。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に紫のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、紫のオプションカードは使用できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードがバトルエリアにあっても、色条件は満たしません。

faqs.question: このカードがバトルエリアに置かれているとき、他に紫のデジモンやテイマーがいなくても、このカードの≪ディレイ≫は発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、すでにバトルエリアにこのカードが置かれている場合は、色条件に関係なく≪ディレイ≫を発揮できます。色条件は、手札からオプションカードを使用するときだけ必要です。

localized.name: 퍼플・메모리 부스트!!
localized.mainEffect:
【메인】 자신의 덱 위에서부터 4장 오픈한다. 그중 퍼플인 디지몬 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 남은 카드는 원하는 순서대로 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다.
【메인】≪딜레이≫(배틀 에어리어에 있는 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 이하의 효과를 발휘한다. 이 효과는 이 카드를 놓은 턴에는 발휘할 수 없다)
・메모리를 +2 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 퍼플인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 퍼플인 옵션 카드는 사용할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 있더라도, 색조건은 만족하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 배틀 에어리어에 놓여 있을 때 다른 퍼플인 디지몬과 테이머가 없더라도 이 카드의 ≪딜레이≫는 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 이미 배틀 에어리어에 이 카드가 놓여 있을 경우에는 색조건과 관계 없이 ≪딜레이≫가 발휘됩니다. 색조건은 패에서 옵션 카드를 사용할 때에만 필요합니다.

Yes, you can. 
You can choose to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and it is possible to choose an opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less as the target.

localized.name: MetalGreymon: Alterous Mode
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] 0 from [MetalGreymon]
The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon].
[When Digivolving] If you have a Tamer in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [MetalGreymon].
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] When this Digimon has [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name and an effect would delete it or return it to your hand or deck, you may trash 2 cards of the same level in this Digimon's digivolution cards to prevent it from leaving play.

faqs.question: Do I trash 2 cards of the same level as this card for "you may trash 2 cards of the same level" in this Digimon's inherited effect?
faqs.answer:
No. You trash 2 cards of the same level as each other from among this Digimon's digivolution cards. 
For example, by trashing 2 level 5 cards in digivolution cards, this Digimon won't be deleted or returned to hands/decks.

faqs.question:
What does this card's ⟨Rule⟩ mean, exactly? 
(*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon]" has been changed to " ⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [MetalGreymon].")Aug. 1, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [MetalGreymon] name.

localized.name: メタルグレイモン:アルタラウスモード
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「メタルグレイモン」から0

【進化時】自分のテイマーがいるとき、DP5000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。
〈ルール〉名称:「メタルグレイモン」としても扱う。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】名称に「グレイモン」か「オメガモン」を含むこのデジモンが効果で消滅するときか、手札、デッキに戻るとき、このデジモンの進化元から、Lv.の同じカード2枚を破棄することで、消滅せず、手札、デッキに戻らない。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果の「Lv.の同じカード2枚を破棄することで」は、このカードと同じLv.のカード2枚を破棄するのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、このカードと同じLv.ではなく、進化元にあるカードの中から、同一のLv.のカード2枚を破棄します。
例えば、進化元からLv.5のカードを2枚破棄することで、このデジモンは消滅せず、手札・デッキに戻らなくなります。

faqs.question:
このカードの〈ルール〉は、どういった固有のルールですか？
(※このカードの「このカード/デジモンの名称は「メタルグレイモン」としても扱う。」は、「〈ルール〉名称:「メタルグレイモン」としても扱う。」に変更されました)2024/08/01 更新
faqs.answer: このカードは、常に名称「メタルグレイモン」としても扱う固有のルールです。

localized.name: 메탈그레이몬: 알타라우스 모드
localized.mainEffect:
【진화】 「메탈그레이몬」에서 0
 【진화 시】자신의 테이머가 있을 때, DP 5000 이하의 상대 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.
〈룰〉 명칭: 「메탈그레이몬」으로도 취급한다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】명칭에 「그레이몬」 또는 「오메가몬」을 포함하는 이 디지몬이 상대의 효과로 소멸하거나, 패 및 덱으로 돌아갈 때, 이 디지몬의 진화원에서 Lv.이 같은 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로, 소멸하지 않고, 패 및 덱으로 돌아가지 않는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과의 「Lv.이 같은 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로」는 이 카드와 같은 Lv.의 카드 2장을 파기하는 것인가요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 이 카드와 같은 Lv.이 아닌 진화원에 있는 카드 중 동일한 Lv.의 카드 2장을 파기합니다.
예를 들어 진화원에서 Lv.5의 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로 패, 덱으로 되돌아가지 않게 됩니다.

faqs.question:
이 카드의 <룰>은 어떤 고유한 룰인가요?
(※이 카드의 「이 카드/디지몬의 명칭은 「메탈그레이몬」으로도 취급한다.」는 「〈룰〉명칭 : 「메탈그레이몬」으로도 취급한다.」로 변경되었습니다)
faqs.answer: 이 카드는 항상 명칭 「메탈그레이몬」으로도 취급하는 고유의 룰입니다.

localized.name: WereGarurumon: Sagittarius Mode
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] 0 from [WereGarurumon]
The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [WereGarurumon].
[When Digivolving] If you have a Tamer in play, return 2 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to their owners' hands.
⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [WereGarurumon].
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] When this Digimon has [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name and would be deleted in battle, you may trash 2 cards of the same level in this Digimon's digivolution cards to prevent that deletion.

faqs.question: Do I trash 2 cards of the same level as this card for "you may trash 2 cards of the same level" in this Digimon's inherited effect?
faqs.answer:
No. You trash 2 cards of the same level as each other from among this Digimon's digivolution cards. 
For example, by trashing 2 level 5 cards in digivolution cards, this Digimon won't be deleted.

faqs.question:
What does this card's ⟨Rule⟩ mean, exactly? 
(*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [WereGarurumon]" has been changed to " ⟨Rule⟩ Name: Also treated as [WereGarurumon].")Aug. 1, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has [WereGarurumon] in its name.

localized.name: ワーガルルモン:サジタリウスモード
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ワーガルルモン」から0

【進化時】自分のテイマーがいるとき、Lv.3の相手のデジモン2体を手札に戻す。
〈ルール〉名称:「ワーガルルモン」としても扱う。
localized.sourceEffect: 【お互いのターン】名称に「ガルルモン」か「オメガモン」を含むこのデジモンがバトルで消滅するとき、このデジモンの進化元から、Lv.の同じカード2枚を破棄することで、消滅しない。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果の「Lv.の同じカード2枚を破棄することで」は、このカードと同じLv.のカード2枚を破棄するのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、このカードと同じLv.ではなく、進化元にあるカードの中から、同一のLv.のカード2枚を破棄します。
例えば、このカードの進化元からLv.5のカードを2枚破棄することで、このデジモンは消滅しません。

faqs.question:
このカードの〈ルール〉は、どういった固有のルールですか？
(※このカードの「このカード/デジモンの名称は「ワーガルルモン」としても扱う。」は、「〈ルール〉名称:「ワーガルルモン」しても扱う。」に変更されました)2024/08/01 更新
faqs.answer: このカードは、常に名称「ワーガルルモン」としても扱う固有のルールです。

localized.name: 워가루몬: 사지타리우스 모드

localized.sourceEffect: 【서로의 턴】명칭에 「가루몬」 또는 「오메가몬」을 포함하는 이 디지몬이 배틀에서 소멸할 때, 이 디지몬의 진화원에서 Lv.이 같은 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로, 소멸하지 않는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과의 「Lv.이 같은 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로」는 이 카드와 같은 Lv.의 카드 2장을 파기하는 것인가요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 이 카드와 같은 Lv.이 아닌 진화원에 있는 카드 중 동일한 Lv.의 카드 2장을 파기합니다.
예를 들어 진화원에서 Lv.5의 카드 2장을 파기하는 것으로 패, 덱으로 되돌아가지 않게 됩니다.

faqs.question:
이 카드의 <룰>은 어떤 고유한 룰인가요?
(※이 카드의 「이 카드/디지몬의 명칭은 「워가루몬」으로도 취급한다.」는 「〈룰〉명칭 : 「워가루몬」으로도 취급한다.」로 변경되었습니다)
faqs.answer: 이 카드는 항상 명칭 「워가루몬」으로도 취급하는 고유의 룰입니다.

localized.name: Boutmon
localized.mainEffect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with [Shaman] or [Wizard] in its traits, you may trash up to 3 cards from the top of your security stack. For each security card trashed by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have 3 security cards, unsuspend this Digimon.

faqs.question: I used [BT14-093 Emissary of Hope] to digivolve this Digimon into a card with the [Shaman] or [Wizard] trait in my security stack. In such cases, can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to trash cards from my security stack?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
The period starting from the use of [BT14-093 Emissary of Hope] until the digivolution is complete and you shuffle your security stack is considered checking your security stack, so it isn't affected by other cards' effects. Therefore, you can't use this card's effect to trash cards from your security stack.

faqs.question: 「BT14-093 希望の使者」を使用して、このデジモンからセキュリティの特徴に「神人型」か「魔人型」を持つカードに進化させることにしました。この場合、このカードの【自分のターン】効果で、セキュリティを破棄することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「BT14-093 希望の使者」は、使用してから進化が完了し、セキュリティをシャッフルして置くまでは、セキュリティを確認している状態とみなして、他のカードの効果を受けません。そのため、このカードの効果でセキュリティを破棄することはできません。

faqs.question: 「BT14-093 희망의 사자」를 사용하여 이 디지몬을 자신의 시큐리티에서 특징으로 「신인형」 또는 「마인형」을 가진 카드로 진화시켰습니다. 이 경우, 이 카드의 【자신의 턴】 효과로 시큐리티를 파기할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 불가능합니다.
「BT14-093 희망의 사자」는 사용으로부터 진화가 완료되고, 시큐리티를 셔플하여 놓을 때까지는 시큐리티를 확인하고 있는 상태로 취급하기 때문에 다른 카드의 효과를 받지 않습니다. 따라서 이 카드의 효과로 시큐리티를 파기할 수 없습니다.

localized.name: Pause Plug-In P
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a Tamer, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP and that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects don't activate.

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

localized.name: 無効化プラグインP
localized.mainEffect:
自分のテイマーがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視して使用できる。
【メイン】次の相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-6000し、そのデジモンの【進化時】効果は発揮しない。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
カードの持つ【進化時】効果が発揮しなくなる効果です。
【進化時】効果が誘発した場合や「【進化時】効果を発揮する」効果などで、【進化時】効果を発揮させることができなくなります。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードでアタックしました。
このとき、そのカードの【進化時】【アタック時】効果を発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮させることができます。
【アタック時】で発揮する場合であれば、発揮させることができます。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されているカードの【進化時】効果を、他の効果で発揮させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードは、【進化時】効果の「ことで」の条件だけを処理することはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、できません。

faqs.question:
「【進化時】効果は発揮しない」を付与されたカードが、【進化時】【アタック時】[ターンに1回]を持つカードに進化しました。
このとき、そのカードに進化したタイミングではその効果は発揮できませんでしたが、その効果の[ターンにX回]は消費しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、消費しません。
進化したタイミングでは【進化時】効果の発揮ができないため、その効果は[ターンにX回]は消費していません。

localized.name: ズバモン
localized.mainEffect: 【登場時】このデジモンを他の自分のデジモン1体の進化元の下に置くことで、自分のデッキの上から3枚オープンする。オープンしたカードを好きな順番でデッキの上か下だけに戻す。その後、特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ自分のデジモンがいるなら、メモリー+2。

localized.name: 즈바몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】이 디지몬을 다른 자신의 디지몬 1마리의 진화원 아래에 놓는 것으로, 자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 오픈한 카드를 원하는 순서대로 덱 위 또는 아래로만 되돌린다. 그 후, 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 자신의 디지몬이 있다면 메모리 +2.
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가지거나 블랙인 자신의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 디지몬은 《돌진》을 얻는다.

localized.name: 兹巴兽
localized.mainEffect: 【登场时】可将此数码宝贝置于我方另1只数码宝贝的进化源最下方,并翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。翻开的卡牌可自选顺序仅放回到卡组最上方或最下方。此后,若我方场上存在拥有“Legend-Arms”特征的数码宝贝,则内存值+2。

faqs.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate if 1 of my Digimon is played by a DigiXros?
faqs.answer:
No. DigiXros itself is not an effect, so the effect doesn't activate for a card played by a DigiXros as a main phase action. 
The effect will activate if a DigiXros is performed when a Digimon is played by an effect.

faqs.question: When my Digimon is affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, is deletion prevented when it loses in battles against my opponent's Security Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, it prevents that deletion.

sourceNotes: リミテッドカードセット2023

localized.name: シードラモン
localized.mainEffect: 【登場時】【進化時】次の相手のターン終了まで、青の自分のデジモン1体はバトルでは消滅しない。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］他の自分のデジモンが効果で登場したとき、このターンの間、青の自分のデジモン1体は≪速攻≫を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、自分のデジモンがデジクロスして登場した場合も発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、デジクロス自体は効果ではないので、メインフェイズのアクションとして登場した場合にデジクロスしたとしても発揮しません。
効果でデジモンが登場するときにデジクロスした場合には、発揮できます。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、効果を受けた自分のデジモンが相手のセキュリティデジモンとのバトルで敗北しても、消滅しなくなりますか？
faqs.answer: はい、消滅しなくなります。

localized.name: 시드라몬

localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】［턴에 1회］다른 자신의 디지몬이 효과로 등장했을 때, 이 턴 동안 블루인 자신의 디지몬 1마리는 《속공》을 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 자신의 디지몬이 디지크로스하여 등장했을 경우에도 발휘되나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 디지크로스 자체는 효과가 아니므로 메인 페이즈의 액션으로서 등장한 경우에는 디지크로스하였어도 발휘되지 않습니다.
효과로 디지몬이 등장할 때, 디지크로스했다면 발휘됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】【진화 시】 효과는 효과를 받지 않는 자신의 디지믄이 상대의 시큐리티 디지몬과의 배틀에서 패배하여도 소멸하지 않게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 소멸하지 않게 됩니다.

localized.name: Offense Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 red card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a red Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: 오펜스・트레이닝
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 덱 위에서부터 2장 오픈한다. 그중 레드인 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【메인】《딜레이》(놓인 다음 턴 이후에 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 효과를 발휘한다) ・자신의 디지몬 1마리를 패의 레드인 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -2 하여 진화시킬 수 있다.

faqs.answer: 아니요, 이 카드의 《딜레이》의 효과로는 진화 조건을 무시할 수 없으므로 진화 조건에 맞는 카드로만 진화할 수 있습니다.

localized.name: Mental Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 blue card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a blue Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？2023/07/28 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果を発揮して、進化しないということはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 테이머에서 「자신의 테이머를 디지몬으로서 취급하여 진화할 수 있다」의 효과를 가진 디지몬 카드로 진화할 수 있나요?

【主要】翻开我方卡组最上方的2张卡牌。将其中的1张蓝色卡牌加入手牌。剩余的卡牌放回到卡组最下方。此后,将此卡牌置于战斗区。

【主要】《延迟》

・可以将我方1只数码宝贝以需支付的进化费用-2进化成手牌中的蓝色数码宝贝卡牌。

localized.name: Physical Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a yellow Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

sourceNotes: リミテッドカードセット2023

localized.name: フィジカル・トレーニング
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から2枚オープンする。その中の黄のカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・自分のデジモン1体を手札の黄のデジモンカードに進化コストを支払って進化できる。この効果で進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-2。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？2023/07/28 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果を発揮して、進化しないということはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 피지컬・트레이닝
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 덱 위에서부터 2장 오픈한다. 그중 옐로인 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【메인】《딜레이》(놓인 다음 턴 이후에 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 효과를 발휘한다) ・자신의 디지몬 1마리를 패의 옐로인 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -2 하여 진화시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 패의 카드로 진화할 때, 진화 조건에 관계 없이 진화시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이 카드의 《딜레이》의 효과로는 진화 조건을 무시할 수 없으므로 진화 조건에 맞는 카드로만 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 패의 카드로 버스트 진화, 조그레스 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 버스트 진화, 조그레스 진화는 할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 테이머에서 「자신의 테이머를 디지몬으로서 취급하여 진화할 수 있다」의 효과를 가진 디지몬 카드로 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 불가능합니다.
이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과는 자신의 디지몬 1마리를 진화시키는 효과이므로 테이머를 진화시킬 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과를 발휘하고, 진화시키지 않아도 되나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

localized.name: Agility Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 green card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a green Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

sourceNotes: リミテッドカードセット2023

localized.name: アジリティ・トレーニング
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から2枚オープンする。その中の緑のカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・自分のデジモン1体を手札の緑のデジモンカードに進化コストを支払って進化できる。この効果で進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-2。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？2023/07/28 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果を発揮して、進化しないということはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: Defense Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 black card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a black Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

sourceNotes: リミテッドカードセット2023

localized.name: ディフェンス・トレーニング
localized.mainEffect:
【メイン】自分のデッキの上から2枚オープンする。その中の黒のカード1枚を手札に加える。残りは好きな順番でデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫（置いた次のターン以降にこのカードを破棄することで、効果を発揮する）
・自分のデジモン1体を手札の黒のデジモンカードに進化コストを支払って進化できる。この効果で進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-2。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？2023/07/28 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果を発揮して、進化しないということはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

【メイン】自分のデッキの上から2枚オープンする。その中の黒のカード1枚を手札に加える。残りはデッキの下に戻す。その後、このカードをバトルエリアに置く。
【メイン】≪ディレイ≫
・自分のデジモン1体を手札の黒のデジモンカードに支払う進化コスト-2で進化できる。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で手札のカードに進化するとき、進化条件に関係なく進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果では進化条件は無視できないので、進化条件が合致するカードにのみ進化できます。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、手札のカードにバースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできますか？2023/07/28 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、バースト進化、ジョグレス進化はできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果で、テイマーから「自分のテイマーをデジモンとして扱い、進化できる」効果を持つデジモンカードに進化することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果は、自分のデジモン1体を進化させる効果なので、テイマーを進化させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの≪ディレイ≫の効果を発揮して、進化しないということはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

localized.name: 디펜스・트레이닝
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】자신의 덱 위에서부터 2장 오픈한다. 그중 블랙인 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다. 그 후, 이 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 놓는다. 【메인】《딜레이》(놓인 다음 턴 이후에 이 카드를 파기하는 것으로, 효과를 발휘한다) ・자신의 디지몬 1마리를 패의 블랙인 디지몬 카드로 지불하는 진화 코스트 -2 하여 진화시킬 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 패의 카드로 진화할 때, 진화 조건에 관계 없이 진화시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이 카드의 《딜레이》의 효과로는 진화 조건을 무시할 수 없으므로 진화 조건에 맞는 카드로만 진화할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 패의 카드로 버스트 진화, 조그레스 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 버스트 진화, 조그레스 진화는 할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과로 테이머에서 「자신의 테이머를 디지몬으로서 취급하여 진화할 수 있다」의 효과를 가진 디지몬 카드로 진화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 불가능합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 《딜레이》 효과를 발휘하고, 진화시키지 않아도 되나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

localized.name: Wisdom Training
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a purple Digimon card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

faqs.question: When I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve into a card in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's <Delay> effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to burst digivolve or DNA digivolve into a card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't burst digivolve or DNA digivolve.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve a Tamer into a Digimon card with a "your Tamer is treated as a Digimon and can digivolve" effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's <Delay> effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's <Delay> effect but choose to not digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: I have 10 or more cards in my trash. Can I use this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve my [Impmon] into [BT2-111 Beelzemon] in my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: 나이트몬

localized.name: 骑士兽

《阻挡者》

localized.name: Morphomon
localized.mainEffect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Eosmon] and 1 [Menoa Bellucci] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, by placing this Digimon as 1 of your [Eosmon]'s bottom digivolution card, you may play 1 [Menoa Bellucci] from your hand without paying the cost.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When another [Eosmon] is played, this Digimon may digivolve into 1 [Eosmon] in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.

faqs.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck with this card's [On Play] effect don't contain both [Eosmon] and [Menoa Bellucci], do I still get to add a card to my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can add just 1 card to your hand when only 1 or the other is revealed.

faqs.question: When the cards revealed from my deck with this card's [On Play] effect contain both [Eosmon] and [Menoa Bellucci], am I allowed to add just one card to my hand?
faqs.answer: No, you can't. You must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

faqs.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve into [Eosmon] in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
faqs.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

localized.name: モルフォモン

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、デッキからオープンしたカードの中に、「エオスモン」と「メノア・ベルッチ」のどちらかしかなかった場合、そのカード1枚だけを手札に加えられますか？

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、デッキからオープンしたカードの中に、「エオスモン」と「メノア・ベルッチ」の両方があったときに、そのどちらか1枚だけを手札に加えて、残りのカードをデッキの下に戻すことはできますか？

faqs.question: What's a token?
faqs.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. You can use this card's effect to play a token that is treated as a Digimon card with the name [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

localized.name: 추추몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 그 중 그린/블루를 포함하는 2색 이상의 카드 1장과 명칭에 「서정우」를 포함하는 테이머 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다.

localized.name: 虫虫兽
localized.mainEffect: 【登场时】翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。将其中1张颜色为2种或更多且包含绿色/蓝色的卡牌和1张名称中包含“一乘寺贤”的驯兽师卡牌加入手牌。剩余的卡牌放回到卡组最下方。

localized.name: Hawkmon
localized.mainEffect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 red or yellow card with 2 or more colors and 1 Tamer card with [Yolei Inoue] in its name among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
localized.sourceEffect: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand.

faqs.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either a red or yellow card with 2 or more colors or a Tamer card with [Yolei Inoue] in its name, can I only add 1 card to my hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

faqs.question: Does "red or yellow card with 2 or more colors" in this card's [On Play] effect mean that I can add a red/yellow or yellow/red card to my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a red or yellow card with 2 or more colors and a Tamer card with [Yolei Inoue] in its name, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
faqs.answer: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、デッキからオープンしたカードの中に、黒/黄を含む2色以上のカードと名称に「火田伊織」を含むテイマーカードの両方があったときに、そのどちらか1枚だけを手札に加えて、残りのカードをデッキの下に戻すことはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、この効果は対象となるカードがあるのであれば、可能な限り手札に加えます。

localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】자신의 덱 위에서부터 3장 오픈한다. 그중 블랙/옐로를 포함하는 2색 이상의 카드 1장과 명칭에 「이재하」를 포함하는 테이머 카드 1장을 패에 추가한다. 나머지는 덱 아래로 되돌린다.

localized.mainEffect: 【登场时】翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。将其中1张颜色为2种或更多且包含黑色/黄色的卡牌和1张名称中包含“火田伊织”的驯兽师卡牌加入手牌。剩余的卡牌放回到卡组最下方。

localized.mainEffect: 【登场时】确认我方所有的安防卡牌内容。可以将其中1张颜色为2种或更多且包含黄色/黑色的卡牌加入手牌。若选择加入手牌,则《恢复+1〈卡组〉》。此后,将我方的安防卡牌进行洗牌。
localized.sourceEffect: 【我方的回合】对方所有的安防数码宝贝DP-2000。

localized.name: Ukkomon
localized.mainEffect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area, you may hatch in your breeding area. Then, gain 1 memory.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect give me 1 memory when one of my Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area, even if I don't hatch in my breeding area?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does. You gain 1 memory when one of your Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area, regardless of whether or not you hatch in your breeding area.

faqs.question: When one of my Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area during the breeding phase, does the hatching in the breeding area and gaining 1 memory for this card's [Your Turn] effect occur during the breeding phase or main phase?
faqs.answer: It occurs during the breeding phase. If effects trigger during the breeding phase, the main phase will come after all effects have activated.

faqs.question: I moved a Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area when this card was in my battle area and all of my Digimon's DP was reduced by activation of an effect. If that Digimon's DP becomes 0 due to the DP-reducing effect at the same time it's moved to the battle area, then it's deleted, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate?
faqs.answer: Yes, it activates.

faqs.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate when this Digimon itself moves from the breeding area to the battle area?
faqs.answer: Yes, it activates.

localized.name: ウッコモン
localized.mainEffect: 【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］自分のデジモンが育成エリアからバトルエリアに移動したとき、自分の育成エリアに孵化できる。その後、メモリー+1。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン】効果は、自分のデジモンが育成エリアからバトルエリアに移動したとき、自分の育成エリアに孵化しなくても、メモリー+1できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。孵化したかしないかに関わらず、自分のターンに自分のデジモンが育成エリアからバトルエリアに移動したとき、メモリー+1されます。

faqs.question: 育成フェイズに育成エリアからデジモンをバトルエリアに移動したとき、このカードの【自分のターン】効果で育成エリアに孵化してメモリー+1するのは、育成フェイズ中に行われるのか、それともメインフェイズになってから行われるのか、どちらになりますか？
faqs.answer: 育成フェイズ中となります。育成フェイズに誘発した効果がある場合、すべて発揮してから、メインフェイズになります。

faqs.question: このカードが自分のバトルエリアに存在し、デジモン全てのDPをマイナスする効果が発揮しているときに、育成エリアからバトルエリアにデジモンを移動させました。DPマイナスの効果でバトルエリアに移動すると同時にそのデジモンのDPが0になって消滅した場合、このカードの【自分のターン】効果は発揮しますか？2023/12/15 更新
faqs.answer: はい、発揮します。

faqs.question: このデジモン自身が、自分のターンに育成エリアからバトルエリアに移動したとき、このカードの【自分のターン】効果は発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮します。

faqs.question: このカードが自分のバトルエリアに存在し、デジモン全てのDPをマイナスする効果が発揮しているときに、育成エリアからバトルエリアにデジモンを移動させました。DPマイナスの効果でバトルエリアに移動すると同時にそのデジモンのDPが0になって消滅した場合、このカードの【自分のターン】効果は発揮しますか？2023/12/15 更新
faqs.answer: はい、発揮します。

faqs.question: このデジモン自身が、自分のターンに育成エリアからバトルエリアに移動したとき、このカードの【自分のターン】効果は発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、発揮します。

localized.mainEffect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and 1 blue Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended, gain 1 memory.

faqs.question: If the 3 cards I reveal from the deck with this card's effect include only a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?
faqs.answer: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

faqs.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and a blue Tamer card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
faqs.answer: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

faqs.question: If this Digimon is unsuspended, then it's suspended by an opponent Digimon's "Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. That Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase" effect, is the effect that prevents unsuspending during the unsuspend phase negated?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's no longer affected by your opponent's effects as soon as it's suspended, so it can now unsuspend.

faqs.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent [Security] effects on my opponent's Security Digimon from affecting this Digimon when it's suspended?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it isn't affected. 
[Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.

faqs.question: アクティブ状態のこのデジモンが、相手のデジモンの「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。そのデジモンは次の相手のアクティブフェイズではアクティブにならない」効果によってレストした場合、アクティブフェイズにアクティブにならない効果は無効になりますか？
faqs.answer: はい、レスト状態になった時点で相手の効果を受けなくなるため無効となり、アクティブになるようになります。

faqs.question: このカードの【お互いのターン】効果は、このデジモンがレスト状態のとき、相手のセキュリティデジモンの【セキュリティ】効果を受けなくなりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、受けません。
セキュリティデジモンの【セキュリティ】効果はデジモンの効果として扱われ、「相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」効果によって効果を受けなくなります。

localized.name: Falcomon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Pinamon]: Cost 0
[On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon. Then, by placing this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon with [Ravemon] in its name, that Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
localized.sourceEffect: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to attack using the Digimon with [Ravemon] in its name where I placed this card in digivolution cards even when it's suspended?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's [On Play] effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

localized.name: ファルコモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「ピナモン」:コスト0
【登場時】Lv.6以下の相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。その後、このデジモンを名称に「レイヴモン」を含む自分のデジモン1体の進化元の下に置くことで、そのデジモンで相手のデジモンにアタックできる。
localized.sourceEffect: 【消滅時】バトル以外で消滅していたなら、相手は相手の手札を1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、このカードを進化元に置いた名称に「レイヴモン」を含むデジモンがレスト状態でもアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【登場時】効果では、アタックできない状態にあるデジモンをアタックさせることはできません。

localized.name: 팔코몬
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】「피나몬」 코스트 0【등장 시】Lv.6 이하의 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 레스트시킨다. 그 후, 이 디지몬을 명칭에 「레이브몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬의 진화원 아래에 놓는 것으로, 그 디지몬으로 상대의 디지몬에게 어택할 수 있다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【소멸 시】배틀 이외로 소멸하고 있었다면, 상대는 본인의 패 1장을 파기한다.

localized.name: 猎鹰兽
localized.mainEffect:
【进化】“皮那兽”:费用0

【登场时】将对方1只等级不高于Lv.6的数码宝贝转换为活跃状态。此后,可将此数码宝贝置于我方1只名称中包含“渡鸦兽”的数码宝贝进化源最下方,并可以用该数码宝贝攻击对方数码宝贝。
localized.sourceEffect: 【消灭时】若被战斗以外的方式消灭,则对方丢弃其1张手牌。

localized.name: Drimogemon
localized.mainEffect: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may move this Digimon to an empty space in your breeding area.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon, it performs any security checks it normally would.)

faqs.question: If a card with <Overflow> is in this card's digivolution cards, is <Overflow> on that card processed when this card's [End of Your Turn] effect moves it to the breeding area?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't processed. 
In this case, <Overflow> isn't processed because the card isn't removed from the area.

faqs.question: Are digivolution cards trashed when this Digimon has digivolution cards and it's moved to the breeding area using this card's effect?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: No, they aren't trashed.

faqs.question: If this Digimon is targeted by an effect such as "1 of your opponent's Digimon gains <Security A. -1>," then this Digimon is moved to the breeding area, what happens to the effect?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: If this Digimon is targeted by an effect and then moved to the breeding area, it remains targeted by the effect. However, it isn't affected by that effect. If it's moved back to the battle area using an effect such as [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect, it will be affected by that effect again.

faqs.question: After I activated this Digimon's [End of Your Turn] effect, I used an effect such as [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect to move this Digimon back to the battle area. Can I activate that Digimon's [End of Your Turn] effect again?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Even if a card is moved, once a [Once Per Turn] effect has activated, it can't be activated again.

faqs.question: I used [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to play [BT16-040 Wormmon], it digivolved into this Digimon, then I used the [End of Your Turn] effect to move it to the breeding area. At such times, does [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s effect return this Digimon to the hand?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't. 
An effect that targets this Digimon will continue targeting it even if it's moved to the breeding area, but because it isn't affected by effects while in the breeding area, it isn't returned to the hand.

faqs.question: If this Digimon is targeted by [EX6-070 Phantom Pain]'s [End of Your Turn] effect and then this Digimon is moved to the breeding area, does [EX6-070 Phantom Pain]'s [End of Your Turn] effect activate?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't activate. 
At the end of your turn, this card's [End of Your Turn] effect and the effect given by [EX6-070 Phantom Pain] will trigger simultaneously, then if this card's effect activates first and this Digimon is moved to the breeding area, [EX6-070 Phantom Pain]'s [End of Your Turn] effect will be pending activation, but it can't activate in the breeding area.

faqs.question: If this Digimon is suspended when its effect moves it to the breeding area, is it still suspended?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, it remains suspended.

faqs.question: If this Digimon is suspended when it's moved to the breeding area, is it unsuspended during my next unsuspend phase?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is. 
During the unsuspend phase, you unsuspend all of your Digimon and Tamers that are placed in the breeding area and battle area.

faqs.question: Can my opponent declare an attack with this Digimon as the target when this Digimon is suspended in the breeding area?Mar. 28, 2024 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, they can't. 
Digimon in breeding areas can't be chosen as attack targets.

sourceNotes: テイマーバトルパック21

localized.name: ドリモゲモン
localized.mainEffect: 【自分のターン終了時】［ターンに1回］このデジモンを空いている自分の育成エリアに移動できる。
localized.sourceEffect: ≪貫通≫（このデジモンがアタックしたバトルで相手のデジモンを消滅させたとき、アタック終了前にチェックする）

faqs.question: このカードの進化元に≪オーバーフロー≫を持つカードがある状態で、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果で育成エリアに移動したとき、そのカードの≪オーバーフロー≫は処理されますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、処理されません。
この場合、エリアから離れていないため、≪オーバーフロー≫は処理されません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で進化元を持つこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動したとき、進化元は破棄されますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、破棄されません。

faqs.question: 「相手のデジモン1体に≪Sアタック-1≫を与える」等の、このデジモンを対象にした効果を与えられたこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動した場合、与えられた効果はどうなりますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer: このデジモンを対象として与えられた効果は、育成エリアに移動した場合にも与えられたままになります。ただし、その効果の影響は受けません。その後、「BT1-089 太刀川ミミ」等の効果で再度バトルエリアに移動した場合、与えられた効果の影響を受けるようになります。

faqs.question: 【自分のターン終了時】の効果を既に発揮したこのデジモンを、「BT1-089 太刀川ミミ」などの効果で再度バトルエリアに移動させました。そのデジモンの【自分のターン終了時】をもう一度発揮できますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
移動した場合でも、既に発揮した[ターンに1回]を、もう一度発揮することはできません。

faqs.question: 「BT16-085 本宮大輔&一乗寺賢」の【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】効果で登場した「BT16-040 ワームモン」をこのデジモンに進化し、【自分のターン終了時】効果で育成エリアに移動しました。この時、「BT16-085 本宮大輔&一乗寺賢」の効果でこのデジモンは、手札に戻りますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、戻りません。
このデジモンを対象として与えられた効果は、育成エリアに移動した場合にも受けたままになりますが、育成エリアでは効果の影響を受けない為、手札に戻りません。

faqs.question: 「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果を与えられたこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動した場合、「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】の効果は発揮しますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮しません。
自分のターン終了時に、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果と「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」に与えられた効果が同時誘発となりますが、このカードの効果を先に発揮して育成エリアに移動した場合、発揮待ちの「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果は、育成エリアでは発揮できません。

faqs.question: レスト状態のこのデジモンがこのデジモンの効果で育成エリアに移動した場合、状態はどうなりますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer: レスト状態のままになります。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元に≪オーバーフロー≫を持つカードがある状態で、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果で育成エリアに移動したとき、そのカードの≪オーバーフロー≫は処理されますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、処理されません。
この場合、エリアから離れていないため、≪オーバーフロー≫は処理されません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で進化元を持つこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動したとき、進化元は破棄されますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer: いいえ、破棄されません。

faqs.question: 「相手のデジモン1体に≪Sアタック-1≫を与える」等の、このデジモンを対象にした効果を与えられたこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動した場合、与えられた効果はどうなりますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer: このデジモンを対象として与えられた効果は、育成エリアに移動した場合にも与えられたままになります。ただし、その効果の影響は受けません。その後、「BT1-089 太刀川ミミ」等の効果で再度バトルエリアに移動した場合、与えられた効果の影響を受けるようになります。

faqs.question: 【自分のターン終了時】の効果を既に発揮したこのデジモンを、「BT1-089 太刀川ミミ」などの効果で再度バトルエリアに移動させました。そのデジモンの【自分のターン終了時】をもう一度発揮できますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
移動した場合でも、既に発揮した[ターンに1回]を、もう一度発揮することはできません。

faqs.question: 「BT16-085 本宮大輔&一乗寺賢」の【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】効果で登場した「BT16-040 ワームモン」をこのデジモンに進化し、【自分のターン終了時】効果で育成エリアに移動しました。この時、「BT16-085 本宮大輔&一乗寺賢」の効果でこのデジモンは、手札に戻りますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、戻りません。
このデジモンを対象として与えられた効果は、育成エリアに移動した場合にも受けたままになりますが、育成エリアでは効果の影響を受けない為、手札に戻りません。

faqs.question: 「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果を与えられたこのデジモンが育成エリアに移動した場合、「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】の効果は発揮しますか？2024/02/16 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、発揮しません。
自分のターン終了時に、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果と「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」に与えられた効果が同時誘発となりますが、このカードの効果を先に発揮して育成エリアに移動した場合、発揮待ちの「EX6-070 ファントムペイン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果は、育成エリアでは発揮できません。

faqs.question: If [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon would be deleted, and [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form]'s inherited effect places it on top of my security stack, does this Digimon's [On Deletion] effect activate?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't activate. 
[EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form]'s inherited effect will trigger/activate "when this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by one of your effects," but since [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form] isn't in this Digimon's digivolution cards at the time of activation of the [On Deletion] effect because it's placed in your security stack before this Digimon is deleted, the "if [X Antibody] was in this Digimon's digivolution cards" condition isn't met, so the effect doesn't activate.

faqs.question: If [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon would be deleted, and [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form]'s inherited effect places it on top of my security stack, does this Digimon's [On Deletion] effect activate?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't activate. 
[EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form]'s inherited effect will trigger/activate "when this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by one of your effects," but since [EX5-070 X Antibody Proto Form] isn't in this Digimon's digivolution cards at the time of activation of the [On Deletion] effect because it's placed in your security stack before this Digimon is deleted, the "if [X Antibody] was in this Digimon's digivolution cards" condition isn't met, so the effect doesn't activate.

localized.name: Maildramon

localized.name: Future Potential!
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a Tamer, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Choose 1 Tamer. You may play 1 Digimon card of the same color as the chosen Tamer and a play cost of 3 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost.

faqs.question: What colors of cards does "the same color" as the specified card refer to?
faqs.answer: It refers to a card that has 1 of the same colors as the specified card.

faqs.question: If I choose a single-color red Tamer for this card's [Main] effect, can I play a multicolor Digimon card that includes red?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If I choose a red and blue 2-color Tamer for this card's [Main] effect, can I play a single-color red or blue Digimon card?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card attacks. In what order do they activate?
faqs.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

faqs.question:
I have this card and EX8-065 [Ryutaro Williams] in the battle area. 
When this card attacks, I activate EX8-065 [Ryutaro Williams]'s [Your Turn] effect and digivolve this Digimon into a card in the hand. 
Can I then activate this card's <Raid> or [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If an effect is lost while it's pending activation, it can no longer be activated.

バトルエリアに自分のこのカードと、自分の「EX8-065 リュウタロー・ウィリアムズ」がいる状況です。

localized.name: ShoeShoemon
localized.mainEffect:
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Play 1 [Familiar] Token. (Digimon/Yellow/3000 DP/"[On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.") At the end of your opponent's turn, delete that token.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)

faqs.question: Do I delete the token that was played by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect at the end of my opponent's turn?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the deletion timing.

faqs.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a token played by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

localized.name: Galemon
localized.mainEffect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if it's your turn, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits in the hand. For every other suspended Digimon, reduce this effect's digivolution cost by 1.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +2000 DP.

faqs.question:
I used BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!], then I played this card. 
I then used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend 1 other Digimon. 
If I use BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!]'s effect to suspend one of my Digimon other than this card when I use the part of the effect after "then" to digivolve this card, how much is the digivolution cost reduced by this card's effect?
faqs.answer: This card's effect reduces the digivolution cost by 2, and the total digivolution cost reduction when combined with BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!] is 7.

localized.name: ゲイルモン
localized.mainEffect: 【登場時】【進化時】デジモン1体をレストできる。その後、自分のターンなら、このデジモンを手札の特徴に「鳥」を含むデジモンカードに進化できる。レスト状態の他のデジモン1体ごとに、この効果で支払う進化コスト-1。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】このデジモンをDP+2000。

faqs.question:
「BT3-103 秘めたる力の発現!!」を使用したあとに、このカードを登場させました。
そのあとに、このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、他のデジモン1体をレストさせました。
「その後」以降の効果でこのカードを進化させるときに、「BT3-103 秘めたる力の発現!!」の効果でこのカード以外の自分のデジモンをレストさせた場合、このカードの効果によって支払う進化コストは何コストマイナスされますか？
faqs.answer: このカードの効果によって支払う進化コストは-2され、「BT3-103 秘めたる力の発現!!」と合わせて支払う進化コストは合計-7コストされます。

localized.name: 沙地龙兽
localized.mainEffect: 【我方的主要阶段开始时】【进化时】可从我方数码宝贝的进化源中,丢弃1张拥有“矿物型”/“矿石型”特征的卡牌,并翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。将其中1张拥有“矿物型”/“矿石型”特征的卡牌加入手牌,或置于此数码宝贝进化源的最下方。剩余的卡牌仅放回到卡组最上方或最下方。

localized.name: Close
localized.mainEffect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When effects trash digivolution cards from any of your [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, place 1 card with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait from your trash as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card.

faqs.question: What Digimon's digivolution card being trashed will trigger this card's [All Turns] effect?
faqs.answer:
This effect will trigger when a card is trashed from the digivolution cards of your Digimon with the [Mineral] trait or your Digimon with the [Rock] trait. 
It doesn't require a specific card to be trashed from digivolution cards.

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, ⟨Rule⟩, digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. 
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

faqs.question:
This card's inherited effect and BT21-064 [Guilmon]'s inherited effect triggered simultaneously when BT21-068 [Growlmon] with this card and BT21-064 [Guilmon] in its digivolution cards was deleted. 
At such times, if I activate this card's effect first and BT21-068 [Growlmon] is returned from the trash to the hand, can I then activate BT21-064 [Guilmon]'s inherited effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. 
If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if BT21-068 [Growlmon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT21-068 [Growlmon]. 
If the deleted BT21-068 [Growlmon] leaves the trash, the inherited [On Deletion] effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

At such times, if I activate this card's effect first and BT21-068 [Growlmon] is returned from the trash to the hand, can I then activate BT21-068 [Growlmon]'s inherited effect?Feb. 6, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card.

faqs.question:
This card's inherited effect and BT21-064 [Guilmon]'s inherited effect triggered simultaneously when BT21-068 [Growlmon] with this card and BT21-064 [Guilmon] in its digivolution cards was deleted. 
At such times, if I activate this card's effect first and BT21-068 [Growlmon] is returned from the trash to the hand, can I then activate BT21-064 [Guilmon]'s inherited effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't activate it. 
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. 
If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. 
In this case, if BT21-068 [Growlmon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT21-068 [Growlmon]. 
If the deleted BT21-068 [Growlmon] leaves the trash, the inherited [On Deletion] effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

localized.name: Royal Base
localized.mainEffect:
[Security] [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Royal Base] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
[Main] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as your bottom security card.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
faqs.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. 
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

localized.name: ローヤルベース
localized.mainEffect:
［セキュリティ］【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］自分のデジモンが特徴に「ローヤルベース」を持つデジモンカードに進化するとき、支払う進化コスト-1。
【メイン】自分のセキュリティを上から1枚手札に加える。その後、このカードを自分のセキュリティの下に表向きで置く。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、自分のセキュリティが0枚のときでも発揮できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
この場合、手札に加えるセキュリティがないため、セキュリティを手札に加えず、このカードをセキュリティに置きます。

faqs.question: 効果でセキュリティに表向きで置かれたカードは、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きのセキュリティとなり、公開されたままになります。
表向きになっていること以外のルールは、通常のセキュリティと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティをチェックする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
公開されたままチェックされます。
公開されたまま以外のルールは、通常のチェックと変わりません。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティがチェックされた場合、そのカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、誘発します。

faqs.question: 表向きで置かれたセキュリティを含むセキュリティをシャッフルする場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
表向きになっていたセキュリティを裏向きに戻してから、シャッフルします。
シャッフルしたあとに、そのカードを表向きにはしません。

faqs.question: Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?
faqs.answer:
No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger. 
In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.

faqs.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw. 
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

faqs.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

faqs.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card. 
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't.

faqs.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, it does.

faqs.question: テイマーから進化する進化条件は進化元となるテイマーをデジモンとしても扱い進化しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、テイマーからそのまま進化します。デジモンが進化するとは扱わず、「デジモンが進化するとき」効果や「デジモンが進化したとき」効果は誘発しません。
また、「デジモンが進化できない」効果が発揮された場合でも、この進化条件でテイマーから進化できます。

faqs.question: テイマーから進化した場合でも、進化ドローは行いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化ドローを行います。
どのような進化の場合でも、進化ドローは行います。

faqs.question: 登場したターンのテイマーから進化したこのカードは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
登場でエリアに置かれたカードから進化しても、そのターン中アタックできません。登場したターンでなければ、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: デジモンの下に置かれているテイマーカードは、進化元になりますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、進化元になります。
そのデジモンがエリアを離れる場合、通常の進化元と同様破棄されます。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストのセキュリティ効果を得ますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、得ません。

faqs.question: デジモンは、進化元にあるテイマーカードの下段テキストの進化元効果を得ますか？

localized.name: Apollomon ACE
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Light Fang]/[Night Claw] trait: Cost 3
{Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -4000 DP for the turn for each of your Digimon with the [Olympos XII] trait. Then, delete up to 7000 DP total worth of their Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [GraceNovamon] in the hand. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
localized.sourceEffect:
＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may attack.

faqs.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to reduce the DP of multiple Digimon?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
You choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon, then that Digimon's DP is reduced by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect.

faqs.question: After DNA digivolving, can the DNA digivolved Digimon attack using this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, it can attack.

faqs.question: If I choose to not use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, can I still use it to have 1 of my Digimon attack?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, it can attack.

faqs.question:
At the end of my turn, I used this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve this card and 1 of my Digimon into [GraceNovamon], then I used that [GraceNovamon] to attack. 
Can I then activate this card's inherited effect?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's inherited effect doesn't trigger at such timings.

faqs.question:
I have an unsuspended BT22-077 [Dianamon] with this card in its digivolution cards in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, can I activate this card's inherited effect to attack, then use BT22-077 [Dianamon]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to unsuspend?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
If you use this card's inherited effect to attack, then use BT22-077 [Dianamon]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to unsuspend, the counter timing will occur once all other processing has been resolved.

faqs.question:
I have a suspended BT22-077 [Dianamon] with this card in its digivolution cards in the battle area. 
At the end of my turn, can I activate BT22-077 [Dianamon]'s [End of Your Turn] effect, unsuspend, and then use this card's inherited effect to attack?Jul. 4, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
このカードの効果で、相手のデジモンのDPが0になりました。
このとき、DPが0になったデジモンはその時点で消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。
発揮した効果を全て解決したあとルールチェックになり、その時点でDPが0のデジモン全てが同時に消滅します。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、複数のデジモンのDPをマイナスすることはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果は、相手のデジモン1体を選び、そのデジモンのDPをマイナスします。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、ジョグレス進化した後に、ジョグレス進化したそのデジモンでアタックすることはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer: はい、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question: このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果は、ジョグレス進化をせずに、自分のデジモン1体でアタックすることはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer: はい、アタックすることができます。

faqs.question:
自分のターン終了時になり、このカードの【自分のターン終了時】効果で、このカードを含む自分のデジモン1体で「グレイスノヴァモン」にジョグレス進化し、その「グレイスノヴァモン」でアタックしました。
そのあとに、このカードの進化元効果を発揮することはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
そのタイミングでは、このカードの進化元効果は誘発していません。

faqs.question:
このカードを進化元に持つ、アクティブ状態の自分の「BT22-077 ディアナモン」がバトルエリアにいる状況です。
自分のターン終了時、このカードの進化元効果を発揮でアタックしたあとに、「BT22-077 ディアナモン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果でアクティブにすることはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
このカードの進化元効果でアタックしたあと、「BT22-077 ディアナモン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果でアクティブにしたあと、他に解決していない処理がなければ、カウンタータイミングに進行します。

faqs.question:
このカードを進化元に持つ、レスト状態の自分の「BT22-077 ディアナモン」がバトルエリアにいる状況です。
自分のターン終了時、「BT22-077 ディアナモン」の【自分のターン終了時】効果を発揮しアクティブになったあとに、このカードの進化元効果でアタックすることはできますか？2025/07/04 更新
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
faqs.answer:

faqs.question: 「記述があるカード」とは、どういったカードを指しますか？
faqs.answer:
指定の単語かアイコンが「名称・特徴・効果・進化元効果・〈ルール〉・進化条件・ジョグレス・デジクロス条件・バースト進化・アプ合体・リンク・アセンブリ条件」に含まれているカードを指します。

faqs.question:
Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's [On Deletion] effect at the end of my turn? 
And if the Digimon that was played by the [On Play] effect was prevented from being deleted at the end of the turn, is it still prevented from digivolving?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it's deleted upon the deletion timing. 
If another effect prevents the Digimon played by the [On Play] effect from being deleted by this effect, it's still prevented from digivolving.

faqs.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a Digimon played by this card's [On Play] or [On Deletion] effect?Feb. 6, 2026 Updated
faqs.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects don't affect this Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -10000 DP until their turn ends.

faqs.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
