localized.name: 치쿠리몬
localized.mainEffect: 【서로의 턴】서로는 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의「지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없다」는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 「지불하는 등장 코스트를 -x 한다」효과가 무효되는 효과입니다. 자신과 상대는 그것들의 효과를 발휘하더라도 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없고 카드에 기술되어있는 대로의 등장 코스트를 지불하지 않으면 등장할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 있을 때, 「코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다」효과는 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 「코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다」효과는 등장 코스트를 마이너스하는 효과는 아니기 때문에 발휘할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 있을 때, 상대의 「BT13-007 위그드라실_7D6」의 【자신의 턴】 효과는 특징으로 「로얄나이츠」를 갖는 디지몬의 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 마이너스할 수 없게 됩니다. 「BT8-071 사이케몬」의 효과는 디지몬을 대상으로 하는 효과가 아니기 때문에 해당 카드가 육성에리어에 있어도 막을 수 없고 「BT8-071 사이케몬」에 의해 해당 카드의 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스하는 효과는 발휘할 수 없게 됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 디지몬이 있을 때, 상대의 「BT14-046 니드몬」의 【자신의 턴】 효과 또는 그린인 테이머 카드의 등장 코스트를 마이너스할 수 없게 됩니까?
faqs.answer:
네. 마이너스할 수 없게 됩니다.
이 카드의 효과는 테이머 카드를 등장시킬 때에 지불하는 등장 코스트를 마이너스하는 효과도 발휘할 수 없어집니다.

localized.mainEffect: [On Play] By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon that's red or has [Legend-Arms] in its traits as its bottom digivolution card, you may reveal the top card of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with [Legend-Arms] in its traits and a play cost of 7 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Add the rest to your hand.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a Digimon that's red or has [Legend-Arms] in its traits in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)

faqs.question: Can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, the effect reads "By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon [...] as its bottom digivolution card," so you may also choose to not place it as the bottom digivolution card. In such cases, it remains in the battle area as a Digimon like normal.

faqs.question: When I reveal a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect, can I choose to not play that card?
faqs.answer: Yes, the effect reads "you may play it," so you may also choose to not play it. In such cases, you add it to your hand like any other card.

faqs.question: I revealed a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect] when I had a [BT9-047 Pomumon]. What happens to that card?
faqs.answer: It can't be played due to [BT9-047 Pomumon]'s effect, so you add it to your hand like any other card.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ ラグナロードモン [ST-13]

localized.name: ルドモン
localized.mainEffect: 【登場時】このデジモンを特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つか赤の他の自分のデジモン1体の進化元の下に置くことで、自分のデッキの上から1枚オープンする。そのカードが特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ登場コスト7以下のデジモンカードならコストを支払わずに登場できる。残りは手札に加える。
localized.sourceEffect: 【相手のターン】特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つか赤の自分のデジモンがいる間、このデジモンは≪ブロッカー≫（相手のデジモンがアタックしたとき、このデジモンをレストさせることでアタックの対象をこのデジモンにする）を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果は、発揮させないこともできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、「進化元の下に置くことで」なので、進化元に置かないことも選択できます。そうした場合は通常どおり、デジモンとしてバトルエリアに残ります。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】効果で、デッキから特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ登場コスト7以下のデジモンカードがめくられたとき、そのカードを登場させないことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、「登場できる」なので、登場させないことを選択できます。そうした場合は他のカードだった場合と同様に、手札に加えます。

faqs.question: 「BT9-047 ポームモン」がいるとき、このカードの【登場時】効果で、デッキから特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ登場コスト7以下のデジモンカードがめくられたとき、そのカードはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 「BT9-047 ポームモン」の効果で登場できないため、それ以外のカードが出たときと同じように手札に加えます。

localized.name: 루도몬
localized.mainEffect: 【등장 시】이 디지몬을 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가지거나 레드인 자신의 다른 디지몬 1마리의 진화원 아래에 놓는 것으로, 자신의 덱 위에서부터 1장 오픈한다. 그 카드가 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 등장 코스트 7 이하의 디지몬 카드라면 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킬 수 있다. 남은 카드는 패에 추가한다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【상대의 턴】특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가지거나 레드인 자신의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 디지몬은 《블로커》 (상대의 디지몬이 어택했을 때, 이 디지몬을 레스트시키는 것으로 어택의 대상을 이 디지몬으로 한다)를 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】 효과는 발휘하지 않을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 「진화원 아래에 놓는 것으로」이므로 진화원으로 놓지 않는 것을 선택할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 한다면 정상적으로 디지몬으로 배틀 에어리어에 남습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【등장 시】 효과로 덱에서 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 등장 코스트 7 이하인 디지몬 카드가 넘겨졌을 때, 그 카드를 등장시키지 않을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 「등장시킬 수 있다」이므로 등장시키지 않을 수 있습니다. 그랬을 경우에는 다른 카드였을 경우와 마찬가지로 패에 넣습니다.

faqs.question: 「BT9-047 폼몬」이 있을 때, 이 카드의 【등장 시】 효과로 덱에서 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 등장 코스트 7 이하인 디지몬 카드가 넘겨졌을 때, 그 카드는 어떻게됩니까?
faqs.answer: 「BT9-047 폼몬」의 효과로 등장할 수 없기 때문에 그 이외의 카드가 나왔을 때와 똑같이 패에 넣습니다.

localized.name: RaijiLudomon
localized.mainEffect: [Opponent's Turn] This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects.
localized.sourceEffect: [End of Your Turn] You may DNA digivolve this Digimon and one of your other Digimon in play into a Digimon card in your hand for its DNA digivolve cost.

faqs.question: How does this card's inherited effect work, exactly?
faqs.answer: At the end of your turn, this effect allows you to DNA digivolve the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, along with one of your other Digimon, into a Digimon that has a DNA digivolution requirement from your hand. Note that this happens before it becomes your opponent's turn.

faqs.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn't have a DNA digivolution requirement?
faqs.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can't DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn't have a DNA digivolution requirement.

faqs.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?
faqs.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can't DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren't specified in [DNA Digivolution].

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ ラグナロードモン [ST-13]

localized.name: ライジルドモン
localized.mainEffect: 【相手のターン】このデジモンは、相手の効果では消滅しない。
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン終了時】このデジモンと他の自分のデジモンで、手札のデジモンカードにコストを支払ってジョグレス進化できる。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、どういう効果なのですか？
faqs.answer: 自分のターン終了時に、このカードを進化元に持つデジモンともう1体のデジモンで、手札の「ジョグレス」を持つデジモンに、相手にターンが移る前にジョグレス進化ができる効果となります。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果で、手札の「ジョグレス」を持たないデジモンカードにジョグレス進化できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、進化条件を無視することはできないので、「ジョグレス」を持たないデジモンカードにジョグレス進化することはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果で、手札の「ジョグレス」に指定されていないデジモンでジョグレス進化はできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、進化条件を無視することはできないので、「ジョグレス」で指定されていないデジモンでジョグレス進化することはできません。

localized.name: 라이지루도몬
localized.mainEffect: 【상대의 턴】이 디지몬은 상대의 효과로는 소멸하지 않는다.
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴 종료 시】이 디지몬과 자신의 다른 디지몬으로, 코스트를 지불하여 패의 디지몬 카드로 조그레스 진화할 수 있다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 어떤 효과입니까?
faqs.answer: 자신의 턴 종료 시에, 이 카드를 진화원으로 갖고 있는 디지몬과, 다른 디지몬으로 패에서 「조그레스」를 가진 디지몬으로 상대에게 턴이 넘어가기 전에 조그레스 진화할 수 있는 효과입니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과로, 패에서 「조그레스」를 갖고 있지 않은 디지몬 카드로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 진화 조건을 무시할 수 없어, 「조그레스」를 갖지 않은 디지몬 카드로 조그레스 진화할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과로, 패에서 「조그레스」로 지정되지 않은 색・Lv.인 디지몬으로 조그레스 진화할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 진화 조건을 무시할 수 없어, 「조그레스」로 지정되지 않은 색・Lv.인 디지몬으로 조그레스 진화할 수 없습니다.

[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under this Digimon, your opponent's effects can't delete this Digimon or return it to its owner's hand or deck until the end of their turn.
[When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with [Legend-Arms] in its traits and a play cost of 7 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
localized.sourceEffect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is [RagnaLoardmon], it isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.

faqs.question: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect reveals a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less in my deck, can I choose to not play that card?
faqs.answer: Yes, the effect reads "you may play it," so you may also choose to not play it. In such cases, you place it at the bottom of the deck with the rest of the cards.

faqs.question: If there's a [BT9-047 Pomumon] and I reveal a Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less with this card's [When Attacking] effect, what happens to that card?
faqs.answer: It can't be played due to [BT9-Pomumon]'s effect, so return it to the bottom of the deck with the rest of the cards.

faqs.question: If my Digimon is targeted by the [End of Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] while it has this card in its digivolution cards, does this card's inherited effect prevent it from being deleted due to my opponent's effect?
faqs.answer: No, this card's inherited effect has the [Opponent's Turn] timing, but the turns haven't changed at the end of your turn, so this card's inherited effect can't be activated and the effect of your opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] can't be prevented.

faqs.question: 「BT9-047 ポームモン」がいるとき、このカードの【進化時】効果で、デッキから特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ登場コスト7以下のデジモンカードがめくられたとき、そのカードはどうなりますか？2022/07/15 更新

faqs.question: 相手の「BT9-112 デクスモン」の【相手のターン終了時】の効果で対象となった自分のデジモンが、このカードを進化元に持っていた場合、このカードの進化元効果で相手の効果を受けずに消滅しないことになりますか？

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】 효과로 、덱에서 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 등장 코스트 7 이하인 디지몬 카드가 넘겨졌을 때, 그 카드를 등장시키지 않을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 「등장시킬 수 있다」이므로 등장시키지 않을 수 있습니다. 그랬을 경우에는 다른 카드였을 경우와 마찬가지로 덱 밑으로 되돌립니다.

faqs.question: 「BT9-047 폼몬」이 있을 때, 이 카드의 【진화 시】 효과로 、덱에서 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 등장 코스트 7 이하인 디지몬 카드가 넘겨졌을 때, 그 카드는 어떻게됩니까?2022/07/15 更新
faqs.answer: 「BT9-047 폼몬」의 효과로 등장할 수 없기 때문에 그 이외의 카드가 나왔을 때와 마찬가지로 덱 밑으로 되돌립니다.

faqs.question: 상대의 「BT9-112 데크스몬」의 【상대의 턴 종료 시】 효과로 대상이 되는 자신의 디지몬이 이 카드를 진화원으로 갖고 있을 경우, 이 카드의 진화원 효과로 상대의 효과를 받지 않고 소멸하지 않을 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드의 진화원 효과의 타이밍은 【상대의 턴】으로 턴 종료시는 아직 턴이 교대하지 않기 때문에 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 발휘하지않고 상대의 「BT9-112 데크스몬」 효과는 막을 수 없습니다.

localized.name: 布利维路德龙兽
localized.mainEffect:
【我方的回合】[每回合1次]当此数码宝贝的进化源因我方的效果而增加时,直到下个对方的回合结束为止,此数码宝贝不会因对方的效果被消灭,不会放回手牌、卡组。

【进化时】翻开我方卡组最上方的3张卡牌。可以不支付费用登场其中1张拥有“Legend-Arms”特征的登场费用不高于7的数码宝贝卡牌。剩余的卡牌可自选顺序放回到卡组最下方。
localized.sourceEffect: 【对方的回合】此数码宝贝为“诸神之主兽”的期间,此数码宝贝不会受到对方数码宝贝的效果影响。

localized.name: Direct Smasher
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a Digimon with [Legend-Arms] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP.

faqs.question: If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, can I delete them all with this card's [Main] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, this card can only delete 1 Digimon.
If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, this card's player chooses 1 target among them to delete.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ ラグナロードモン [ST-13]

localized.name: ディレクトスマッシャー
localized.mainEffect:
特徴に「Legend-Arms」を持つ自分のデジモンがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視して使用できる。
【メイン】最もDPの高い相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果は、最もDPの高い相手のデジモンが複数いるとき、それらすべてを消滅させられますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードで消滅させられるのは1体だけです。最もDPの高い相手のデジモンが複数いる場合、このカードのプレイヤーが、その中から消滅させる対象を選択します。

localized.name: 다이렉트 스매셔
localized.mainEffect: 특징으로 「Legend-Arms」를 가진 자신의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 카드는 색 조건을 무시하고 사용할 수 있다. 【메인】가장 DP가 높은 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】 효과는 가장 DP가 높은 상대의 디지몬이 여러 마리 있을 때 그걸 전부 소멸시킵니까?
faqs.answer:
아니요. 이 카드로 소멸시키는 것은 1마리 뿐입니다.
가장 DP가 높은 상대의 디지몬이 여럿 있을 경우, 이 카드의 플레이어가 그 중에서 소멸시킬 대상을 선택합니다.

localized.name: 直达撞击者
localized.mainEffect:
我方场上存在拥有“Legend-Arms”特征的数码宝贝期间,可以无视颜色条件使用此卡牌。
【主要】消灭对方1只DP最高的数码宝贝。

localized.name: Legend-Arms Alliance
localized.mainEffect:
[Main] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Legend-Arms] in its traits and a play cost of 7 or less in your hand without paying its memory cost. Then, place this card in your Battle Area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
・Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Place those cards on the top or bottom of your deck in any order.

faqs.question: If I don't play a Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my hand with this card's [Main] effect, can I still activate the effect to place this card in my Battle Area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: Can I return some of the cards revealed with this card's <Delay> effect to the top of the deck and the others to the bottom of the deck?
faqs.answer: No, you can't. Choose whether to return all revealed cards to the top of the deck, or return all revealed cards to the bottom of the deck.

＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)

faqs.question: How does this card's "This Digimon can't attack players" effect work if this Digimon is affected by a "make 1 of your opponent's Digimon attack" effect from my opponent?
faqs.answer:
If there are targets that this Digimon can attack, such as an opponent's suspended Digimon, it will attack that target.
If the only possible target is the opponent, no attack will occur because of the "This Digimon can't attack players" effect.

faqs.question: このカードの「このデジモンはプレイヤーにアタックできない。」の効果は、相手から「相手のデジモン1体をアタックさせる」の効果を受けた場合、どういった処理になりますか？
faqs.answer:
レスト状態の相手のデジモンなど、アタックが可能な対象がいれば、その対象にアタックします。
プレイヤー以外にアタックできない場合は、「このデジモンはプレイヤーにアタックできない。」の効果によってアタックは行いません。

레스트 상태인 상대 디지몬 등, 어택이 가능한 대상이 있다면 그 대상에 어택합니다.
플레이어 이외에 어택할 수 없는 경우에는 「이 디지몬은 플레이어에게 어택할 수 없다.」 효과로 인해 어택은 실행되지 않습니다.

localized.name: Ai & Mako
localized.mainEffect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Evil], [Wizard], or [Demon Lord] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

faqs.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and gain 1 memory even when I have 0 cards in my hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can activate this effect.
"return 1 card from your hand on top of your deck" is not a "by <X>, <Y>" effect ("by returning..."), so you gain 1 memory even when you can't perform that action.
However, if you do have cards in your hand, you must return 1 card on top of the deck.

localized.mainEffect:

【自分のターン】自分のデジモンが紫のデジモンに進化したとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、自分の手札1枚をデッキの上に戻し、メモリー+1。

faqs.answer:
はい、発揮できます。
「自分の手札1枚をデッキの上に戻し」は「～することで」の効果ではないため、それが行えなくてもメモリー+1することができます。
ただし、手札が1枚以上ある場合は必ずデッキの上に戻さなくてはなりません。

localized.name: Breakthrough of Courage
localized.mainEffect:
While you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Unsuspend 1 of your Digimon. Then, 1 of your Digimon with [Greymon] in its name isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of your opponent's turn.

faqs.question: When my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name isn't affected by my opponent's Digimon's effects from this card's [Main] effect, can it be blocked by an opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be blocked.
<Blocker> is an effect that allows the Digimon with the effect to block, so it isn't affected by "isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effects.

faqs.question: When my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name isn't affected by my opponent's Digimon's effects from this card's [Main] effect, is it affected by [Security] effects on my opponent's Digimon?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't affected. 
[Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.

localized.name: 勇気の前進
localized.mainEffect:
名称に「八神太一」を含む自分のテイマーがいる間、このカードは色条件を無視できる。
【メイン】自分のデジモン1体をアクティブにする。その後、相手のターン終了まで、名称に「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモン1体は相手のデジモンの効果を受けない。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果によって、相手のデジモンの効果を受けなくなった、名称に「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモンは、相手のデジモンからブロックされないのですか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、ブロックされます。
≪ブロッカー≫は、そのデジモンがブロックを行えるという効果で、相手のデジモンに対する効果ではないため、「相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」効果からは影響を受けません。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果によって、相手のデジモンの効果を受けなくなった、名称に「グレイモン」を含む自分のデジモンは、相手のセキュリティデジモンの【セキュリティ】効果は受けますか？2023/10/13 更新
faqs.answer:
いいえ、受けません。
セキュリティデジモンの【セキュリティ】効果はデジモンの効果として扱われ、「相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」効果によって効果を受けなくなります。

localized.name: 용기의 전진
localized.mainEffect: 명칭에 「신태일」을 포함하는 자신의 테이머가 있는 동안, 이 카드는 색 조건을 무시할 수 있다. 【메인】자신의 디지몬 1마리를 액티브로 한다. 그 후, 상대의 턴 종료까지 명칭에 「그레이몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬 1마리는 상대의 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】효과에 의해 상대의 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않게 된 「그레이몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬은 상대의 디지몬에 의해 블록당하지 않나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 블록당합니다.
《블로커》는 그 디지몬이 블록을 진행하는 효과로, 상대의 디지몬을 향하는 효과가 아니기 때문에 「상대의 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는」효과로는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】효과에 의해 상대의 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않게 된 「그레이몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬은 상대의 시큐리티 디지몬의 【시큐리티】효과는 받나요?
faqs.answer:
아니요, 받지 않습니다.
시큐리티 디지몬의 【시큐리티】효과는 디지몬의 효과로 취급되어, 「상대의 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다」효과에 의해 효과를 받지 않게 됩니다.

faqs.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "this Digimon can't attack" effect as the target for "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" when I activate this card's [Main] effect?

Yes, you can.

faqs.question: What happens if I use this card twice and 2 of my opponent's Digimon gain the "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" effect?
faqs.answer:
At the start of your opponent's main phase, the effects gained from this card's effect are triggered at the same time, and your opponent determines which one activates first. After effects such as [When Attacking] have activated, and before the counter timing occurs, it is time to activate the effect of the 2nd Digimon that was pending activation. However, since the 1st Digimon is already attacking, the effect ends without an attack made.
As a result, only the Digimon whose effect was activated first can attack.

faqs.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with an "[Opponent's Turn] This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect as the target for "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" when I activate this card's [Main] effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, as soon as it becomes your opponent's turn, the target opposing Digimon loses the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects" effect, and the attack occurs at the start of the main phase by this card's effect.

localized.name: トライデントアーム
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】相手のデジモン1体を≪退化3≫。その後、相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体に「【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】このデジモンでアタックする。」の効果を与える。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、「このデジモンはアタックできない」効果を持つ相手のデジモンを、「【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】このデジモンでアタックする。」の効果を与える対象に選べますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
ただしその場合、「このデジモンはアタックできない」効果によって、アタックは行われません。

faqs.question: このカードを2回枚使用して、相手のデジモン2体に「【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】このデジモンでアタックする。」効果をそれぞれ与えたら、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
相手のメインフェイズ開始時に、このカードの効果で与えた効果が同時誘発し、相手がどちらを先に発揮させるかを決定します。
【アタック時】効果などの発揮後、カウンタータイミングの前に発揮待ちだった2体目のデジモンの効果が発揮するタイミングになりますが、すでに1体目のデジモンのアタック中のため、アタックはできずに効果が終了します。
結果として、最初に効果を発揮した相手のデジモンのみ、アタックすることになります。

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、「【相手のターン】このデジモンは相手の効果を受けない」効果を持つ相手のデジモンを、「【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】このデジモンでアタックする。」の効果を与える対象に選べますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
その場合、相手のターンになった時点で、対象となった相手のデジモンの「このデジモンは相手の効果を受けない」が効果を失うので、このカードによって与えられた効果によって、メインフェイズ開始時にアタックさせます。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】효과로 「이 디지몬은 어택할 수 없다」 효과를 가진 상대의 디지몬을 「【자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시】이 디지몬으로 어택한다.」의 효과를 주는 대상으로 선택할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
네, 가능합니다.
단, 그 경우에 「이 디지몬은 어택할 수 없다」효과에 의해 어택은 진행되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 2회 사용하여, 상대의 디지몬 2마리에게 「【자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시】이 디지몬으로 어택한다.」의 효과를 각각 줬다면 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer:
상대의 메인 페이즈 개시 시에 이 카드의 효과로 받은 효과가 동시 유발되어, 상대가 어느쪽을 우선 발휘할지 결정합니다.
【어택 시】효과 등이 발휘한 뒤, 카운터 타이밍 이전에 발휘를 기다리고 있던 2번째 디지몬의 효과가 발휘하는 타이밍이 되지만, 이미 1번째 디지몬의 어택이 진행되고 있기 때문에 2번째 디지몬의 어택은 진행되지 않고 효과가 종료됩니다.
결과적으로 먼저 효과를 발휘한 상대의 디지몬만이 어택하게 됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】효과로 「【상대의 턴】이 디지몬은 상대의 효과를 받지 않는다」효과를 가진 상대의 디지몬을 「【자신의 메인 페이즈 개시 시】이 디지몬으로 어택한다.」의 효과를 주는 대상으로 선택할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer:
네, 가능합니다.
그 경우에는 상대의 턴이 된 시점에 대상이 된 상대의 디지몬의 「【상대의 턴】이 디지몬은 상대의 효과를 받지 않는다」가 효과를 잃기 때문에, 이 카드에 의해 받은 효과로 메인 페이즈 개시 시에 어택하게 됩니다.

faqs.question: I used this card's [Main] effect to to give 1 of my Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name "[On Deletion] Play this card without paying the cost." What happens to the effect if the target Digimon later becomes a Digimon without [Garururmon] in its name by digivolving or <De-Digivolve>?

faqs.question: このカードの【メイン】効果で、名称に「ガルルモン」を含む自分のデジモン1体に「【消滅時】このカードをコストを支払わずに登場させる。」の効果を与えました。その後、対象のデジモンが進化もしくは≪退化≫したことによって名称に「ガルルモン」を含まないデジモンになった場合、与えられた効果はどうなりますか？

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【메인】효과로 명칭에 「가루몬」을 포함하는 자신의 디지몬 1마리에게 「【소멸 시】이 카드를 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다.」의 효과를 줬습니다. 그 후, 대상의 디지몬이 진화 또는 《퇴화》하는 것에 의해 명칭에 「가루몬」을 포함하지 않게 된 경우, 부여된 효과는 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 이 카드의 발동 시에 조건을 만족하고 있었다면, 상대의 턴 종료까지는 명칭에 「가루몬」을 포함하지 않는 디지몬이 되더라도, 효과는 계속됩니다.

localized.name: MegaGargomon ACE
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] [Rapidmon] in name: Cost 5
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Blocker＞ ＜Reboot＞
[When Digivolving] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 2 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend or digivolve until the end of their turn.
[When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may unsuspend this Digimon.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)

faqs.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect suspend 1 each of my opponent's Digimon and Tamers?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can.

faqs.question: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect also prevent my opponent's Tamers from digivolving into Digimon cards in cases where Tamers can digivolve?
faqs.answer: Yes. Digivolutions from Tamers are also no longer possible.

faqs.question: Can I activate the "can't unsuspend or digivolve" effect in this card's [When Digivolving] effect on opponent's Digimon/Tamers other than the ones suspended by this effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If this card's [When Digivolving] effect is activated for an opponent's suspended Digimon with a "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of your opponent's turn," does that Digimon unsuspend during my opponent's next turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't unsuspend. 
The target Digimon is unaffected by this card's effect during the turn it activated, but the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of your opponent's turn" effect is lost when the turn switches, and then this card's effect prevents it from unsuspending.

faqs.question: If this card's [When Digivolving] effect is activated for an opponent's suspended Digimon with a "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of your opponent's turn," does that Digimon unsuspend during my opponent's next turn?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't unsuspend. 
The target Digimon is unaffected by this card's effect during the turn it activated, but the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of your opponent's turn" effect is lost when the turn switches, and then this card's effect prevents it from unsuspending.

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果は、相手のデジモンとテイマー1体ずつをレストさせることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果は、相手のテイマーがテイマーから進化できるデジモンカードに進化することもできなくさせますか？
faqs.answer: はい、テイマーからの進化もできなくなります。

faqs.question: このカードの【進化時】効果は、この効果でレストさせたのとは別の相手のデジモン/テイマーに「アクティブにならず、進化できない。」効果を発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: 「相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」効果を持つレスト状態の相手のデジモンに対して、このカードの【進化時】効果を発揮した場合、次の相手のターンで、その相手のデジモンはアクティブになりますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、アクティブにはなりません。
対象となったデジモンは、効果を発揮したターンの間はこのカードの効果による影響を受けませんが、ターンが交代した時点で「相手のターン終了まで、相手のデジモンの効果を受けない」の効果を失うため、このカードの効果によってアクティブにならなくなっています。

localized.name: 세인트가르고몬 ACE
localized.mainEffect: 【진화】명칭에 「래피드몬」을 포함 : 코스트 5［패］【카운터】《블래스트 진화》(자신의 디지몬을 이 카드로 코스트를 지불하지 않고 진화시킬 수 있다) 《재기동》《블로커》 【진화 시】상대의 디지몬/테이머 2마리(명)를 레스트시킨다. 그 후, 상대의 턴 종료까지 상대의 디지몬/테이머 2마리(명)는 액티브가 되지 않고, 진화할 수 없다. 【진화 시】【어택 종료 시】［턴에 1회］이 디지몬을 액티브로 할 수 있다.
localized.sourceEffect: 《오버플로우 《-4》》(에어리어 또는 카드 아래에서부터, 그 이외의 장소로 보내질 경우, 메모리 -4)

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과는 상대의 디지몬과 테이머 1마리/명씩을 레스트시킬 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과는 상대의 테이머가 테이머에서 진화할 수 있는 디지몬 카드로 진화할 수 없게 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 테이머에서의 진화도 할 수 없게 됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과는 이 효과로 레스트시킨 것과는 다른 상대의 디지몬/테이머에 「액티브가 되지 않고, 진화할 수 없다.」 효과를 발휘할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

faqs.question: 「상대의 턴 종료 시까지 상대 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다」 효과를 가진 레스트 상태인 상대의 디지몬에 대하여 이 카드의 【진화 시】효과를 발휘한 경우, 다음 상대의 턴에 그 상대의 디지몬은 액티브가 됩니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 액티브는 되지 않습니다. 대상이 된 디지몬은, 효과를 발휘한 턴 동안 이 카드의 효과에 의한 영향을 받지 않습니다만, 턴을 교대한 시점에 「상대의 턴 종료 시까지 상대 디지몬의 효과를 받지 않는다」 효과를 잃기 때문에 이 카드의 효과에 의해 액티브되지 않습니다.

faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
This effect doesn't specify a player, so you can specify either player's Digimon as the effect's target.

localized.name: Pteromon
localized.mainEffect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits and 1 card with the [Vortex Warriors] or [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
localized.sourceEffect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +2000 DP.

faqs.question: If the 3 cards revealed for this card's [On Play] effect include only either 1 card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits or 1 card with the [Vortex Warriors] or [LIBERATOR] trait, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

faqs.question: If the 3 cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits and a card with the [Vortex Warriors] or [LIBERATOR] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

Yes, you can.

faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
Even if you specify an already suspended Digimon as the target for a suspending effect, it isn't considered to be suspended by the effect.

faqs.question: If the 3 cards revealed for this card's [On Play] effect include only either 1 card with the [Puppet] trait or 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
Even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

faqs.question: If the 3 cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Puppet] trait and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】進化元を持たない相手のデジモンがいる間、このデジモンは≪セキュリティアタック+1≫（このデジモンがチェックするセキュリティの枚数+1）を得る。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、進化元を持たない相手のデジモンが1体でもいれば発揮するのですか？
faqs.answer: はい、その通りです。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つ自分のデジモンが、進化元を1枚だけ持つ相手のデジモンに対してアタックし、別の【アタック時】効果でその進化元のカードを破棄しました。その場合、このカードの進化元効果は発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: はい、バトルエリアに進化元のカードを1枚も持たない相手のデジモンが存在している時点で、このカードの進化元効果が発揮します。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、育成エリアに進化元を持たない相手のデジモンがいる場合でも発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、育成エリアにいるデジモンは参照しません。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、バトルエリアに相手のデジモンが1体もいないときにも発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、バトルエリアに相手のデジモンが1体もいないときは発揮しません。

localized.name: 워가루몬
localized.sourceEffect: 【자신의 턴】 진화원을 갖지 않은 상대의 디지몬이 있는 동안, 이 디지몬은 《시큐리티 어택 +1》 (이 디지몬이 체크하는 시큐리티의 매수 +1)을 얻는다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 진화원을 갖지 않은 상대 디지몬이 1마리라도 있다면 발휘하나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 그렇습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 진화원으로 하는 자신의 디지몬이 진화원을 한 장만 가지고 있는 상대방의 디지몬을 어택하여, 다른 【어택 시】 효과로 그 진화원의 카드를 파기하였습니다. 이 경우에는 그 카드의 진화원 효과는 발휘하나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 배틀 에어리어에 진화원 카드가 1장도 없는 상대의 디지몬이 존재하는 시점에서 이 카드의 진화원 효과가 발휘합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 육성 에어리어에 진화원이 없는 상대의 디지몬이 있는 경우에도 발휘하나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 육성 에어리어에 있는 디지몬은 참조하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 배틀 에어리어에 상대의 디지몬이 한 마리도 없을 때에도 발휘하나요?

localized.name: MetalGarurumon
localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] Unsuspend this Digimon.

faqs.question: Does this Digimon unsuspend itself each time it attacks?
faqs.answer: No, it only unsuspends itself once per turn. In other words, it only unsuspends the first time it attacks each turn.

faqs.question: Does this Digimon's effect only activate once per game?
faqs.answer: No. You can use the effect again during your next turn.

faqs.question: At what timing does this Digimon unsuspend itself?
faqs.answer: After you declare your attack, suspend the Digimon, then declare your attack target. When performing your security check or resolving a battle with your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon will already be unsuspended.

localized.name: メタルガルルモン
localized.mainEffect: 【アタック時】［ターンに1回］このデジモンをアクティブにする。

faqs.question: このデジモンは、アタックするたびにアクティブ状態に戻るのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このデジモンの効果はターンに1回しか発揮しないので、アクティブ状態になるのは各ターン、このデジモンの最初のアタック1回だけです。

faqs.question: このデジモンの効果は、ゲーム中1回しか発揮しないのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、次の自分のターンが来れば、再び発揮できるようになります。

faqs.question: このデジモンの効果でアクティブ状態になるのは、どのタイミングですか？
faqs.answer: アタック宣言を行い、レスト状態にして、アタックの対象を指定した後になります。セキュリティのチェック、または相手デジモンのバトルを解決する時点では、アクティブ状態になっています。

localized.name: Matt Ishida
localized.mainEffect: [Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.

faqs.question: Do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon my opponent has without digivolution cards?
faqs.answer: No. You only gain 1 memory no matter how many Digimon your opponent has without digivolution cards.

faqs.question: Does this Tamer's effect apply if my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in their breeding area?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't check Digimon in the breeding area.

faqs.question: Does this Tamer's effect apply when my opponent has no Digimon in their battle area?
faqs.answer: No, it doesn't. Your opponent has to have a Digimon in their battle area for it to activate.

faqs.question: If I have two of this Tamer in play and my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards, do I gain 2 memory from this Tamer's effect?
faqs.answer: Yes. The effect of each copy activates, causing you to gain 2 memory.

localized.name: Sorrow Blue
localized.mainEffect: [Main] Choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards. That Digimon can't attack or block until the end of your opponent's next turn.

faqs.question: If one of my opponent's Digimon has this card's effect used on it and is suspended, can I attack that Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: If one of my opponent's Digimon has this card's effect used on it and it digivolves and now has 1 or more digivolution cards, how does this card's effect resolve?
faqs.answer: This card can only be used to target cards that meet its requirements upon activation. So the effect would still apply, and even though the target Digimon has gained digivolution cards, it still can't attack or block.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ コキュートスブルー [ST-2]

localized.name: ソローブルー
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】進化元を持たない相手のデジモン1体を選ぶ。そのデジモンは次の相手のターン終了時までアタックとブロックができない。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けている相手のデジモンがレスト状態のとき、そのデジモンに対してアタックできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けている相手のデジモンが、進化を行って進化元を1枚以上持つようになりました。このカードの効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: このカードは発揮時に条件に合う対象を選択するタイプのカードですので、効果は継続し、対象のデジモンは進化元のカードを獲得してもアタックとブロックは行えません。

localized.name: 소로 블루
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 진화원을 갖지 않은 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 선택한다. 그 디지몬은 다음 상대의 턴 종료 시까지 어택과 블록을 할 수 없다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받고 있는 상대 디지몬이 레스트 상태일 때, 그 디지몬을 어택할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 할 수 있습니다.

localized.name: 悲伤蓝调
localized.mainEffect: 【主要】选择对方1只没有进化源的数码宝贝,使其直到下个对方的回合结束时为止无法进行攻击和阻挡。

localized.name: Kaiser Nail
localized.mainEffect: [Main] Choose a Digimon digivolution card placed under 1 of your Digimon and play it as another Digimon without paying its memory cost.

faqs.question: Can I use the effect of this Option card to play a level 2 Digimon that is currently a digivolution card of one of my Digimon?
faqs.answer: No. This card's effect can only be used on Digimon cards that are digivolution cards. It can't be used on Digi-Egg cards or Tamer cards in a Digimon's digivolution cards.

faqs.question: If I use this Option card's effect to play a digivolution card of one of my suspended Digimon, does it come into play suspended?
faqs.answer: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is played unsuspended.

faqs.question: If one of my Digimon has an effect applied to it that lasts a turn, then I use the effect of this Option card to play one of its digivolution cards as a Digimon, does that Digimon come into play with the same effect applied to it?
faqs.answer: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is not affected by any effects of the original Digimon it was under.

faqs.question: Can Digimon played by this card's effect attack the turn they were played?
faqs.answer: No, since it would count as the turn they were played.

localized.name: カイザーネイル
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】自分のデジモン1体の進化元のデジモンカード1枚を選び、そのカードをコストを支払わずに別のデジモンとして登場させる。

faqs.question: このオプションカードの効果で、自分のデジモンの進化元になっている、Lv.2のデジモンカードをバトルエリアに登場させられますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの対象になるは進化元のデジモンカードのみなので、進化元のデジタマカードやテイマーカードは対象にできません。

faqs.question: レスト状態の自分のデジモンの進化元のカードを、このオプションカードの効果でデジモンとして登場させた場合、そのデジモンもレスト状態のままですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、別のデジモンとして登場させるので、アクティブ状態で登場します。

faqs.question: 1ターンの間続く効果を受けている自分のデジモンの進化元のカードを、このオプションカードの効果でデジモンとして登場させた場合、そのデジモンにも1ターンの間続く効果が発揮することになりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、別のデジモンとして登場させるので、元のデジモンが受けていた効果は受けません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で登場したデジモンは、そのターンにアタックできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、登場したターンとなるので、アタックはできません。

localized.name: 카이저 네일
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 자신의 디지몬 1마리의 진화원인 디지몬 카드 1장을 선택하고, 그 카드를 코스트를 지불하지 않고 다른 디지몬으로서 등장시킨다.

faqs.question: 이 옵션 카드의 효과로 자신의 디지몬의 진화원이 된 Lv.2 디지몬 카드를 배틀 에어리어에 등장시킬 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이 카드의 대상이 되는 진화원 디지몬 카드만 해당되므로 진화원 디지타마 카드나 테이머 카드는 대상이 되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 레스트 상태의 자신의 디지몬의 진화원 카드를 이 옵션 카드의 효과로 디지몬으로써 등장시켰을 경우, 그 디지몬도 레스트 상태인 채인가요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 다른 디지몬으로써 등장시키는 것이기에 액티브 상태로 등장합니다.

faqs.question: 1턴 동안 계속되는 효과를 받고 있는 자신의 디지몬의 진화원 카드를, 이 옵션 카드의 효과로 디지몬으로써 등장시켰을 경우, 그 디지몬에도 1턴 동안 지속되는 효과가 발휘하나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 다른 디지몬으로써 등장시키므로 원래의 디지몬이 받고 있던 효과는 받지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 등장한 디지몬은 그 턴에 어택할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 등장한 턴이므로 어택은 할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: Can my opponent digivolve a card using a "digivolve without paying the cost" effect while a "your opponent can't reduce digivolution costs" effect is activated?

Yes, it can be digivolved. 
"Digivolve without paying the cost" effects aren't effects that reduce the digivolution cost.

localized.sourceEffect: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)

faqs.question:
A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

faqs.question: What does "none of your [...] Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP."

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digmon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

localized.name: Gomamon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0
[All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects.

faqs.question: What does the "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
faqs.answer: With this effect, your opponent's memory will no longer increase by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects the opponent player.

faqs.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

faqs.question: 「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer: 相手はテイマーの効果を除く、全ての効果でメモリーがプラスできなくなる効果です。この効果は、相手プレイヤーに影響を及ぼします。

faqs.question: 相手の「相手はテイマーの効果以外でメモリーをプラスできない」効果が発揮されている間、「デジモン・DPX000としても扱う」効果でデジモンとして扱われているテイマーの効果でメモリーをプラスできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、メモリーをプラスすることができます。
デジモン及びテイマーとして扱われているカードが発揮した効果は、デジモンの効果とテイマーの効果の両方を含むため、メモリーをプラスすることができます。

localized.name: Ikkakumon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

faqs.question: If a Digimon affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect later gains a digivolution card, can it now attack or block?
faqs.answer:
No, it can't. 
This effect affects 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, and the processing prevents that Digimon from attacking or blocking until their turn ends. 
Even if it gains a digivolution card after being affected by the effect, the effect will continue processing.

While you have no face-up [Gennai's House] security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [Your Turn] All of your level 3 or higher Digimon get +3000 DP.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed. 
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

faqs.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, it triggers.

faqs.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
faqs.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. 
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

faqs.question: Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?Jun. 25, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.

faqs.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. 
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

faqs.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. 
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
faqs.answer: No, it can't be activated.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?Nov. 21, 2025 Updated
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. 
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
faqs.answer:
No, it doesn't count. 
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

faqs.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to use an Option card from under a Tamer, what happens to that Option card?
faqs.answer:
As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area. 
After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.

No, it doesn't trigger. 
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

faqs.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
faqs.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation. 
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. 
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

faqs.question:
I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. 
At such times, does this effect trash an opponent's security card?
faqs.answer: No, it isn't trashed.

faqs.question:
I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. 
At such times, does it count as a use of this effect's [Once Per Turn]?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it counts. A use of [X Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to activate the effect. 
In this case, a use of [Once Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card.

localized.name: サクヤモン:巫女モード
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】「サクヤモン」:コスト1
【登場時】【進化時】自分の手札かテイマーの下から、特徴に「陰陽術」/「プラグイン」を持つオプションカード1枚をコストを支払わずに使用できる。
【お互いのターン】［ターンに1回］自分がオプションカードを使用したときか、自分のセキュリティが減ったとき、最もDPの低い相手のデジモン1体をセキュリティの下に置くことで、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、テイマーの下からオプションカードを使用する場合、そのオプションカードはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 使用したオプションカードは、通常のルールと同じように、一度どの領域にも属さなくなります。使用して、そのオプションカードの【メイン】効果を発揮したあと、そのカードがどの場所にも置かれていなければ破棄されます。

faqs.question: 「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果が誘発した場合、どのタイミングで発揮できますか？
faqs.answer: 使用したオプションカードの【メイン】効果を発揮したあとに発揮できます。

faqs.question: 使用以外でオプションカードの効果を発揮した場合、「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、誘発しません。
【セキュリティ】効果や≪ディレイ≫などで、使用せずにオプションカードの効果を発揮した場合は、「オプションカードを使用したとき」効果は誘発しません。

faqs.question: セキュリティをチェックしたとき、【セキュリティ】効果と、「セキュリティをチェックしたとき」効果、「セキュリティが減ったとき」効果が同時誘発した場合、どの順で発揮しますか？
faqs.answer:
【セキュリティ】効果が優先して発揮されます。
【セキュリティ】効果はチェックされた場合、発揮待ちにならずに即座に発揮されます。
それ以外の誘発した効果は、ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。

faqs.question:
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、相手のデジモンをセキュリティの下に置こうとし、他の効果でそのデジモンが離れませんでした。
このとき、この効果で相手のセキュリティは破棄されますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、破棄されません。

faqs.question:
このカードの【お互いのターン】効果で、相手のデジモンをセキュリティの下に置こうとし、他の効果でそのデジモンが離れませんでした。
このとき、この効果の[ターンに1回]は消費しますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、消費します。[ターンにX回]は、発揮を選択した時点で消費されます。
この状況の場合、相手のデジモンをセキュリティの下に置くことを選択した時点で、[ターンに1回]を消費します。

faqs.question: If an effect places a card under this card while it already has one or more cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?

faqs.question:

faqs.question:
My Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name attacks, and this card's [Your Turn] effect triggers. 
If another effect then digivolves the attacking Digimon and it no longer has [Renamon], [Kyubimon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name, can I still activate this effect?

localized.name: 牧野留姫
localized.mainEffect:
【自分のメインフェイズ開始時】【登場時】自分の手札から、特徴に「陰陽術」/「プラグイン」を持つオプションカード1枚をこのテイマーの下に置くことで、≪1ドロー≫し、メモリー+1。
【自分のターン】名称に「レナモン」/「キュウビモン」/「タオモン」/「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモンがアタックしたとき、このテイマーをレストさせることで、このテイマーの下から、使用コストがそのデジモンのLv.の数値以下の特徴に「陰陽術」/「プラグイン」を持つオプションカード1枚をコストを支払わずに使用できる。

faqs.question: 既にこのカードの下に重ねられているカードがあるときに、効果でこのカードの下にカードを置く場合、どの位置に置きますか？
faqs.answer: 重ねられているカードの一番下に置きます。

faqs.question:
Lv.5の「タオモン」がアタックし、このカードの【自分のターン】効果が誘発しました。
このとき、他の効果でアタックしたデジモンが進化し、Lv.6の「サクヤモン」に進化した場合、このカードの【自分のターン】効果で発揮できるオプションカードは何コスト以下ですか？
faqs.answer: 6コスト以下です。このカードの【自分のターン】効果を発揮したタイミングで、アタックしたデジモンのLv.を参照します。

faqs.question:
名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモンがアタックし、このカードの【自分のターン】効果が誘発しました。
このとき、他の効果でアタックしたデジモンが進化し、名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含まなくなった場合でも、この効果を発揮することはできますか？

localized.mainEffect:

faqs.question: If this card's 1st effect and a "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect trigger simultaneously when this card is trashed from the security stack, in what order do they activate?
faqs.answer:
The turn player activates their effect first. 
If both effects are the turn player's, they can activate them in any order.

faqs.question: What is a {Security} effect?
faqs.answer:
A {Security} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is face up in the security stack. 
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the face-up security cards.

faqs.question:
I have multiple copies of this card face-up in my security stack. 
When my Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name would leave the battle area other than by battle, I activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 1st copy of this card, and that Digimon is prevented from leaving. Can I then activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 2nd copy of this card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can. 
The {Security} [All Turns] effects on the 2 copies of this card trigger simultaneously when your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name would leave the battle area other than by battle. After activating the effect on the 1st copy, the Digimon is prevented from leaving, then you can activate the {Security} [All Turns] effect on the 2nd copy of this card. 
After that, the 1st effect on the 2 copies of this card will trigger simultaneously, and you can activate them one at a time for a total of 2 activations.

faqs.question:
I have this card placed face-up in my security stack. 
If this card's {Security} [All Turns] effect activates when multiples of my Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in their names would leave the battle area other than by battle, then this card is trashed from the security stack, what happens?
faqs.answer:
You choose 1 of your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon], or [Sakuyamon] in its name, and that Digimon is prevented from leaving the battle area. 
If you have another face-up copy of this card in your security stack, the {Security} [All Turns] effects on those copies will also activate, and you can choose 1 more Digimon that will be prevented from leaving.

faqs.answer:
ターンプレイヤー側の効果から発揮させます。
どちらもターンプレイヤーの効果の場合、ターンプレイヤーが好きな順で選んで発揮させます。

faqs.answer:
そのカードがセキュリティに表向きにある間、誘発・発揮できる効果です。
表向きのセキュリティ以外の場所では、誘発・発揮できません。

faqs.question:
自分のセキュリティに、このカードが表向きで複数枚置かれている状況です。
名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモンがバトル以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、1枚目のこのカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、そのデジモンを離れなくしました。そのあとに、2枚目のこのカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果を発揮することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、可能です。
名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモンがバトル以外でバトルエリアを離れるとき、このカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果が同時誘発します。1枚目の効果を発揮して、そのデジモンが離れなくなったあとに、2枚目のこのカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果も発揮することができます。
そのあとに、2枚のこのカードの1つ目の効果が同時誘発しているため、1枚ずつ、合計2回発揮します。

faqs.question:
自分のセキュリティに、このカードが表向きで置かれている状況です。
名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモン複数体がバトル以外で同時にバトルエリアを離れるとき、このカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果を発揮して、セキュリティに置かれているこのカードを破棄した場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer:
バトルエリアを離れる、名称に「レナモン」か「キュウビモン」か「タオモン」か「サクヤモン」を含む自分のデジモンの中から1体を選び、そのデジモンがバトルエリアを離れなくなります。
セキュリティに表向きのこのカードが複数枚あれば、そのカードの{セキュリティ}【お互いのターン】効果も発揮して、さらに離れなくするデジモン1体を選ぶことができます。

faqs.question:
At the end of the turn, I used <Vortex> on this card to attack an opponent's Digimon, this Digimon was deleted in the battle, and I used <Fortitude> to play this card from the trash. 
At such times, can I again use <Vortex> to attack?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
<Vortex> on this card triggers at the timing upon the end of the turn. If this card attacks using the triggered <Vortex> effect, is deleted in battle, and is played using <Fortitude>, the <Vortex> on this card hasn't triggered after being played, therefore it can't activate.

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Fallen Angel]/[CS] trait: Cost 3
When this card would be played, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in either their hand or trash, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent trashes cards in their hand so that they have 6 cards left. If this effect didn't trash, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 of them. Then, if they have 5 or fewer, delete 1 of their lowest level Digimon.

faqs.question:
My opponent has 5 cards in their hand and 5 cards in their trash. 
Can I activate this card's 1st effect and play it with the play cost reduced by 5?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
This card's 1st effect activates when your opponent has 10 or more cards in their hand or 10 or more cards in their trash, then the play cost will be reduced by 5. 
It doesn't activate when the total number of cards in their hand and trash is 10.

faqs.question:
My opponent has 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash. 
If I activate this card's 1st effect, what is the reduction to the play cost?
faqs.answer:
The play cost is reduced by 5. 
Even if they have 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash, the reduction to the play cost will be 5.

localized.sourceEffect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, this [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon unsuspends.

faqs.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time. 
In addition, if an Option card is used by this effect, once the used Option card's [Main] effect has resolved and the Option card is trashed, then all Digimon with DPs of 0 will be deleted. 
If digivolving by Arts Digivolve, after digivolving, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted.

このカードの効果で、相手のデジモンのDPが0になりました。
このとき、DPが0になったデジモンはその時点で消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。

アーツ進化で進化する場合は、進化したあとにDPが0のデジモン全てが消滅します。

localized.name: Gekkomon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[Glowing Dawn] trait: Cost 0
[When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 [Glowing Dawn] trait card to the hand and place 1 such card face down under any of your [Glowing Dawn] trait Tamers. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
localized.sourceEffect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)

faqs.question: What happens if I use this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect and only 1 card with the [Glowing Dawn] trait is among the revealed cards?
faqs.answer: You add that card to your hand.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
faqs.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Only the player of those cards can search/look at them. 
The opponent player can't search/look at them.

faqs.question: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
faqs.answer: It's placed face-up in the trash.

localized.mainEffect:

localized.name: Atratusmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Glowing Dawn] trait: Cost 3
＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent's Digimon effects don't affect this Digimon until their turn ends. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.

faqs.question: Is this card treated as an Option card with the traits shown on this card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it is. 
This card is treated as an Option card with traits such as Glowing Dawn and BEATBREAK.

faqs.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
faqs.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. 
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen. 
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

faqs.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
faqs.answer:
Yes, it can. 
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. 
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

faqs.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
faqs.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

faqs.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
faqs.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

faqs.question:
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. 
Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
faqs.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

localized.name: アトラタスモン
localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴「グローイングドーン」を持つLv.5:コスト3
≪Sアタック+1≫≪再起動≫≪ブロッカー≫
【進化時】【アタック時】[ターン1回]相手のターン終了まで、このデジモンは相手のデジモンの効果を受けない。その後、最もDPの低い相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

sourceAttributes.type: 突然変異型/グローイングドーン/ビートブレイク

faqs.question: このカードは、このカードに記述されている特徴を持つオプションカードとして扱いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、扱います。
このカードであれば、特徴に「グローイングドーン」や「ビートブレイク」などを持つオプションカードとして扱います。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」とは、どういった効果ですか？
faqs.answer:
効果による影響を受けない効果です。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で選ばれてもレストされず、「相手のデジモン1体をDP-3000。」で選ばれてもDPが-3000されません。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードを、効果で選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、選ぶことができます。
例えば、「相手のデジモン1体をレストさせる。」で、効果を受けないデジモンを選ぶことができます。

faqs.question: 「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、効果を付与できますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、付与することができます。
効果の影響は受けませんが、効果を付与することはできます。
ただし、効果を受けないデジモンに≪Sアタック≫などを付与しても、その効果を持つようには扱いません。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されているカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を得た場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けなくなった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けなくなります。

faqs.question: 効果を付与されている「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードが、あとから「効果を受けない」効果を失った場合、付与されている効果はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 効果を受けるようになった時点から、付与されている効果の影響を受けます。

faqs.question:
「効果を受けない」効果を持つカードに、【アタック時】効果などの誘発する効果を付与しました。
そのあとに、そのカードがその効果の誘発の条件を満たした場合、その効果は誘発しますか？
faqs.answer: 誘発するタイミングでそのデジモンが効果を受けない場合は、その効果は誘発しません。

localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [ShineGreymon] in its name or the [DATA SQUAD] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, it doesn't leave.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 1 face-down card from under a Tamer for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't. 
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. 
The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards under your Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I trash a total of 2 face-down cards from under multiple Tamers for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. 
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
faqs.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet. 
Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time. 
In addition, if an Option card is used by this effect, once the used Option card's [Main] effect has resolved and the Option card is trashed, then all Digimon with DPs of 0 will be deleted. 
If digivolving by Arts Digivolve, after digivolving, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted.

faqs.answer:
いいえ、できません。
「ことで」の条件は、その内容を一部だけ実行することはできません。
この【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果の条件の場合、指定された枚数分、テイマーの下のカードを破棄する必要があります。

faqs.question:
このカードの効果で、相手のデジモンのDPが0になりました。
このとき、DPが0になったデジモンはその時点で消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。
このカードの【登場時】【進化時】【アタック時】効果を全て解決したあとに、その時点でDP0のデジモンが全て同時に消滅します。

アーツ進化で進化する場合は、進化したあとにDPが0のデジモン全てが消滅します。

【進化】名称に「ライズグレイモン」を含むLv.5/特徴「セイバーズ」を持つLv.5:コスト3
≪突進≫≪貫通≫≪Sアタック+1≫
【進化時】【アタック時】[ターン1回]自分の手札/トラッシュから、登場コスト5以下のテイマーカード1枚をコストを支払わず登場できる。その後、ターン終了まで、相手のデジモン1体をDP-9000。

faqs.question: このカードは、このカードに記述されている特徴を持つオプションカードとして扱いますか？
faqs.answer:
はい、扱います。
このカードであれば、特徴に「セイバーズ」を持つオプションカードとして扱います。

faqs.question:
「ジオグレイソード」を使用し、【メイン】効果で相手のデジモンのDPが0になりました。
このとき、その時点でDPが0になったそのデジモンは消滅しますか？
faqs.answer:
いいえ、その時点では消滅しません。
使用したオプションカードを破棄するか、アーツ進化で進化したあとに、ルールチェックでDPが0のデジモン全てが消滅します。そのあとに、消滅したカードが【消滅時】効果を持っていればその効果と、このカードの【進化時】効果が同時誘発となります。

localized.name: Sunflowmon
localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 2
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, you may place the top card of your deck face down under any of your [DATA SQUAD] trait Tamers.
localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] This Digimon gets +1000 DP.

faqs.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
faqs.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer: No, you can't.

faqs.question: Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
faqs.answer:
Only the player of those cards can search/look at them. 
The opponent player can't search/look at them.

faqs.question: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
faqs.answer: It's placed face-up in the trash.

localized.mainEffect:
【進化】特徴「セイバーズ」を持つLv.3:コスト2

faqs.question: このカードの【登場時】【進化時】効果で、下に重ねられているカードがあるテイマーの下にカードを置く場合、どの順で置きますか？

faqs.question: テイマーの下に重ねられている裏向きのカードの重なり順を変えることはできますか？

faqs.question: テイマーの下に重ねられている裏向きのカードの内容を確認することはできますか？
faqs.answer:
そのカードのプレイヤーのみ確認することができます。
相手は確認することはできません。

faqs.question: テイマーの下に重ねられている裏向きのカードが破棄された場合、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: 表向きでトラッシュに置かれます。

localized.mainEffect:
[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 3
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. localized.sourceEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Rosemon] in its name or the [DATA SQUAD] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, it doesn't leave.

faqs.question: Can I trash just 1 face-down card from under a Tamer for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
faqs.answer:
No, you can't.

The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards under your Tamer.

faqs.question: Can I trash a total of 2 face-down cards from under multiple Tamers for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

localized.name: MagnaAngemon
localized.sourceEffect: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's inherited effect to target one of my opponent's Digimon with 1000 DP or less and delete it?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: A Digimon with this card as a digivolution card attacks an opponent's Digimon, then that Digimon's DP is reduced to 0 and deleted by this card's inherited effect. What happens to the attack?
faqs.answer: No battle occurs, and the attack ends. If there are other effects to activate (When Attacking effects, etc.), the attack ends after activating them.

faqs.question: A Digimon with this card as a digivolution card attacks an opponent's Digimon, then the opponent blocks with a Digimon that has <Blocker>. Can I use this card's inherited effect to reduce the DP of the blocking Digimon to 0 and delete it?
faqs.answer: No, blocking can only be performed in the blocker timing that occurs after all [When Attacking] effects finish resolving. As such, once a block has been declared, the window for activating this card's inherited effect has already passed, so it can't be activated.

localized.name: ホーリーエンジェモン
localized.sourceEffect: 【アタック時】このターンの間、相手のデジモン1体のDPを-1000する。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果は、ＤＰ1000以下の相手のデジモンを対象とすることで、ＤＰを0にして消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、可能です。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つデジモンで相手のデジモンにアタックし、そのアタック対象をこのカードの進化元効果によって、ＤＰ0にして消滅させました。そのアタックはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: バトルは行われず、アタック終了となります。他の【アタック時】効果などがあれば、そちらを発揮した後で終了となります。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つデジモンでアタックし、相手が≪ブロッカー≫を持つデジモンでブロックを行いました。ブロックした相手のデジモンを、このカードの進化元効果によって、ＤＰ0にして消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、ブロックは、【アタック時】効果などがすべて発揮した後の、ブロックタイミングで行えます。ですので、ブロックされた後では、このカードの進化元効果の発揮タイミングは過ぎているので、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つデジモンで相手のデジモンにアタックし、そのアタック対象をこのカードの進化元効果によって、ＤＰ0にして消滅させました。そのアタックはどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: バトルは行われず、アタック終了となります。他の【アタック時】効果などがあれば、そちらを発揮した後で終了となります。

faqs.question: このカードを進化元に持つデジモンでアタックし、相手が≪ブロッカー≫を持つデジモンでブロックを行いました。ブロックした相手のデジモンを、このカードの進化元効果によって、ＤＰ0にして消滅させることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、ブロックは、【アタック時】効果などがすべて発揮した後の、ブロックタイミングで行えます。ですので、ブロックされた後では、このカードの進化元効果の発揮タイミングは過ぎているので、発揮させることはできません。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과는 DP 1000 이하의 상대 디지몬을 대상으로 하여 예를 0으로 만들어 소멸시키는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 네, 가능합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 진화원으로 하는 디지몬으로 상대 디지몬을 공격하여, 그 공격 대상을 이 카드의 진화원 효과로 DP 0로 만들어 소멸시켰습니다. 그 어택은 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 배틀은 이루어지지 않으며 어택이 종료됩니다. 다른 【어택 시】 효과가 있는 경우에는 이를 발휘한 뒤에 종료됩니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드를 진화원으로 가지는 디지몬으로 어택하여, 상대가 《블로커》 를 가진 디지몬으로 블록하였습니다. 블록한 상대 디지몬을 이 카드의 진화원 효과로 DP 0으로 만들어 소멸시키는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 《블로커》 등 「상대 디지몬이 어택했을 때」 의 효과는 【어택 시】 효과 등이 모두 발휘된 뒤의 리액션으로 발휘합니다. 따라서 블록이 선언되면 이 카드의 진화원 효과의 발휘 타이밍이 지나간 뒤이므로 발휘할 수 없습니다.

localized.mainEffect: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: Can I use this card's effect to target one of my opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less, reduce its DP to 0, and delete it?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

faqs.question: This card attacks an opponent's Digimon, then that Digimon's DP is reduced to 0 and deleted by this card's effect. What happens to the attack?
faqs.answer: No battle occurs, and the attack ends. If there are other effects to activate (When Attacking effects, etc.), the attack ends after activating them.

faqs.question: This card attacks an opponent's Digimon, then my opponent blocks with a Digimon that has <Blocker>. Can I use this card's effect to reduce the DP of the blocking Digimon to 0 and delete it?
faqs.answer: No. <Blocker> and other effects that activate when an opponent's Digimon attacks only activate during the reaction timing window that occurs after When Attacking effects, etc. finish activating. As such, once a block has been declared, the window for activating this card's inherited effect has already passed, so it can't be activated.

faqs.question: What happens when a Digimon has a security check number of 0 because of this card's effect and it attacks a player?
faqs.answer: That Digimon can't perform security checks, so the battle ends. Even if your opponent has no cards in their security stack, you would not win the game by attacking with that Digimon.

faqs.question: This card's effect causes a Digimon to gain <Security Attack -3>, giving them a security check number of 0. How many security cards could that Digimon check if it gained <Security Attack +1>?
faqs.answer: It would still check 0 cards. In order to check 1 or more security cards, that Digimon would need to gain <Security Attack +3> or higher.

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受け、チェックする枚数が0枚になっているデジモンがプレイヤーにアタックしたとき、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: セキュリティをチェックすることはできず、バトルは終了します。また相手のセキュリティが0枚のときにアタックしたとしても、ゲームに勝利することはできません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果によって≪セキュリティアタック-3≫の効果を受け、チェックする枚数が0枚になったデジモンが、その効果を受けている間に≪セキュリティアタック+1≫を得た場合、チェックする枚数はどうなりますか？
faqs.answer: チェックする枚数は0枚のままとなります。チェックする枚数を1枚以上にするには、≪セキュリティアタック+3≫以上に相当する効果が必要となります。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받아 체크하는 매수가 0장이 된 디지몬이 플레이어에게 어택했을 때에는 어떻게 되나요?

faqs.question: I use this card's inherited effect to trash an opponent's Security Card. Does the security effect on that card activate?
faqs.answer: No, [Security] effects only activate when flipped over from the security stack.

faqs.question: My opponent has an empty security stack. If I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, and I use it to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive, do I win the game?
faqs.answer: No, this effect only trashes the top card of your opponent's security stack. It doesn't win you the game if it's empty.

localized.name: アトラーカブテリモン
localized.sourceEffect: 【自分のターン】［ターンに1回］このデジモンがバトルで相手のデジモンだけを消滅させたとき、相手のセキュリティを上から1枚破棄する。

faqs.question: このカードの進化元効果で破棄された相手のセキュリティのカードは、【セキュリティ】効果を発揮しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、チェックによってめくられたのではないので、発揮しません。

faqs.question: 相手のセキュリティが0枚のとき、このカードを進化元に持つデジモンがバトルで相手のデジモンだけを消滅させたら、ゲームに勝利できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、この効果は相手のセキュリティを破棄させる効果ですので、相手のセキュリティが0枚のときに発揮しても、ゲームに勝利するわけではありません。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 진화원 효과로 파기된 상대의 시큐리티의 카드는 【시큐리티】효과를 발휘할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 체크로인해 뒤집은 것이 아니기에 발휘하지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 상대의 시큐리티가 0매일 때, 이 카드를 진화원으로 갖는 디지몬이 배틀에서 상대 디지몬만을 소멸시키면 게임에서 승리할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 이 효과는 상대의 시큐리티를 파기하는 효과이기에 상대 시큐리티가 0매일 때 발휘하여도 게임에 승리하게 되는 것은 아닙니다.

faqs.question: I use this card's effect on an opponent's Digimon. Can I attack that Digimon if it's suspended?
faqs.answer: Yes. The effect simply prevents the Digimon from attacking or blocking. You can still attack it.

faqs.question: I use this card's effect on an opponent's Digimon. If that Digimon digivolves into a different Digimon, can it attack and block again?
faqs.answer: No, the effect persists, even if they digivolve.

faqs.question: I use this card's effect on an opponent's Digimon. If that Digimon activates an effect that allows it to attack other Digimon or players, what happens?
faqs.answer: The effect preventing it from attacking takes priority. Your opponent's Digimon still can't attack.

localized.mainEffect: 【進化時】次の相手のターン終了時まで、相手のデジモン1体はアタックとブロックができない。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けた相手のデジモンがレスト状態のとき、そのデジモンにアタックしてバトルをすることはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、相手のデジモンがブロックできない状態であっても、こちらからアタックしてバトルすることは可能です。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンが進化して別のデジモンになったら、アタックやブロックができるようになりますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、進化や退化をしても受けた効果は引き継ぐので、できません。

faqs.question: このカードの効果を受けたデジモンが、相手のデジモンやプレイヤーにアタックできる効果を発揮したら、どうなりますか？
faqs.answer: アタックできない効果が優先となるため、効果によるものであってもアタックはできません。

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 상대의 디지몬이 레스트 상태일 때, 그 디지몬에게 어택하여 배틀하는 것은 가능한가요?
faqs.answer: 네, 상대 디지몬이 블록할 수 없는 상태이더라도, 이쪽에서 어택하여 배틀하는 것은 가능합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬이 진화하여 다른 디지몬이 되면, 어택 또는 블록을 할 수 있게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요, 진화 또는 퇴화하더라도 받은 효과는 이어받으므로, 할 수 없습니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과를 받은 디지몬이, 상대방의 디지몬 또는 플레이어에게 어택할 수 있는 효과를 발휘하면 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 어택할 수 없는 효과가 우선시되므로, 효과에 의한 것이더라도 어택은 할 수 없습니다.

localized.name: GeoGreymon
localized.mainEffect:
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying its memory cost.
[On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

faqs.question: If I use this card's effect to play this Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?
faqs.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.

faqs.question: Can I play this Digimon with its [Security] effect even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, regardless of the battle's outcome, you get to play this Digimon at the end of the battle.

faqs.question:
This card is flipped over during a security check and battles the attacking Digimon as a Security Digimon. Once the battle ends, the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Is this card played off its [Security] effect first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks? 
Also, when does this Digimon's [On Play] effect activate?
faqs.answer:
This Digimon is played before your opponent's next security check. 
Likewise, this Digimon's [On Play] effect activates before your opponent's next checks.

faqs.question: I play this card using its [Security] effect. If the attacking Digimon has 4000 DP or less and <Jamming>, can I use this Digimon's [On Play] effect to delete the attacking Digimon?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can.

localized.name: ジオグレイモン
localized.mainEffect:
【セキュリティ】バトル終了時、このカードをコストを支払わずに登場させる。
【登場時】DP4000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。

faqs.question: このカードの効果で登場したデジモンは、バトルエリアでもセキュリティデジモンとして扱われるのですか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、この効果によって登場した時点から、通常のデジモンとして扱います。

faqs.question: このカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、アタックしてきたデジモンとのバトルで敗北しても、登場できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、勝敗に関係なく、バトル終了時に登場します。

faqs.question: このカードの【セキュリティ】効果は、このカードがセキュリティデジモンとしてバトルした後、アタックしたデジモンがまだセキュリティのチェックを行えるとき、次のチェックとこのデジモンの登場はどちらが先になりますか？また、このデジモンの登場時効果は、どのタイミングで行うのですか？
faqs.answer: 次のチェックよりも前に登場します。登場時効果も、登場してすぐ、次のチェックを行う前に発揮します。

faqs.question: このカードが【セキュリティ】効果によって登場したとき、アタックしたデジモンがDP4000以下で≪ジャミング≫を持っていた場合、このデジモンの登場時効果でアタックしたデジモンを消滅させられますか？
faqs.answer: はい、消滅させられます。

localized.name: 지오그레이몬
localized.mainEffect:
【시큐리티】 배틀 종료 시, 이 카드를 코스트를 지불하지 않고 등장시킨다.
【등장 시】 DP 4000 이하의 상대 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 효과로 등장한 디지몬은, 배틀 에어리어라도 시큐리티 디지몬으로서 취급합니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 효과에 의해 등장한 시점부터, 통상적인 디지몬으로 취급합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【시큐리티】 효과는 어택해 온 디지몬과의 배틀에서 패배하였더라도 등장할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. 승패와 상관 없이 배틀 종료 시에 등장합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【시큐리티】 효과는 이 카드가 시큐리티 디지몬으로서 배틀한 후, 어택한 디지몬이 아직 시큐리티 체크를 실행하고 있을 때, 다음 체크와 이 디지몬의 등장은 어느쪽이 먼저입니까? 또한, 이 디지몬의 등장 시 효과는 어느 타이밍에 실행됩니까?
faqs.answer: 다음 체크보다 앞서 등장합니다. 등장 시 효과도 등장하자마자 다음 체크를 실행하기 전에 발휘합니다.

faqs.question: 이 카드가 【시큐리티】 효과에 의해 등장했을 때, 어택한 디지몬이 DP 4000 이하에 ≪재밍≫을 갖고 있을 경우, 이 디지몬의 등장 시 효과로 어택한 디지몬을 소멸시킬 수 있습니까?

＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.

faqs.question: This card's [When Attacking] effect reads, “Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If you don't...” What does “If you don't” refer to?
faqs.answer: “If you don't” refers to a state such as in which, when resolving this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect, your opponent doesn't have a Digimon with 4000 DP or less in play, or your opponent has a Digimon that can't be deleted with the effect. Essentially, if your opponent doesn't have a Digimon that can be deleted by “Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less,” follow the instructions listed after “If you don't”.

faqs.question: My opponent has a Digimon with 4000 DP or less in play. Can I choose not to delete my opponent's Digimon so that this Digimon gets +3000 DP?
faqs.answer: No. If you activate this card's [When Attacking] effect and your opponent has a Digimon with 4000 DP or less in play, you must choose that Digimon as the target of the effect. If a valid target exists, you must choose it.

faqs.question: My opponent has a Digimon with 4000 DP or less and an effect that reads, “This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects,” and another Digimon with 4000 DP or less but no effect. Can I intentionally choose the Digimon with the effect preventing deletion to have this Digimon gain +3000 DP?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you chose your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less as a target, it counts for this card's effect, even if the chosen Digimon has an effect that prevents it from being deleted.

localized.name: デュークモン
localized.mainEffect:
≪セキュリティアタック+1≫（このデジモンがチェックするセキュリティの枚数+1）
【アタック時】DP4000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。この効果で相手のデジモンが消滅しなかったとき、このターンの間、このデジモンのDPを+3000する。

sourceAttributes.type: 聖騎士型/ロイヤルナイツ

faqs.question: このカードの【アタック時】効果の、「DP4000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる。この効果で相手のデジモンが消滅しなかったとき」は、どういう意味ですか？
faqs.answer: このデジモンの【アタック時】効果を解決したとき、DP4000以下の相手のデジモンがいなかったり、または効果によって消滅しないデジモンしかいなかったなど、「DP4000以下の相手のデジモン1体を消滅させる」の効果で消滅させる相手のデジモンが存在しなかったときを指します。

faqs.question: DP4000以下の相手のデジモンがいるとき、このカードの【アタック時】効果で、あえて相手のデジモンを消滅させないことで、このデジモンのDPを+3000できますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、このカードの【アタック時】効果を発揮し、DP4000以下の相手のデジモンがいるのであれば、必ずそのデジモンを対象に効果を発揮させてください。適切な対象がいる状態で対象を選択しないということはできません。

faqs.question: DP4000以下の、「相手の効果では消滅しない」効果を持つデジモンと、そうでないデジモンがそれぞれいるとき、このカードの【アタック時】効果で、わざと「相手の効果では消滅しない」効果を持つデジモンを対象にして消滅させないことで、このデジモンのDPを+3000できますか？
faqs.answer: はい、DP4000以下の相手のデジモンであれば対象として選べるので、わざと「相手の効果では消滅しない」効果を持つデジモンを選んで消滅に失敗することは可能です。

localized.name: 듀크몬
localized.mainEffect:
《시큐리티 어택 +1》 (이 디지몬이 체크하는 시큐리티의 매수 +1)
【어택 시】 DP 4000 이하의 상대 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 이 효과로 상대 디지몬이 소멸하지 않았을 때, 이 턴 동안 이 디지몬의 DP를 +3000 한다.

faqs.question: 이 카드의 【어택 시】 효과의 「DP 4000 이하의 상대 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다. 이 효과로 상대 디지몬이 소멸하지 않았을 때」는 어떤 의미입니까?
faqs.answer: 이 디지몬의 【어택 시】 효과를 해결했을 때, DP 4000 이하인 상대의 디지몬이 없거나, 효과에 의해 소멸하지 않는 디지몬만 있다면, 「DP 4000 이하인 상대의 디지몬 1마리를 소멸시킨다」 효과로 소멸되는 상대의 디지몬이 없을 경우를 가리킵니다.

faqs.question: DP 4000 이하인 상대의 디지몬이 있을 때, 이 카드의 【어택 시】 효과로 일부러 상대의 디지몬을 소멸시키지 않는 것으로 이 디지몬의 DP를 +3000할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 이 카드의 【어택 시】 효과를 발휘하여 DP 4000 이하인 상대의 디지몬이 있다면, 반드시 그 디지몬을 대상으로 효과를 발휘해야 합니다. 적절한 대상이 있을 경우에 대상을 선택하지 않을 수는 없습니다.

faqs.question: DP 4000 이하인 「상대의 효과로는 소멸하지 않는」효과를 가진 디지몬과 그렇지 않은 디지몬이 각각 있을 때, 이 카드의 【어택 시】 효과로 일부러 「상대의 효과로는 소멸하지 않는」효과를 가진 디지몬을 대상으로 소멸되지 않은 것으로 이 디지몬의 DP를 +3000할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. DP 4000 이하인 상대의 디지몬이라면 대상으로 선택할 수 있어, 일부러 「상대의 효과로는 소멸하지 않는」 효과를 가진 디지몬을 선택하여 소멸에 실패할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: I use this card, and my opponent and I both have the same number of cards in our security stacks. Later, my opponent loses a security card. When this happens, do I remove <Security Attack +1> from this card's effect?

localized.name: Atomic Blaster
localized.mainEffect: [Main] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less and delete them.

faqs.question: What does “Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less” mean, exactly?
faqs.answer: You can choose any number of your opponent's Digimon, as long as the DP of the chosen Digimon adds up to 8000 or less. For example, you could choose 1 Digimon with 3000 DP + 1 Digimon with 5000 DP, or 2 Digimon with 2000 DP + 1 Digimon with 3000 DP.

faqs.question: Can I choose fewer cards than possible, even if the DP of the chosen cards adds up to less than 8000?
faqs.answer: Yes. As long as the total DP of the chosen cards is 8000 DP or less, you can choose as many or as few cards as you like. However, note that you must choose a minimum of 1 Digimon with 8000 DP or less.

faqs.question: My opponent has a [BT4-066 Golemon] in play. If [BT4-066 Golemon] is chosen as part of this card's effect, [BT4-066 Golemon]'s deletion will cause my opponent's black Digimon to each receive -1000 DP. Can I choose more of my opponent's Digimon with this card's effect to cover the gap to reach 8000 DP?
faqs.answer: No. When [BT4-066 Golemon] is deleted, reducing the DP of your opponent's Digimon, this card's effect will have already finished activating. As such, you cannot choose additional Digimon with this card's effect midway.

sourceNotes: スタートデッキ デュークモン [ST-7]

localized.name: アトミックブラスター
localized.mainEffect: 【メイン】DPの合計が8000以下になるように相手のデジモンを選び、選んだデジモン全てを消滅させる。

faqs.question: 「DPの合計が8000以下になるように相手のデジモンを選び」とは、具体的にどういう事でしょうか？
faqs.answer: 「DP3000のデジモン1体+DP5000のデジモン1体」や、「DP2000のデジモン2体+DP3000のデジモン1体」のように、DPの合計が8000以下になるように相手のデジモンを好きな数だけ選び、そのデジモンに対して効果を発揮させます。

faqs.question: DP合計が8000未満になるように、わざと少なく対象を選ぶことはできますか？
faqs.answer: はい、DP8000以下になるのであれば自由に選べます。ただし、DP8000以下の相手のデジモンを、最低1体は選択してください。

faqs.question: 相手に「BT4-066 ゴーレモン」がいて、このカードの効果の対象に「BT4-066 ゴーレモン」を含めたとき、「BT4-066 ゴーレモン」の消滅によって相手の黒のデジモンのDPがそれぞれ1000下がるので、その分を計算して、追加で相手のデジモンを対象に含めることはできますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ、「BT4-066 ゴーレモン」の消滅によって相手のデジモンのDPが下がるのは、このカードの効果を発揮し終わった時点となります。そのため、そこから新たに対象を追加することはできません。

localized.name: 아토믹 블래스터
localized.mainEffect: 【메인】 DP의 합계가 8000 이하가 되도록 상대 디지몬을 골라, 고른 디지몬 전부를 소멸시킨다.

faqs.question: 「 DP의 합계가 8000 이하가 되도록 상대 디지몬을 골라」는 구체적으로 어떤 것입니까?
faqs.answer: 「DP 3000인 디지몬 1마리 + DP 5000인 디지몬 1마리」 혹은, 「DP 2000인 디지몬 2마리 + DP 3000인 디지몬 1마리」 등, DP의 합계가 8000 이하가 되도록 상대의 디지몬을 원하는 수만큼 선택하여 그 디지몬에게 효과를 발휘합니다.

faqs.question: DP 합계가 8000 미만이 되도록 일부러 적게 대상을 선택할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 네. DP 8000 이하가 되기만 한다면 자유롭게 선택할 수 있습니다. 단, DP 8000 이하인 상대의 디지몬을 최저 1마리는 선택해야합니다.

faqs.question: 상대에게 「BT4-066 록몬」이 있고, 이 카드의 효과 대상으로 「BT4-066 록몬」을 포함했을 때, 「BT4-066 록몬」 소멸에 의해 상대의 블랙인 디지몬의 DP가 각각 1000 내려가기 때문에 그만큼 계산하여 추가로 상대의 디지몬을 대상으로할 수 있습니까?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 「BT4-066 록몬」의 소멸로 인해 상대의 디지몬의 DP가 내려가는 것은, 이 카드의 효과를 발휘하여 종료된 시점입니다. 그래서 그 시점에 새로운 대상을 추가할 수는 없습니다.
